item.name: Antitoxin
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can drink a vial of Antitoxin to gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.
entries_es: Como un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, se puede beber un frasco de Antitoxina para ganar {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en lanzamientos de ahorro para evitar o terminar la condición {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} durante 1 hora.

item.name: Antitoxin (vial)
entries: A creature that drinks this vial of liquid gains advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour. It confers no benefit to undead or constructs.
entries_es: Una criatura que bebe este frasco de líquido gana ventaja en salvar tiros contra veneno durante 1 hora. No confiere ningún beneficio a los no muertos ni a los constructos.

item.name: Apparatus of Kwalish
entries: This item first appears to be a Large sealed iron barrel weighing 500 pounds. The barrel has a hidden catch, which can be found with a successful {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. Releasing the catch unlocks a hatch at one end of the barrel, allowing two Medium or smaller creatures to crawl inside. Ten levers are set in a row at the far end, each in a neutral position, able to move either up or down. When certain levers are used, the apparatus transforms to resemble a giant lobster.
The apparatus of Kwalish is a Large object with the following statistics:

items.name: Speed:
items.entry: 30 ft., swim 30 ft. (or 0 ft. for both if the legs and tail aren't extended)

items.name: Damage Immunities:
items.entry: poison, psychic

entries: To be used as a vehicle, the apparatus requires one pilot. While the apparatus's hatch is closed, the compartment is airtight and watertight. The compartment holds enough air for 10 hours of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.
The apparatus floats on water. It can also go underwater to a depth of 900 feet. Below that, the vehicle takes {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage per minute from pressure.

A creature in the compartment can use an action to move as many as two of the apparatus's levers up or down. After each use, a lever goes back to its neutral position. Each lever, from left to right, functions as shown in the Apparatus of Kwalish Levers table.

entries.caption: Apparatus of Kwalish Levers:
rows: Legs and tail extend, allowing the apparatus to walk and swim.
Legs and tail retract, reducing the apparatus's speed to 0 and making it unable to benefit from bonuses to speed.
Forward window shutter opens.
Forward window shutter closes.
Side window shutters open (two per side).
Side window shutters close (two per side).
Two claws extend from the front sides of the apparatus.
The claws retract.

The apparatus walks or swims backward.

The apparatus rises up to 20 feet in liquid.

The rear hatch closes and seals.

item.name: Arcanaloth's Music Box
entries: This music box is made of dark wood with gold filigree. Each of its five sides is sculpted with the image of a horned woman playing a different {@item musical instrument|PHB}: a {@item dulcimer|PHB}, a {@item flute|PHB}, a harp, a {@item lyre|PHB}, and a {@item viol|PHB}. While touching the box, you can use an action to make it play music featuring one of the instruments shown, which can be heard up to 60 feet away. You can also use an action to stop the music.
entries_es: Esta caja de música está hecha de madera oscura con filigrana de oro. Cada uno de sus cinco lados está esculpida con la imagen de una mujer cachonda que juega un diferente {@item musical instrument|PHB}: un {@item dulcimer|PHB}, un {@item flute|PHB}, un arpa, un {@item lyre|PHB} y un {@item viol|PHB}]]. Al tocar la caja, puede utilizar una acción para hacer que toque música con uno de los instrumentos mostrados, que se pueden escuchar hasta 60 pies de distancia. También puede utilizar una acción para detener la música.

item.name: Arcane Cannon
entries: This Large cannon is imbued with magic. It requires no ammunition and doesn't need to be loaded. It takes one action to aim the cannon and one action to fire it. After the cannon has fired, it must recharge for 5 minutes before it can be fired again.
The creature firing the cannon chooses the effect from the following options:

entries.name: Acid Jet
entries: The cannon discharges acid in a line 300 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@damage 4d10}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In addition, a creature that fails its saving throw takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) acid damage at the start of each of its turns; a creature can end this damage by using its action to wash off the acid with a pint or more of water.
entries_es: El cañón descarga ácido en una línea de 300 pies de largo y 5 pies de ancho. Cada criatura en esa línea debe hacer un {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ([TAG1]) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Además, una criatura que falla su tiro de ahorro toma 11 ([TAG2]) daño ácido al comienzo de cada una de sus vueltas; una criatura puede terminar este daño utilizando su acción para lavar el ácido con una pinta o más de agua.

entries.name: Fire Jet
entries: The cannon discharges fire in a line 300 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.
entries_es: El cañón descarga fuego en una línea de 300 pies de largo y 5 pies de ancho. Cada criatura en el área debe hacer un {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 ([TAG1]]) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. El fuego enciende cualquier objeto inflamable en la zona que no está siendo usado o llevado.

entries.name: Frost Shot
entries: The cannon shoots a ball of frost to a point you can see within 1,200 feet of the cannon. The ball then expands to form a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) cold damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage, and its speed isn't reduced. A creature whose speed is reduced by this effect can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
entries_es: El cañón dispara una bola de helada a un punto que se puede ver dentro de 1.200 pies del cañón. La bola entonces se expande para formar una esfera de 30 pies-radius centrada en ese punto. Cada criatura en ese área debe hacer un {@dc 15} La Constitución salvando el tiro. En un ahorro fallido, una criatura toma 22 ({@damage 4d10}) daño frío, y su velocidad se reduce en 10 pies por 1 minuto. En un ahorro exitoso, la criatura toma la mitad de daño, y su velocidad no se reduce. Una criatura cuya velocidad se reduce por este efecto puede repetir el ahorro al final de cada uno de sus turnos, terminando el efecto sobre sí misma en un éxito.

entries.name: Lightning Shot
entries: The cannon shoots a ball of lightning to a point you can see within 1,200 feet of the cannon. The lightning then expands to form a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures wearing metal armor have disadvantage on the save.
entries_es: El cañón dispara una bola de relámpago a un punto que se puede ver dentro de 1.200 pies del cañón. El relámpago se expande para formar una esfera de 20 pies-radius centrada en ese punto. Cada criatura en ese área debe hacer un {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 ([TAG1]) relámpago en un ahorro fallido, o la mitad de daño en uno exitoso. Las criaturas que usan armaduras metálicas tienen desventaja en el ahorro.

entries.name: Poison Spray
entries: The cannon expels poison gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}. A creature {@condition poisoned} in this way can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
entries_es: El cañón expulsa gas venenoso en un cono de 60 pies. Cada criatura en ese área debe hacer un {@dc 15} La Constitución salvando el tiro. En un ahorro fallido, la criatura toma 22 ({@damage 4d10}) daño venenoso y es {@condition poisoned} por 1 minuto. En un ahorro exitoso, la criatura toma la mitad de daño y no es {@condition poisoned}. Una criatura {@condition poisoned} de esta manera puede repetir el lanzamiento de ahorro al final de cada uno de sus turnos, terminando el efecto sobre sí mismo en un éxito.

item.name: Arcane Propulsion Arm
item.reqAttune: by a creature missing a hand or an arm
entries: This prosthetic appendage was developed by artificers of House Cannith. To attune to this item, you must attach it to your arm at the wrist, elbow, or shoulder, at which point the prosthetic magically forms a copy of the appendage it's replacing.
While attached, the prosthetic provides these benefits:

items: The prosthetic is a fully capable part of your body.
You can take an action to remove the prosthetic, and it removes itself if your attunement to it ends. It can't be removed against your will.

The prosthetic is a magic melee weapon with which you're proficient. It deals {@damage 1d8} force damage on a hit and has the thrown property, with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. When thrown, the prosthetic detaches and flies at the target of the attack, then immediately returns to you and reattaches.

entries_es: Este prótesis apéndice fue desarrollado por los artificios de House Cannith. Para afinar a este artículo, debe adjuntarlo a su brazo en la muñeca, codo o hombro, en cuyo momento la prótesis mágicamente forma una copia del apéndice que está reemplazando.
Mientras se adjunta, la prótesis proporciona estos beneficios:

items: The prosthetic is a fully capable part of your body.

item.name: Armor of Invulnerability
entries: You have resistance to nonmagical damage while you wear this armor. Additionally, you can use an action to make yourself immune to nonmagical damage for 10 minutes or until you are no longer wearing the armor. Once this special action is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Tienes resistencia al daño no mágico mientras usas esta armadura. Además, puede utilizar una acción para hacerse inmune al daño no mágico durante 10 minutos o hasta que ya no esté usando la armadura. Una vez que se utiliza esta acción especial, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage while you wear this armor.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When the Armor of the Valiant Soul reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The AC bonus of the armor increases to +2.
You have resistance to acid damage while wearing this armor.
You are immune to the {@condition frightened} condition while wearing this armor.
The spell save DC for the armor's {@spell command} spell increases to 16, and the spell can target up to three creatures.

entries_es: Cuando la Armadura del Alma Valiant alcanza un estado despierto, usted obtiene los siguientes beneficios:

items: The AC bonus of the armor increases to +2.
You have resistance to acid damage while wearing this armor.
You are immune to the {@condition frightened} condition while wearing this armor.
The spell save DC for the armor's {@spell command} spell increases to 16, and the spell can target up to three creatures.

item.name: Armor of the Valiant Soul (Dormant)
entries: This antique armor forged from jade and black dragon scales was once worn by J'mon Sa Ord of {@book Ank'Harel|TDCSR|3|Marquet}.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While the Armor of the Valiant Soul is in a dormant state, you gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing it. You can also cast the {@spell command} spell (save {@dc 14}) while attuned to this armor. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until you finish a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|long rest}.
entries_es: Mientras que el Armor del Alma Valiant está en un estado inactivo, usted gana un bono +1 al AC mientras lo lleva. También puede lanzar el hechizo {@spell command} (salvar {@dc 14}]) mientras se ajusta a esta armadura. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta que termine un {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|long rest}.
Esta armadura antigua forjada de jade y escamas de dragón negro fue una vez usada por J'mon Sa Ord de {@book Ank'Harel|TDCSR|3|Marquet}.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When the Armor of the Valiant Soul reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The AC bonus of the armor increases to +3.
You are immune to acid damage while wearing this armor.
All friendly creatures within 15 feet of you are immune to the {@condition frightened} condition as long as you are conscious.
The spell save DC of the armor's {@spell command} spell increases to 18, and the spell can target up to five creatures.

item.name: Armor of Vulnerability (Bludgeoning)
entries: While wearing this armor, you have resistance to bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This armor is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when an {@spell identify} spell is cast on the armor or you attune to it. Attuning to the armor curses you until you are targeted by the {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic; removing the armor fails to end the curse. While cursed you have vulnerability to piercing and slashing damage.
entries_es: Esta armadura está maldecida, un hecho que se revela sólo cuando un hechizo {@spell identify} es lanzado en la armadura o usted atonta a ella. Attuning to the armor maldices you until you are targeted by the [[TAG1] hechizo or similar magic; Eliminar la armadura no termina la maldición. Mientras maldecido usted tiene vulnerabilidad a perforar y recortar daños.
Mientras usas esta armadura, tienes resistencia al daño desgarrador.

item.name: Arrow-Catching Shield
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to AC against ranged attacks while you wield this shield. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC. In addition, whenever an attacker makes a ranged attack against a target within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to become the target of the attack instead.
entries_es: Usted gana un bono +2 a AC contra ataques variados mientras que usted maneja este escudo. Este bono es además del bono normal del escudo a AC. Además, cada vez que un atacante hace un ataque contra un objetivo a menos de 5 pies de usted, puede utilizar su reacción para convertirse en el blanco del ataque en su lugar.

item.name: Arrow-Catching Shield
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} against ranged attack rolls while you wield this Shield. This bonus is in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
Whenever an attacker makes a ranged attack roll against a target within 5 feet of you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to become the target of the attack instead.
entries_es: Ganas un bono de +2 a {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} contra los rollos de ataque rangos mientras pelabas este escudo. Este bono es además del bono normal del escudo a AC.
Cada vez que un atacante hace un tiro de ataque contra un objetivo a menos de 5 pies de usted, usted puede tomar un {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} para convertirse en el blanco del ataque en su lugar.

item.name: Ascendant Dragon Vessel
entries: This vessel can be a potion bottle, drinking horn, or other container meant to hold a liquid.

As a bonus action, if the vessel is empty, you can speak the command word to fill the vessel with one of the following (your choice): ale, olive oil, mead, wine, whiskey, a {@item potion of healing}, a {@item potion of greater healing}, a {@item potion of superior healing}, a {@item potion of supreme healing}, a {@item potion of climbing}, a {@item potion of fire breath}, a {@item potion of flying}, or a {@item potion of dragon's majesty|FTD}. Once this property is used, it can't be used until the next dawn. A potion you create in this way loses its magical properties if it isn't imbibed within 24 hours.
entries_es: Este recipiente puede ser una botella de poción, cuerno para beber u otro recipiente destinado a sostener un líquido.

Como acción de bonificación, si el buque está vacío, puede hablar la palabra de comando para llenar el recipiente con una de las siguientes (su elección): ale, aceite de oliva, mead, vino, whiskey, a [[TAG0], a [[TAG1], a {@item potion of superior healing}, a {@item potion of supreme healing}, a [[TAG4], a [[TAG6] Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar hasta el siguiente amanecer. Una poción que creas de esta manera pierde sus propiedades mágicas si no está impregnada dentro de 24 horas.

item.name: Ascendant Dragon-Touched Focus
entries: This wondrous item can be a scepter, an orb, an amulet, a crystal, or another finely crafted object. It typically incorporates imagery of dragons' wings, claws, teeth, or scales.
You have advantage on initiative rolls. While you are holding the focus, it can function as a spellcasting focus for all your spells.
The focus gains an additional property determined by the family of the dragon in whose hoard it became Stirring:

items.name: Chromatic
entries: Whenever you use a spell slot to cast a spell that deals acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage, roll a {@dice d6}, and you gain a bonus equal to the number rolled to one of the spell's damage rolls.
entries_es: Cada vez que usas una ranura de hechizo para lanzar un hechizo que trata ácido, frío, fuego, relámpago o daño venenoso, rodar un {@dice d6}, y ganas un bono igual al número rodado a uno de los rollos de daño del hechizo.

items.name: Gem
entries: Whenever you use a spell slot to cast a spell, you can immediately teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of you.
entries_es: Cada vez que usas una ranura de hechizos para lanzar un hechizo, puedes inmediatamente teletransportar a un espacio no ocupado que puedes ver a menos de 15 pies de ti.

items.name: Metallic
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes a saving throw, you can use your reaction to give that creature advantage on the saving throw.
entries_es: Cuando una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 30 pies de ti hace un lanzamiento de ahorro, puedes usar tu reacción para darle ventaja a esa criatura en el lanzamiento de ahorro.

entries: While you are holding a Wakened focus, you can use it to cast certain spells. Once the item is used to cast a given spell, it can't be used to cast that spell again until the next dawn. The spells are determined by the family of the dragon in whose hoard it became Wakened.

items.name: Chromatic
entries: {@spell Hold monster}, {@spell Rime's binding ice|FTD}
entries_es: {@spell Hold monster}, {@spell Rime's binding ice|FTD}

items.name: Gem
entries: {@spell Rary's telepathic bond}, {@spell Raulothim's psychic lance|FTD}
entries_es: {@spell Rary's telepathic bond}, {@spell Raulothim's psychic lance|FTD}

items.name: Metallic
entries: {@spell Fizban's platinum shield|FTD}, {@spell legend lore}
entries_es: {@spell Fizban's platinum shield|FTD}, {@spell legend lore}

entries: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher while holding this focus, you can treat the spell as if it were cast using a 9th-level spell slot. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Este maravilloso artículo puede ser un cetro, un orbe, un amuleto, un cristal u otro objeto finamente elaborado. Normalmente incorpora imágenes de alas, garras, dientes o escamas de dragones.
Usted tiene ventaja en los rollos de iniciativa. Mientras usted está manteniendo el foco, puede funcionar como un foco de ortografía para todos sus hechizos.
El enfoque gana una propiedad adicional determinada por la familia del dragón en cuyo acaparamiento se convirtió en Stirring:

items.name: Chromatic
entries: Whenever you use a spell slot to cast a spell that deals acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage, roll a {@dice d6}, and you gain a bonus equal to the number rolled to one of the spell's damage rolls.
entries_es: Cada vez que usas una ranura de hechizo para lanzar un hechizo que trata ácido, frío, fuego, relámpago o daño venenoso, rodar un {@dice d6}, y ganas un bono igual al número rodado a uno de los rollos de daño del hechizo.

items.name: Gem
entries: Whenever you use a spell slot to cast a spell, you can immediately teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of you.
entries_es: Cada vez que usas una ranura de hechizos para lanzar un hechizo, puedes inmediatamente teletransportar a un espacio no ocupado que puedes ver a menos de 15 pies de ti.

items.name: Metallic
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes a saving throw, you can use your reaction to give that creature advantage on the saving throw.
entries_es: Cuando una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 30 pies de ti hace un lanzamiento de ahorro, puedes usar tu reacción para darle ventaja a esa criatura en el lanzamiento de ahorro.

Mientras sostienes un foco Wakened, puedes utilizarlo para lanzar ciertos hechizos. Una vez que el artículo se utiliza para lanzar un hechizo dado, no se puede utilizar para lanzar ese hechizo de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer. Los hechizos son determinados por la familia del dragón en cuya barba se despertó.

items.name: Chromatic
entries: {@spell Hold monster}, {@spell Rime's binding ice|FTD}
entries_es: {@spell Hold monster}, {@spell Rime's binding ice|FTD}

items.name: Gem
entries: {@spell Rary's telepathic bond}, {@spell Raulothim's psychic lance|FTD}
entries_es: {@spell Rary's telepathic bond}, {@spell Raulothim's psychic lance|FTD}

items.name: Metallic
entries: {@spell Fizban's platinum shield|FTD}, {@spell legend lore}
entries_es: {@spell Fizban's platinum shield|FTD}, {@spell legend lore}

Cuando lanzas un hechizo de primer nivel o superior mientras sostienes este enfoque, puedes tratar el hechizo como si fuera lanzado usando una ranura de hechizo de 9o nivel. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Ascendant Scaled Ornament
entries: This ornament can be jewelry, a cloak, or another wearable accessory. It appears to be fashioned from a dragon's scale, tooth, or claw, or it incorporates images in those shapes.

You gain a +1 bonus to AC, and you can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}. Moreover, each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you has advantage on saving throws it makes to avoid being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} or to end those conditions on itself.

When you would take damage of the type dealt by the breath of the dragon in whose hoard the ornament became Wakened, you can use your reaction to take no damage instead, and you regain hit points equal to the damage you would have taken. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
While you are wearing the ornament, you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. While you are flying using this speed, spectral dragon wings appear on your back.
entries_es: Este ornamento puede ser joyería, un manto u otro accesorio usable. Parece estar de moda a partir de la escala, diente o garra de un dragón, o incorpora imágenes en esas formas.

Usted gana un bono +1 a AC, y no puede ser {@condition charmed} o {@condition frightened}]. Por otra parte, cada criatura de su elección dentro de 30 pies de usted tiene ventaja en salvar los lanzamientos que hace para evitar ser {@condition charmed} o {@condition frightened} o para terminar esas condiciones en sí mismo.

Cuando usted tomaría el daño del tipo tratado por el aliento del dragón en cuyo acaparamiento el adorno se Despierta, usted puede utilizar su reacción para no tomar ningún daño en su lugar, y usted recupera puntos de éxito igual al daño que habría tomado. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

Mientras usted está usando el adorno, usted gana una velocidad de vuelo igual a su velocidad de caminar y puede bucear. Mientras estás volando usando esta velocidad, las alas de dragón espectral aparecen en tu espalda.

item.name: Assassin's Blood
entries: A creature subjected to this poison must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) poison damage and is {@condition poisoned} for 24 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn't {@condition poisoned}.
entries_es: Una criatura sometida a este veneno debe hacer un {@dc 10} La Constitución salvando el tiro. En un ahorro fallido, toma 6 ({@damage 1d12}) daño venenoso y es {@condition poisoned} durante 24 horas. En un ahorro exitoso, la criatura toma medio daño y no es {@condition poisoned}.

item.name: Assassin's Blood
entries: A creature subjected to Assassin's Blood makes a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) Poison damage and has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 24 hours. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.
entries_es: Una criatura sometida a la Sangre de Assassin hace un {@dc 10} La Constitución salvando el tiro. En un fallido ahorro, la criatura toma 6 ({@damage 1d12}) Daño en veneno y tiene la condición [[TAG2] durante 24 horas. Con un ahorro exitoso, la criatura toma la mitad del daño sólo.

item.name: Astral Shard
entries: This crystal is a solidified shard of the Astral Plane, swirling with silver mist. As an action, you can attach the shard to a Tiny object (such as a weapon or a piece of jewelry) or detach it. It falls off if your attunement to it ends. You can use the shard as a spellcasting focus while you hold or wear it.
When you use a Metamagic option on a spell while you are holding or wearing the shard, immediately after casting the spell you can teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you.
entries_es: Este cristal es un fragmento solidificado del Plano Astral, girando con niebla plateada. Como acción, puede adjuntar el fragmento a un objeto Tiny (como un arma o una pieza de joyería) o desmontarlo. Se cae si su atontado termina. Puede utilizar el fragmento como un foco de ortografía mientras lo mantiene o lo usa.

Cuando usas una opción Metamagic en un hechizo mientras estás sosteniendo o usando el duro, inmediatamente después de lanzar el hechizo puedes teletransportar a un espacio no ocupado que puedes ver a menos de 30 pies de ti.

item.name: Astromancy Archive
entries: This brass disc of articulated, concentric rings unfolds into an armillary sphere. As a bonus action, you can unfold it into the sphere or back into a disc. When found, it contains the following spells, which are wizard spells for you while you are attuned to it: {@spell augury}, {@spell divination}, {@spell find the path}, {@spell foresight}, {@spell locate creature}, and {@spell locate object}. It functions as a spellbook for you, with spells encoded on the rings.
While you are holding the archive, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your wizard spells.
The archive has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can use the charges in the following ways while holding it:

items: If you spend 1 minute studying the archive, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your prepared wizard spells with a different spell in the archive. The new spell must be of the divination school.

When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge and force the creature to roll a {@dice d4} and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the original roll. You can do this after you see the roll but before its effects are applied.

entries_es: Este disco de latón de anillos articulados y concéntricos se desarrolla en una esfera armilaria. Como una acción de bonificación, se puede desarrollar en la esfera o volver a un disco. Cuando se encuentra, contiene los siguientes hechizos, que son hechizos magos para usted mientras usted está afinado a él: {@spell augury}, {@spell divination}], {@spell find the path}, {@spell foresight}], {@spell locate creature}], y {@spell locate object}. Funciona como un libro de hechizos para ti, con hechizos codificados en los anillos.
Mientras usted está manteniendo el archivo, puede utilizarlo como un foco de ortografía para sus hechizos magos.
El archivo tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. Puede utilizar los cargos de las siguientes maneras mientras lo sostiene:

items: If you spend 1 minute studying the archive, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your prepared wizard spells with a different spell in the archive. The new spell must be of the divination school.

When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge and force the creature to roll a {@dice d4} and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the original roll. You can do this after you see the roll but before its effects are applied.

item.name: Atlas of Endless Horizons
entries: This thick book is bound in dark leather, crisscrossed with inlaid silver lines suggesting a map or chart. When found, the book contains the following spells, which are wizard spells for you while you are attuned to the book: {@spell arcane gate}, {@spell dimension door}, {@spell gate}, {@spell misty step}, {@spell plane shift}, {@spell teleportation circle}, and {@spell word of recall}. It functions as a spellbook for you.
While you are holding the book, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your wizard spells.
The book has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can use the charges in the following ways while holding it:

items: If you spend 1 minute studying the book, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your prepared wizard spells with a different spell in the book. The new spell must be of the conjuration school.

When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge to teleport up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. If your new position is out of range of the attack, it misses you.

entries_es: Este libro grueso está encuadernado en cuero oscuro, cruzado con líneas de plata incrustadas que sugieren un mapa o gráfico. Cuando se encuentra, el libro contiene los siguientes hechizos, que son hechizos magos para usted mientras usted está afinado al libro: {@spell arcane gate}, {@spell dimension door}, {@spell gate}, {@spell misty step}], {@spell plane shift}], [[TAG5], y {@spell word of recall}. Funciona como un libro de hechizos para ti.
Mientras sostienes el libro, puedes utilizarlo como un foco de ortografía para tus hechizos magos.
El libro tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Puede utilizar los cargos de las siguientes maneras mientras lo sostiene:

items: If you spend 1 minute studying the book, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your prepared wizard spells with a different spell in the book. The new spell must be of the conjuration school.

When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge to teleport up to 10 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. If your new position is out of range of the attack, it misses you.

item.name: Axe Beak
entries: Use the {@creature Axe Beak|XMM} stat block.
entries_es: Usa el bloque {@creature Axe Beak|XMM}.

item.name: Axe Beak
entries: An {@creature axe beak}'s splayed toes allow it to run across snow, and it can carry as much weight as a mule. A domesticated axe beak can be purchased in Ten-Towns for 50 gp.
entries_es: Un {@creature axe beak} dedos de los dedos esculpidos le permite correr a través de la nieve, y puede llevar tanto peso como una mula. Un pico de hacha domesticado se puede comprar en Ten-Towns por 50 gp.

item.name: Axe of the Dwarvish Lords
entries: Seeing the peril his people faced, a young dwarf prince came to believe that his people needed something to unite them. Thus, he set out to forge a weapon that would be such a symbol.

Venturing deep under the mountains, deeper than any dwarf had ever delved, the young prince came to the blazing heart of a great volcano. With the aid of Moradin, the dwarven god of creation, he first crafted four great tools: the {@italic Brutal Pick}, the {@italic Earthheart Forge}, the {@italic Anvil of Songs}, and the {@italic Shaping Hammer}. With them, he forged the {@italic Axe of the Dwarvish Lords}.

Armed with the artifact, the prince returned to the dwarf clans and brought peace. His axe ended grudges and answered slights. The clans became allies, and they threw back their enemies and enjoyed an era of prosperity. This young dwarf is remembered as the First King. When he became old, he passed the weapon, which had become his badge of office, to his heir. The rightful inheritors passed the axe on for many generations.

Later, in a dark era marked by treachery and wickedness, the axe was lost in a bloody civil war fomented by greed for its power and the status it bestowed. Centuries later, the dwarves still search for the axe, and many adventurers have made careers of chasing after rumors and plundering old vaults to find it.

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: The {@italic Axe of the Dwarvish Lords} is a magic weapon that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. The axe also functions as a {@item belt of dwarvenkind}, a {@item dwarven thrower}, and a {@item sword of sharpness}.
entries_es: El {@italic Axe of the Dwarvish Lords} es un arma mágica que otorga un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con él. El hacha también funciona como un {@item belt of dwarvenkind}, un {@item dwarven thrower}, y un {@item sword of sharpness}.

entries.name: Blessings of Moradin
entries: If you are a dwarf attuned to the axe, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have immunity to poison damage.
The range of your {@sense darkvision} increases by 60 feet.
You gain proficiency with {@item artisan's tools|PHB} related to blacksmithing, brewing, and stonemasonry.

entries_es: Si usted es un enano afinado al hacha, usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: You have immunity to poison damage.
The range of your {@sense darkvision} increases by 60 feet.
You gain proficiency with {@item artisan's tools|PHB} related to blacksmithing, brewing, and stonemasonry.

entries.name: Conjure Earth Elemental
entries: If you are holding the axe, you can use your action to cast the {@spell conjure elemental} spell from it, summoning an {@creature earth elemental}. You can't use this property again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Si usted está sosteniendo el hacha, puede utilizar su acción para lanzar el [[TAG0] hechizo de él, convocando un {@creature earth elemental}. No puedes usar esta propiedad de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Travel the Depths
entries: You can use an action to touch the axe to a fixed piece of dwarven stonework and cast the {@spell teleport} spell from the axe. If your intended destination is underground, there is no chance of a mishap or arriving somewhere unexpected. You can't use this property again until 3 days have passed.
entries_es: Puedes usar una acción para tocar el hacha a una pieza fija de piedra enana y lanzar el hechizo {@spell teleport} del hacha. Si su destino previsto es subterráneo, no hay posibilidad de un mishap o llegar a algún lugar inesperado. No puedes usar esta propiedad de nuevo hasta que hayan pasado 3 días.

entries.name: Curse
entries: The axe bears a curse that affects any non-dwarf that becomes attuned to it. Even if the attunement ends, the curse remains. With each passing day, the creature's physical appearance and stature become more dwarflike. After seven days, the creature looks like a typical dwarf, but the creature neither loses its racial traits nor gains the racial traits of a dwarf. The physical changes wrought by the axe aren't considered magical in nature (and therefore can't be dispelled), but they can be undone by any effect that removes a curse, such as a {@spell greater restoration} or {@spell remove curse} spell.
entries_es: El hacha lleva una maldición que afecta a cualquier no enano que se atune a él. Incluso si la atontación termina, la maldición permanece. Con cada día que pasa, la apariencia física y la estatura de la criatura se vuelven más enanas. Después de siete días, la criatura parece un enano típico, pero la criatura no pierde sus rasgos raciales ni gana los rasgos raciales de un enano. Los cambios físicos causados por el hacha no se consideran mágicos en la naturaleza (y por lo tanto no pueden ser disipados), pero pueden ser deshechos por cualquier efecto que elimina una maldición, como un hechizo {@spell greater restoration} o {@spell remove curse}.

entries.name: Destroying the Axe
entries: The only way to destroy the axe is to melt it down in the {@italic Earthheart Forge}, where it was created. It must remain in the burning forge for fifty years before it finally succumbs to the fire and is consumed.
entries_es: La única manera de destruir el hacha es derretirlo en el {@italic Earthheart Forge}, donde fue creado. Debe permanecer en la forja ardiente durante cincuenta años antes de que finalmente sucumba al fuego y se consume.

Con ellos, forjó el {@italic Axe of the Dwarvish Lords}.

Armado con el artefacto, el príncipe regresó a los clanes enanos y trajo paz. Su hacha terminó con rencor y respondió leves. Los clanes se convirtieron en aliados, y devolvieron a sus enemigos y disfrutaron de una era de prosperidad. Este joven enano es recordado como el Primer Rey. When you attack a creature with the axe and roll a 20 on the {@dice d20} for the attack roll, the axe deals an extra 20 Slashing damage.

Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon flies back to your hand.

entries_es: Usted gana {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} con una gama de 60 pies. Si usted ya tiene {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}, su rango aumenta en 60 pies.

items.name: Fortitude of Stone
entries: Your Constitution increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.
entries_es: Su Constitución aumenta en 2, a un máximo de 20.

items.name: Gifts of the Creator
entries: You have proficiency with {@item Brewer's Supplies|XPHB}, {@item Mason's Tools|XPHB}, and {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB}.
entries_es: Tiene competencia con {@item Brewer's Supplies|XPHB}, {@item Mason's Tools|XPHB} y {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB}].

items.name: One with the Forge
entries: You have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison damage and {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Fire damage.
entries_es: Usted tiene {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} al daño de veneno y {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} al daño del fuego.

items.name: Sunder
entries: When you hit an object with the axe, the object takes the maximum amount of damage possible.
entries_es: Al golpear un objeto con el hacha, el objeto toma la cantidad máxima de daño posible.

entries_es.name: Conjure Earth Elemental
entries: While holding the axe, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to summon an {@creature Earth Elemental|XMM}. It appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count. The elemental disappears after 24 hours, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can't use this property again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras sostiene el hacha, puede tomar una [[TAG0] acción para convocar una {@creature Earth Elemental|XMM}]. Aparece en un espacio no ocupado que eliges a menos de 30 pies de ti mismo, comprende tus idiomas, obedece tus mandamientos, y toma su turno inmediatamente después de que cuentes. El elemental desaparece después de 24 horas, cuando muere, o cuando lo despide como un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. No puedes usar esta propiedad de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries_es.name: Random Properties
entries: The axe has the following random properties:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|minor beneficial} properties
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property
2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} properties

entries_es: El hacha tiene las siguientes propiedades aleatorias:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|minor beneficial} properties
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property
2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} properties

entries_es.name: Travel the Depths
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to touch the axe to a fixed piece of dwarven stonework and cast {@spell Teleport|XPHB} from the axe. If your intended destination is underground, there is no chance of a mishap or arriving somewhere unexpected. You can't use this property again until 3 days have passed.
entries_es: Puede tomar una acción [[TAG0] para tocar el hacha a un pedazo fijo de piedra enana y fundir {@spell Teleport|XPHB} del hacha. Si su destino previsto es subterráneo, no hay posibilidad de un mishap o llegar a algún lugar inesperado. No puedes usar esta propiedad de nuevo hasta que hayan pasado 3 días.

entries_es.name: Destroying the Axe
entries: The only way to destroy the axe is to melt it down in the Earthheart Forge, where it was created. It must remain in the burning forge for 50 years before it finally succumbs to the fire and is consumed.
entries_es: La única manera de destruir el hacha es derretirlo en la Forja de la Tierra, donde fue creada. Debe permanecer en la forja ardiente durante 50 años antes de que finalmente sucumba al fuego y se consume.

item.name: Azorius Guild Signet
entries: This ring, adorned with the symbol of Azorius, allows you to cast {@spell ensnaring strike}. A guild signet is sometimes awarded to a guild member whose renown score in that guild is 5 or higher, as a reward for performing special services for the guild. Aside from its magical properties, the ring is also an indicator of Azorius's recognition and favor.
A signet has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast the associated spell (save {@dc 13}).
entries_es: Este anillo, adornado con el símbolo de Azorius, te permite echar {@spell ensnaring strike}. Un guild signet es a veces otorgado a un miembro del gremio cuyo renombre puntuación en ese gremio es 5 o superior, como recompensa por realizar servicios especiales para el gremio. Aparte de sus propiedades mágicas, el anillo es también un indicador del reconocimiento y favor de Azorius.
Un letrero tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. Al llevarla, puede gastar 1 carga para lanzar el hechizo asociado (salvar {@dc 13}).

item.name: Azorius Keyrune
item.reqAttune: by a member of the Azorius guild
entries: This keyrune is carved from white marble and lapis lazuli to resemble a noble bird of prey. It can become a {@creature giant eagle} for up to 1 hour. While the transformed eagle is within 1 mile of you, you can communicate with it telepathically. As an action, you can see through the eagle's eyes and hear what it hears until the start of your next turn, and you gain the benefit of its keen sight. During this time, you are deaf and blind with regard to your own senses.

When you use an action to speak the item's command word and place the keyrune on the ground in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, the keyrune transforms into a {@creature giant eagle}. If there isn't enough space for the eagle, the keyrune doesn't transform.

The creature is friendly to you, your companions, and other members of your guild (unless those guild members are hostile to you). It understands your languages and obeys your spoken commands. If you issue no commands, the eagle takes the {@action Dodge} action and moves to avoid danger.

At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its keyrune form. It reverts early if it drops to 0 hit points or if you use an action to speak the command word again while touching it. When the creature reverts to its keyrune form, it can't transform again until 36 hours have passed.
entries_es: Esta llavero está tallada de mármol blanco y lapis lazuli para parecerse a un pájaro noble de presa. Puede convertirse en un [[TAG0] por hasta 1 hora. Mientras el águila transformado está a 1 milla de ustedes, pueden comunicarse con él telepáticamente. Como acción, se puede ver a través de los ojos del águila y escuchar lo que oye hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno, y se obtiene el beneficio de su mirada aguda. Durante este tiempo, eres sordo y ciego con respecto a tus propios sentidos.

Cuando usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando del artículo y colocas el llavero en el suelo en un espacio no ocupado a 5 pies de ti, el llavero se transforma en un {@creature giant eagle}. Si no hay suficiente espacio para el águila, la llave no se transforma.

La criatura es amistosa con usted, sus compañeros y otros miembros de su gremio (a menos que esos miembros del gremio sean hostiles a usted). Comprende tus idiomas y obedece tus mandamientos hablados. Si no emite ningún comando, el águila toma la acción {@action Dodge} y se mueve para evitar el peligro.

Al final de la duración, la criatura vuelve a su forma de llave. Revierte temprano si cae a 0 puntos de éxito o si usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo mientras la toca. Cuando la criatura vuelve a su forma de llavero, no puede transformarse hasta que hayan pasado 36 horas.

item.name: Azuredge
entries: Forged by the archwizard Ahghairon, this intelligent battleaxe was crafted to defend Waterdeep. Its current wielder is a former member of Force Grey named {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH}, but the weapon is searching for a new owner.

Azuredge has a solid steel handle etched with tiny runes, wrapped in blue dragon hide with a star sapphire set into the pommel. The axe head is forged from silver, electrum, and steel alloys whose edges constantly shimmer with a deep blue luminescence.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The {@spell shield} spell provides no defense against the axe, which passes through that spell's barrier of magical force.
When you hit a fiend or an undead with the axe, cold blue flames erupt from its blade and deal an extra {@damage 2d6} radiant damage to the target.

entries.name: Hurling
entries: The battleaxe has 3 charges. You can expend 1 charge and make a ranged attack with the axe, hurling it as if it had the thrown property with a normal range of 60 feet and a long range of 180 feet. Whether it hits or misses, the axe flies back to you at the end of the current turn, landing in your open hand or at your feet in your space (as you choose). The axe regains all expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: El hacha de batalla tiene 3 cargos. Puede gastar 1 carga y hacer un ataque con el hacha, abrazarlo como si tuviera la propiedad lanzada con un rango normal de 60 pies y una larga gama de 180 pies. Ya sea que golpee o se pierda, el hacha vuelve a usted al final del turno actual, aterrizando en su mano abierta o a sus pies en su espacio (como usted elige). El hacha recupera todos los cargos enviados diariamente al amanecer.

entries.name: Illumination
entries: While holding the axe, you can use an action to cause the axe to glow blue or to quench the glow. This glow sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.
entries_es: Mientras sostiene el hacha, puede utilizar una acción para hacer que el hacha brille azul o para apagar el resplandor. Este resplandor arroja luz brillante en un radio de 30 pies y luz oscura para 30 pies adicionales.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Azuredge is a sentient lawful neutral weapon with an Intelligence of 12, a Wisdom of 15, and a Charisma of 15. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.

The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak, read, and understand Common. It has a calm, delicate voice. The weapon can sense the presence of non-lawful creatures within 120 feet of it.
entries_es: Azuredge es un arma sensible y lícita neutral con una Inteligencia de 12, una Sabiduría de 15, y una Charisma de 15. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.

El arma se comunica telepáticamente con su wielder y puede hablar, leer y comprender Común. Tiene una voz tranquila y delicada. El arma puede sentir la presencia de criaturas no legales a 120 pies de ella.

entries.name: Personality
entries: Azuredge is sworn to protect Waterdeep, and it desires to be wielded by a law-abiding person willing to dedicate everything to the city's defense. The weapon is patient and takes its time finding its ideal wielder.

If someone tries to use Azuredge against its will, the axe can become ten times heavier than normal, and can magically adhere to any Medium or larger object or surface it comes into contact with. Once it does so, the axe can't be wielded. Nothing short of a {@spell wish} spell can separate the axe from the item or surface to which it is adhered without destroying one or the other, though the axe can choose to end the effect at any time.
entries_es: Azuredge es jurada para proteger a Waterdeep, y desea ser manipulada por una persona de derecho dispuesta a dedicar todo a la defensa de la ciudad. El arma es paciente y toma su tiempo encontrando su peladora ideal.

Si alguien intenta usar Azuredge contra su voluntad, el hacha puede llegar a ser diez veces más pesado de lo normal, y puede adherirse mágicamente a cualquier objeto o superficie medio o mayor con el que entra en contacto. Una vez que lo hace, el hacha no puede ser marchitado. Nada menos que un hechizo {@spell wish} puede separar el hacha del elemento o la superficie a la que se adhiere sin destruir uno o el otro, aunque el hacha puede elegir terminar el efecto en cualquier momento.

Forjado por el arquero Ahghairon, este juego inteligente fue elaborado para defender Waterdeep. Su actual arma es un ex miembro de Force Grey llamado {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH}, pero el arma está buscando un nuevo propietario.

Azuredge tiene un mango de acero sólido grabado con pequeñas runas, envuelto en piel de dragón azul con un zafiro estrella establecido en el pommel. La cabeza del hacha está forjada de aleaciones de plata, eléctricas y de acero cuyos bordes constantemente brillan con una luminiscencia azul profunda.
Ganas un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma mágica. El hechizo {@spell shield} no proporciona defensa contra el hacha, que pasa por la barrera de ese hechizo de fuerza mágica.
Cuando usted golpeó un fiend o un no muerto con el hacha, las llamas azules frías eruptieron de su espada y tratar un daño radiante adicional [[TAG0] al objetivo.

item.name: Azuremite
entries: The ruins of this sprawling city are now known as the Crystalfen Caverns. These caves are home to scattered veins of {@item azuremite|TDCSR}, a gorgeous blue crystal that formed from millennia of psychic energies existing near element deposits. Curious explorers who discovered the veins found that, when mined and refined into a fine dust, the {@item azuremite|TDCSR} powder is a strong mind-altering agent and induces temporary visions and other psychic phenomena.

While a number of small, isolated entrances to this labyrinth of tunnels have been discovered and adventuring parties have attempted to chart the mines, the caverns are so vast and deep that either they gave up for fear of becoming lost, or they were assailed by the terrible denizens of the caverns, never to return. Most who now brave the caverns are foolish treasure hunters or criminals seeking to mine more {@item azuremite|TDCSR} to sell on the black market.
entries_es: Las ruinas de esta ciudad espeluznante son ahora conocidas como las Cavernas de Crystalfen. Estas cuevas son el hogar de venas dispersas de {@item azuremite|TDCSR}, un magnífico cristal azul que se formó a partir de milenios de energías psíquicas existentes cerca de depósitos de elementos. Curiosos exploradores que descubrieron las venas encontraron que, cuando se minó y refinado en un polvo fino, el polvo [[TAG0] es un agente fuerte que altera la mente e induce visiones temporales y otros fenómenos psíquicos.

Si bien se han descubierto algunas pequeñas entradas aisladas a este laberinto de túneles y las fiestas de advenimiento han intentado trazar las minas, las cavernas son tan vastas y profundas que ya se rindieron por temor a perderse, o fueron asaltadas por los terribles habitantes de las cavernas, nunca para regresar. La mayoría de los que ahora valientes las cavernas son cazadores de tesoros tontos o criminales que buscan mimar más {@item azuremite|TDCSR} para vender en el mercado negro.

item.name: Azurite
entries: An opaque mottled deep blue gemstone.
entries_es: Una gema azul opaca moteada.

item.name: Azurite
entries: A mottled deep blue gemstone.
entries_es: Una gema azul moteada.

item.name: Baba Yaga's Dancing Broom
entries: The archfey {@book Baba Yaga|XDMG|8|Baba Yaga} crafted many of these magic brooms. No two appear exactly alike. While holding the broom, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to transform it into an {@creature Animated Broom|XMM} under your control. The broom then moves into an unoccupied space as close to you as possible. The broom acts immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count and remains animate until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and use a command word to render it inanimate.

On your turn, you can mentally command the animated broom if it is within 30 feet of you and you don't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition (no action required). You decide what action the broom takes and where it moves during its next turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location.

If the broom is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it shatters and is destroyed. If the broom reverts to its inanimate form before losing all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} it regains all of them.
item.name_es: Sala de baile de Baba Yaga
entries_es: El arzobispo {@book Baba Yaga|XDMG|8|Baba Yaga} creó muchas de estas escobas mágicas. No aparecen dos exactamente iguales. Mientras sostiene la escoba, puede tomar una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para transformarla en un {@creature Animated Broom|XMM} bajo su control. La escoba entonces se mueve en un espacio no ocupado tan cerca de usted como sea posible. La escoba actúa inmediatamente después de usted en su {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} contar y permanece animada hasta que usted tome un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} y utilizar una palabra de comando para hacerlo inanimado.

A su vez, puede ordenar mentalmente la escoba animada si está a menos de 30 pies de usted y no tiene la condición {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} (no se requiere acción). Usted decide qué acción toma la escoba y dónde se mueve durante su próximo turno, o puede emitir un comando general, como atacar a sus enemigos o guardar un lugar.

Si la escoba se reduce a 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, se rompe y se destruye. Si la escoba vuelve a su forma inanimada antes de perder todo su {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} recupera todos ellos.

item.name: Baba Yaga's Mortar and Pestle
entries: The creations of the immortal hag Baba Yaga defy the laws of mortal magic. Among the notorious implements that cement her legend on countless worlds are the artifacts that propel her through the planes: Baba Yaga's Mortar and Pestle. These signature tools of Baba Yaga are a single artifact for purposes of attunement. Should the two objects become separated, the pestle appears next to the mortar at the next dawn.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: This artifact has the following random properties, which you can determine by rolling on the tables in the "Artifacts" section of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} properties
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property

entries_es: Este artefacto tiene las siguientes propiedades aleatorias, que usted puede determinar al rodar en las tablas en la sección "Artifactos" de la {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} properties
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property

entries.name: Properties of the Mortar
entries: The mortar is a Tiny wooden bowl. However, the mortar increases in size to accommodate anything you place inside, expanding-if there's enough space-up to Large size, meaning it can hold even a Large creature.
entries_es: El mortero es un tazón de madera. Sin embargo, el mortero aumenta en tamaño para acomodar cualquier lugar dentro, expandiendo-si hay suficiente espacio-up a gran tamaño, lo que significa que puede contener incluso una gran criatura.

entries.name: Properties of the Pestle
entries: The pestle is a 6-inch-long, worn wooden tool. Once during your turn while you are holding the pestle, you can extend it into a quarterstaff or shrink it back into a pestle (no action required). As a quarterstaff, the pestle is a magic weapon that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

The pestle has 12 charges. When you hit with a melee attack using the pestle, you can expend up to 3 of its charges to deal an extra {@damage 1d8} force damage for each charge expended. The pestle regains all expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: El pestle es una herramienta de madera de 6 pulgadas de largo. Una vez durante su turno mientras está sosteniendo el pestle, puede extenderlo a un quarterstaff o encogerlo de nuevo en un pestle (no se requiere acción). Como quarterstaff, el pestle es un arma mágica que otorga un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con él.

El peste tiene 12 cargos. Cuando usted golpeó con un ataque de melee usando el pestle, usted puede gastar hasta 3 de sus cargos para tratar un daño adicional [[TAG0] fuerza por cada carga gastada. La plaga recupera todos los cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

entries.name: Perfect Tools
entries: While holding the mortar and pestle, you can use your action to say the name of any nonmagical plant, mineral, or fluid and an amount of the material worth 10 gp or less. The mortar instantly fills with the desired amount of that material. Once you use this action, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

You can also use the artifact as {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB}, {@item brewer's supplies|PHB}, {@item cook's utensils|PHB}, an {@item herbalism kit|PHB}, and a {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}. You have advantage on any check you make using the artifact as one of these tools.
entries_es: Mientras sostiene el mortero y el peste, puede utilizar su acción para decir el nombre de cualquier planta no mágica, mineral o líquido y una cantidad del material que vale 10 gp o menos. El mortero se llena instantáneamente con la cantidad deseada de ese material. Una vez que usas esta acción, no puedes hacerlo de nuevo hasta que termines un breve o largo descanso.

También puede utilizar el artefacto como {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB}, {@item brewer's supplies|PHB}, {@item cook's utensils|PHB}], un {@item herbalism kit|PHB}, y un {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}. Usted tiene ventaja en cualquier cheque que haga utilizando el artefacto como una de estas herramientas.

entries.name: Primal Parts
entries: As an action while the pestle and the mortar is within 5 feet of you, you can command the pestle to grind. For the next minute, or until you use your action to verbally command it to stop, the pestle moves on its own, grinding the contents of the mortar into a mush or fine powder that's equally useful for cooking or alchemy. At the start of each of your turns, whatever is in the mortar takes {@damage 4d10} force damage. If this reduces the target's hit points to 0, the target is reduced to powder, pulp, or paste, as appropriate. Only magic items are unaffected. If you wish, when the pestle stops, you can have the mortar separate its contents-like powdered bone, crushed herbs, pulped organs-into separate piles.
entries_es: Como una acción mientras la plaga y el mortero están a 5 pies de usted, usted puede ordenar la plaga para moler. Por el minuto siguiente, o hasta que utilice su acción para ordenar verbalmente que pare, la plaga se mueve por su cuenta, moler el contenido del mortero en un polvo mush o fino que es igualmente útil para cocinar o alquimia. Al comienzo de cada uno de sus turnos, lo que está en el mortero toma {@damage 4d10} daño de fuerza. Si esto reduce los puntos de impacto del objetivo a 0, el objetivo se reduce a polvo, pulpa o pasta, según corresponda. Sólo objetos mágicos no son afectados. Si lo deseas, cuando el peste se detiene, puedes hacer que el mortero separe su hueso en polvo de contenido, hierbas trituradas, órganos pulpados en pilas separadas.

entries.name: Traverse the Night
entries: If you are holding the pestle while you are inside the mortar, you can use your action to verbally command the mortar to travel to a specific place or creature.

You don't need to know where your destination is, but it must be a specific destination-not just the nearest river or a red dragon's lair. If the stated destination is within 1,000 miles of you, the mortar lifts into the air and vanishes. You and any creatures in the mortar travel through a dreamlike sky, with hazy reflections of the world passing by below. Creatures might see images of you streaking through the sky between your point of origin and the destination. You arrive at the location 1 hour later or, if it is night, 1 minute later.
entries_es: Si usted está sosteniendo la peste mientras usted está dentro del mortero, usted puede utilizar su acción para ordenar verbalmente el mortero para viajar a un lugar o criatura específico.

entries.name: Destroying the Mortar and Pestle
entries: The mortar and pestle are destroyed if they are crushed underfoot by the {@i Dancing Hut of Baba Yaga} or by Baba Yaga herself.
entries.name_es: Destruyendo el Mortar y el Pestle

item.name_es: Mortero y Pestle de Baba Yaga
entries_es: Las creaciones del inmortal hag Baba Yaga desafian las leyes de la magia mortal. Entre los famosos implementos que cementan su leyenda en innumerables mundos están los artefactos que la impulsan a través de los planos: Mortero y Pestle de Baba Yaga. Estas herramientas de firma de Baba Yaga son un único artefacto para propósitos de attunement. Si los dos objetos se separan, la plaga aparece junto al mortero en el siguiente amanecer.

entries_es.name: Properties of the Mortar
entries: The mortar is a Tiny wooden bowl. However, the mortar increases in size to accommodate anything you place inside, expanding-if there's enough space-up to Large size, meaning it can hold even a Large creature.
entries_es: El mortero es un tazón de madera. Sin embargo, el mortero aumenta en tamaño para acomodar cualquier lugar dentro, expandiendo-si hay suficiente espacio-up a gran tamaño, lo que significa que puede contener incluso una gran criatura.

entries_es.name: Properties of the Pestle
entries: The pestle is a 6-inch-long, worn wooden tool. Once during your turn while you are holding the pestle, you can extend it into a quarterstaff or shrink it back into a pestle (no action required). As a quarterstaff, the pestle is a magic weapon that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

The pestle has 12 charges. When you hit with a melee attack using the pestle, you can expend up to 3 of its charges to deal an extra {@damage 1d8} force damage for each charge expended. The pestle regains all expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: El pestle es una herramienta de madera de 6 pulgadas de largo. Una vez durante su turno mientras está sosteniendo el pestle, puede extenderlo a un quarterstaff o encogerlo de nuevo en un pestle (no se requiere acción). Como quarterstaff, el pestle es un arma mágica que otorga un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con él.

El peste tiene 12 cargos. Cuando usted golpeó con un ataque de melee usando el pestle, usted puede gastar hasta 3 de sus cargos para tratar un daño adicional [[TAG0] fuerza por cada carga gastada. La plaga recupera todos los cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

entries_es.name: Perfect Tools
entries: While holding the mortar and pestle, you can use your action to say the name of any nonmagical plant, mineral, or fluid and an amount of the material worth 10 gp or less. The mortar instantly fills with the desired amount of that material. Once you use this action, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

You can also use the artifact as {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB}, {@item brewer's supplies|PHB}, {@item cook's utensils|PHB}, an {@item herbalism kit|PHB}, and a {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}. You have advantage on any check you make using the artifact as one of these tools.
entries_es: Mientras sostiene el mortero y el peste, puede utilizar su acción para decir el nombre de cualquier planta no mágica, mineral o líquido y una cantidad del material que vale 10 gp o menos. El mortero se llena instantáneamente con la cantidad deseada de ese material. Una vez que usas esta acción, no puedes hacerlo de nuevo hasta que termines un breve o largo descanso.

También puede utilizar el artefacto como {@item alchemist's supplies|PHB}, {@item brewer's supplies|PHB}, {@item cook's utensils|PHB}], un {@item herbalism kit|PHB}, y un {@item poisoner's kit|PHB}. Usted tiene ventaja en cualquier cheque que haga utilizando el artefacto como una de estas herramientas.

entries_es.name: Primal Parts
entries: As an action while the pestle and the mortar is within 5 feet of you, you can command the pestle to grind. For the next minute, or until you use your action to verbally command it to stop, the pestle moves on its own, grinding the contents of the mortar into a mush or fine powder that's equally useful for cooking or alchemy. At the start of each of your turns, whatever is in the mortar takes {@damage 4d10} force damage. If this reduces the target's hit points to 0, the target is reduced to powder, pulp, or paste, as appropriate. Only magic items are unaffected. If you wish, when the pestle stops, you can have the mortar separate its contents-like powdered bone, crushed herbs, pulped organs-into separate piles.
entries_es: Como una acción mientras la plaga y el mortero están a 5 pies de usted, usted puede ordenar la plaga para moler. Por el minuto siguiente, o hasta que utilice su acción para ordenar verbalmente que pare, la plaga se mueve por su cuenta, moler el contenido del mortero en un polvo mush o fino que es igualmente útil para cocinar o alquimia. Al comienzo de cada uno de sus turnos, lo que está en el mortero toma {@damage 4d10} daño de fuerza. Si esto reduce los puntos de impacto del objetivo a 0, el objetivo se reduce a polvo, pulpa o pasta, según corresponda. Sólo objetos mágicos no son afectados. Si lo deseas, cuando el peste se detiene, puedes hacer que el mortero separe su hueso en polvo de contenido, hierbas trituradas, órganos pulpados en pilas separadas.

entries_es.name: Traverse the Night
entries: If you are holding the pestle while you are inside the mortar, you can use your action to verbally command the mortar to travel to a specific place or creature.

You don't need to know where your destination is, but it must be a specific destination-not just the nearest river or a red dragon's lair. If the stated destination is within 1,000 miles of you, the mortar lifts into the air and vanishes. You and any creatures in the mortar travel through a dreamlike sky, with hazy reflections of the world passing by below. Creatures might see images of you streaking through the sky between your point of origin and the destination. You arrive at the location 1 hour later or, if it is night, 1 minute later.

item.name: Backpack
entries: A backpack can hold one cubic foot or 30 pounds of gear. You can also strap items, such as a bedroll or a coil of rope, to the outside of a backpack.
entries_es: Una mochila puede contener un pie cúbico o 30 libras de engranaje. También se pueden sujetar elementos, como una bobina o una bobina de cuerda, al exterior de una mochila.

item.name: Backpack
entries: A Backpack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot. It can also serve as a saddlebag.
entries_es: Una mochila tiene hasta 30 libras dentro de 1 pie cúbico. También puede servir como una montura.

item.name: Backpack Parachute
entries: A humanoid wearing this piece of gear can deploy the parachute as a reaction while falling, or as an action otherwise. The parachute requires at least a 10-foot cube of unoccupied space in which to deploy, and it doesn't open fast enough to slow a fall of less than 60 feet. If it has sufficient time and space to deploy properly, the parachute allows its wearer to land without taking falling damage. Once it has been used, the parachute takes 10 minutes to repack.
entries_es: Un humanoide que lleva este equipo puede desplegar el paracaídas como reacción mientras cae, o como acción de otra manera. El paracaídas requiere al menos un cubo de 10 pies de espacio inocupado en el que desplegar, y no se abre lo suficientemente rápido para frenar una caída de menos de 60 pies. Si tiene tiempo y espacio suficiente para desplegarse correctamente, el paracaídas permite a su portador aterrizar sin sufrir daños. Una vez que se ha utilizado, el paracaídas tarda 10 minutos en volver a empaquetar.

item.name: Badge of the Watch
entries: A badge of the Watch is given only to those who have earned the trust of the Open Lord of Waterdeep. The badge, signifying the rank of captain in Waterdeep's City Watch, bears the emblem of Waterdeep and is meant to be worn or carried.
While wearing the badge, you gain a +2 bonus to AC if you aren't using a {@item shield|phb}.

If the badge is more than 5 feet away from you for more than 1 minute, it vanishes and harmlessly reappears on a surface within 5 feet of the Open Lord. While holding the badge, the Open Lord knows your location, provided the two of you are on the same plane of existence and your attunement to the badge hasn't ended.
As an action, the Open Lord can touch the badge and end your attunement to it.
entries_es: Una insignia del reloj se da sólo a aquellos que han ganado la confianza del Señor Abierto del Agua. La placa, que significa el rango de capitán en Waterdeep's City Watch, lleva el emblema de Waterdeep y está destinada a ser usado o llevado.
Mientras usas la placa, obtienes un bono +2 a AC si no estás usando un {@item shield|phb}.

Si la insignia está a más de 5 pies de distancia de usted por más de 1 minuto, desaparece y reaparece inofensivamente en una superficie a 5 pies del Señor Abierto. Mientras sostienen la insignia, el Señor Abierto conoce su ubicación, siempre que ustedes dos estén en el mismo plano de la existencia y su atontado a la insignia no ha terminado.
Como una acción, el Señor Abierto puede tocar la insignia y terminar su atontado a ella.

item.name: Bag of Beans
entries: Inside this heavy cloth bag are {@dice 3d4} dry beans. The bag weighs ½ pound plus ¼ pound for each bean it contains.

If you dump the bag's contents out on the ground, they explode in a 10-foot radius, extending from the beans. Each creature in the area, including you, must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d4} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

If you remove a bean from the bag, plant it in dirt or sand, and then water it, the bean produces an effect 1 minute later from the ground where it was planted. The DM can choose an effect from the following table, determine it randomly, or create an effect.

rows: {@dice 5d4} toadstools sprout. If a creature eats a toadstool, roll any die. On an odd roll, the eater must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 5d6} poison damage and become {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. On an even roll, the eater gains {@dice 5d6} temporary hit points for 1 hour.
A geyser erupts and spouts water, beer, berry juice, tea, vinegar, wine, or oil (DM's choice) 30 feet into the air for {@dice 1d12} rounds.
A {@creature treant} sprouts. There's a {@chance 50} chance that the treant is chaotic evil and attacks.

An animate, immobile stone statue in your likeness rises. It makes verbal threats against you. If you leave it and others come near, it describes you as the most heinous of villains and directs the newcomers to find and attack you. If you are on the same plane of existence as the statue, it knows where you are. The statue becomes inanimate after 24 hours.
A campfire with blue flames springs forth and burns for 24 hours (or until it is extinguished).
{@dice 1d6 + 6} {@creature shrieker||shriekers} sprout.

{@dice 1d4 + 8} bright pink toads crawl forth. Whenever a toad is touched, it transforms into a Large or smaller monster of the DM's choice. The monster remains for 1 minute, then disappears in a puff of bright pink smoke.
A hungry {@creature bulette} burrows up and attacks.

A fruit tree grows. It has {@dice 1d10 + 20} fruit, {@dice 1d8} of which act as randomly determined magic potions, while one acts as an ingested poison of the DM's choice. The tree vanishes after 1 hour. Picked fruit remains, retaining any magic for 30 days.

A nest of {@dice 1d4 + 3} eggs springs up. Any creature that eats an egg must make a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, a creature permanently increases its lowest ability score by 1, randomly choosing among equally low scores. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 10d6} force damage from an internal magical explosion.

A pyramid with a 60-foot-square base bursts upward. Inside is a sarcophagus containing a {@creature mummy lord}. The pyramid is treated as the {@creature mummy lord||mummy lord's} lair, and its sarcophagus contains treasure of the DM's choice.

A giant beanstalk sprouts, growing to a height of the DM's choice. The top leads where the DM chooses, such as to a great view, a {@creature cloud giant||cloud giant's} castle, or a different plane of existence.

El fuego enciende objetos inflamables en la zona que no están siendo usados o llevados.

item.name: Bag of Devouring
entries: This bag superficially resembles a {@item bag of holding} but is a feeding orifice for a gigantic extradimensional creature. Turning the bag inside out closes the orifice.

The extradimensional creature attached to the bag can sense whatever is placed inside the bag. Animal or vegetable matter placed wholly in the bag is devoured and lost forever. When part of a living creature is placed in the bag, as happens when someone reaches inside it, there is a {@chance 50} chance that the creature is pulled inside the bag. A creature inside the bag can use its action to try to escape with a successful {@dc 15} Strength check. Another creature can use its action to reach into the bag to pull a creature out, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Strength check (provided it isn't pulled inside the bag first). Any creature that starts its turn inside the bag is devoured, its body destroyed.

Inanimate objects can be stored in the bag, which can hold a cubic foot of such material. However, once each day, the bag swallows any objects inside it and spits them out into another plane of existence. The DM determines the time and plane.
If the bag is pierced or torn, it is destroyed, and anything contained within it is transported to a random location on the Astral Plane.
entries_es: Esta bolsa se asemeja superficialmente a {@item bag of holding} pero es un orificio de alimentación para una gigantesca criatura extradimensional. La vuelta de la bolsa dentro cierra el orificio.

La criatura extradimensional adjunta a la bolsa puede sentir lo que se coloca dentro de la bolsa. La materia animal o vegetal colocada totalmente en la bolsa es devorada y perdida para siempre. Cuando parte de una criatura viviente se coloca en la bolsa, como sucede cuando alguien llega dentro de ella, hay una posibilidad [[TAG0] que la criatura se tira dentro de la bolsa. Una criatura dentro de la bolsa puede usar su acción para intentar escapar con un éxito {@dc 15} Control de fuerza. Otra criatura puede usar su acción para llegar a la bolsa para sacar a una criatura, haciéndolo con un éxito {@dc 20} Comprobación de fuerza (siempre que no se tire dentro de la bolsa primero). Cualquier criatura que comience su turno dentro de la bolsa está devorada, su cuerpo destruido.

Los objetos inanimados se pueden almacenar en la bolsa, que puede contener un pie cúbico de dicho material. Sin embargo, una vez cada día, la bolsa traga objetos dentro de ella y los escupe hacia otro plano de existencia. El DM determina el tiempo y el avión.
Si la bolsa es perforada o desgarrada, es destruida, y cualquier cosa contenida dentro de ella es transportada a un lugar al azar en el Plano Astral.
