item.name: Bag of Holding
entries: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions, roughly 2 feet in diameter at the mouth and 4 feet deep. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 15 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires an action.

If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it ruptures and is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth, unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. Breathing creatures inside the bag can survive up to a number of minutes equal to 10 divided by the number of creatures (minimum 1 minute), after which time they begin to suffocate.

Placing a bag of holding inside an extradimensional space created by a {@item Heward's handy haversack}, {@item portable hole}, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 feet of the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.
entries_es: Esta bolsa tiene un espacio interior considerablemente mayor que sus dimensiones exteriores, aproximadamente 2 pies de diámetro en la boca y 4 pies de profundidad. La bolsa puede sostener hasta 500 libras, no exceder un volumen de 64 pies cúbicos. La bolsa pesa 15 libras, independientemente de su contenido. Recuperar un artículo de la bolsa requiere una acción.

Si la bolsa está sobrecargada, perforada o desgarrada, se rompe y se destruye, y su contenido se dispersa en el Plano Astral. Si la bolsa se apaga dentro, su contenido se derrame, sin dañar, pero la bolsa debe ser puesta justo antes de que pueda ser utilizado de nuevo. Las criaturas que respiran dentro de la bolsa pueden sobrevivir hasta un número de minutos igual a 10 divididos por el número de criaturas (mínimo 1 minuto), después de lo cual comienzan a sofocarse.

Colocar una bolsa de sostener dentro de un espacio extradimensional creado por un {@item Heward's handy haversack}, {@item portable hole}], o elemento similar destruye instantáneamente ambos elementos y abre una puerta al Plano Astral. La puerta se origina donde el único elemento fue colocado dentro del otro. Cualquier criatura dentro de 10 pies de la puerta es succionada a través de ella a un lugar aleatorio en el Plano Astral. La puerta se cierra. La puerta es de una sola dirección y no se puede reabrir.

item.name: Bag of Holding
entries: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions—roughly 2 feet square and 4 feet deep on the inside. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action.

If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. The bag holds enough air for 10 minutes of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a {@item Heward's Handy Haversack|XDMG}, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way and can't be reopened.
entries_es: Esta bolsa tiene un espacio interior considerablemente más grande que sus dimensiones exteriores, aproximadamente 2 pies cuadrados y 4 pies de profundidad en el interior. La bolsa puede sostener hasta 500 libras, no exceder un volumen de 64 pies cúbicos. La bolsa pesa 5 libras, independientemente de su contenido. Recuperar un artículo de la bolsa requiere una acción [[TAG0].

Si la bolsa está sobrecargada, perforada o desgarrada, se destruye, y su contenido se dispersa en el Plano Astral. Si la bolsa se apaga dentro, su contenido se derrame sin dañar, pero la bolsa debe ser puesta justo antes de que pueda ser utilizado de nuevo. La bolsa tiene suficiente aire durante 10 minutos de respiración, dividido por el número de criaturas respiratorias dentro.

Colocar una bolsa de retención dentro de un espacio extradimensional creado por un {@item Heward's Handy Haversack|XDMG}, Agujero portátil o artículo similar destruye instantáneamente ambos elementos y abre una puerta al Plano Astral. La puerta se origina donde el único elemento fue colocado dentro del otro. Cualquier criatura dentro de un radio de 10 pies {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centrado en la puerta es succionada a través de ella a un lugar al azar en el Plano Astral. La puerta se cierra. La puerta es de un solo camino y no se puede reabrir.

item.name: Bag of Tricks, Gray
entries: This ordinary bag, made from gray cloth, appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object.

You can use an action to pull the fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When the object lands, it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling a {@dice d8} and consulting the table. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it is reduced to 0 hit points.

The creature is friendly to you and your companions, and it acts on your turn. You can use a bonus action to command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, or to give it general orders, such as to attack your enemies. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature.
Once three fuzzy objects have been pulled from the bag, the bag can't be used again until the next dawn.

rows: {@creature Weasel}
{@creature Giant rat}
{@creature Badger}
{@creature Boar}
{@creature Panther}
{@creature Giant badger}
{@creature Dire wolf}
{@creature Giant elk}

entries_es: Esta bolsa ordinaria, hecha de tela gris, aparece vacía. Alcanzar dentro de la bolsa, sin embargo, revela la presencia de un objeto pequeño y borroso.

Puedes usar una acción para sacar el objeto borroso de la bolsa y tirarlo hasta 20 pies. Cuando el objeto aterriza, se transforma en una criatura que determinas rodando un {@dice d8} y consultando la tabla. La criatura desaparece en el siguiente amanecer o cuando se reduce a 0 puntos de éxito.

La criatura es amistosa contigo y tus compañeros, y actúa en tu turno. Usted puede utilizar una acción de bonificación para ordenar cómo se mueve la criatura y qué acción toma en su próximo turno, o para darle órdenes generales, como atacar a sus enemigos. En ausencia de tales órdenes, la criatura actúa de una manera apropiada a su naturaleza.
Una vez que tres objetos borrosos han sido sacados de la bolsa, la bolsa no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Balance Card
entries: As an action, you can brandish this card at one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself and drain its life force. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 4d8} necrotic damage. You then regain a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage the target takes. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn."
entries_es: Como acción, puedes marcar esta tarjeta a una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 30 pies de ti mismo y drenar su fuerza vital. El objetivo debe tener éxito en un {@dc 17} Constitución salvando la lanza o tomar {@damage 4d8} daño necrótico. Luego recuperas un número de puntos de éxito iguales al daño necroático que el objetivo toma. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer."

item.name: Balance of Harmony
entries: This scale bears celestial symbols on one pan and fiendish symbols on the other. You can use the scale to cast {@spell detect evil and good} as a ritual. Doing so requires you to place the scale on a solid surface, then sprinkle the pans with holy water or place a transparent gem worth 100 gp in each pan. The scale remains motionless if it detects nothing, tips to one side or the other for good (consecrated) or evil (desecrated), and fluctuates slightly if it detects a creature appropriate to the spell but neither good nor evil. By touching the scales after casting the ritual, you instantly learn any information the spell can normally convey, and then the effect ends.
entries_es: Esta escala lleva símbolos celestiales en una sartén y símbolos fidedignos en la otra. Puede utilizar la escala para fundir {@spell detect evil and good} como un ritual. Hacerlo requiere que coloque la escala en una superficie sólida, luego espolvoree las sartenes con agua bendita o coloque una gema transparente de 100 gp en cada sartén. La escala permanece inmóvil si no detecta nada, consejos a un lado o al otro para el bien (consacrado) o el mal (desecrado), y fluctúa ligeramente si detecta una criatura apropiada al hechizo, pero ni buena ni mala. Al tocar las escalas después de lanzar el ritual, usted aprende instantáneamente cualquier información que el hechizo puede transmitir normalmente, y luego el efecto termina.

item.name: Baleful Talon
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this hooked, obsidian dagger.

When you hit a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 19 or 20 on the attack roll, the creature must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw as the dagger flares with sickly light. The creature takes {@damage 6d6} necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, the creature disintegrates into dust.
entries_es: Ganas un bono +1 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con esta daga obsidiana enganchada.

Cuando golpeas a una criatura con este arma mágica y rodas un 19 o 20 en el rollo de ataque, la criatura debe hacer un {@dc 15} La Constitución salvando la lanza mientras la daga brilla con luz enferma. La criatura toma {@damage 6d6} daño necrótico en un ahorro fallido, o la mitad en uno exitoso. Si este daño reduce a la criatura a 0 puntos de impacto, la criatura se desintegra en polvo.

item.name: Ball Bearing
entries: Most commonly found inside a {@item Ball Bearings (Bag of 1,000)|phb|bag of ball bearings}.
entries_es: Más comúnmente encontrado en un [[TAG0].

item.name: Ball Bearings
entries: As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can spill Ball Bearings from their pouch. They spread to cover a level, 10-foot-square area within 10 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Ball Bearings.
entries_es: Como una acción {@action Utilize|XPHB}, puede derrapar los rodamientos de bolas de su bolsa. Se extendieron para cubrir un nivel, área de 10 pies cuadrados dentro de 10 pies de ti mismo. Una criatura que entra en esta área por primera vez en un giro debe tener éxito en un {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw o tener la condición [[TAG2]. Se tarda 10 minutos en recuperar los rodamientos de bolas.

item.name: Ball Bearings (bag of 1,000)
entries: As an action, you can spill these tiny metal balls from their pouch to cover a level area 10 feet square. A creature moving across the covered area must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. A creature moving through the area at half speed doesn't need to make the saving throw.
entries_es: Como acción, se puede derramar estas pequeñas bolas de metal de su bolsa para cubrir un área de nivel 10 pies cuadrados. Una criatura que cruza el área cubierta debe tener éxito en un {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition prone}. Una criatura que pasa por el área a media velocidad no necesita hacer el lanzamiento de ahorro.

item.name: Balloon Pack
entries: This backpack contains the spirit of an {@creature air elemental} and a compact leather balloon. While you're wearing the backpack, you can deploy the balloon as an action and gain the effect of the {@spell levitate} spell for 10 minutes, targeting yourself and requiring no {@status concentration}. Alternatively, you can use a reaction to deploy the balloon when you're falling and gain the effect of the {@spell feather fall} spell for yourself.

When either spell ends, the balloon slowly deflates as the elemental spirit escapes and returns to the Elemental Plane of Air. As the balloon deflates, you descend gently toward the ground for up to 60 feet. If you are still in the air at the end of this distance, you fall if you have no other means of staying aloft.
After the spirit departs, the backpack's property is unusable unless the backpack is recharged for 1 hour in an elemental air node, which binds another spirit to the backpack.
entries_es: Esta mochila contiene el espíritu de un {@creature air elemental} y un globo de cuero compacto. Mientras usted está usando la mochila, usted puede desplegar el globo como una acción y ganar el efecto del hechizo {@spell levitate} durante 10 minutos, apuntando a sí mismo y sin requerir {@status concentration}. Alternativamente, puede utilizar una reacción para desplegar el globo cuando está cayendo y ganar el efecto del hechizo {@spell feather fall} para usted mismo.

Cuando termina el hechizo, el globo se desinfla lentamente mientras el espíritu elemental escapa y regresa al Plano Elemental del Aire. A medida que el globo desinfla, descendes suavemente hacia el suelo por hasta 60 pies. Si usted todavía está en el aire al final de esta distancia, usted cae si no tiene otros medios de permanecer aloft.
Después de que el espíritu se vaya, la propiedad de la mochila es inutilizable a menos que la mochila sea recargada durante 1 hora en un nodo de aire elemental, que une otro espíritu a la mochila.

item.name: Banded Agate
entries: A translucent striped brown, blue, white, or red gemstone.
entries_es: Una gema marrón translúcida, azul, blanca o roja.

item.name: Banded Agate
entries: A striped brown, blue, white, or red gemstone.
entries_es: Una gema marrón rayada, azul, blanca o roja.

item.name: Banner of the Krig Rune
entries: Crafted from a thick, red fabric, this banner measures 5 feet high and 3 feet wide. The krig (war) rune is displayed on the fabric with round, metal plates sewn into it. It can be attached to a 10-foot pole to serve as a standard. Furling or unfurling the banner requires an action. The banner has the following properties.

entries.name: Mark of Courage
entries: As a bonus action, you can touch the unfurled banner and cause it to emanate courage. You and your allies are immune to the {@condition frightened} condition while within 20 feet of it. This benefit lasts for 10 minutes or until the banner is furled. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
entries_es: Como una acción de bonificación, usted puede tocar la bandera sin amueblar y hacer que emana el coraje. Usted y sus aliados son inmunes a la condición [[TAG0] mientras que a 20 pies de ella. Este beneficio dura 10 minutos o hasta que el banner se enfurece. Una vez que utilice esta propiedad, no puede utilizarla de nuevo hasta que termine un breve o largo descanso.

entries.name: Sentinel Standard
entries: You can see {@condition invisible} creatures while they are within 20 feet of the unfurled banner and within your line of sight.
entries_es: Usted puede ver [[TAG0] criaturas mientras que están a 20 pies de la bandera sin amueblar y dentro de su línea de visión.

entries.name: Standard's Shield
entries: As a bonus action, you can touch the unfurled banner and invoke this power. Any ranged attack roll that targets you or an ally of yours has disadvantage if the target is within 20 feet of the unfurled banner. This benefit lasts for 1 minute or until the banner is furled. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
entries_es: Como una acción de bonificación, puede tocar la bandera sin amueblar e invocar este poder. Cualquier rollo de ataque que te dirija o un aliado tuyo tiene desventaja si el objetivo está a menos de 20 pies de la bandera sin amueblar. Este beneficio dura 1 minuto o hasta que la bandera se enfurece. Una vez que utilice esta propiedad, no puede utilizarla de nuevo hasta que termine un breve o largo descanso.

entries.name: Gift of Battle
entries: You can transfer the banner's magic to a place by tracing the krig rune on the ground with your finger. The point where you trace it becomes the center of a spherical area of magic that has a 500-foot radius and that is fixed to the place. The transfer takes 8 hours of work that requires the banner to be within 5 feet of you and during which you choose creatures, creature types, or both that will benefit from the magic. At the end, the banner is destroyed, and the area gains the following property:
While in the 500-foot-radius sphere, the creatures you chose during the transfer process are immune to the {@condition frightened} condition and gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and AC.
entries_es: Puedes transferir la magia de la bandera a un lugar rastreando la runa de krig en el suelo con el dedo. El punto donde traza se convierte en el centro de una zona esférica de magia que tiene un radio de 500 pies y que se fija al lugar. La transferencia lleva 8 horas de trabajo que requiere que la bandera esté a 5 pies de ti y durante la cual eliges criaturas, tipos de criaturas, o ambas que se beneficiarán de la magia. Al final, la bandera es destruida, y el área gana la propiedad siguiente:

Mientras que en la esfera de 500 pies-radius, las criaturas que elegiste durante el proceso de transferencia son inmunes a la condición {@condition frightened} y ganan un bono +1 para atacar rollos y AC.

item.name: Barking Box
entries: This metal cube, 6 inches on a side, has a crank on top. Using an action to wind the crank activates the box for 8 hours. While activated, the box barks whenever it detects vibrations within 15 feet of it, as long as the box and the source of the vibrations are in contact with the same ground or substance. A switch on one side of the box sets the device to emit either a small dog's bark or a large dog's bark.
entries_es: Este cubo de metal, de 6 pulgadas a un lado, tiene una manivela encima. Usando una acción para enrollar la manivela activa la caja durante 8 horas. Mientras se activa, la caja ladra cada vez que detecta vibraciones dentro de 15 pies de ella, siempre y cuando la caja y la fuente de las vibraciones estén en contacto con el mismo suelo o sustancia. Un interruptor en un lado de la caja establece el dispositivo para emitir la corteza de un perro pequeño o la corteza de un perro grande.

item.name: Barrel
entries: A barrel can hold 40 gallons of liquid or 4 cubic feet of solids.
entries_es: Un barril puede contener 40 galones de líquido o 4 pies cúbicos de sólidos.

item.name: Barrel
entries: A Barrel holds up to 40 gallons of liquid or up to 4 cubic feet of dry goods.
entries_es: Un Barril tiene hasta 40 galones de líquido o hasta 4 pies cúbicos de productos secos.

item.name: Barrier Peaks Trinket
entries: At any point while the characters are searching through unusual equipment or detritus in the Monastery of the Distressed Body or the city of Daoine Gloine, roll on the following table to determine what they find. Each character finds one Barrier Peaks trinket over the course of the adventure.

entries.caption: Barrier Peaks Trinkets
rows: A handheld device containing a glowing green gem that darkens when no oxygen is present
A foot-long, egg-shaped object made from stitched leather
A black metal cylinder that dictates the history of an unknown plant or animal species when held
A cylindrical jar containing a pickled crustacean of unknown origin
A small thumb-button storage cylinder that releases a useless iron key when pressed
An unusual heraldic cloak pin that emits a short musical fanfare when tapped
A handheld tube that sucks in dust when squeezed and captures it in a detachable compartment
A scintillating disk of unknown material
A dial that can be twisted to slowly click back to its origin, whereupon it emits a loud ringing noise
A hovering, apple-sized orb of metal that follows you around
The {@condition petrified} cocoon of an unknown insect
A bronze gauntlet set with many slots, and which violently expels any object pressed into those slots
A box that plays an illusory message in an unknown language when opened
A rod that causes you to forget the last five minutes when you press a button near its tip
A palm-sized cylinder that emits a harmless ray of glowing blue light when squeezed
A bead that suppresses your hearing when secreted inside either ear, causing you to be {@condition deafened}
An amulet that displays your current health as a green bar above your head, with the bar retracting as your hit point total decreases
A casket containing one hundred tasteless blue pills that produce no discernible effect when swallowed
A metal mechanical puzzle with no apparent solution
A metal spinning top that never tips over when spun
Two strips of cloth-like material, each coated with a soft, hair-like fuzz on one side
A simple wire pyramid that preserves any foodstuffs it is placed over
A star chart labeled in an unknown script
A rectangle of black glass that displays indecipherable arcane runes when you swipe your finger across it
A schematic that shows the inner workings of an impossibly complex device
An odd pair of comfortable shoes made from supple, multicolored material
A mirror that makes you appear more beautiful when you tap your reflection
A mechanical metal puppy that playfully follows you around when activated
A talking bracelet that speaks only to correct your grammar
A bar of soap that can remove any stain
A journal in Common, written by someone in a world similar to but not quite the same as your own
A tub containing one serving of disgusting but nutritious goop that refills itself slowly over the course of one week
An instruction manual for activating a mysterious, world-destroying device
A small supple disk that displays weird moving symbols when placed over either eye
A tiny desk set with large, colorful buttons, each of which plays a discordant musical fanfare when pressed
A pair of tinted spectacles that reduce the glare of the sun when worn
An inflatable bedroll made from an unknown material, and which slowly deflates when used
A rod tipped with a blunt metal pincer whose grip can be adjusted by turning a screw
A battered helmet with a transparent orange visor that flips into place when donned
An animated map of a mysterious city that appears to be tracking the movements of five creatures
A cylinder of mist that holds your hair perfectly in shape when sprayed onto your head
A talking wand that tells you the name of any plant you point it at
A metal bracelet that displays the number of steps you've taken since your last long rest
A tiny handheld device that projects a glowing dot onto whatever you point it at
A rectangular piece of glass that displays a twelve-digit countdown on its surface
A wall chart of mysterious formulae arranged into a color-coded grid
A handheld device that solves any math problem you input using its buttons
A ball of speckled brown fur that appears to be alive
A complicated crystal board game that you don't know how to play
A large glass rectangle that displays a storm of black and white patterns when you press a button on its underside

item.name: Barrier Tattoo (Large)
entries: Produced by a special needle, this magic tattoo depicts protective imagery and uses ink that resembles liquid metal.

entries.name: Tattoo Attunement
entries: To attune to this item, you hold the needle to your skin where you want the tattoo to appear, pressing the needle there throughout the attunement process. When the attunement is complete, the needle turns into the ink that becomes the tattoo, which appears on the skin.
If your attunement to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes, and the needle reappears in your space.
entries_es: Para afinar a este artículo, usted sostiene la aguja a su piel donde desea que aparezca el tatuaje, presionando la aguja allí durante todo el proceso de atracción. Cuando el dispositivo está completo, la aguja se convierte en la tinta que se convierte en el tatuaje, que aparece en la piel.
Si su atontado al tatuaje termina, el tatuaje desaparece, y la aguja reaparece en su espacio.

entries.name: Protection
entries: While you aren't wearing armor, the tattoo grants you an Armor Class of 18. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.
entries_es: Mientras no llevas armadura, el tatuaje te otorga una clase de armadura de 18. Puedes usar un escudo y ganar este beneficio.

entries_es: Para afinar a este artículo, usted sostiene la aguja a su piel donde desea que aparezca el tatuaje, presionando la aguja allí durante todo el proceso de atracción. Cuando el dispositivo está completo, la aguja se convierte en la tinta que se convierte en el tatuaje, que aparece en la piel.
Si su atontado al tatuaje termina, el tatuaje desaparece, y la aguja reaparece en su espacio.

entries_es.name: Protection
entries: While you aren't wearing armor, the tattoo grants you an Armor Class of 12 + your dexterity bonus. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.
entries_es: Mientras no llevas armadura, el tatuaje te otorga una Clase Armor de 12 + tu bono de destreza. Puedes usar un escudo y ganar este beneficio.

item.name: Basic Fishing Equipment
entries: Basic Fishing Equipment includes a pole, a line, a hook, and either a lure or some bait.

Fishing is a popular pastime in Wildspace and the Astral Sea, though this activity isn't possible aboard a ship that is moving faster than its flying speed. At the end of each hour spent fishing, a character can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) check. A failed check indicates no fish is caught during that hour. On a successful check, roll a {@dice d10} and consult the Fishing table to determine the catch.

rows: Tiny, inedible fish (a creature that consumes it is poisoned for 1 hour)
Tiny, edible fish (feeds one person)
Small, edible fish (feeds up to four people)
Hostile {@creature space eel|BAM} (see {@book Boo's Astral Menagerie|BAM}; feeds up to twelve people)
Hostile {@creature gray scavver|BAM} (see {@book Boo's Astral Menagerie|BAM}; feeds up to twenty people), some other creature of the DM's choosing, or an Tiny object of the DM's choosing

entries_es: El equipo básico de pesca incluye un poste, una línea, un gancho, y una lure o algo de cebo.

La pesca es un pasatiempo popular en Wildspace y el Mar Astral, aunque esta actividad no es posible a bordo de un barco que se mueve más rápido que su velocidad de vuelo. Al final de cada hora de pesca gastada, un personaje puede hacer un cheque {@dc 15} de sabiduría ([TAG1]]). Un cheque fallido indica que no se pesca durante esa hora. En un cheque exitoso, rodar un {@dice d10} y consultar la tabla de pesca para determinar la captura.

item.name: Basic Poison
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can use a vial of Basic Poison to coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition. A creature that takes Piercing or Slashing damage from the poisoned weapon or ammunition takes an extra {@damage 1d4} Poison damage. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever comes first.
entries_es: Como un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, puede utilizar un frasco de veneno básico para cubrir un arma o hasta tres piezas de municiones. Una criatura que toma daño a Piercing o Slashing del arma envenenada o municiones toma un extra {@damage 1d4} Daño al veneno. Una vez aplicado, el veneno conserva potencia durante 1 minuto o hasta que se reparte su daño, lo que viene primero.

item.name: Basic Poison (vial)
entries: You can use the poison in this vial to coat one slashing or piercing weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition. Applying the poison takes an action. A creature hit by the poisoned weapon or ammunition must make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} poison damage. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute before drying.
entries_es: Puede usar el veneno en este frasco para recubrir un arma de corte o perforación o hasta tres piezas de municiones. Aplicar el veneno toma una acción. Una criatura golpeada por el arma envenenada o municiones debe hacer un {@dc 10} Constitución salvando la lanza o tomar {@damage 1d4} daño venenoso. Una vez aplicado, el veneno conserva potencia durante 1 minuto antes de secar.

item.name: Basket
entries: A basket holds 2 cubic feet or 40 pounds of gear.
entries_es: Una cesta tiene 2 pies cúbicos o 40 libras de engranaje.

item.name: Basket
entries: A Basket holds up to 40 pounds within 2 cubic feet.
entries_es: Una cesta tiene hasta 40 libras dentro de 2 pies cúbicos.

item.name: Battering Shield
entries: While holding this iron tower shield, you gain a +1 bonus to AC. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC.

Additionally, the shield has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. If you are holding the shield and push a creature within your reach at least 5 feet away, you can expend 1 charge to push that creature an additional 10 feet, knock it {@condition prone}, or both.
entries_es: Mientras sostiene este escudo de torre de hierro, usted gana un bono +1 a AC. Este bono es además del bono normal del escudo a AC.

Además, el escudo tiene 3 cargos, y recupera {@dice 1d3} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Si usted está sosteniendo el escudo y empujar a una criatura dentro de su alcance al menos 5 pies de distancia, usted puede gastar 1 carga para empujar a esa criatura 10 pies adicionales, golpearlo {@condition prone}, o ambos.

item.name: Battle Standard of Infernal Power
entries: This hell-forged battle standard is made of infernal iron and fitted with a small, unopenable cage containing a {@creature quasit}. The trapped {@creature quasit} is {@condition incapacitated}, and its cage has AC 19, 10 hit points, and immunity to all types of damage except force damage. If killed or somehow released, the {@creature quasit} disappears in a cloud of smoke, and a new one appears in the cage, provided the cage is intact.
While you hold the banner, your weapon attacks and those of all allied creatures within 300 feet of you count as magical for the purposes of overcoming damage immunities and resistances.
item.name_es: Nivel de batalla del poder infernal
entries_es: Este estándar de batalla forjado en el infierno está hecho de hierro infernal y equipado con una jaula pequeña y sin abrir que contenga un {@creature quasit}. El atrapado {@creature quasit} es {@condition incapacitated}, y su jaula tiene AC 19, 10 puntos de impacto, e inmunidad a todo tipo de daño excepto el daño de la fuerza. Si se mata o se libera de alguna manera, el {@creature quasit} desaparece en una nube de humo, y aparece una nueva en la jaula, siempre que la jaula esté intacta.
Mientras sostienes la bandera, tus ataques de armas y los de todas las criaturas aliadas a menos de 300 pies de ti cuentan como mágico para superar las inmunidades y resistencias del daño.

item.name: Bead of Force
entries: This small black sphere measures ¾ of an inch in diameter and weighs an ounce. Typically, {@dice 1d4 + 4} {@italic beads of force} are found together.

You can use an action to throw the bead up to 60 feet. The bead explodes on impact and is destroyed. Each creature within a 10-foot radius of where the bead landed must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 5d4} force damage. A sphere of transparent force then encloses the area for 1 minute. Any creature that failed the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside this sphere. Creatures that succeeded on the save, or are partially within the area, are pushed away from the center of the sphere until they are no longer inside it. Only breathable air can pass through the sphere's wall. No attack or other effect can.

An enclosed creature can use its action to push against the sphere's wall, moving the sphere up to half the creature's walking speed. The sphere can be picked up, and its magic causes it to weigh only 1 pound, regardless of the weight of creatures inside.
entries_es: Esta pequeña esfera negra mide 3⁄4 de pulgada de diámetro y pesa una onza. Típicamente, {@dice 1d4 + 4} {@italic beads of force} se encuentran juntos.

Puedes usar una acción para tirar la cuenta hasta 60 pies. La granada explota en el impacto y es destruida. Cada criatura dentro de un radio de 10 pies de donde la cuentas aterrizó debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 5d4} force damage. Una esfera de fuerza transparente cierra la zona durante 1 minuto. Cualquier criatura que fracasó el ahorro y está completamente dentro del área está atrapada dentro de esta esfera. Las criaturas que tuvieron éxito en el ahorro, o están parcialmente dentro del área, se alejan del centro de la esfera hasta que ya no están dentro de ella. Sólo el aire respirable puede pasar por la pared de la esfera. Ningún ataque u otro efecto puede.

Una criatura encerrada puede usar su acción para empujar contra la pared de la esfera, moviendo la esfera hasta la mitad de la velocidad de caminar de la criatura. La esfera se puede recoger, y su magia hace que pesa sólo 1 libra, independientemente del peso de las criaturas dentro.

item.name: Bead of Nourishment
entries: This flavorless, gelatinous bead dissolves on your tongue and provides as much nourishment as 1 day of Rations.
entries_es: Esta granada sin sabor, gelatina se disuelve en su lengua y proporciona tanto alimento como 1 día de Raciones.

item.name: Bead of Nourishment
entries: This spongy, flavorless, gelatinous bead dissolves on your tongue and provides as much nourishment as 1 day of rations.
entries_es: Esta bola esponjosa, sin sabor, gelatina se disuelve en su lengua y proporciona tanto alimento como 1 día de raciones.

item.name: Bead of Refreshment
entries: This flavorless, gelatinous bead dissolves in liquid, transforming up to a pint of the liquid into fresh, cold drinking water. The bead has no effect on magical liquids or harmful substances such as poison.
entries_es: Esta abeja sin sabor, gelatina se disuelve en líquido, transformando hasta una pinta del líquido en agua potable fresca y fría. La cuenta no tiene efecto en líquidos mágicos o sustancias nocivas como el veneno.

item.name: Bedroll
entries: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against {@hazard extreme cold|XDMG} (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}).
entries_es: Un Bedroll duerme una criatura pequeña o mediana. Mientras que en un Bedroll, usted tiene éxito automáticamente en los lanzamientos de ahorro contra {@hazard extreme cold|XDMG}] (ver {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}).

item.name: Belashyrra's Beholder Crown
entries: This symbiotic crown is carved from dark purple and mauve stone, with ten points like stalks set with gemstones resembling the eyestalks of a {@creature beholder}. To attune to this item, you must wear it on your head for the entire attunement period, during which the crown's hidden tendrils burrow into your scalp to bond with your skull.
While wearing the crown, you can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.

entries.name: Spells
entries: The crown has 10 charges. While wearing it, you can use an action to expend some of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it (spell save {@dc 16}): {@spell charm person} (1 charge), {@spell disintegrate} (6 charges), {@spell fear} (3 charges), {@spell finger of death} (7 charges), {@spell flesh to stone} (6 charges), {@spell hold person} (2 charges), {@spell ray of enfeeblement} (2 charges), {@spell sleep} (1 charge), {@spell slow} (3 charges), {@spell telekinesis} (5 charges).
The crown regains {@dice 1d6 + 3} expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: La corona tiene 10 cargos. Mientras lo lleva, puede utilizar una acción para exponer algunos de sus cargos para emitir uno de los siguientes hechizos de él (salvar la palabra {@dc 16}): {@spell charm person} (1 cargo), {@spell disintegrate} (6 cargos), {@spell fear} (3 cargos), {@spell finger of death} (7 cargos), {@spell flesh to stone} (6 cargos), [[2] [2 cargos]).
La corona recupera {@dice 1d6 + 3} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

entries.name: Symbiotic Nature
entries: The crown can't be removed from you while you're attuned to it, and you can't voluntarily end your attunement to it. If you're targeted by a spell that ends a curse, your attunement to the crown ends, and it detaches from you.
The daelkyr {@creature Belashyrra|ERLW} made these crowns. While on the same plane of existence as the crown, Belashyrra can see through its eyestalks.
entries_es: La corona no puede ser removida de ti mientras estás en sintonía con ella, y no puedes terminar voluntariamente tu attunement a ella. Si eres blanco de un hechizo que termina una maldición, tu atontado a la corona termina, y se separa de ti.
El daelkyr [[TAG0] hizo estas coronas. Mientras que en el mismo plano de la existencia como la corona, Belashyrra puede ver a través de sus ojostalks.

Mientras llevas la corona, puedes ver normalmente en la oscuridad, tanto mágica como no mágica, a una distancia de 120 pies.

item.name: Bell
entries: When rung as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, a Bell produces a sound that can be heard up to 60 feet away.
entries_es: Cuando el rang como una acción {@action Utilize|XPHB}, una Bell produce un sonido que se puede escuchar hasta 60 pies de distancia.

item.name: Bell Branch
entries: This silver implement is shaped like a tree branch and is strung with small golden bells. The branch is a spellcasting focus for your spells while you hold it.
The branch has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can use the charges in the following ways while holding it:

items: As a bonus action, you can expend 1 charge to detect the presence of aberrations, celestials, constructs, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead within 60 feet of you. If such creatures are present and don't have {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} from you, the bells ring softly, their tone indicating the creature types present.
As an action, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell protection from evil and good}.

entries_es: Este implemento plateado se forma como una rama del árbol y es strung con pequeñas campanas doradas. La rama es un foco de ortografía para tus hechizos mientras lo sostienes.
La rama tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Puede utilizar los cargos de las siguientes maneras mientras lo sostiene:

items: As a bonus action, you can expend 1 charge to detect the presence of aberrations, celestials, constructs, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead within 60 feet of you. If such creatures are present and don't have {@quickref Cover||3||total cover} from you, the bells ring softly, their tone indicating the creature types present.
As an action, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell protection from evil and good}.

item.name: Belt of Cloud Giant Strength
entries: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 27. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt's score.

item.name: Belt of Dwarvenkind
entries: While wearing this belt, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your Constitution score increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks made to interact with dwarves.

entries: In addition, while attuned to the belt, you have a {@chance 50} chance each day at dawn of growing a full beard if you're capable of growing one, or a visibly thicker beard if you already have one.
If you aren't a dwarf, you gain the following additional benefits while wearing the belt:

items: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.
You have {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet.
You can speak, read, and write Dwarvish.

item.name: Bigby's Beneficent Bracelet
entries: This gorgeous jewelry piece, crafted by the wizard Bigby himself, consists of four gold rings attached via delicate chains to a wrist cuff studded with sapphires and diamonds.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: The bracelet has the following random properties, determined by rolling on the appropriate table in the Dungeon Master's Guide:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property

entries_es: El brazalete tiene las siguientes propiedades al azar, determinadas por rodar en la tabla apropiada en la Guía del Maestro de Dungeon:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property

entries.name: Dexterous Fingers
entries: While wearing the bracelet, you can cast {@spell mage hand}.
entries_es: Mientras llevas el brazalete, puedes echar {@spell mage hand}.

entries.name: Force Sculpture
entries: By focusing and channeling the bracelet's magic for 1 minute, you can create a spectral copy of a Large or smaller nonmagical object. The copy appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you, and it is made of tangible but translucent force that mimics the size, weight, and other properties of the object it's copying. The copy must appear on a surface or liquid that can support it. Creatures can touch and interact with the copy as if it were a nonmagical object.
The copy is immune to all damage and can't be dispelled, but a {@spell disintegrate} spell destroys it immediately. Otherwise, the copy disappears after 8 hours or when you dismiss it as an action.
The bracelet can create up to three copies and regains all expended uses at dawn.
entries_es: Al enfocar y canalizar la magia de la pulsera durante 1 minuto, puede crear una copia espectral de un objeto no mágico grande o menor. La copia aparece en un espacio no ocupado dentro de 10 pies de usted, y está hecha de fuerza tangible pero translúcida que imita el tamaño, el peso y otras propiedades del objeto que está copiando. La copia debe aparecer en una superficie o líquido que pueda soportarla. Las criaturas pueden tocar e interactuar con la copia como si fuera un objeto no mágico.

La copia es inmune a todos los daños y no puede ser disipada, pero un hechizo [[TAG0] la destruye inmediatamente. De lo contrario, la copia desaparece después de 8 horas o cuando la desestima como una acción.
El brazalete puede crear hasta tres copias y recuperar todos los usos gastados al amanecer.

entries.name: Helpful Hand
entries: As an action, you can use the bracelet to cast {@spell Bigby's hand} as a 9th-level spell (spell attack bonus +13). When you cast the spell this way, the spell doesn't require {@status concentration}. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Como acción, puede utilizar el brazalete para fundir {@spell Bigby's hand} como un hechizo de 9o nivel (bono de ataque de alta +13). Cuando usted lanza el hechizo de esta manera, el hechizo no requiere {@status concentration}. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.
Esta hermosa pieza de joyería, elaborada por el mago Bigby mismo, consta de cuatro anillos de oro unidos a través de delicadas cadenas a un manguito de muñeca atornillado con zafiros y diamantes.

item.name: Biza's Breath
entries: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. The {@condition poisoned} creature must use its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no other creature within its reach, the {@condition poisoned} creature does nothing on its turn. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
entries_es: Una criatura sometida a este veneno debe tener éxito en un {@dc 16} Constitución ahorrando lanzamiento o convirtiéndose {@condition poisoned} por 1 minuto. La criatura {@condition poisoned} debe utilizar su acción para hacer un simple ataque contra una criatura determinada aleatoriamente a su alcance. Si no hay otra criatura a su alcance, la criatura [[TAG1] no hace nada a su turno. La criatura puede repetir el lanzamiento de ahorro al final de cada uno de sus turnos, terminando el efecto sobre sí mismo en un éxito.

item.name: Black Crystal Tablet
item.reqAttune: by a creature that has proficiency in the {@skill Arcana} skill
entries: Any creature that attunes to the tablet must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw at the end of its next long rest. On a failed save, the creature becomes afflicted with a random form of long-term madness (see "{@book Madness|dmg|8|Madness}" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}).

As an action, a creature attuned to the Black Crystal Tablet can use it to cast {@spell eyebite} or {@spell gate} (the portal created by this spell links to the Far Realm only). After the tablet is used to cast a spell, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Cualquier criatura que attunes a la tableta debe hacer un {@dc 20} Sabiduría ahorrando el tiro al final de su próximo descanso largo. En un fallido ahorro, la criatura se aflige con una forma aleatoria de locura a largo plazo (ver "[TAG1]]" en el capítulo 8 del {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}).

Como acción, una criatura afinada a la Tabla de Cristal Negro puede utilizarla para fundir {@spell eyebite}] o {@spell gate} (el portal creado por este hechizo vincula al Reino Extremo solamente). Después de que la tableta se utiliza para lanzar un hechizo, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Black Dragon Mask
entries: This horned mask of glossy ebony has horns and a skull-like mien. The mask reshapes to fit a wearer attuned to it. While you are wearing the mask and attuned to it, you can access the following properties.

entries.name: Damage Absorption
entries: You have resistance to acid damage. If you already have damage resistance to acid from another source, you gain immunity to acid damage. If you already have immunity to acid damage from another source, you regain hit points equal to half of any acid damage you are dealt.
entries_es: Usted tiene resistencia al daño ácido. Si usted ya tiene resistencia al ácido de otra fuente, usted gana inmunidad al daño ácido. Si usted ya tiene inmunidad para el daño ácido de otra fuente, usted recupera puntos de éxito igual a la mitad de cualquier daño ácido que se trata.

entries.name: Draconic Majesty
entries: While you are wearing no armor, you can add your Charisma bonus to your Armor Class.
entries_es: Mientras no llevas armadura, puedes añadir tu bono de Charisma a tu Clase Armor.

entries.name: Dragon Breath
entries: If you have a breath weapon that requires rest to recharge, it gains a recharge of 6.
entries_es: Si usted tiene un arma respiratoria que requiere descanso para recargar, gana una recarga de 6.

entries.name: Dragon Sight
entries: You gain {@sense darkvision} with a radius of 60 feet, or an additional 60 feet of {@sense darkvision} if you already have that sense. Once per day, you can gain {@sense blindsight} out to a range of 30 feet for 5 minutes.
entries_es: Usted gana {@sense darkvision} con un radio de 60 pies, o un adicional de 60 pies de {@sense darkvision} si usted ya tiene ese sentido. Una vez por día, puede ganar {@sense blindsight} a una gama de 30 pies por 5 minutos.

entries.name: Dragon Tongue
entries: You can speak and understand Draconic. You also have advantage on any Charisma check you make against Black dragons.
entries_es: Puedes hablar y entender Draconic. También tienes ventaja en cualquier cheque de Charisma que hagas contra los dragones negros.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: (1/Day) If you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.
entries_es: (1/Día) Si falla un tiro de ahorro, puede elegir tener éxito en su lugar.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: You can breathe underwater.
entries_es: Puedes respirar bajo el agua.

item.name: Black Dragon Scale Mail
entries: Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids. Other times, hunters carefully skin and preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, dragon scale mail is highly valued. While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, you have advantage on saving throws against the Frightful Presence and breath weapons of dragons, and you have resistance to acid damage.

Additionally, you can focus your senses as an action to magically discern the distance and direction to the closest black dragon within 30 miles of you. This special action can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: El correo de escala de dragón está hecho de las escalas de un tipo de dragón. A veces los dragones recogen sus escamas desechables y les dan a los humanoides. Otras veces, los cazadores se pellejan cuidadosamente y preservan el escondite de un dragón muerto. En cualquier caso, el correo de escala de dragón es altamente valorado. Al usar esta armadura, usted gana un bono +1 a AC, usted tiene ventaja en el ahorro de tiros contra la presencia justa y las armas de aliento de los dragones, y usted tiene resistencia al daño ácido.

Además, usted puede enfocar sus sentidos como una acción para discernir mágicamente la distancia y dirección al dragón negro más cercano dentro de 30 millas de usted. Esta acción especial no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Black Ghost Orchid Seed
entries: Every few years, a ghost orchid colony grows a black pod as thick as a human fist that holds three soft, black seeds. A creature that consumes one of these black seeds is affected by the spell {@spell feign death}. If the creature is unaware of the pod's effects or does not wish to be affected, it can resist the effect by succeeding on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw. Otherwise, it is considered to be a willing recipient of the spell.
item.name_es: Semilla de la orquídea del fantasma negro
entries_es: Cada pocos años, una colonia de orquídeas fantasma crece una cápsula negra tan gruesa como un puño humano que sostiene tres semillas negras y suaves. Una criatura que consume una de estas semillas negras se ve afectada por el hechizo {@spell feign death}. Si la criatura no tiene conocimiento de los efectos de la cápsula o no desea ser afectada, puede resistir el efecto al tener éxito en un {@dc 16} La Constitución salvando el tiro. De lo contrario, se considera un receptor dispuesto del hechizo.

item.name: Black Sap
entries: This tarry substance harvested from the dark boughs of the death's head willow is a powerful intoxicant. It can be smoked as a concentrate or injected directly into the bloodstream. A creature subjected to a dose of black sap cannot be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} for {@dice 1d6} hours.

For each dose of black sap consumed, a creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for {@dice 2d4} hours—an effect that is cumulative with multiple doses.
entries_es: Esta sustancia de la cizaña cosechada de las ramas oscuras del sauce de la cabeza de la muerte es un poderoso intoxicante. Se puede fumar como concentrado o inyectado directamente en el torrente sanguíneo. Una criatura sometida a una dosis de savia negra no puede ser {@condition charmed} o {@condition frightened} por {@dice 1d6} horas.

Para cada dosis de savia negra consumida, una criatura debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15} El ahorro de la Constitución arroja o se convierte en {@condition poisoned} para {@dice 2d4} horas—un efecto acumulativo con múltiples dosis.

item.name: Blackrazor
item.reqAttune: by a creature of non-lawful alignment
entries: Hidden in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain, Blackrazor shines like a piece of night sky filled with stars. Its black scabbard is decorated with pieces of cut obsidian.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the following additional properties.

entries.name: Devour Soul
entries: Whenever you use it to reduce a creature to 0 hit points, the sword slays the creature and devours its soul, unless it is a construct or an undead. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Blackrazor can be restored to life only by a {@spell wish} spell.

When it devours a soul, Blackrazor grants you temporary hit points equal to the slain creature's hit point maximum. These hit points fade after 24 hours. As long as these temporary hit points last and you keep Blackrazor in hand, you have advantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks.

If you hit an undead with this weapon, you take {@damage 1d10} necrotic damage and the target regains {@dice 1d10} hit points. If this necrotic damage reduces you to 0 hit points, Blackrazor devours your soul.
entries_es: Cada vez que lo usas para reducir una criatura a 0 puntos de impacto, la espada mata a la criatura y devora su alma, a menos que sea una construcción o un no muerto. Una criatura cuyo alma ha sido devorada por Blackrazor puede ser restaurada a la vida sólo por un hechizo {@spell wish}.

Cuando devora un alma, Blackrazor te otorga puntos de éxito temporales iguales al máximo de la criatura muerta. Estos puntos de éxito se desvanecen después de 24 horas. Mientras estos puntos de éxito temporales duren y mantengas a Blackrazor en la mano, tienes ventaja en los rollos de ataque, ahorrando lanzamientos y cheques de habilidad.

Si usted golpeó a un no muerto con este arma, usted toma {@damage 1d10} daño necrotico y el objetivo recupera [[TAG1] puntos de éxito. Si este daño necrótico te reduce a 0 puntos de impacto, Blackrazor devora tu alma.

entries.name: Soul Hunter
entries: While you hold the weapon. you are aware of the presence of Tiny or larger creatures within 60 feet of you that aren't constructs or undead. You also can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.
Blackrazor can cast the {@spell haste} spell on you once per day. It decides when to cast the spell and maintains {@status concentration} on it so that you don't have to.
entries_es: Mientras sostienes el arma. usted es consciente de la presencia de criaturas pequeñas o grandes a menos de 60 pies de usted que no son construcciones o no están muertos. Tampoco puede ser {@condition charmed} o {@condition frightened}.
Blackrazor puede lanzar el hechizo [[TAG0] en usted una vez al día. Decide cuándo lanzar el hechizo y mantiene {@status concentration} en él para que no tengas que hacerlo.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Blackrazor is a sentient chaotic neutral weapon with an Intelligence of 17, a Wisdom of 10, and a Charisma of 19. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.

The weapon can speak, read, and understand Common, and can communicate with its wielder telepathically. Its voice is deep and echoing. While you are attuned to it, Blackrazor also understands every language you know.
entries_es: Blackrazor es un arma caótica sensible neutral con una inteligencia de 17, una sabiduría de 10, y una carisma de 19. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.

El arma puede hablar, leer y entender Común, y puede comunicarse con su wielder telepáticamente. Su voz es profunda y resonante. Mientras estás al tanto de ello, Blackrazor también entiende cada idioma que conoces.

entries.name: Personality
entries: Blackrazor speaks with an imperious tone, as though accustomed to being obeyed.

The sword's purpose is to consume souls. It doesn't care whose souls it eats, including the wielder's. The sword believes that all matter and energy sprang from a void of negative energy and will one day return to it. Blackrazor is meant to hurry that process along.

Despite its nihilism, Blackrazor feels a strange kinship to {@item Wave} and {@item Whelm}, two other weapons locked away under White Plume Mountain. It wants the three weapons to be united again and wielded together in combat, even though it violently disagrees with {@item Whelm} and finds {@item Wave} tedious.

Ganas un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma mágica. Tiene las siguientes propiedades adicionales.

entries_es.name: Devour Soul
entries: Whenever you use it to reduce a creature to 0 hit points, the sword slays the creature and devours its soul, unless it is a construct or an undead. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Blackrazor can be restored to life only by a {@spell wish} spell.

When it devours a soul, Blackrazor grants you temporary hit points equal to the slain creature's hit point maximum. These hit points fade after 24 hours. As long as these temporary hit points last and you keep Blackrazor in hand, you have advantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks.

If you hit an undead with this weapon, you take {@damage 1d10} necrotic damage and the target regains {@dice 1d10} hit points. If this necrotic damage reduces you to 0 hit points, Blackrazor devours your soul.
entries_es: Cada vez que lo usas para reducir una criatura a 0 puntos de impacto, la espada mata a la criatura y devora su alma, a menos que sea una construcción o un no muerto. Una criatura cuyo alma ha sido devorada por Blackrazor puede ser restaurada a la vida sólo por un hechizo {@spell wish}.

Cuando devora un alma, Blackrazor te otorga puntos de éxito temporales iguales al máximo de la criatura muerta. Estos puntos de éxito se desvanecen después de 24 horas. Mientras estos puntos de éxito temporales duren y mantengas a Blackrazor en la mano, tienes ventaja en los rollos de ataque, ahorrando lanzamientos y cheques de habilidad.

Si usted golpeó a un no muerto con este arma, usted toma {@damage 1d10} daño necrotico y el objetivo recupera [[TAG1] puntos de éxito. Si este daño necrótico te reduce a 0 puntos de impacto, Blackrazor devora tu alma.

entries_es.name: Soul Hunter
entries: While you hold the weapon. you are aware of the presence of Tiny or larger creatures within 60 feet of you that aren't constructs or undead. You also can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}.
Blackrazor can cast the {@spell haste} spell on you once per day. It decides when to cast the spell and maintains {@status concentration} on it so that you don't have to.
entries_es: Mientras sostienes el arma. usted es consciente de la presencia de criaturas pequeñas o grandes a menos de 60 pies de usted que no son construcciones o no están muertos. Tampoco puede ser {@condition charmed} o {@condition frightened}.
Blackrazor puede lanzar el hechizo [[TAG0] en usted una vez al día. Decide cuándo lanzar el hechizo y mantiene {@status concentration} en él para que no tengas que hacerlo.

entries_es.name: Sentience
entries: Blackrazor is a sentient chaotic neutral weapon with an Intelligence of 17, a Wisdom of 10, and a Charisma of 19. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.

The weapon can speak, read, and understand Common, and can communicate with its wielder telepathically. Its voice is deep and echoing. While you are attuned to it, Blackrazor also understands every language you know.
entries_es: Blackrazor es un arma caótica sensible neutral con una inteligencia de 17, una sabiduría de 10, y una carisma de 19. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.

El arma puede hablar, leer y entender Común, y puede comunicarse con su wielder telepáticamente. Su voz es profunda y resonante. Mientras estás al tanto de ello, Blackrazor también entiende cada idioma que conoces.

entries_es.name: Personality
entries: Blackrazor speaks with an imperious tone, as though accustomed to being obeyed.

The sword's purpose is to consume souls. It doesn't care whose souls it eats, including the wielder's. The sword believes that all matter and energy sprang from a void of negative energy and will one day return to it. Blackrazor is meant to hurry that process along.

Despite its nihilism, Blackrazor feels a strange kinship to {@item Wave} and {@item Whelm}, two other weapons locked away under White Plume Mountain. item.name: Blackrazor
entries: Hidden in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain, Blackrazor shines like a piece of night sky filled with stars. Its black scabbard is decorated with pieces of cut obsidian.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. If you hit an Undead with this weapon, you take {@damage 1d10} Necrotic damage, and the target regains {@dice 1d10} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. If this Necrotic damage reduces you to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, Blackrazor devours your soul (see "Devour Soul" below).

While you hold this weapon, you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions, and you have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 30 feet.

entries.name: Devour Soul
entries: Whenever you use Blackrazor to reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the sword slays the creature and devours its soul unless it is a Construct or an Undead. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Blackrazor can be restored to life only by a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.
When Blackrazor devours a soul that isn't yours, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the slain creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum.

Una criatura cuyo alma ha sido devorada por Blackrazor puede ser restaurada a la vida sólo por un hechizo {@spell Wish|XPHB}.
Cuando Blackrazor devora un alma que no es tuya, ganas {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} igual al máximo de la criatura muerta [[TAG1].

entries.name: Haste
entries: Blackrazor can cast {@spell Haste|XPHB} on you, after which it can't cast this spell again until the next dawn. Blackrazor decides when to cast the spell, which takes effect at the start of your turn. The spell lasts for 1 minute (no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required) or until Blackrazor decides to end it, which it can do at the end of any of your turns.
entries_es: Blackrazor puede lanzar {@spell Haste|XPHB} sobre usted, después de lo cual no puede volver a lanzar este hechizo hasta el siguiente amanecer. Blackrazor decide cuándo lanzar el hechizo, que tiene efecto al comienzo de su turno. El hechizo dura 1 minuto (no {@status Concentration|XPHB}) o hasta que Blackrazor decida terminarlo, que puede hacer al final de cualquiera de sus turnos.

entries: Blackrazor can be destroyed by crushing it in the great gears of Mechanus. Primus, the creator of the modrons, also knows a series of musical tones that Blackrazor can't stand to hear, causing the sword to shatter.
entries_es: Blackrazor se puede destruir aplastando en los grandes engranajes de Mechanus. Primus, el creador de los modrons, también conoce una serie de tonos musicales que Blackrazor no puede soportar escuchar, provocando que la espada se rompa.
