item.name: Blackstaff
item.reqAttune: by the Blackstaff heir, who must be a wizard
entries: The Blackstaff is a sentient, rune-carved staff set with thin silver veins. It is the symbol of office for the Blackstaff, the highest-ranking wizard in Waterdeep. As the rightful owner of the Blackstaff, Vajra Safahr is the only one who can become attuned to it. The staff can, however, choose a new owner (see "Personality" below).

This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls.

The staff has 20 charges for the following properties. The staff regains {@dice 2d8 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack and damage roll but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regain {@dice 1d8 + 2} charges.

entries.name: Power Strike
entries: When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage to the target.
entries_es: Cuando usted golpeó con un ataque de melee usando el personal, usted puede gastar 1 carga para tratar un daño adicional [[TAG0] fuerza al objetivo.

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding this staff, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and spell attack bonus: {@spell cone of cold} (5 charges), {@spell fireball} (5th-level version, 5 charges), {@spell globe of invulnerability} (6 charges), {@spell hold monster} (5 charges), {@spell levitate} (2 charges), {@spell lightning bolt} (5th-level version, 5 charges), {@spell magic missile} (1 charge), {@spell ray of enfeeblement} (1 charge), or {@spell wall of force} (5 charges).
entries_es: Mientras mantiene a este personal, puede utilizar una acción para exponer 1 o más de sus cargos para lanzar uno de los siguientes hechizos de él, utilizando su bonificación de ahorro de hechizos DC y de ataque de hechizos: [[TAG0] (5 cargos), {@spell fireball} [versión de 5o nivel, 5o cargo]] [ [TAG2]]] (6 cargos), {@spell levitate}]

entries.name: Retributive Strike
entries: You can use an action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface, performing a retributive strike. The staff is destroyed and releases its remaining magic in an explosion that expands to fill a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on it.

You have a {@chance 50} chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take force damage equal to 16 × the number of charges in the staff. Every other creature in the area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes an amount of damage based on how far away it is from the point of origin, as shown in the following table. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

rows: 10 ft. away or closer
8 × the number of charges in the staff
11 to 20 ft. away
6 × the number of charges in the staff
21 to 30 ft. away
4 × the number of charges in the staff

entries_es: Usted puede utilizar una acción para romper el personal sobre su rodilla o contra una superficie sólida, realizando una huelga retributiva. El personal es destruido y libera su magia restante en una explosión que se expande para llenar una esfera de 30 pies-radius centrada en ella.

Usted tiene una [[TAG0] oportunidad de viajar al instante a un plano de existencia aleatorio, evitando la explosión. Si usted no evita el efecto, usted toma la fuerza daño igual a 16 × el número de cargos en el personal. Cada otra criatura en el área debe hacer un {@dc 17} Un lanzamiento de ahorro de destreza. En un ahorro fallido, una criatura toma una cantidad de daño basado en lo lejos que está desde el punto de origen, como se muestra en la tabla siguiente. En un ahorro exitoso, una criatura toma la mitad de daño.

rows: 10 ft. away or closer
8 × the number of charges in the staff
11 to 20 ft. away
6 × the number of charges in the staff
21 to 30 ft. away
4 × the number of charges in the staff

entries.name: Animate Walking Statues
entries: You can expend 1 or more of the staff's charges as an action to animate or deactivate one or more of the {@creature walking statue of Waterdeep|wdh|walking statues of Waterdeep}. You must be in the city to use this property, and you can animate or deactivate one statue for each charge expended. An animated statue obeys the telepathic commands of Khelben Arunsun's spirit, which is trapped inside the staff (see "Personality" below). A walking statue becomes inanimate if deactivated or if the staff is broken.
entries_es: Usted puede gastar 1 o más de los cargos del personal como una acción para animar o desactivar uno o más de {@creature walking statue of Waterdeep|wdh|walking statues of Waterdeep}. Usted debe estar en la ciudad para utilizar esta propiedad, y puede animar o desactivar una estatua por cada cargo gastado. Una estatua animada obedece los comandos telepáticos del espíritu de Khelben Arunsun, que está atrapado dentro del personal (ver "Personalidad" abajo). Una estatua caminando se vuelve inanimada si se desactiva o si el personal está roto.

entries.name: Dispel Magic
entries: You can expend 1 of the staff's charges as a bonus action to cast {@spell dispel magic} on a creature, an object, or a magical effect that you touch with the tip of the staff. If the target is an unwilling creature or an object in the possession of such a creature, you must hit the creature with a melee attack using the Blackstaff before you can expend the charge to cast the spell.
entries_es: Usted puede gastar 1 de los cargos del personal como una acción de bonificación para lanzar {@spell dispel magic} en una criatura, un objeto, o un efecto mágico que usted toca con la punta del personal. Si el objetivo es una criatura no voluntaria o un objeto en posesión de tal criatura, usted debe golpear a la criatura con un ataque de melee usando el Blackstaff antes de que usted pueda expulsar la carga para lanzar el hechizo.

entries.name: Drain Magic
entries: This property affects only creatures that use spell slots. When you hit such a creature with a melee attack using the Blackstaff, you can expend 1 of the staff's charges as a bonus action, causing the target to expend one spell slot of the highest spell level it can cast without casting a spell. If the target has already expended all its spell slots, nothing happens. Spell slots that are expended in this fashion are regained when the target finishes a long rest, as normal.
entries_es: Esta propiedad afecta sólo a criaturas que usan ranuras de hechizo. Cuando golpeas a una criatura con un ataque de melee usando el Blackstaff, puedes gastar 1 de los cargos del personal como una acción de bonificación, causando que el objetivo de expulsar una ranura de hechizo del nivel de hechizo más alto que puede lanzar sin lanzar un hechizo. Si el objetivo ya ha gastado todas sus ranuras de hechizo, nada sucede. Las ranuras de recambio que se gastan en esta moda se recuperan cuando el objetivo termina un descanso largo, como normal.

entries.name: Master of Enchantment
entries: When you cast an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher while holding the staff, you can make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check with a DC of 10 + the level of the spell. If the check succeeds, you cast the spell without expending a spell slot.
entries_es: Cuando usted lanza un hechizo de encantamiento de primer nivel o superior mientras mantiene el personal, usted puede hacer un control de inteligencia ([TAG0]) con un DC de 10 + el nivel del hechizo. Si el cheque tiene éxito, usted lanza el hechizo sin gastar una ranura de hechizo.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: The Blackstaff is a sentient staff of neutral alignment, with an Intelligence of 22, a Wisdom of 15, and a Charisma of 18. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet, and it can communicate telepathically with any creature that is holding it.
entries_es: El Blackstaff es un personal sensible de alineación neutral, con una Inteligencia de 22, una Sabiduría de 15, y una Charisma de 18. Tiene audiencia y {@sense darkvision} a una gama de 120 pies, y puede comunicarse telepáticamente con cualquier criatura que la sostiene.

entries.name: Personality
entries: The staff has the spirits of all previous Blackstaffs trapped within it. Its creator, Khelben Arunsun, is the dominant personality among them. Like Khelben, the staff is extremely devious and manipulative. It prefers to counsel its owner without exerting outright control. The staff's primary goal is to protect Waterdeep and its Open Lord, currently Laeral Silverhand. Its secondary goal is to help its wielder become more powerful.

In the event that the holder of the office of the Blackstaff no longer serves the staff's wishes, the staff ceases to function until it finds a worthy inheritor—someone whose loyalty to Waterdeep is beyond reproach.
entries_es: El personal tiene los espíritus de todos los Blackstaffs anteriores atrapados dentro de él. Su creador, Khelben Arunsun, es la personalidad dominante entre ellos. Como Khelben, el personal es extremadamente delicado y manipulador. Prefiere aconsejar a su propietario sin ejercer un control directo. El objetivo principal del personal es proteger Waterdeep y su Señor Abierto, actualmente Laeral Silverhand. Su objetivo secundario es ayudar a que su wielder se vuelva más poderoso.

En el caso de que el titular de la oficina de Blackstaff ya no sirva a los deseos del personal, el personal deja de funcionar hasta que encuentre a un heredero digno —alguien cuya lealtad a Waterdeep está más allá del reproche.

entries.name: Spirit Trap
entries: When the Blackstaff dies, the spirit of that individual becomes trapped in the staff along with the spirits of the previous Blackstaffs. (A Blackstaff whose spirit is trapped in the staff can't be raised from the dead.)

Destroying the staff would release the spirits trapped inside it, but in that event, Khelben's spirit can lodge itself inside any one piece of the staff that remains. The piece containing Khelben's spirit has the staff's Sentience property but none of its other properties. As long as this piece of the staff exists, Khelben's spirit can make the staff whole again whenever he wishes. When the staff is remade, the spirits of the previous Blackstaffs become trapped inside it again.
entries_es: Cuando el Blackstaff muere, el espíritu de ese individuo se queda atrapado en el personal junto con los espíritus de los Blackstaffs anteriores. (Un Blackstaff cuyo espíritu está atrapado en el personal no puede ser levantado de los muertos.)

Destruir al personal liberaría a los espíritus atrapados dentro de él, pero en ese caso, el espíritu de Khelben puede alojarse dentro de cualquier pieza del personal que permanece. La pieza que contiene el espíritu de Khelben tiene la propiedad Sentience del personal pero ninguna de sus otras propiedades. Mientras exista esta pieza del personal, el espíritu de Khelben puede hacer que el personal esté completo de nuevo cuando lo desee. Cuando el personal es rehecho, los espíritus de los Blackstaffs anteriores se vuelven atrapados dentro de él otra vez.

El Blackstaff es un personal sensible y tallado con venas de plata finas. Es el símbolo de la oficina para el Blackstaff, el mago de mayor rango en Waterdeep. Como el propietario legítimo del Blackstaff, Vajra Safahr es el único que puede llegar a ser atendida. El personal puede, sin embargo, elegir un nuevo propietario (ver "Personalidad" abajo).

Este personal puede ser manipulado como un quarterstaff mágico que otorga un bono +2 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con él. Mientras lo sostienes, obtienes un bono +2 a Armor Class, ahorrando lanzamientos y rollos de ataque de hechizo.

El personal tiene 20 cargos por las siguientes propiedades. El personal recupera {@dice 2d8 + 4} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Si usted expulsa el último cargo, enrolle un {@dice d20}. En un 1, el personal conserva su bono +2 para atacar y dañar rollo, pero pierde todas las demás propiedades. A los 20, el personal recupera los cargos {@dice 1d8 + 2}.

entries_es.name: Power Strike
entries: When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage to the target.
entries_es: Cuando usted golpeó con un ataque de melee usando el personal, usted puede gastar 1 carga para tratar un daño adicional [[TAG0] fuerza al objetivo.

entries_es.name: Spells
entries: While holding this staff, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and spell attack bonus: {@spell cone of cold} (5 charges), {@spell fireball} (5th-level version, 5 charges), {@spell globe of invulnerability} (6 charges), {@spell hold monster} (5 charges), {@spell levitate} (2 charges), {@spell lightning bolt} (5th-level version, 5 charges), {@spell magic missile} (1 charge), {@spell ray of enfeeblement} (1 charge), or {@spell wall of force} (5 charges).
entries_es: Mientras mantiene a este personal, puede utilizar una acción para exponer 1 o más de sus cargos para lanzar uno de los siguientes hechizos de él, utilizando su bonificación de ahorro de hechizos DC y de ataque de hechizos: [[TAG0] (5 cargos), {@spell fireball} [versión de 5o nivel, 5o cargo]] [ [TAG2]]] (6 cargos), {@spell levitate}]

entries_es.name: Retributive Strike
entries: You can use an action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface, performing a retributive strike. The staff is destroyed and releases its remaining magic in an explosion that expands to fill a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on it.

You have a {@chance 50} chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take force damage equal to 16 × the number of charges in the staff. Every other creature in the area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes an amount of damage based on how far away it is from the point of origin, as shown in the following table. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

rows: 10 ft. away or closer
8 × the number of charges in the staff
11 to 20 ft. away
6 × the number of charges in the staff
21 to 30 ft. away
4 × the number of charges in the staff

entries_es: Usted puede utilizar una acción para romper el personal sobre su rodilla o contra una superficie sólida, realizando una huelga retributiva. El personal es destruido y libera su magia restante en una explosión que se expande para llenar una esfera de 30 pies-radius centrada en ella.

Usted tiene una [[TAG0] oportunidad de viajar al instante a un plano de existencia aleatorio, evitando la explosión. Si usted no evita el efecto, usted toma la fuerza daño igual a 16 × el número de cargos en el personal. Cada otra criatura en el área debe hacer un {@dc 17} Un lanzamiento de ahorro de destreza. En un ahorro fallido, una criatura toma una cantidad de daño basado en lo lejos que está desde el punto de origen, como se muestra en la tabla siguiente. En un ahorro exitoso, una criatura toma la mitad de daño.

rows: 10 ft. away or closer
8 × the number of charges in the staff
11 to 20 ft. away
6 × the number of charges in the staff
21 to 30 ft. away
4 × the number of charges in the staff

entries_es.name: Animate Walking Statues
entries: You can expend 1 or more of the staff's charges as an action to animate or deactivate one or more of the {@creature walking statue of Waterdeep|wdh|walking statues of Waterdeep}. You must be in the city to use this property, and you can animate or deactivate one statue for each charge expended. An animated statue obeys the telepathic commands of Khelben Arunsun's spirit, which is trapped inside the staff (see "Personality" below). A walking statue becomes inanimate if deactivated or if the staff is broken.
entries_es: Usted puede gastar 1 o más de los cargos del personal como una acción para animar o desactivar uno o más de {@creature walking statue of Waterdeep|wdh|walking statues of Waterdeep}. Usted debe estar en la ciudad para utilizar esta propiedad, y puede animar o desactivar una estatua por cada cargo gastado. Una estatua animada obedece los comandos telepáticos del espíritu de Khelben Arunsun, que está atrapado dentro del personal (ver "Personalidad" abajo). Una estatua caminando se vuelve inanimada si se desactiva o si el personal está roto.

entries_es.name: Dispel Magic
entries: You can expend 1 of the staff's charges as a bonus action to cast {@spell dispel magic} on a creature, an object, or a magical effect that you touch with the tip of the staff. If the target is an unwilling creature or an object in the possession of such a creature, you must hit the creature with a melee attack using the Blackstaff before you can expend the charge to cast the spell.
entries_es: Usted puede gastar 1 de los cargos del personal como una acción de bonificación para lanzar {@spell dispel magic} en una criatura, un objeto, o un efecto mágico que usted toca con la punta del personal. Si el objetivo es una criatura no voluntaria o un objeto en posesión de tal criatura, usted debe golpear a la criatura con un ataque de melee usando el Blackstaff antes de que usted pueda expulsar la carga para lanzar el hechizo.

entries_es.name: Drain Magic
entries: This property affects only creatures that use spell slots. When you hit such a creature with a melee attack using the Blackstaff, you can expend 1 of the staff's charges as a bonus action, causing the target to expend one spell slot of the highest spell level it can cast without casting a spell. If the target has already expended all its spell slots, nothing happens. Spell slots that are expended in this fashion are regained when the target finishes a long rest, as normal.
entries_es: Esta propiedad afecta sólo a criaturas que usan ranuras de hechizo. Cuando golpeas a una criatura con un ataque de melee usando el Blackstaff, puedes gastar 1 de los cargos del personal como una acción de bonificación, causando que el objetivo de expulsar una ranura de hechizo del nivel de hechizo más alto que puede lanzar sin lanzar un hechizo. Si el objetivo ya ha gastado todas sus ranuras de hechizo, nada sucede. Las ranuras de recambio que se gastan en esta moda se recuperan cuando el objetivo termina un descanso largo, como normal.

entries_es.name: Master of Enchantment
entries: When you cast an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher while holding the staff, you can make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check with a DC of 10 + the level of the spell. If the check succeeds, you cast the spell without expending a spell slot.
entries_es: Cuando usted lanza un hechizo de encantamiento de primer nivel o superior mientras mantiene el personal, usted puede hacer un control de inteligencia ([TAG0]) con un DC de 10 + el nivel del hechizo. Si el cheque tiene éxito, usted lanza el hechizo sin gastar una ranura de hechizo.

entries_es.name: Sentience
entries: The Blackstaff is a sentient staff of neutral alignment, with an Intelligence of 22, a Wisdom of 15, and a Charisma of 18. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet, and it can communicate telepathically with any creature that is holding it.
entries_es: El Blackstaff es un personal sensible de alineación neutral, con una Inteligencia de 22, una Sabiduría de 15, y una Charisma de 18. Tiene audiencia y {@sense darkvision} a una gama de 120 pies, y puede comunicarse telepáticamente con cualquier criatura que la sostiene.

entries_es.name: Personality
entries: The staff has the spirits of all previous Blackstaffs trapped within it. Its creator, Khelben Arunsun, is the dominant personality among them. Like Khelben, the staff is extremely devious and manipulative. It prefers to counsel its owner without exerting outright control. The staff's primary goal is to protect Waterdeep and its Open Lord, currently Laeral Silverhand. Its secondary goal is to help its wielder become more powerful.

In the event that the holder of the office of the Blackstaff no longer serves the staff's wishes, the staff ceases to function until it finds a worthy inheritor—someone whose loyalty to Waterdeep is beyond reproach.
entries_es: El personal tiene los espíritus de todos los Blackstaffs anteriores atrapados dentro de él. Su creador, Khelben Arunsun, es la personalidad dominante entre ellos. Como Khelben, el personal es extremadamente delicado y manipulador. Prefiere aconsejar a su propietario sin ejercer un control directo. El objetivo principal del personal es proteger Waterdeep y su Señor Abierto, actualmente Laeral Silverhand. Su objetivo secundario es ayudar a que su wielder se vuelva más poderoso.

En el caso de que el titular de la oficina de Blackstaff ya no sirva a los deseos del personal, el personal deja de funcionar hasta que encuentre a un heredero digno —alguien cuya lealtad a Waterdeep está más allá del reproche.

entries_es.name: Spirit Trap
entries: When the Blackstaff dies, the spirit of that individual becomes trapped in the staff along with the spirits of the previous Blackstaffs. (A Blackstaff whose spirit is trapped in the staff can't be raised from the dead.)

Destroying the staff would release the spirits trapped inside it, but in that event, Khelben's spirit can lodge itself inside any one piece of the staff that remains. The piece containing Khelben's spirit has the staff's Sentience property but none of its other properties. As long as this piece of the staff exists, Khelben's spirit can make the staff whole again whenever he wishes. When the staff is remade, the spirits of the previous Blackstaffs become trapped inside it again.
entries_es: Cuando el Blackstaff muere, el espíritu de ese individuo se queda atrapado en el personal junto con los espíritus de los Blackstaffs anteriores. (Un Blackstaff cuyo espíritu está atrapado en el personal no puede ser levantado de los muertos.)

Destruir al personal liberaría a los espíritus atrapados dentro de él, pero en ese caso, el espíritu de Khelben puede alojarse dentro de cualquier pieza del personal que permanece. La pieza que contiene el espíritu de Khelben tiene la propiedad Sentience del personal pero ninguna de sus otras propiedades. Mientras exista esta pieza del personal, el espíritu de Khelben puede hacer que el personal esté completo de nuevo cuando lo desee. Cuando el personal es rehecho, los espíritus de los Blackstaffs anteriores se vuelven atrapados dentro de él otra vez.

item.name: Blade of Avernus
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores resistance to slashing damage.

When you attack a creature that has at least one head with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, you cut off one of the creature's heads. The creature dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it is immune to slashing damage, doesn't have or need a head, has legendary actions, or the DM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off with this weapon. Such a creature instead takes an extra {@damage 6d8} slashing damage from the hit.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: The sword has the following randomly determined properties, as described in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master's Guide:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial properties}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial property}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|dmg|major detrimental property}, which is suppressed while the sword is attuned to an archdevil

entries_es: La espada tiene las siguientes propiedades determinadas al azar, como se describe en el capítulo 7 de la Guía del Maestro Dungeon:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial properties}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial property}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|dmg|major detrimental property}, which is suppressed while the sword is attuned to an archdevil

entries.name: Ruler of Avernus
entries: As an action, you can point this sword at one devil you can see within 60 feet of you. That devil must succeed on a {@dc 22} Charisma saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by you for 1 hour. While {@condition charmed} in this way, the devil follows your orders to the best of its ability. If you command the devil to do something it perceives as suicidal, the effect ends and you can no longer use this power of the sword against that devil.
entries_es: Como acción, puedes señalar esta espada a un demonio que puedes ver a menos de 60 pies de ti. Ese diablo debe tener éxito en un [[TAG0] Charisma ahorrando lanzamiento o ser {@condition charmed} por usted durante 1 hora. Mientras {@condition charmed} de esta manera, el diablo sigue sus órdenes a lo mejor de su capacidad. Si mandas al diablo a hacer algo que percibe como suicida, el efecto termina y ya no puedes usar este poder de la espada contra ese diablo.

entries.name: Infernal Recall
entries: As an action, you can use the sword to cast {@spell word of recall}. Creatures transported by this spell appear in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the current ruler of Avernus, or a sanctuary you designate if you rule Avernus.
entries_es: Como acción, puedes usar la espada para lanzar {@spell word of recall}. Las criaturas transportadas por este hechizo aparecen en un espacio no ocupado dentro de 30 pies del actual gobernante de Avernus, o un santuario que usted designa si usted gobierna Avernus.

entries.name: Destroying the Sword
entries: The sword can be destroyed by casting it into the River Styx or melting it down in the forge that created it.
entries_es: La espada puede ser destruida al arrojarla al río Styx o fundirla en la forja que la creó.
Ganas un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma mágica. Además, el arma ignora la resistencia a la reducción del daño.

Cuando atacas a una criatura que tiene al menos una cabeza con este arma y rodas un 20 en el rollo de ataque, cortas una de las cabezas de la criatura. La criatura muere si no puede sobrevivir sin la cabeza perdida. Una criatura es inmune a este efecto si es inmune a cortar el daño, no tiene o necesita una cabeza, tiene acciones legendarias, o el DM decide que la criatura es demasiado grande para que su cabeza sea cortada con este arma. Tal criatura en su lugar toma un daño extra [[TAG0] recortando el golpe.

items.name: Awakened
entries: When the dagger reaches an awakened state, it gains the following properties:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.

While holding the weapon, you can use an action to cast one of the following spells from it (save {@dc 15}): {@spell fabricate}, {@spell hallucinatory terrain}, {@spell major image}, or {@spell phantasmal killer}. Once a spell has been cast using the dagger, that spell can't be cast from the dagger again until the next dawn.

entries_es: Cuando la daga alcanza un estado despierto, gana las siguientes propiedades:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.

While holding the weapon, you can use an action to cast one of the following spells from it (save {@dc 15}): {@spell fabricate}, {@spell hallucinatory terrain}, {@spell major image}, or {@spell phantasmal killer}. Once a spell has been cast using the dagger, that spell can't be cast from the dagger again until the next dawn.

item.name: Blade of Broken Mirrors (Dormant)
entries: A weapon of Tharizdun, this dagger is a piece of jagged stone whose blade is scribed with a maze-like pattern with no beginning or end.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: The Blade of Broken Mirrors is a sentient chaotic evil weapon with an Intelligence of 21, a Wisdom of 24, and a Charisma of 24. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak, read, and understand Abyssal and Common.
entries_es: La espada de los espejos rotos es un arma caótica sensible con una inteligencia de 21, una sabiduría de 24, y un carisma de 24. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.
El arma se comunica telepáticamente con su wielder y puede hablar, leer y entender Abyssal y Common.

entries.name: Personality
entries: An insane {@creature glabrezu} named Ragazuu lives within the Blade of Broken Mirrors. The weapon yearns to cause chaos. It learns its wielder's principles, then uses those ideals to encourage reckless action. The dagger whispers ideas of revolution.
entries_es: Un loco [[TAG0] llamado Ragazuu vive dentro de la Espada de Espejos Rotos. El arma anhela causar caos. Aprende los principios de su wielder, luego utiliza esos ideales para fomentar la acción imprudente. La daga susurra ideas de la revolución.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: The dagger grants the following benefits in its dormant state:

items: You can speak, read, and write Abyssal.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with this weapon, it returns to your hand.

Whenever you kill a humanoid with an attack using the Blade of Broken Mirrors, the blade remembers the creature's appearance. While holding the dagger, you can use an action to change your form to match any humanoid the blade remembers. Your statistics, other than your size, don't change. Any equipment you are wearing or carrying isn't transformed. You can revert to your true appearance as an action. You revert to your true appearance automatically when you die. When the Blade of Broken Mirrors attunes to a new wielder, the appearances of humanoids it has killed are wiped from its memory.

entries_es: La daga otorga los siguientes beneficios en su estado inactivo:

items: You can speak, read, and write Abyssal.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with this weapon, it returns to your hand.

Whenever you kill a humanoid with an attack using the Blade of Broken Mirrors, the blade remembers the creature's appearance. While holding the dagger, you can use an action to change your form to match any humanoid the blade remembers. Your statistics, other than your size, don't change. Any equipment you are wearing or carrying isn't transformed. You can revert to your true appearance as an action. You revert to your true appearance automatically when you die. When the Blade of Broken Mirrors attunes to a new wielder, the appearances of humanoids it has killed are wiped from its memory.

entries.name: Betrayer Artifact Properties
entries: The Arms of the Betrayers advance in power in the same manner as the Vestiges of Divergence. In its dormant state, each of these artifacts has one {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property and one {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property. When the artifact attains an awakened state, it gains an additional {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property and an additional {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property. When the item reaches its exalted state, it gains a {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property. See "Artifact Properties" in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for more information.
entries_es: Los brazos de los Betrayers avanzan en el poder de la misma manera que los Vestigos de la Divergencia. En su estado inactivo, cada uno de estos artefactos tiene una propiedad [[TAG0] y una propiedad {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental}. Cuando el artefacto alcanza un estado despertado, gana una propiedad adicional [[TAG0] y una propiedad adicional {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental}. Cuando el artículo alcanza su estado exaltado, gana una propiedad [[TAG4]. Ver "Artifact Properties" en el capítulo 7 de la Guía del Maestro Dungeon para obtener más información.

items.name: Exalted
entries: When the dagger reaches an exalted state, it gains the following properties:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +3.
The saving throw DC for spells cast from the dagger increases to 17.

While holding the dagger, you can turn {@condition invisible} as an action. Anything you are wearing or carrying is {@condition invisible} with you. You remain {@condition invisible} until you stop holding the dagger, until you attack or cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw, or until you use a bonus action to become visible again.

entries_es: Cuando la daga alcanza un estado exaltado, gana las siguientes propiedades:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +3.
The saving throw DC for spells cast from the dagger increases to 17.

While holding the dagger, you can turn {@condition invisible} as an action. Anything you are wearing or carrying is {@condition invisible} with you. You remain {@condition invisible} until you stop holding the dagger, until you attack or cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw, or until you use a bonus action to become visible again.

item.name: Blanket
entries: While wrapped in a blanket, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against {@hazard extreme cold|XDMG} (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}).
entries_es: Mientras está envuelto en una manta, usted tiene {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en lanzamientos de ahorro contra {@hazard extreme cold|XDMG}] (ver {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG}).

item.name: Blast Scepter
entries: The Blast Scepter can be used as an arcane focus.

Whoever is attuned to the Blast Scepter gains resistance to fire and lightning damage and can, as an action, use it to cast {@spell thunderwave} as a 4th-level spell (save {@dc 16}) without expending a spell slot.
entries_es: El Esceptor Blast se puede utilizar como un enfoque arcano.

Quien sea afinado al Esceptor de la Explosión gana resistencia al fuego y al rayo y puede, como una acción, utilizarlo para fundir {@spell thunderwave} como un hechizo de 4to nivel (salvar {@dc 16}]) sin gastar una ranura de hechizo.

item.name: Blasted Goggles
entries: These tinker's goggles have 3 charges. As an action, you can expend 1 charge to shoot a beam of fiery light from the goggles at a creature you can see within 120 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 3d6} fire damage. The goggles regain {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.

entries.name: Cursed
entries: The goggles are cursed, and becoming attuned to them extends the curse to you. You can't remove the goggles or end your attunement to them until you are targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse} spell or similar magic.

Whenever you use the goggles' fiery beam and the target rolls a 20 on the {@dice d20} for the saving throw, the goggles expose you to a flash of violent {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}. As a result, you have the blinded condition for 24 hours.
entries_es: Las gafas están maldecidas, y llegar a ellas extiende la maldición a ustedes. No se puede quitar las gafas o terminar su atontado a ellos hasta que usted es concentrado por un hechizo {@spell Remove Curse} o magia similar.

Cada vez que usas el rayo de fuego de las gafas y el objetivo roda un 20 en el {@dice d20} para el lanzamiento de ahorro, las gafas te exponen a un flash de violento [[TAG1]. Como resultado, usted tiene la condición ciega durante 24 horas.

Las gafas de este tinker tienen 3 cargos. Como acción, usted puede gastar 1 carga para disparar un rayo de luz ardiente de las gafas a una criatura que se puede ver dentro de 120 pies de usted mismo. El objetivo debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 3d6} fire damage. Las gafas recuperan {@dice 1d3} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

entries_es.name: Cursed
entries: The goggles are cursed, and becoming attuned to them extends the curse to you. You can't remove the goggles or end your attunement to them until you are targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse} spell or similar magic.

Whenever you use the goggles' fiery beam and the target rolls a 20 on the {@dice d20} for the saving throw, the goggles expose you to a flash of violent {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light}. As a result, you have the blinded condition for 24 hours.

Cada vez que usas el rayo de fuego de las gafas y el objetivo roda un 20 en el {@dice d20} para el lanzamiento de ahorro, las gafas te exponen a un flash de violento [[TAG1]. Como resultado, usted tiene la condición ciega durante 24 horas.

item.name: Blasting Powder
entries: This volatile alchemical powder comes in a small pouch. When ignited by an open flame or a fuse, the powder explodes. Each creature within 5 feet of the exploding pouch must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

A character can bind multiple pouches of blasting powder together so they explode at the same time. Each additional pouch increases the damage by {@dice 1d6} (maximum of {@dice 10d6}) and the blast radius by 5 feet (maximum of 20 feet).
entries_es: Este volátil polvo alquímico viene en una bolsa pequeña. Cuando se enciende por una llama abierta o un fusible, el polvo explota. Cada criatura a 5 pies de la bolsa de explosión debe hacer un {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Un personaje puede atar múltiples bolsas de polvo de explosión juntos para que exploten al mismo tiempo. Cada bolsa adicional aumenta el daño por {@dice 1d6} (máximo de {@dice 10d6}]) y el radio de explosión por 5 pies (máximo de 20 pies).

item.name: Blight Ichor
entries: This bitter chartreuse concoction is distilled from a fungus native to the Blightshore badlands. The sickly green liqueur harbors potent psychedelic properties. Provided it is neither a construct nor undead, a creature subjected to a dose of blight ichor gains advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks, as well as vulnerability to psychic damage, for 1 hour. For each dose of blight ichor consumed, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} for {@dice 1d6} hours and suffer the effects of a {@spell confusion} spell for 1 minute. An undead creature subjected to a dose of blight ichor gains advantage on all Dexterity checks and is immune to the {@condition frightened} condition for 1 hour.
entries_es: Esta concocción amarga de la Cartuja se destila de un hongo nativo de las tierras del Blightshore. El licor verde enfermo alberga potentes propiedades psicodélicas. Si no es ni un constructo ni un muerto, una criatura sometida a una dosis de ichor blight gana ventaja en los controles de inteligencia y sabiduría, así como vulnerabilidad al daño psíquico, durante 1 hora. Para cada dosis de ichor lúcido, la criatura debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15} La Constitución ahorra el lanzamiento o se convierte en {@condition poisoned} por {@dice 1d6} horas y sufre los efectos de un hechizo {@spell confusion} durante 1 minuto. Una criatura no muerta sometida a una dosis de ichor blight gana ventaja en todos los controles de Dexterity y es inmune a la condición {@condition frightened} durante 1 hora.

item.name: Block and Tackle
entries: A set of pulleys with a cable threaded through them and a hook to attach to objects, a block and tackle allows you to hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.
entries_es: Un conjunto de poleas con un cable roscado a través de ellos y un gancho para fijar a objetos, un bloque y el tacto le permite subir hasta cuatro veces el peso que normalmente se puede levantar.

item.name: Block and Tackle
entries: A {@item Block and Tackle|XPHB} allows you to hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.
entries_es: A {@item Block and Tackle|XPHB} le permite subir hasta cuatro veces el peso que normalmente puede levantar.

item.name: Blod Stone
entries: This diamond contains the blood of a creature—blood that appears in the form of the blod (blood) rune. While the item is on your person, you can use your action to divine the location of the creature nearest to you that is related to the blood in the item and that isn't undead. You sense the distance and direction of the creature relative to your location. The creature is either the one whose blood is in the item or a blood relative.

This item is made from a large diamond worth at least 5,000 gp. When the blood of a creature is poured onto it during the creation process, the blood seeps into the heart of the gem. If the gem is destroyed, the blood evaporates and is gone forever. A vengeful being might use a blod stone to hunt down an entire bloodline. Such stones are sometimes given as gifts to siblings or handed down from parent to child.
entries_es: Este diamante contiene la sangre de una criatura — sangre que aparece en la forma del bloque (sangre) runa. Mientras que el artículo está en su persona, usted puede utilizar su acción para adivinar la ubicación de la criatura más cercana a usted que está relacionado con la sangre en el artículo y que no es no muerto. Usted siente la distancia y dirección de la criatura relativa a su ubicación. La criatura es la que tiene sangre en el ítem o en un pariente de sangre.

Este artículo está hecho de un diamante grande por lo menos 5.000 gp. Cuando la sangre de una criatura se derrama sobre ella durante el proceso de creación, la sangre aparece en el corazón de la gema. Si la gema es destruida, la sangre se evapora y se ha ido para siempre. Un ser vengativo podría usar una piedra rubia para cazar un linaje entero. Estas piedras a veces se dan como regalos a los hermanos o se entregan de padres a hijos.

item.name: Blood Fury Tattoo
entries: Produced by a special needle, this magic tattoo evokes fury in its form and colors.

entries.name: Tattoo Attunement
entries: To attune to this item, you hold the needle to your skin where you want the tattoo to appear, pressing the needle there throughout the attunement process. When the attunement is complete, the needle turns into the ink that becomes the tattoo, which appears on the skin.
If your attunement to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes, and the needle reappears in your space.
entries_es: Para afinar a este artículo, usted sostiene la aguja a su piel donde desea que aparezca el tatuaje, presionando la aguja allí durante todo el proceso de atracción. Cuando el dispositivo está completo, la aguja se convierte en la tinta que se convierte en el tatuaje, que aparece en la piel.
Si su atontado al tatuaje termina, el tatuaje desaparece, y la aguja reaparece en su espacio.

entries.name: Bloodthirsty Strikes
entries: The tattoo has 10 charges, and it regains all expended charges daily at dawn. While this tattoo is on your skin, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend a charge to deal an extra {@damage 4d6} necrotic damage to the target, and you regain a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.
When a creature you can see damages you, you can expend a charge and use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature, with advantage on your attack roll.

entries_es: El tatuaje tiene 10 cargos, y recupera todos los cargos enviados diariamente al amanecer. Mientras este tatuaje está en su piel, usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend a charge to deal an extra {@damage 4d6} necrotic damage to the target, and you regain a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt.
When a creature you can see damages you, you can expend a charge and use your reaction to make a melee attack against that creature, with advantage on your attack roll.

item.name: Blood of the Lycanthrope
entries: This poison is created from blood harvested from a dead or {@condition incapacitated} lycanthrope in its animal or hybrid form. A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with lycanthropy (see the Monster Manual). The curse lasts until removed by the {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic.
The type of lycanthropy depends on the lycanthrope used to create the poison. To determine the type of lycanthropy randomly, roll a {@dice d6}:

rows: {@creature Wererat}
{@creature Werewolf}
{@creature Wereboar}

entries_es: Este veneno se crea a partir de la sangre recolectada de un muerto o [TAG0] licantropa en su forma animal o híbrida. Una criatura sometida a este veneno debe tener éxito en un {@dc 12} La Constitución salvando el tiro o ser maldecido con la licantropía (ver el Manual del Monstruo). La maldición dura hasta que se elimina por el hechizo {@spell remove curse} o magia similar.
El tipo de licantropía depende del licántropo utilizado para crear el veneno. Para determinar el tipo de licantropía al azar, enrolle un {@dice d6}:

rows: {@creature Wererat}
{@creature Werewolf}
{@creature Wereboar}

item.name: Blood of the Lycanthrope Antidote
entries: This clear potion has dark red flecks within, resembling clotted blood. When you drink this potion, it removes the curse of lycanthropy from you if that curse was imposed by a lycanthrope's bite or similar effect.
entries_es: Esta poción clara tiene manchas rojas oscuras dentro, parecidos a sangre obstruida. Cuando bebes esta poción, elimina la maldición de la lintropía de ti si esa maldición fue impuesta por la mordida de un licántropo o efecto similar.

item.name: Blood Spear
entries: Kavan was a ruthless chieftain whose tribe lived in the Balinok Mountains centuries before the arrival of {@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS}. Although he was very much alive, Kavan had some traits in common with vampires: he slept during the day and hunted at night, he drank the blood of his prey, and he lived underground. In battle, he wielded a spear stained with blood. His was the first blood spear, a weapon that drains life from those it kills and transfers that life to its wielder, imbuing that individual with the stamina to keep fighting.
When you hit with a melee attack using this magic spear and reduce the target to 0 hit points, you gain {@dice 2d6} temporary hit points.
Any creature can wield the spear, but only the character {@adventure chosen by Kavan|CoS|14|Blood Spear of Kavan} to wield it gains a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
entries_es: Kavan era un jefe despiadado cuya tribu vivía en las montañas de Balinok siglos antes de la llegada de {@creature Strahd von Zarovich|CoS}. Aunque estaba muy vivo, Kavan tenía algunos rasgos en común con los vampiros: durmió durante el día y cazó por la noche, bebió la sangre de su presa, y vivió bajo tierra. En la batalla, usó una lanza manchada de sangre. Su fue la primera lanza sanguínea, un arma que drena la vida de aquellos que mata y transfiere esa vida a su araña, imbuyendo a ese individuo con la resistencia para seguir luchando.
Cuando golpeas con un ataque de melee usando esta lanza mágica y reduces el objetivo a 0 puntos de éxito, ganas {@dice 2d6} puntos de éxito temporales.

Cualquier criatura puede pelar la lanza, pero sólo el personaje {@adventure chosen by Kavan|CoS|14|Blood Spear of Kavan} para pelar gana un bono +2 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma mágica.

item.name: Bloodaxe
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic axe. The axe deals an extra {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage to creatures that aren't constructs or undead. If you reduce such a creature to 0 hit points with an attack using this axe, you gain 10 temporary hit points.
This axe is forged from a dark, rust-colored metal and once belonged to the goliath barbarian Grog Strongjaw of Vox Machina.
entries_es: Ganas un bono +2 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este hacha mágica. El hacha trata un daño necrótico extra [[TAG0] a criaturas que no son construcciones o no están muertas. Si usted reduce tal criatura a 0 puntos de impacto con un ataque usando este hacha, usted gana 10 puntos de éxito temporal.
Este hacha está forjada de un metal oscuro, de color rusto y una vez perteneció a la Gruta bárbara goliat de Vox Machina.

item.name: Bloodrage Greataxe
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic greataxe while you have half your hit points or fewer.
entries_es: Ganas un bono +2 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este granaxe mágico mientras tienes la mitad de tus puntos de éxito o menos.

item.name: Bloodstone
entries: An opaque dark gray with red flecks gemstone.
entries_es: Un gris oscuro opaco con gemas rojas.

item.name: Bloodstone
entries: A dark gray with red flecks gemstone.
entries_es: Un gris oscuro con piedras preciosas rojas.

item.name: Blue Dragon Mask
entries: This mask of glossy azure has spikes around its edges and a ridged horn in its center. The mask reshapes to fit a wearer attuned to it. While you are wearing the mask and attuned to it, you can access the following properties.

entries.name: Damage Absorption
entries: You have resistance against lightning damage. If you already have resistance to lightning damage from another source, you instead have immunity to lightning damage. If you already have immunity to lightning damage from another source, whenever you are subjected to lightning damage, you take none of that damage and regain a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt of that type.
entries_es: Usted tiene resistencia contra daños de relámpago. Si usted ya tiene resistencia al relámpago de otra fuente, usted tiene inmunidad para relámpagos. Si usted ya tiene inmunidad para relámpagos de otra fuente, cada vez que está sujeto a daños de relámpago, usted no toma ninguno de esos daños y recuperar un número de puntos de impacto igual a la mitad del daño de ese tipo.

entries.name: Draconic Majesty
entries: While you are wearing no armor, you can add your Charisma bonus to your Armor Class.
entries_es: Mientras no llevas armadura, puedes añadir tu bono de Charisma a tu Clase Armor.

entries.name: Dragon Breath
entries: If you have a breath weapon that requires rest to recharge, it gains a recharge of 6.
entries_es: Si usted tiene un arma respiratoria que requiere descanso para recargar, gana una recarga de 6.

entries.name: Dragon Sight
entries: You gain {@sense darkvision} out to 60 feet, or to an additional 60 feet if you already have that sense. Once per day, you can gain {@sense blindsight} out to 30 feet for 5 minutes.
entries_es: Usted gana {@sense darkvision} a 60 pies, o a 60 pies adicionales si usted ya tiene ese sentido. Una vez por día, puede ganar [[TAG1] a 30 pies por 5 minutos.

entries.name: Dragon Tongue
entries: You can speak and understand Draconic. You also have advantage on any Charisma check you make against Blue Dragons.
entries_es: Puedes hablar y entender Draconic. También tiene ventaja en cualquier cheque de Charisma que haga contra los Dragones Azules.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: (1/Day) If you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.
entries_es: (1/Día) Si falla un tiro de ahorro, puede elegir tener éxito en su lugar.

entries.name: Lingering Shock
entries: If you deal lightning damage to a creature, it can't take reactions until its next turn.
entries_es: Si usted hace daño al rayo a una criatura, no puede tomar reacciones hasta su próximo turno.

entries_es: Si usted hace daño al rayo a una criatura, no puede tomar reacciones hasta su próximo turno.

item.name: Blue Dragon Scale Mail
entries: Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids. Other times, hunters carefully skin and preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, dragon scale mail is highly valued. While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, you have advantage on saving throws against the Frightful Presence and breath weapons of dragons, and you have resistance to lightning damage.

Additionally, you can focus your senses as an action to magically discern the distance and direction to the closest blue dragon within 30 miles of you. This special action can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: El correo de escala de dragón está hecho de las escalas de un tipo de dragón. A veces los dragones recogen sus escamas desechables y les dan a los humanoides. Otras veces, los cazadores se pellejan cuidadosamente y preservan el escondite de un dragón muerto. En cualquier caso, el correo de escala de dragón es altamente valorado. Al usar esta armadura, usted gana un bono +1 a AC, usted tiene ventaja en el ahorro de tiros contra la Presencia y las armas de aliento de los dragones, y usted tiene resistencia al rayo daño.

Además, usted puede enfocar sus sentidos como una acción para discernir mágicamente la distancia y dirección al dragón azul más cercano dentro de 30 millas de usted. Esta acción especial no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries: A transparent pale blue gemstone.
entries_es: Una gema azul pálida transparente.

entries: A transparent deep blue gemstone.

item.name: Bob
entries: This +1 battleaxe floats on water and other liquids, and grants its bearer advantage on Strength ({@skill Athletics}) checks made to swim.
entries_es: Este juego de batalla +1 flota en agua y otros líquidos, y otorga a su portador ventaja en Strength ([TAG0]) cheques hechos para nadar.

item.name: Bobbing Lily Pad
entries: This magic vehicle is a 10-foot-diameter leaf that floats on water. It has tendrils that propel it across land and across the water's surface (but not underwater), as well as through the air. It has a walking, flying, and swimming speed of 20 feet, and it can hover. It moves according to your spoken directions while you are riding it.
The lily pad can transport up to 300 pounds without hindrance. It can carry up to twice this weight, but it moves at half speed if it carries more than its normal capacity.
entries_es: Este vehículo mágico es una hoja de 10 pies de diámetro que flota en el agua. Tiene tendriles que lo empujan a través de la tierra y a través de la superficie del agua (pero no bajo el agua), así como a través del aire. Tiene una velocidad de caminar, volar y nadar de 20 pies, y puede agitar. Se mueve de acuerdo a tus direcciones habladas mientras estás montando.
El lirio puede transportar hasta 300 libras sin obstáculos. Puede llevar hasta el doble de este peso, pero se mueve a media velocidad si lleva más de su capacidad normal.

item.name: Bomb
entries: As an action, a character can light this bomb and throw it at a point up to 60 feet away. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 3d6} fire damage.
entries_es: Como acción, un personaje puede encender esta bomba y tirarla a un punto de hasta 60 pies de distancia. Cada criatura dentro de 5 pies de ese punto debe tener éxito en un {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 3d6} fire damage.

item.name: Bomb
entries: As an action, you can light a Bomb and throw it at a point up to 60 feet away, where it explodes. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point makes a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries_es: Como acción, puedes encender una bomba y tirarla a un punto de hasta 60 pies de distancia, donde explota. Cada criatura en un radical de 5 pies [[TAG0] centrado en ese punto hace un {@dc 12}] Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} Daño al fuego en un ahorro fallido o la mitad de daño en uno exitoso.

item.name: Bombard
entries: Bombards are built by giff. The major feature of each ship is an enormous cannon that fires massive cannon balls capable of blowing other ships to smithereens. (The cannon is included in the cost of the ship.) A bombard can carry up to fourteen giant cannon balls, each of which weighs 10 tons. These cannon balls make up most of the weight of the ship's cargo. A winch mounted on the aft deck is used to load the cannon balls on board.
A bombard can float and sail on water, but it can't land safely on the ground (its keel would cause it to roll on its side).
entries_es: Los bombarderos son construidos por giff. La característica principal de cada nave es un cañón enorme que dispara bolas masivas de cañón capaces de soplar otros barcos a herreens. (El cañón está incluido en el costo de la nave.) Un bombardeo puede llevar hasta catorce bolas gigantes de cañón, cada una de las cuales pesa 10 toneladas. Estas bolas de cañón representan la mayor parte del peso de la carga del barco. Un winch montado en la cubierta de popa se utiliza para cargar las bolas de cañón a bordo.
Un bombardeo puede flotar y navegar en el agua, pero no puede aterrizar con seguridad en el suelo (su quilla causaría que rodara en su lado).

item.name: Bonecounter
entries: This weapon is a magical +2 mace called Bonecounter. Whenever this weapon is used to destroy an undead creature, a single silver piece appears in the wielder's pocket.
entries_es: Este arma es una maza mágica +2 llamada Bonecounter. Cada vez que este arma se utiliza para destruir una criatura no muerta, una sola pieza de plata aparece en el bolsillo del pelador.

item.name: Book
entries: A book might contain poetry, historical accounts, information pertaining to a particular field of lore, diagrams and notes on gnomish contraptions, or just about anything else that can be represented using text or pictures. A book of spells is a {@item spellbook|phb}.
entries_es: Un libro podría contener poesía, relatos históricos, información relativa a un campo particular de lore, diagramas y notas sobre contrapciones gnomish, o simplemente sobre cualquier otra cosa que pueda ser representada usando texto o imágenes. Un libro de hechizos es un [[TAG0].

item.name: Book
entries: A Book contains fiction or nonfiction. If you consult an accurate nonfiction Book about its topic, you gain a +5 bonus to Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}, {@skill History|XPHB}, {@skill Nature|XPHB}, or {@skill Religion|XPHB}) checks you make about that topic.
entries_es: Un libro contiene ficción o no ficción. Si usted consulta un libro de no ficción exacto sobre su tema, usted gana un bono +5 a Inteligencia ([TAG0]], {@skill History|XPHB}, {@skill Nature|XPHB}], o {@skill Religion|XPHB}) cheques que usted hace sobre ese tema.

item.name: Book of Exalted Deeds
item.reqAttune: by a creature of good alignment
entries: The definitive treatise on all that is good in the multiverse, the fabled Book of Exalted Deeds figures prominently in many religions. Rather than being a scripture devoted to a particular faith, the book's various authors filled the pages with their own vision of true virtue, providing guidance for defeating evil.

The Book of Exalted Deeds rarely lingers in one place. As soon as the book is read, it vanishes to some other corner of the multiverse where its moral guidance can bring light to a darkened world. Although attempts have been made to copy the work, efforts to do so fail to capture its magical nature or translate the benefits it offers to those pure of heart and firm of purpose.

A heavy clasp, wrought to look like angel wings, keeps the book's contents secure. Only a creature of good alignment that is attuned to the book can release the clasp that holds it shut. Once the book is opened, the attuned creature must spend 80 hours reading and studying the book to digest its contents and gain its benefits. Other creatures that peruse the book's open pages can read the text but glean no deeper meaning and reap no benefits. An evil creature that tries to read from the book takes {@damage 24d6} radiant damage. This damage ignores resistance and immunity, and can't be reduced or avoided by any means. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage disappears in a blinding flash and is destroyed, leaving its possessions behind.

Benefits granted by the Book of Exalted Deeds last only as long as you strive to do good. If you fail to perform at least one act of kindness or generosity within the span of 10 days, or if you willingly perform an evil act, you lose all the benefits granted by the book.

entries.name: Increased Wisdom
entries: After you spend the requisite amount of time reading and studying the book, your Wisdom score increases by 2, to a maximum of 24. You can't gain this benefit from the book more than once.
entries_es: Después de pasar la cantidad necesaria de tiempo leyendo y estudiando el libro, su puntuación de Sabiduría aumenta en 2, a un máximo de 24. No puedes ganar este beneficio del libro más de una vez.

entries.name: Enlightened Magic
entries: Once you've read and studied the book, any spell slot you expend to cast a cleric or paladin spell counts as a spell slot of one level higher.
entries_es: Una vez que haya leído y estudiado el libro, cualquier tragaperras de hechizos que usted gasta para lanzar un hechizo clérigo o paladín cuenta como un hechizo de un nivel superior.

entries.name: Halo
entries: Once you've read and studied the book, you gain a protective halo. This halo sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. You can dismiss or manifest the halo as a bonus action. While present, the halo gives you advantage on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks made to interact with good creatures and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks made to interact with evil creatures. In addition, fiends and undead within the halo's bright light make attack rolls against you with disadvantage.
entries_es: Una vez que has leído y estudiado el libro, ganas un halo protector. Este halo arroja luz brillante en un radio de 10 pies y luz oscura por 10 pies adicionales. Usted puede descartar o manifestar el halo como una acción de bonificación. Mientras está presente, el halo te da ventaja sobre Charisma ([TAG0]) cheques hechos para interactuar con las buenas criaturas y Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) cheques hechos para interactuar con las criaturas malvadas. Además, fiends and undead within the halo's bright light make attack rolls against you with disadvantage.

entries.name: Destroying the Book
entries: It is rumored that the Book of Exalted Deeds can't be destroyed as long as good exists in the multiverse. However, drowning the book in the River Styx removes all writing and imagery from its pages and renders the book powerless for {@dice 1d100} years.
entries_es: Se rumorea que el Libro de las escrituras expuestas no puede ser destruido mientras el bien exista en el multiverso. Sin embargo, ahogar el libro en el Río Styx elimina toda escritura e imágenes de sus páginas y hace que el libro sea impotente para [[TAG0] años.

Tan pronto como se lee el libro, desaparece a algún otro rincón del multiverso donde su guía moral puede traer luz a un mundo oscurecido. Aunque se han hecho intentos de copiar el trabajo, los esfuerzos por hacerlo no captan su naturaleza mágica o traducen los beneficios que ofrece a aquellos puros de corazón y firmes de propósito.

Un cierre pesado, hecho para parecer alas de ángel, mantiene el contenido del libro seguro. Sólo una criatura de buena alineación que está afinada al libro puede liberar el cierre que lo mantiene cerrado. Una criatura malvada que intenta leer del libro toma [[TAG0] daño radiante. Este daño ignora la resistencia y la inmunidad, y no puede ser reducido o evitado por ningún medio. Una criatura reducida a 0 puntos de impacto por este daño desaparece en un flash cegador y es destruida, dejando sus posesiones atrás.

Los beneficios concedidos por el Libro de Hechos Exaltados duran sólo mientras se esfuerzan por hacer el bien. Si usted no realiza al menos un acto de bondad o generosidad dentro del lapso de 10 días, o si usted voluntariamente realiza un acto maligno, usted pierde todos los beneficios concedidos por el libro.

item.name: Book of Vile Darkness
entries: The contents of this foul manuscript of ineffable wickedness are the meat and drink of those in evil's thrall. No mortal was meant to know the secrets it contains, knowledge so horrid that to even glimpse the scrawled pages invites madness.

Most believe the lich-god Vecna authored the Book of Vile Darkness. He recorded in its pages every diseased idea, every unhinged thought, and every example of blackest magic he came across or devised. Vecna covered every vile topic he could, making the book a gruesome catalog of all mortal wrongs.

Other practitioners of evil have held the book and added their own input to its catalog of vile knowledge. Their additions are clear, for the writers of later works stitched whatever they were writing into the tome or, in some cases, made notations and additions to existing text. There are places where pages are missing, torn. or covered so completely with ink, blood, and scratches that the original text can't be divined.

Nature can't abide the book's presence. Ordinary plants wither in its presence, animals are unwilling to approach it, and the book gradually destroys whatever it touches. Even stone cracks and turns to powder if the book rests on it long enough.

A creature attuned to the book must spend 80 hours reading and studying it to digest its contents and reap its benefits. The creature can then freely modify the book's contents, provided that those modifications advance evil and expand the lore already contained within.
Whenever a non-evil creature attunes to the Book of Vile Darkness, that creature must make a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's alignment changes to neutral evil.

The Book of Vile Darkness remains with you only as long as you strive to work evil in the world. If you fail to perform at least one evil act within the span of 10 days, or if you willingly perform a good act, the book disappears. If you die while attuned to the book, an entity of great evil claims your soul. You can't be restored to life by any means while your soul remains imprisoned.

entries.name: Adjusted Ability Scores
entries: After you spend the requisite amount of time reading and studying the book, one ability score of your choice increases by 2, to a maximum of 24. Another ability score of your choice decreases by 2, to a minimum of 3. The book can't adjust your ability scores again.

entries.name: Mark of Darkness
entries: After you spend the requisite amount of time reading and studying the book, you acquire a physical disfigurement as a hideous sign of your devotion to vile darkness. An evil rune might appear on your face, your eyes might become glossy black, or horns might sprout from your forehead. Or you might become wizened and hideous, lose all facial features, gain a forked tongue, or some other feature the DM chooses. entries.name: Destroying the Book
entries: The Book of Vile Darkness allows pages to be torn from it, but any evil lore contained on those pages finds its way back into the book eventually, usually when a new author adds pages to the tome.
If a {@creature solar} tears the book in two, the book is destroyed for {@dice 1d100} years, after which it reforms in some dark corner of the multiverse.

A creature attuned to the book for one hundred years can unearth a phrase hidden in the original text that, when translated to Celestial and spoken aloud, destroys both the speaker and the book in a blinding flash of radiance. However, as long as evil exists in the multiverse, the book reforms {@dice 1d10 × 100} years later.
If all evil in the multiverse is wiped out, the book turns to dust and is forever destroyed.
entries_es: El Libro de la Oscuridad Vile permite que las páginas sean arrancadas de ella, pero cualquier mal lore contenido en esas páginas encuentra su camino de regreso al libro eventualmente, generalmente cuando un nuevo autor añade páginas al tomo.

El contenido de este manuscrito sucio de maldad inefable es la carne y la bebida de los que están en la ruina del mal. Ningún mortal estaba destinado a conocer los secretos que contiene, conocimiento tan horrendo que incluso vislumbrar las páginas desgarradas invita la locura.

La mayoría creen que el Lich-god Vecna autorizó el Libro de la Oscuridad Vile. Grabó en sus páginas cada idea enferma, cada pensamiento insensato, y cada ejemplo de la magia más negra que encontró o diseñó. Vecna cubrió todo tópico vil que podía, haciendo del libro un catálogo espantoso de todos los errores mortales.

Otros practicantes del mal han sostenido el libro y añadido su propia entrada a su catálogo de conocimiento vil. Sus adiciones son claras, porque los escritores de obras posteriores cosieron lo que estaban escribiendo en el tomo o, en algunos casos, hicieron notaciones y adiciones al texto existente. Hay lugares donde las páginas están desaparecidas, rotas. o cubierto tan completamente con tinta, sangre y rasguños que el texto original no puede ser adivinado.

La naturaleza no puede soportar la presencia del libro. Las plantas ordinarias se marchitan en su presencia, los animales no están dispuestos a acercarse a ella, y el libro destruye gradualmente lo que toca. Incluso grietas de piedra y gira a polvo si el libro descansa en él lo suficiente.

Una criatura afinada al libro debe pasar 80 horas leyendo y estudiando para digerir su contenido y cosechar sus beneficios. La criatura puede entonces modificar libremente el contenido del libro, siempre que esas modificaciones avancen el mal y amplíen el loro que ya contiene.

Cada vez que una criatura no malvada atune al Libro de la Oscuridad Vile, esa criatura debe hacer un {@dc 17} Charisma ahorrando. En un fallido ahorro, la alineación de la criatura cambia al mal neutral.

El Libro de la Oscuridad Vile permanece con ustedes sólo mientras se esfuerzan por trabajar el mal en el mundo. Si usted no realiza al menos un acto maligno dentro del lapso de 10 días, o si usted voluntariamente realiza un buen acto, el libro desaparece. Si mueres mientras estás al tanto del libro, una entidad de gran maldad reclama tu alma. No se puede restaurar a la vida por ningún medio mientras su alma permanece encarcelada.

item.name: Book of Vile Darkness
entries: The contents of this foul manuscript are the meat and drink of the wicked. It contains knowledge so horrid that to even glimpse the scrawled pages invites doom.

Most believe the lich-god {@book Vecna|XDMG|8|Vecna} authored the Book of Vile Darkness. He recorded in its pages every horrid idea, every corrupt thought, and every example of foul magic he came across or devised.

Other practitioners of evil have added their own input to the book's catalog of vile knowledge. Their additions are clear, for the writers of later works stitched whatever they were writing into the tome or, in some cases, made notations and additions to existing text. There are places where pages are missing, torn, or covered so completely with ink, blood, and scratches that the original text can't be divined.

{@skill Nature|XPHB} can't abide the book's presence. Ordinary plants wither in its presence, common animals are unwilling to approach it, and the book gradually destroys whatever it touches. Even stone cracks and turns to powder if the book rests on it long enough.

Whenever a creature that isn't a Fiend or an Undead attunes to the Book of Vile Darkness, that creature makes a {@dc 17} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is magically transformed into a {@creature Larva|XMM} under the DM's control. Only a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell can reverse this vile transformation.
A creature attuned to the book must spend 80 hours reading and studying it to digest its contents and use its Adjusted Ability Scores, Tireless Form, Spells, Vile Lore, and Vile Speech properties.

The Book of Vile Darkness remains with you only as long as you strive to work evil in the world. If you fail to perform at least one evil act within the span of 10 days, or if you willingly perform a good act, the book disappears, your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to it ends immediately, and you lose all benefits granted by it. If you die while attuned to the book, an entity of great evil claims your soul. You can't be restored to life by any means while your soul remains imprisoned.
