items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial property}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial property}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental property}

entries.name: Properties of the Eye
entries: Your alignment changes to neutral evil, and you gain the following benefits:

items: You have {@sense truesight}.
You can use an action to see as if you were wearing a {@item ring of X-ray vision}. You can end this effect as a bonus action.

The eye has 8 charges. You can use an action and expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 18}) from it: {@spell clairvoyance} (2 charges), {@spell crown of madness} (1 charge), {@spell disintegrate} (4 charges), {@spell dominate monster} (5 charges), or {@spell eyebite} (4 charges). The eye regains {@dice 1d4 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. Each time you cast a spell from the eye, there is a {@chance 5} chance that Vecna tears your soul from your body, devours it, and then takes control of the body like a puppet. If that happens, you become an NPC under the DM's control.

entries_es: Tu alineación cambia al mal neutral, y obtienes los siguientes beneficios:

items: You have {@sense truesight}.
You can use an action to see as if you were wearing a {@item ring of X-ray vision}. You can end this effect as a bonus action.

The eye has 8 charges. You can use an action and expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 18}) from it: {@spell clairvoyance} (2 charges), {@spell crown of madness} (1 charge), {@spell disintegrate} (4 charges), {@spell dominate monster} (5 charges), or {@spell eyebite} (4 charges). The eye regains {@dice 1d4 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. Each time you cast a spell from the eye, there is a {@chance 5} chance that Vecna tears your soul from your body, devours it, and then takes control of the body like a puppet. If that happens, you become an NPC under the DM's control.

entries.name: Properties of the Eye and Hand
entries: If you are attuned to both the hand and eye, you gain the following additional benefits:

items: You are immune to disease and poison.
Using the eye's X-ray vision never causes you to suffer {@condition exhaustion}.
You experience premonitions of danger and, unless you are {@condition incapacitated}, can't be {@status surprised}.
If you start your turn with at least 1 hit point, you regain {@dice 1d10} hit points.

If a creature has a skeleton, you can attempt to turn its bones to jelly with a touch of the {@item Hand of Vecna}. You can do so by using an action to make a melee attack against a creature you can reach, using your choice of your melee attack bonus for weapons or spells. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.
You can use an action to cast {@spell wish}. This property can't be used again until 30 days have passed.

entries.name_es: Propiedades del ojo y de la mano
entries_es: Si usted está al tanto de la mano y el ojo, usted gana los siguientes beneficios adicionales:

items: You are immune to disease and poison.
Using the eye's X-ray vision never causes you to suffer {@condition exhaustion}.
You experience premonitions of danger and, unless you are {@condition incapacitated}, can't be {@status surprised}.
If you start your turn with at least 1 hit point, you regain {@dice 1d10} hit points.

If a creature has a skeleton, you can attempt to turn its bones to jelly with a touch of the {@item Hand of Vecna}. You can do so by using an action to make a melee attack against a creature you can reach, using your choice of your melee attack bonus for weapons or spells. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.
You can use an action to cast {@spell wish}. This property can't be used again until 30 days have passed.

entries.name: Destroying the Eye and Hand
entries: If the Eye of Vecna and the {@item Hand of Vecna} are both attached to the same creature, and that creature is slain by the {@item Sword of Kas}, both the eye and the hand burst into flame, turn to ash, and are destroyed forever. Any other attempt to destroy the eye or hand seems to work, but the artifact reappears in one of Vecna's many hidden vaults, where it waits to be rediscovered.
entries.name_es: Destruyendo el ojo y la mano
entries_es: Si el Ojo de Vecna y el {@item Hand of Vecna} están ambos unidos a la misma criatura, y esa criatura es muerta por el {@item Sword of Kas}, tanto el ojo como la mano irrumpen en llamas, se convierten en ceniza, y son destruidos para siempre. Cualquier otro intento de destruir el ojo o la mano parece funcionar, pero el artefacto reaparece en una de las muchas bóvedas ocultas de Vecna, donde espera ser redescubierto.

raramente es el nombre de Vecna hablado excepto en una voz abrasada. Vecna era, en su tiempo, uno de los más poderosos de todos los magos. A través de magia oscura y conquista, forjó un imperio terrible. Por todo su poder, Vecna no pudo escapar de su propia mortalidad. Comenzó a temer a la muerte y tomó medidas para evitar que su fin llegara.

{@creature Orcus|MTF}, el príncipe demonio de la muerte, enseñó a Vecna un ritual que le permitiría vivir como un {@creature lich}. Más allá de la muerte, se convirtió en el más grande de todas las liras. A pesar de que su cuerpo gradualmente se marchitaba y decaía, Vecna continuó expandiendo su mal dominio. Tan formidable y horrible era su temperamento que sus súbditos temían hablar su nombre. Era el Whispered One, el Maestro del Trono Araña, el Rey Undying, y el Señor de la Torre Rotted.

Algunos dicen que el teniente Kas de Vecna codiciaba el Trono Araña por sí mismo, o que la espada que su señor hizo por él lo sedujo en rebelión. Sea cual sea la razón, Kas trajo la regla del Rey Undying a un fin en una terrible batalla que dejó la torre de Vecna un montón de ceniza. De Vecna, todo lo que quedaba era una mano y un ojo, artefactos grises que todavía buscan trabajar la voluntad del Whispered One en el mundo.

El Ojo de Vecna y el {@item Hand of Vecna} podrían encontrarse juntos o por separado. El ojo parece un órgano de disparo de sangre arrancado de la toma. La mano es una extremidad izquierda momificada y arrugada.

Para afinar al ojo, debe sacar su propio ojo y presionar el artefacto en la toma vacía. El ojo se injerta en su cabeza y permanece allí hasta que mueras. Una vez en su lugar, el ojo se transforma en un ojo dorado con una abertura para un alumno, mucho como el de un gato. Si se quita el ojo, mueres.

Para afinar a la mano, debe arrancar la mano izquierda en la muñeca y la prensa el artefacto contra el bulto. La mano se injerta en su brazo y se convierte en un apéndice funcional. Si se quita la mano, mueres.

entries_es.name: Properties of the Eye
entries: Your alignment changes to neutral evil, and you gain the following benefits:

items: You have {@sense truesight}.
You can use an action to see as if you were wearing a {@item ring of X-ray vision}. You can end this effect as a bonus action.

The eye has 8 charges. You can use an action and expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 18}) from it: {@spell clairvoyance} (2 charges), {@spell crown of madness} (1 charge), {@spell disintegrate} (4 charges), {@spell dominate monster} (5 charges), or {@spell eyebite} (4 charges). The eye regains {@dice 1d4 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. Each time you cast a spell from the eye, there is a {@chance 5} chance that Vecna tears your soul from your body, devours it, and then takes control of the body like a puppet. If that happens, you become an NPC under the DM's control.

entries_es.name: Properties of the Eye and Hand
entries: If you are attuned to both the hand and eye, you gain the following additional benefits:

items: You are immune to disease and poison.
Using the eye's X-ray vision never causes you to suffer {@condition exhaustion}.
You experience premonitions of danger and, unless you are {@condition incapacitated}, can't be {@status surprised}.
If you start your turn with at least 1 hit point, you regain {@dice 1d10} hit points.

If a creature has a skeleton, you can attempt to turn its bones to jelly with a touch of the {@item Hand of Vecna}. You can do so by using an action to make a melee attack against a creature you can reach, using your choice of your melee attack bonus for weapons or spells. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.
You can use an action to cast {@spell wish}. This property can't be used again until 30 days have passed.

entries_es.name: Destroying the Eye and Hand
entries: If the Eye of Vecna and the {@item Hand of Vecna} are both attached to the same creature, and that creature is slain by the {@item Sword of Kas}, both the eye and the hand burst into flame, turn to ash, and are destroyed forever. Any other attempt to destroy the eye or hand seems to work, but the artifact reappears in one of Vecna's many hidden vaults, where it waits to be rediscovered.
entries_es.name_es: Destruyendo el ojo y la mano
entries_es: Si el Ojo de Vecna y el {@item Hand of Vecna} están ambos unidos a la misma criatura, y esa criatura es muerta por el {@item Sword of Kas}, tanto el ojo como la mano irrumpen en llamas, se convierten en ceniza, y son destruidos para siempre. Cualquier otro intento de destruir el ojo o la mano parece funcionar, pero el artefacto reaparece en una de las muchas bóvedas ocultas de Vecna, donde espera ser redescubierto.

item.name: Eye of Vecna
entries: {@book Vecna|XDMG|8|Vecna} was a mighty wizard who, through magic and conquest, forged a terrible empire. For all his power, however, Vecna feared death and took steps to prevent his demise by becoming a lich.

A treacherous lieutenant named Kas brought Vecna's rule to an end in a terrible battle. Of Vecna, all that remained were one hand and one eye, grisly Artifacts that still seek to work Vecna's will in the world.

The Eye of Vecna and the {@item Hand of Vecna|XDMG} are separate Artifacts that might be found together or separately. The eye looks like a bloodshot organ torn free from the socket. The hand is a shriveled left extremity.

item.name: Eyes of Charming
entries: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. They have 3 charges. While wearing them, you can expend 1 charge as an action to cast the {@spell charm person} spell (save {@dc 13}) on a humanoid within 30 feet of you, provided that you and the target can see each other. The lenses regain all expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: Estos lentes de cristal encajan sobre los ojos. Tienen 3 cargos. Mientras los usas, puedes gastar 1 carga como acción para lanzar el hechizo {@spell charm person} (salvar {@dc 13}]) en un humanoide a menos de 30 pies de ti, siempre y cuando tú y el objetivo puedan verse. Los lentes recuperan todos los cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Eyes of Charming
entries: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. They have 3 charges. While wearing them, you can expend 1 or more charges to cast {@spell Charm Person|XPHB} (save {@dc 13}). For 1 charge, you cast the level 1 version of the spell. You increase the spell's level by one for each additional charge you expend. The lenses regain all expended charges daily at dawn.

entries_es: Estos lentes de cristal encajan sobre los ojos. Mientras los usa, su visión mejora significativamente a un rango de 1 pie, concediéndole {@sense Darkvision|XPHB}] dentro de ese rango y {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en Inteligencia ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) cheques realizados para examinar algo dentro de ese rango.

item.name: Eyes of the Eagle
entries: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. While wearing them, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight. In conditions of clear visibility, you can make out details of even extremely distant creatures and objects as small as 2 feet across.
entries_es: Estos lentes de cristal encajan sobre los ojos. Mientras los usa, usted tiene ventaja en las comprobaciones de Sabiduría ([TAG0]]) que dependen de la vista. En condiciones de clara visibilidad, usted puede hacer detalles de criaturas y objetos incluso extremadamente distantes tan pequeños como 2 pies de ancho.

item.name: Eyes of the Eagle
entries: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. While wearing them, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight. In conditions of clear visibility, you can make out details of even extremely distant creatures and objects as small as 2 feet across.
entries_es: Estos lentes de cristal encajan sobre los ojos. Mientras los llevas, tienes {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} cheques de Sabiduría ([TAG1]]) que dependen de la vista. En condiciones de clara visibilidad, usted puede hacer detalles de criaturas y objetos incluso extremadamente distantes tan pequeños como 2 pies de ancho.

item.name: Eyescratch
entries: A creature that comes into contact with this poison must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour and {@condition blinded} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. A {@spell lesser restoration} spell or similar magic ends the effect.
entries_es: Una criatura que entra en contacto con este veneno debe tener éxito en un {@dc 14} La Constitución salvando el lanzamiento o ser {@condition poisoned} durante 1 hora y {@condition blinded}] mientras {@condition poisoned} de esta manera. Un hechizo o magia similar termina el efecto.

item.name: Fabulist Gem
entries: This glittering red gem is commonly found embedded in a ring or brooch.
While wearing the gem, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Counterfeit Coins
entries: You can use your action to magically create a pile of coins, worth no more than 100 gp total, in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of yourself. The pile must appear on a surface that can support it. After 1 hour, the coins vanish, regardless of where they are. Once this action is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Usted puede utilizar su acción para crear mágicamente una pila de monedas, no vale más de 100 gp total, en un espacio no ocupado dentro de 10 pies de usted mismo. La pila debe aparecer en una superficie que puede soportarla. Después de 1 hora, las monedas desaparecen, independientemente de dónde estén. Una vez que se utiliza esta acción, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Illusory Fashion
entries: As a bonus action, you can magically change the appearance of your clothing and armor. You can change the style, color, and apparent quality of what you're wearing, or you can make it appear as if you were wearing different garments entirely. In either case, the changes wrought by this magic fail to pass physical inspection.
entries_es: Como una acción de bonificación, puede cambiar mágicamente la apariencia de su ropa y armadura. Puedes cambiar el estilo, el color y la calidad aparente de lo que estás usando, o puedes hacerlo aparecer como si estuvieras usando ropas diferentes por completo. En cualquier caso, los cambios realizados por esta magia no pasan la inspección física.
Esta gema roja brillante se encuentra comúnmente incrustada en un anillo o broche.
Mientras usas la gema, obtienes los siguientes beneficios.

En cualquier caso, los cambios realizados por esta magia no pasan la inspección física.

item.name: Faerie Dust
entries: A pinch of this dust can substitute for the material components of any enchantment spell of 3rd level or lower. If a pinch of faerie dust is sprinkled on a creature, roll percentile dice and consult the Faerie Dust table to determine the effect.

entries.caption: Faerie Dust
rows: The creature sprinkled with dust gains a flying speed of 60 feet for 10 minutes.

The creature sprinkled with dust must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. The creature awakens if it takes damage or if it is shaken or slapped as an action.
The creature sprinkled with dust must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be affected by a {@spell confusion} spell.

The creature sprinkled with dust becomes {@condition invisible} for 1 hour. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is {@condition invisible} as long as it is on the creature's person. The effect on the creature ends if it attacks, deals any damage, or casts a spell.

entries_es: Una pizca de este polvo puede sustituir los componentes materiales de cualquier hechizo de 3er nivel o inferior. Si una pizca de polvo de lencería es rociada en una criatura, rodar dados percentiles y consultar la tabla del polvo de la lencería para determinar el efecto.

entries_es.caption: Faerie Dust
rows: The creature sprinkled with dust gains a flying speed of 60 feet for 10 minutes.

The creature sprinkled with dust must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 minute. The creature awakens if it takes damage or if it is shaken or slapped as an action.
The creature sprinkled with dust must succeed on a {@dc 11} Wisdom saving throw or be affected by a {@spell confusion} spell.

The creature sprinkled with dust becomes {@condition invisible} for 1 hour. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is {@condition invisible} as long as it is on the creature's person. The effect on the creature ends if it attacks, deals any damage, or casts a spell.

item.name: Failed Experiment Wand
entries: This wand has 2 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast either a green-flamed {@spell fireball} or a blue {@spell lightning bolt} at random from it (save {@dc 15}).
For 1 charge, you cast the 3rd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend.
The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.
entries_es: Esta varita tiene 2 cargos. Mientras lo sostiene, puede utilizar una acción para gastar 1 o más de sus cargos para lanzar un {@spell fireball} verde o un azul {@spell lightning bolt} al azar de él (salvo {@dc 15}).
Para 1 cargo, usted lanzó la versión 3o nivel del hechizo. Usted puede aumentar el nivel de ranura de hechizo por uno para cada cargo adicional que usted envía.

La varita recupera {@dice 1d6 + 1} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Si usted expulsa la última carga de la varita, enrolle un {@dice d20}. En un 1, la varita se desmorona en cenizas y es destruida.

item.name: Falkir's Helm of Pigheadedness
entries: This steel helm is shaped like the head of a boar. Once you don the helm, it can't be removed until you die or until a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic is cast on it. If you wear the helm and are a humanoid, you gain the following flaw until the helm is removed: "I'm exceedingly stubborn and think I'm right all the time." (This flaw supersedes any conflicting flaw.)
entries_es: Este timón de acero se forma como la cabeza de un jabalí. Una vez que haces el timón, no se puede quitar hasta que mueras o hasta que un hechizo o magia similar sea lanzado en él. Si llevas el timón y eres un humanoide, obtienes el siguiente defecto hasta que se quita el timón: "Soy excesivamente terco y creo que tengo razón todo el tiempo". (Este defecto supera cualquier defecto conflictivo.)

item.name: Fane-Eater
item.reqAttune: by an evil cleric or paladin
entries: Fane-Eater is a battleaxe belonging to {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA}.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls with Fane-Eater. If you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, the creature takes an extra {@damage 2d8} necrotic damage, and you regain a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage taken.
entries_es: Fane-Eater es un hacha de batalla perteneciente a [[TAG0].

Ganas un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos con Fane-Eater. Si atacas a una criatura con este arma y rodas un 20 en el rollo de ataque, la criatura toma un daño necrótico extra [[TAG0], y recuperas un número de puntos de impacto igual al daño necrótico tomado.

item.name: Far Gear
entries: While attuned to this device, you have a +1 bonus to Charisma saving throws, and you have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks.

entries.name: Aberrant Ally
entries: You can conjure an aberrant creature from the chaos of the multiverse to serve you. This functions as the {@spell conjure celestial} spell (no {@status concentration} required), except the creature you summon is an aberration of challenge rating 4 or lower. Once you use this feature of the far gear, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Puedes conjurar a una criatura aberrante del caos del multiverso para servirte. Esto funciona como el hechizo {@spell conjure celestial} (no {@status concentration} requerido), excepto la criatura que usted llama es una aberración de la calificación de desafío 4 o inferior. Una vez que utilizas esta característica del equipo lejano, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Unnatural Bane
entries: You can cast the {@spell bane} spell (save {@dc 15}), which affects any number of creatures within range for 1 minute. Once you use this feature of the far gear, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Puede lanzar el hechizo {@spell bane} (salvar {@dc 15}), que afecta a cualquier número de criaturas dentro del rango durante 1 minuto. Una vez que utilizas esta característica del equipo lejano, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Part of a Whole
entries: While this component is not installed in the {@item Orrery of the Wanderer|AI}, its magic might function sporadically or with unpredictable side effects, as determined by the DM.
entries_es: Si bien este componente no se instala en {@item Orrery of the Wanderer|AI}, su magia puede funcionar esporádicamente o con efectos secundarios impredecibles, según lo determinado por el DM.
Mientras se ajusta a este dispositivo, usted tiene un bono +1 a los lanzamientos de ahorro de Charisma, y tiene ventaja en los cheques de Charisma ([TAG0]).

entries: While this component is not installed in the {@item Orrery of the Wanderer|AI}, its magic might function sporadically or with unpredictable side effects, as determined by the DM.

item.name: Far Realm Shard
entries: This writhing crystal is steeped in the warped essence of the Far Realm. As an action, you can attach the shard to a Tiny object (such as a weapon or a piece of jewelry) or detach it. It falls off if your attunement to it ends. You can use the shard as a spellcasting focus while you hold or wear it.

When you use a Metamagic option on a spell while you are holding or wearing the shard, you can cause a slimy tentacle to rip through the fabric of reality and strike one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or take {@damage 3d6} psychic damage and become {@condition frightened} of you until the start of your next turn.
entries_es: Este cristal retorcido está empinado en la esencia acorazada del reino lejano. Como acción, puede adjuntar el fragmento a un objeto Tiny (como un arma o una pieza de joyería) o desmontarlo. Se cae si su atontado termina. Puede utilizar el fragmento como un foco de ortografía mientras lo mantiene o lo usa.

Cuando usas una opción Metamagic en un hechizo mientras estás sosteniendo o usando el duro, puedes hacer que un tentáculo delgado se rompa a través del tejido de la realidad y golpee a una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 30 pies de ti. La criatura debe tener éxito en un lanzamiento de ahorro de Charisma contra su hechizo salvar DC o tomar {@damage 3d6} daño psíquico y convertirse {@condition frightened} de ustedes hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno.

item.name: Fargab
entries: These backpack-sized devices are created in pairs, with matching numbers engraved on them, and allow communication over a long distance using radio frequencies. While wearing a fargab, you can use an action to speak into the device's mouthpiece and send a short message of twenty-five words or less to another creature wearing the matched fargab while it is within 18 miles of you. The message emits from the speakers of the device and can be heard up to 10 feet away from the device. If no creature is wearing the fargab, the speakers make static noises instead.
entries_es: Estos dispositivos de tamaño de mochila se crean en pares, con números iguales grabados en ellos, y permiten la comunicación a larga distancia utilizando frecuencias de radio. Mientras usas un fargab, puedes usar una acción para hablar en la boquilla del dispositivo y enviar un mensaje corto de veinticinco palabras o menos a otra criatura usando el fargab emparejado mientras que está a menos de 18 millas de ti. El mensaje emite desde los altavoces del dispositivo y se puede escuchar hasta 10 pies del dispositivo. Si ninguna criatura está usando el fargab, los altavoces hacen ruidos estáticos en su lugar.

item.name: Fate Cutter Shears
entries: The blades of these pruning shears bear many nicks and dents but still cut cleanly. The shears function as a magic dagger. The weapon has the following properties:

items.name: Ever Sharp
entries: When you hit with an attack using the shears, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage.
entries_es: Cuando golpeas con un ataque usando las tijeras, el objetivo toma un daño adicional {@damage 1d6} fuerza.

items.name: Sever Threads
entries: When you hit a creature with the shears, you can cut that creature's fate. Until the target finishes a long rest, attack rolls against it score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Cuando golpeas a una criatura con los timbres, puedes cortar el destino de esa criatura. Hasta que el objetivo termine un largo descanso, los rollos de ataque contra él marcan un golpe crítico en un rollo de 19 o 20 en el {@dice d20}. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.
Las cuchillas de estas cuchillas de poda llevan muchos nicks y dentaduras pero aún cortadas limpiamente. Las tijeras funcionan como una daga mágica. El arma tiene las siguientes propiedades:

items.name: Ever Sharp
entries: When you hit with an attack using the shears, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage.
entries_es: Cuando golpeas con un ataque usando las tijeras, el objetivo toma un daño adicional {@damage 1d6} fuerza.

entries: When you hit a creature with the shears, you can cut that creature's fate. Until the target finishes a long rest, attack rolls against it score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Cuando golpeas a una criatura con los timbres, puedes cortar el destino de esa criatura. Hasta que el objetivo termine un largo descanso, los rollos de ataque contra él marcan un golpe crítico en un rollo de 19 o 20 en el {@dice d20}. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Fates Card
entries: As a bonus action, you can brandish this card at one willing creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself, granting the creature a brief glimpse of the future. Until the start of your next turn, the creature has advantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws. Additionally, other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against the target for the duration. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Como una acción de bonificación, puedes marcar esta carta a una criatura dispuesta que puedes ver dentro de 30 pies de ti mismo, otorgando a la criatura un breve vistazo del futuro. Hasta el comienzo de tu próximo turno, la criatura tiene ventaja en los rollos de ataque, cheques de habilidad y lanzamientos de ahorro. Además, otras criaturas tienen desventaja en los rollos de ataque contra el objetivo durante la duración. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Feather of Diatryma Summoning
entries: This bright plume is made from the feather of a {@creature diatryma|wdh} (pronounced dee-ah-TRY-mah), a Large, colorful, flightless bird native to the Underdark. If you use an action to speak the command word and throw the feather into a Large unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet of you, the feather becomes a living diatryma for up to 6 hours, after which it reverts to its feather form. It reverts to feather form early if it drops to 0 hit points or if you use an action to speak the command word again while touching the bird.
When the diatryma reverts to feather form, the magic of the feather can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

The diatryma uses the statistics of an {@creature axe beak}, except that its beak deals piercing damage instead of slashing damage. The creature is friendly to you and your companions, and it can be used as a mount. It understands your languages and obeys your spoken commands. If you issue no commands, the diatryma defends itself but takes no other actions.
entries_es: Esta columna brillante está hecha de la pluma de un {@creature diatryma|wdh} (pronunciado dee-ah-TRY-mah), un pájaro grande, colorido, sin vuelo nativo del Underdark. Si usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando y arrojas la pluma en un gran espacio no ocupado en el suelo a 5 pies de ti, la pluma se convierte en un diatríma vivo por hasta 6 horas, después de lo cual se vuelve a su forma de pluma. Revierte a forma de pluma temprano si cae a 0 puntos de éxito o si usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo mientras toca el pájaro.
Cuando el diatripma se vuelve a la forma de plumas, la magia de la pluma no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta que hayan pasado 7 días.

El diatryma utiliza las estadísticas de un {@creature axe beak}, excepto que su pico trata de perforar daños en lugar de cortar daños. La criatura es amistosa con usted y sus compañeros, y puede ser utilizado como un montaje. Comprende tus idiomas y obedece tus mandamientos hablados. Si no emites órdenes, el diatrísma se defiende pero no toma otras acciones.

item.name: Feather Token
entries: This small metal disk is inscribed with the image of a feather. When you fall at least 20 feet while the token is on your person, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling. The token's magic is expended after you land, whereupon the disk becomes nonmagical.
entries_es: Este pequeño disco metálico está inscrito con la imagen de una pluma. Cuando caes al menos 20 pies mientras el token está en tu persona, bajas 60 pies por ronda y no te dañes de caer. La magia de la ficha es gastada después de aterrizar, donde el disco se convierte en no mágico.

item.name: Feathered mantle with emerald clasp (Sun Empire)

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When Fenthras reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2. Additionally, when you hit with an attack using this weapon, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d4} lightning damage.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can declare it a bramble shot. The attack deals an extra {@damage 3d8} piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or become {@condition restrained} by steely brambles that burst from the arrow. A {@condition restrained} target can repeat the {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until you finish a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|short or long rest}.

entries: This gorgeous {@item longbow|phb} made of everbark from the Fey Realm flexes and shifts like a living entity. It is said to have been wielded by the legendary ranger {@creature Vex'ahlia|TDCSR} against great evils.

item.name: Feywild Shard
entries: This warm crystal glints with the sunset colors of the Feywild sky and evokes whispers of emotional memory. As an action, you can attach the shard to a Tiny object (such as a weapon or a piece of jewelry) or detach it. It falls off if your attunement to it ends. You can use the shard as a spellcasting focus while you hold or wear it.

When you use a Metamagic option on a spell while you are holding or wearing the shard, you can roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB} table in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. If the result is a spell, it is too wild to be affected by your Metamagic, and if it normally requires {@status concentration}, it doesn't require {@status concentration} in this case; the spell lasts for its full duration.
If you don't have the Wild Magic Sorcerous Origin, once this property is used to roll on the {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB} table, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Este cristal cálido brilla con los colores del atardecer del cielo Feywild y evoca susurros de memoria emocional. Como acción, puede adjuntar el fragmento a un objeto Tiny (como un arma o una pieza de joyería) o desmontarlo. Se cae si su atontado termina. Puede utilizar el fragmento como un foco de ortografía mientras lo mantiene o lo usa.

Cuando usas una opción Metamagic en un hechizo mientras estás sosteniendo o usando el duro, puedes rodar en la tabla {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB} en la {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}. Si el resultado es un hechizo, es demasiado salvaje para ser afectado por su Metamagic, y si normalmente requiere {@status concentration}]], no requiere {@status concentration} en este caso; el hechizo dura toda su duración.

Si no tienes el Origen Sorceroso Salvaje Mágico, una vez que esta propiedad se utiliza para rodar sobre la mesa {@table Wild Magic Surge|PHB}, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Feywild Trinket
entries: The Feywild Trinkets table that follows offers a selection of trinkets appropriate for Feywild-themed adventures such as this one. Players whose characters have the feylost or Witchlight hand background can roll on this table instead of the {@book Trinkets|PHB|5|Trinkets} table in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB} to determine what trinkets their characters possess. item.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Bronze Griffon
reprintedAs: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Bronze Griffon|XDMG
entries: A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket. If you use an action to speak the command word and throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of you, the figurine becomes a living creature. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.
The creature is friendly to you and your companions. It understands your languages and obeys your spoken commands. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if it drops to 0 hit points or if you use an action to speak the command word again while touching it. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified in the figurine's description.

entries.name: {@creature griffon||Bronze Griffon}
entries: This bronze statuette is of a {@creature griffon} rampant. It can become a {@creature griffon} for up to 6 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 5 days have passed.

item.name_es: Figura de Wondrous Power, Bronce Griffon
entries_es: Una figura de poder maravilloso es una estatuilla de una bestia lo suficientemente pequeña para encajar en un bolsillo. Si usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando y lanzas la figura a un punto en el suelo a menos de 60 pies de ti, la figura se convierte en una criatura viviente. Si el espacio donde la criatura aparece está ocupado por otras criaturas o objetos, o si no hay suficiente espacio para la criatura, la figura no se convierte en una criatura.
La criatura es amistosa contigo y tus compañeros. Comprende tus idiomas y obedece tus mandamientos hablados. Si no emites órdenes, la criatura se defiende pero no toma ninguna otra acción.

La criatura existe durante una duración específica para cada figura. Al final de la duración, la criatura vuelve a su forma de figura. Revierte a una figura temprano si cae a 0 puntos de éxito o si usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo mientras la toca. Cuando la criatura se convierte en una figura de nuevo, su propiedad no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta que una cierta cantidad de tiempo ha pasado, como se especifica en la descripción de la figura.

entries.name: {@creature riding horse||Ivory Goats}
entries: These ivory statuettes of goats are always created in sets of three. Each goat looks unique and functions differently from the others. Their properties are as follows:

items: The goat of traveling can become a Large goat with the same statistics as a {@creature riding horse}. It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in beast form costs 1 charge. While it has charges, you can use it as often as you wish. When it runs out of charges, it reverts to a figurine and can't be used again until 7 days have passed, when it regains all its charges.
The goat of travail becomes a {@creature giant goat} for up to 3 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 30 days have passed.

The goat of terror becomes a {@creature giant goat} for up to 3 hours. The goat can't attack, but you can remove its horns and use them as weapons. One horn becomes a +1 lance, and the other becomes a +2 longsword. Removing a horn requires an action, and the weapons disappear and the horns return when the goat reverts to figurine form. In addition, the goat radiates a 30-foot-radius aura of terror while you are riding it. Any creature hostile to you that starts its turn in the aura must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of the goat for 1 minute, or until the goat reverts to figurine form. The {@condition frightened} creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once it successfully saves against the effect, a creature is immune to the goat's aura for the next 24 hours. Once the figurine has been used, it can't be used again until 15 days have passed.

entries_es.name: Obsidian Steed (Very Rare)
entries: This polished obsidian horse can become a {@creature Nightmare|XMM} for up to 24 hours. The nightmare fights only to defend itself. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 5 days have passed.

The figurine has a {@chance 10} chance each time you use it to ignore your orders, including a command to revert to figurine form. If you mount the nightmare while it is ignoring your orders, you and the nightmare are instantly transported to a random location on the plane of Hades, where the nightmare reverts to figurine form.
entries_es: Este caballo obsidiano pulido puede convertirse en un [[TAG0] por hasta 24 horas. La pesadilla lucha sólo para defenderse. Una vez que se ha utilizado, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta que hayan pasado 5 días.

La figura tiene una {@chance 10} oportunidad cada vez que la usas para ignorar tus órdenes, incluyendo un comando para volver a figurar. Si usted monta la pesadilla mientras está ignorando sus órdenes, usted y la pesadilla se transportan instantáneamente a una ubicación al azar en el avión de Hades, donde la pesadilla se revierte a la forma de figurina.

item.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Onyx Dog
reprintedAs: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Onyx Dog|XDMG
entries: A figurine of wondrous power is a statuette of a beast small enough to fit in a pocket. If you use an action to speak the command word and throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of you, the figurine becomes a living creature. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.
The creature is friendly to you and your companions. It understands your languages and obeys your spoken commands. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if it drops to 0 hit points or if you use an action to speak the command word again while touching it. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified in the figurine's description.

entries.name: {@creature mastiff||Onyx Dog}
entries: This onyx statuette of a dog can become a {@creature mastiff} for up to 6 hours. The {@creature mastiff} has an Intelligence of 8 and can speak Common. It also has {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet and can see {@condition invisible} creatures and objects within that range. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
entries_es: Esta estatuilla de un perro onyx puede convertirse en un [[TAG0] por hasta 6 horas. El {@creature mastiff} tiene una Inteligencia de 8 y puede hablar Común. Una vez que se ha utilizado, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta que hayan pasado 7 días.

item.name_es: Figura de Wondrous Power, Perro Onyx
entries_es: Una figura de poder maravilloso es una estatuilla de una bestia lo suficientemente pequeña para encajar en un bolsillo. Si el espacio donde la criatura aparece está ocupado por otras criaturas o objetos, o si no hay suficiente espacio para la criatura, la figura no se convierte en una criatura.

item.name: Finder's Goggles
item.reqAttune: by a creature with the Mark of Finding
entries: The lenses of these garish goggles are carved from Siberys dragonshards. While wearing these lenses, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to the check.

As an action, you can use the goggles to examine an object to identify the aura of the last creature that touched it. Make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check against a DC of 13 + the number of days since the last contact occurred. On a success, you learn the creature's type and can immediately use the goggles to cast {@spell locate creature} to find that creature. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Fish Suit
entries: This bulky suit, which fully encases your head and body, takes 1 minute to don or doff. While worn, it enables you to breathe in an airless environment and renders you immune to the harmful effects of any gas that surrounds you. The suit also grants you a swimming speed equal to your walking speed while underwater, or a flying speed equal to your walking speed in an environment with no gravity.
entries_es: Este traje voluminoso, que encierra completamente su cabeza y cuerpo, toma 1 minuto para donar o doff. Mientras se usa, le permite respirar en un ambiente sin aire y le hace inmune a los efectos nocivos de cualquier gas que le rodea. El traje también le otorga una velocidad de natación igual a su velocidad de caminar mientras está bajo el agua, o una velocidad de vuelo igual a su velocidad de caminar en un ambiente sin gravedad.

item.name: Fishing Tackle
entries: This kit includes a wooden rod, silken line, corkwood bobbers, steel hooks, lead sinkers, velvet lures, and narrow netting.
entries_es: Este kit incluye una varilla de madera, línea de seda, bobinas de corcho, ganchos de acero, señuelos de plomo, señuelos de terciopelo y recubrimiento estrecho.

item.name: Flail of Tiamat
entries: This magic flail is made in the image of Tiamat, with five jagged heads shaped like the heads of five different chromatic dragons. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this flail. When you hit with an attack roll using it, the target takes an extra {@damage 5d4} damage of your choice of one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.

While holding the flail, you can use an action and speak a command word to cause the heads to breathe multicolored flames in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 14d6} damage of one of the following damage types (your choice): acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage. Once this action is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Este flail mágico está hecho en la imagen de Tiamat, con cinco cabezas en forma de cabezas de cinco dragones cromáticos diferentes. Ganas un bono +3 para atacar y dañar los rollos hechos con este flail. Cuando golpeas con un rollo de ataque que lo usa, el objetivo toma un daño extra {@damage 5d4} de tu elección de uno de los siguientes tipos de daño: ácido, frío, fuego, relámpago o veneno.

Mientras sostiene el flail, puede utilizar una acción y hablar una palabra de comando para hacer que las cabezas respiren llamas multicolores en un cono de 90 pies. Cada criatura en ese área debe hacer un {@dc 18} Un lanzamiento de ahorro de destreza. En un ahorro fallido, se necesita [[TAG1] daño de uno de los siguientes tipos de daños (su elección): ácido, frío, fuego, relámpago o veneno. En un ahorro exitoso, se necesita la mitad de daño. Una vez que se utiliza esta acción, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Flame Tongue Shortsword of Greed
entries: You can use a bonus action to speak this magic sword's command word, causing flames to erupt from the blade. These flames shed bright light in a 40-foot radius and dim light for an additional 40 feet. While the sword is ablaze, it deals an extra {@damage 2d6} fire damage to any target it hits. The flames last until you use a bonus action to speak the command word again or until you drop or sheathe the sword.
While you are attuned to this sword you can use an action to mentally command it to detect gems and jewels. You learn the kind and number of such objects within 60 feet of the sword.
entries_es: Usted puede utilizar una acción de bonificación para hablar la palabra de mando de esta espada mágica, causando que las llamas erupcionen de la espada. Estas llamas arrojan luz brillante en un radio de 40 pies y luz oscura por unos 40 pies adicionales. Mientras la espada se ablanda, se ocupa de un daño extra {@damage 2d6} de fuego a cualquier objetivo que golpee. Las llamas duran hasta que usted usa una acción de bonificación para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo o hasta que usted cae o derrama la espada.
Mientras estás afinado a esta espada puedes usar una acción para mandarla mentalmente para detectar gemas y joyas. Usted aprende el tipo y el número de tales objetos dentro de 60 pies de la espada.

item.name: Flamefriend Lantern
entries: This wrought-iron lantern holds a small fire elemental spirit. To attune to this item, you must also succeed on a {@dc 10} Charisma check to bond with the spirit inside the lantern.

entries.name: Light and Flame
entries: While attuned to the lantern, you can verbally ask the elemental to glow (no action required), causing the lantern to cast bright light in a radius of your choice up to 60 feet and dim light for the same distance beyond that. You can also cast the {@spell produce flame} cantrip from the lantern at will. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell.
entries_es: Mientras se afina a la linterna, se puede pedir verbalmente al elemental que brille (no se requiere acción), causando que la linterna arroja luz brillante en un radio de su elección de hasta 60 pies y luz tenue para la misma distancia más allá de eso. También puede echar el [[TAG0] de la linterna a voluntad. La sabiduría es tu habilidad de ortografía para este hechizo.

entries.name: Elemental Essence
entries: The fire elemental spirit in the lantern can grant you a small fragment of its power. As an action, you gain one of the following benefits of your choice for 1 hour:

items: You have resistance to fire damage.
Whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack, that creature takes fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

You can cast the {@spell burning hands} spell (spell save {@dc 15}) from the lantern at 3rd level. Once you cast the spell, you can't do so again until the next time you use this property of the lantern.

entries: Once the elemental has shared its power with you in this way, it can't do so again until the next dawn.
entries_es: El espíritu elemental de fuego en la linterna puede otorgarle un pequeño fragmento de su poder. Como acción, usted gana uno de los siguientes beneficios de su elección durante 1 hora:

items: You have resistance to fire damage.
Whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack, that creature takes fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

You can cast the {@spell burning hands} spell (spell save {@dc 15}) from the lantern at 3rd level. Once you cast the spell, you can't do so again until the next time you use this property of the lantern.

entries_es: Una vez que el elemental ha compartido su poder con usted de esta manera, no puede hacerlo de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Willful Attunement
entries: Your {@quickref attunement|DMG|1|0} to the lantern lasts until you choose to end it, or until you anger the elemental (by dousing the lantern in water, attacking another nonhostile elemental being, and so forth). You can attempt to attune to the lantern again and repeat the check to bond with the elemental during a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|short or long rest}, but you make this check with {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage} until you have made amends to the spirit, as the GM determines.
entries_es: Tu {@quickref attunement|DMG|1|0} a la linterna dura hasta que elijas terminarla, o hasta que enojes al elemental (haciendo la linterna en agua, atacando a otro ser elemental no hostil, y así sucesivamente). Usted puede intentar afinar a la linterna de nuevo y repetir el cheque para vincularse con el elemental durante un {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|short or long rest}, pero usted hace este cheque con {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage}] hasta que usted ha hecho enmiendas al espíritu, como el GM determina.

Esta linterna de hierro forjado sostiene un pequeño espíritu elemental de fuego. Para ajustarse a este tema, también debe tener éxito en un {@dc 10} Charisma comprueba el vínculo con el espíritu dentro de la linterna.

item.name: Flames Card
entries: You can use this card to summon a devil. The card is attuned to {@filter a specific devil with a challenge rating of 8 or lower|bestiary|source=|Challenge Rating=[&0;&8]|tag=devil|miscellaneous=}. As an action, you can hold this card aloft and summon that devil, which appears in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you. The devil is initially unfriendly toward you and your companions. Roll initiative for the devil, which has its own turns. The DM has the creature's stat block. On each of your turns, you can issue a verbal command to the devil (no action required by you), and as long as you are holding this card, the devil obeys your commands. Otherwise, it is under the DM's control and acts according to its nature—it might attack you if it thinks it can prevail or try to tempt you to undertake an evil act in exchange for further service. After 1 minute or when the devil's hit points drop to 0, the devil returns to the Lower Planes. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Puedes usar esta tarjeta para llamar a un diablo. La tarjeta está afinada a {@filter a specific devil with a challenge rating of 8 or lower|bestiary|source=|Challenge Rating=[&0;&8]|tag=devil|miscellaneous=}. Como acción, se puede mantener esta tarjeta en alto y convocar a ese diablo, que aparece en un espacio no ocupado que se puede ver dentro de 30 pies de usted. El diablo inicialmente no es amistoso con usted y sus compañeros. Rollo de iniciativa para el diablo, que tiene sus propios giros. El DM tiene el bloque de la criatura. En cada uno de sus turnos, usted puede emitir un mandamiento verbal al diablo (no hay acción requerida por usted), y mientras usted está sosteniendo esta tarjeta, el diablo obedece sus órdenes. De lo contrario, está bajo el control del DM y actúa según su naturaleza, podría atacarte si cree que puede prevalecer o intentar tentarte a emprender un acto maligno a cambio de un nuevo servicio. Después de 1 minuto o cuando los puntos de éxito del diablo caen a 0, el diablo vuelve a los Planos inferiores. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Flask
entries: A flask holds 1 pint of liquid.
entries_es: Un frasco tiene 1 pinta de líquido.

item.name: Flask
entries: A Flask holds up to 1 pint.
entries_es: Un Flask tiene hasta 1 pinta.

item.name: Flayer Slayer
entries: Carvings of decapitated mind flayers adorn this greataxe's metal blade. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this greataxe.

An Aberration hit with this greataxe takes an extra {@damage 1d12} slashing damage. If the Aberration is currently grappling a creature, the Aberration must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or release each creature it is grappling.
entries_es: Las tallas de flayers mentales decapitados adornan la hoja de metal de este gran hacha. Ganas un bono +1 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este granaxe.

Un golpe de Aberración con este granaxe toma un daño extra [[TAG0]. Si la Aberración está actualmente afligiendo a una criatura, la Aberración debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15}] Fuerza ahorrando lanzamiento o liberando a cada criatura es grappling.

item.name: Flensing Claws (Huge)
entries: Flensing claws take the form of articulated digits that extend into long metal blades. The claws are knitted into the flesh and bones of a creature's arms and can't be removed without surgical amputation.

Each set of flensing claws is designed for a specific creature and can't be used by anyone else. A creature equipped with flensing claws can use its action to make one melee weapon attack with the claws. The creature adds its proficiency bonus and Strength modifier to any attack roll made with the claws, and its Strength modifier to its damage roll when it hits a target with the claws.
entries_es: Las garras Flensing toman la forma de dígitos articulados que se extienden en largas cuchillas metálicas. Las garras se tejen en la carne y los huesos de los brazos de una criatura y no pueden ser removidas sin amputación quirúrgica.

Cada conjunto de garras flensing está diseñado para una criatura específica y no puede ser utilizado por nadie más. Una criatura equipada con garras flensing puede usar su acción para hacer un ataque de arma melee con las garras. La criatura añade su bonificación de competencia y modificador de fuerza a cualquier rollo de ataque hecho con las garras, y su modificador de fuerza a su rollo de daño cuando golpea un objetivo con las garras.

item.name: Flying Chariot
entries: The chariot's riders and creatures pulling the chariot gain a +1 bonus to their AC.
If this magic chariot is pulled by one or more flying creatures, it too can fly.

entries.name: Chariots
entries: Chariots and the creatures pulling them work like controlled mounts, as described in the mounted combat rules in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB|9|Mounted Combat}, but with the following differences:

items: Mounting or dismounting a chariot costs you 5 feet of movement, rather than a number of feet equal to half your speed.
Being mounted on a chariot grants you {@quickref Cover||3||half cover}.
A chariot's speed is equal to the speed of the slowest creature pulling it.
If multiple creatures are pulling the chariot, they all act on the same initiative, and they must take the same action on their turn.

entries_es: Los carros y las criaturas que los tiran trabajan como monturas controladas, como se describe en las reglas de combate montadas en el {@book Player's Handbook|PHB|9|Mounted Combat}, pero con las siguientes diferencias:

If multiple creatures are pulling the chariot, they all act on the same initiative, and they must take the same action on their turn.

Si este carro mágico es tirado por una o más criaturas voladoras, también puede volar.

item.name: Flying Citadel Helm
entries: The function of this ornate chair is to propel and maneuver a flying citadel on which it has been installed. The chair has AC 15, 18 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. It is destroyed if reduced to 0 hit points.
The sensation of being attuned to a flying citadel helm is akin to the pins-and-needles effect one experiences after one's arm or leg falls asleep, but not as intense.

While attuned to a flying citadel helm and sitting in it, you gain the following abilities for as long as you maintain {@status concentration} (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell):

items: You can use the flying citadel helm to move the citadel through the air, up to 80 feet per round, or up to 8 miles per hour.
You can steer the citadel, albeit in a somewhat clumsy fashion, in much the way that a rudder or oars can be used to maneuver a seafaring ship.
At any time, you can see and hear from the highest point outside the citadel as though you were at that location.

entries: If no creature attuned to the helm is maintaining {@status concentration}, the citadel remains motionless in its space.

entries.name: Transfer Attunement
entries: You can use an action or a bonus action to touch a willing spellcaster, whereupon that creature attunes to the flying citadel helm immediately, and your attunement to the flying citadel helm ends.
entries_es: Usted puede utilizar una acción o una acción de bonificación para tocar una ortografía dispuesta, en la que esa criatura attunes a la ciudadela voladora helm inmediatamente, y su entrada a los extremos de la ciudadela voladora.

entries.name: Crash
entries: Should the flying citadel helm be destroyed, the citadel it is installed on loses power and begins to crumble. If the crumbling citadel is in the air, it descends at a rate of 30 feet per round, or 300 feet per minute. Any creature on the citadel or on the ground within 120 feet of the citadel when it lands must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 39 ({@damage 6d12}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries_es: Si la ciudadela voladora se destruye, la ciudadela se instala en el poder de pérdida y comienza a desmoronarse. Si la ciudadela desmoronada está en el aire, baja a una velocidad de 30 pies por ronda, o 300 pies por minuto. Cualquier criatura en la ciudadela o en el suelo a 120 pies de la ciudadela cuando aterriza debe hacer un {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 39 ([TAG1]) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

La función de esta silla ornamentada es impulsar y maniobrar una ciudadela voladora en la que se ha instalado. La silla tiene AC 15, 18 puntos de impacto, e inmunidad para envenenar y daños psíquicos. Se destruye si se reduce a 0 puntos de impacto.
La sensación de estar afinada a un timón de ciudadela volador es similar al efecto de pins y agujas una experiencia después de que el brazo o la pierna se duerma, pero no tan intensa.

Mientras se atrevía a un timón de la ciudadela voladora y sentado en él, usted gana las siguientes habilidades por el tiempo que usted mantiene {@status concentration}] (como si {@status concentration||concentrating} en un hechizo):

items: You can use the flying citadel helm to move the citadel through the air, up to 80 feet per round, or up to 8 miles per hour.
You can steer the citadel, albeit in a somewhat clumsy fashion, in much the way that a rudder or oars can be used to maneuver a seafaring ship.
At any time, you can see and hear from the highest point outside the citadel as though you were at that location.

entries_es: Si ninguna criatura afinada al timón está manteniendo {@status concentration}, la ciudadela permanece inmóvil en su espacio.

item.name: Flying Fish Ship
entries: Aside from space galleons, flying fish ships are the most common vessels in Wildspace, favorites among merchants and adventurers alike.

A flying fish ship can float and sail on water, but it isn't built to land on the ground (the ventral fins would snap under the weight of the ship during landing, and the keel would cause the ship to roll to one side).
Typical weapons on a flying fish ship include a forward-mounted mangonel and an aft-mounted ballista.
entries_es: Aparte de los galleones espaciales, los barcos de peces voladores son los buques más comunes en Wildspace, los favoritos entre comerciantes y aventureros por igual.

Un barco de peces volador puede flotar y navegar sobre el agua, pero no se construye para aterrizar en el suelo (las aletas ventrales se romperían bajo el peso del barco durante el aterrizaje, y el quilla haría que el barco rodara a un lado).
Las armas típicas en un barco de peces voladores incluyen un mangonel montado en el futuro y un balista montado en popa.

item.name: Flying Snake
entries: Pet flying snakes use the {@creature Flying Snake|XMM} stat block.
entries_es: Las serpientes voladoras utilizan el bloque [[TAG0].

item.name: Folding Boat
entries: This object appears as a wooden box that measures 12 inches long, 6 inches wide, and 6 inches deep. It weighs 4 pounds and floats. It can be opened to store items inside. This item also has three command words, each requiring you to use an action to speak it.

One command word causes the box to unfold into a boat 10 feet long, 4 feet wide, and 2 feet deep. The boat has one pair of oars, an anchor, a mast, and a lateen sail. The boat can hold up to four Medium creatures comfortably.

The second command word causes the box to unfold into a ship 24 feet long, 8 feet wide; and 6 feet deep. The ship has a deck, rowing seats, five sets of oars, a steering oar, an anchor, a deck cabin, and a mast with a square sail. The ship can hold fifteen Medium creatures comfortably.
When the box becomes a vessel, its weight becomes that of a normal vessel its size, and anything that was stored in the box remains in the boat.

The third command word causes the folding boat to fold back into a box, provided that no creatures are aboard. Any objects in the vessel that can't fit inside the box remain outside the box as it folds. Any objects in the vessel that can fit inside the box do so.
entries_es: Este objeto aparece como una caja de madera que mide 12 pulgadas de largo, 6 pulgadas de ancho y 6 pulgadas de profundidad. Pesa 4 libras y flota. Se puede abrir para almacenar artículos dentro. Este artículo también tiene tres palabras de comando, cada una que requiere que utilice una acción para hablarlo.

Una palabra de comando hace que la caja se desarrolle en un barco de 10 pies de largo, 4 pies de ancho, y 2 pies de profundidad. El barco tiene un par de remos, un ancla, un mástil y una vela de catorce. El barco puede sostener hasta cuatro criaturas medianas cómodamente.

La segunda palabra de mando hace que la caja se despliegue en un barco de 24 pies de largo, 8 pies de ancho, y 6 pies de profundidad. El barco tiene una cubierta, asientos de remo, cinco conjuntos de remos, un oso de dirección, un ancla, una cabina de cubierta, y un mástil con una vela cuadrada. El barco puede contener quince criaturas medianas cómodamente.
Cuando la caja se convierte en un recipiente, su peso se convierte en el de un vaso normal su tamaño, y cualquier cosa que se almacena en la caja permanece en el barco.

La tercera palabra de comando hace que el barco plegable se dobla de nuevo en una caja, siempre que ninguna criatura está a bordo. Cualquier objeto en el recipiente que no pueda encajar dentro de la caja permanece fuera de la caja mientras se dobla. Cualquier objeto en el recipiente que pueda encajar dentro de la caja lo hace.

item.name: Fool Card
entries: As an action, you can brandish this card at one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw, or for the next minute, the target can't cast spells or activate magic items, it has disadvantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have resistance to all damage it deals. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Como acción, puedes marcar esta carta a una criatura que puedes ver a menos de 30 pies de ti mismo. El objetivo debe tener éxito en un {@dc 17} El lanzamiento de ahorro de sabiduría, o al minuto siguiente, el objetivo no puede lanzar hechizos o activar objetos mágicos, tiene desventaja en todos los lanzamientos de ahorro, y otras criaturas tienen resistencia a todos los daños que trata. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Forgery Kit
entries: This small box contains a variety of papers and parchments, pens and inks, seals and sealing wax, gold and silver leaf, and other supplies necessary to create convincing forgeries of physical documents. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to create a physical forgery of a document.
additionalEntries: A forgery kit is designed to duplicate documents and to make it easier to copy a person's seal or signature.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: A forgery kit includes several different types of ink, a variety of parchments and papers, several quills, seals and sealing wax, gold and silver leaf, and small tools to sculpt melted wax to mimic a seal.
entries_es: Un kit de falsificación incluye varios tipos diferentes de tinta, una variedad de pergaminos y papeles, varias piezas, sellos y cera de sellado, oro y hoja de plata, y pequeñas herramientas para esculpir cera fundida para imitar un sello.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana
entries: A forgery kit can be used in conjunction with the Arcana skill to determine if a magic item is real or fake.
entries_es: Un kit de falsificación se puede utilizar junto con la habilidad Arcana para determinar si un elemento mágico es real o falso.

additionalEntries.name: Deception
entries: A well-crafted forgery, such as papers proclaiming you to be a noble or a writ that grants you safe passage, can lend credence to a lie.
entries_es: Una falsificación bien hecha, como papeles que proclaman que eres un noble o un escrito que te otorga un pasaje seguro, puede dar credibilidad a una mentira.

additionalEntries.name: History
entries: A forgery kit combined with your knowledge of history improves your ability to create fake historical documents or to tell if an old document is authentic.
entries_es: Un kit de falsificación combinado con su conocimiento de la historia mejora su capacidad para crear documentos históricos falsos o para saber si un viejo documento es auténtico.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: When you examine objects, proficiency with a forgery kit is useful for determining how an object was made and whether it is genuine.
entries_es: Cuando se examinan objetos, la competencia con un kit de falsificación es útil para determinar cómo se hizo un objeto y si es genuino.

additionalEntries.name: Other Tools
entries: Knowledge of other tools makes your forgeries that much more believable. For example, you could combine proficiency with a forgery kit and proficiency with cartographer's tools to make a fake map.
entries_es: El conocimiento de otras herramientas hace que sus falsificaciones sean mucho más creíbles. Por ejemplo, podría combinar la competencia con un kit de falsificación y la competencia con las herramientas del cartógrafo para hacer un mapa falso.

additionalEntries.name: Quick Fake
entries: As part of a short rest, you can produce a forged document no more than one page in length. As part of a long rest, you can produce a document that is up to four pages long. Your Intelligence check using a forgery kit determines the DC for someone else's Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to spot the fake.
entries_es: Como parte de un breve descanso, usted puede producir un documento falsificado no más de una página de longitud. Como parte de un largo descanso, puede producir un documento de hasta cuatro páginas. Su comprobación de inteligencia usando un kit de falsificación determina el DC para la inteligencia de otra persona ([TAG0]) comprobar para detectar la falsificación.

item.name: Fulminating Treatise
entries: This thick, scorched spellbook reeks of smoke and ozone, and sparks of energy crackles along the edges of its pages. When found, the book contains the following spells: {@spell contingency}, {@spell fireball}, {@spell gust of wind}, {@spell Leomund's tiny hut}, {@spell magic missile}, {@spell thunderwave}, and {@spell wall of force}. It functions as a spellbook for you.
While you are holding the book, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your wizard spells.
The book has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can use the charges in the following ways while holding it:

items: If you spend 1 minute studying the book, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your prepared wizard spells with a different spell in the book. The new spell must be of the evocation school.

When one creature you can see takes damage from an evocation spell you cast, you can use your reaction and expend 1 charge to deal an extra {@damage 2d6} force damage to the creature and knock the creature {@condition prone} if it is Large or smaller.

entries_es: Este libro de hechizos espeso y anotado apesta a humo y ozono, y chispas de energía a lo largo de los bordes de sus páginas. Cuando se encuentra, el libro contiene los siguientes hechizos: {@spell contingency}, {@spell fireball}], {@spell gust of wind}, {@spell Leomund's tiny hut}, {@spell magic missile}, {@spell thunderwave}, y {@spell wall of force}. Funciona como un libro de hechizos para ti.
Mientras sostienes el libro, puedes utilizarlo como un foco de ortografía para tus hechizos magos.
El libro tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Puede utilizar los cargos de las siguientes maneras mientras lo sostiene:

items: If you spend 1 minute studying the book, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your prepared wizard spells with a different spell in the book. The new spell must be of the evocation school.

When one creature you can see takes damage from an evocation spell you cast, you can use your reaction and expend 1 charge to deal an extra {@damage 2d6} force damage to the creature and knock the creature {@condition prone} if it is Large or smaller.

item.name: Galder's Bubble Pipe
entries: This finely carved pipe blows odorless bubbles instead of smoke when used. The pipe has 3 charges, and it regains all spent charges daily at dawn. While you hold the pipe, you can expend charges to gain access to the following properties:

items: You can cast {@spell fog cloud} as an action (1 charge).
You can cast {@spell misty step} as a bonus action (2 charges).

You can summon a {@creature steam mephit} as an action (3 charges). The mephit is friendly to you, obeys your verbal commands, and acts on its own turn in the initiative order. It disappears in a harmless puff of steam after 1 minute or if it ends its turn more than 60 feet from the pipe.

entries_es: Esta tubería finamente tallada sopla burbujas sin olor en lugar de humo cuando se utiliza. La tubería tiene 3 cargos, y recupera todos los cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Mientras mantiene la tubería, puede gastar cargos para obtener acceso a las siguientes propiedades:

items: You can cast {@spell fog cloud} as an action (1 charge).
You can cast {@spell misty step} as a bonus action (2 charges).

You can summon a {@creature steam mephit} as an action (3 charges). The mephit is friendly to you, obeys your verbal commands, and acts on its own turn in the initiative order. It disappears in a harmless puff of steam after 1 minute or if it ends its turn more than 60 feet from the pipe.

item.name: Garb of Light and Shadow
entries: This garb appeals to Fey from one Domain of Delight, such as the Gloaming Court or the Summer Court. While wearing the garb, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks to influence Fey associated with that Domain of Delight.
entries_es: Este garbo apela a Fey de un Dominio de Deleite, como el Tribunal de Gloaming o el Tribunal de Verano. Mientras usas el garbo, tienes {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en cheques de habilidad para influir en Fey asociado con ese Dominio de Deleite.

item.name: Gauntlets of Flaming Fury
entries: While you wear both of these steel gauntlets, any non-magical weapon you grasp with either gauntlet is treated as a magic weapon. As a bonus action, you can use the gauntlets to cause magical flames to envelop one or two melee weapons in your grasp. Each flaming weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d6} fire damage on a hit. The flames last until you sheath or let go of either weapon. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras usted usa ambos de estos guantes de acero, cualquier arma no mágica que usted agarra con cualquier gauntlet se trata como un arma mágica. Como una acción de bonificación, puede utilizar los gauntlets para causar llamas mágicas para envolver una o dos armas de meleo en su mano. Cada arma en llamas tiene un daño de fuego adicional [[TAG0] en un golpe. Las llamas duran hasta que usted derrame o deje ir de cualquier arma. Una vez utilizado, esta propiedad no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
entries: Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is already 19 or higher without them.
entries_es: Su puntaje de fuerza es de 19 años mientras usa estos gauntlets. No tienen ningún efecto en ti si tu Fuerza ya es 19 o superior sin ellos.

entries: Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is 19 or higher without them.
