item.name: Gauntlets of Rage
item.reqAttune: by a bard, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: You gain the power of never-ending fury. After you make a melee weapon attack, you automatically enter a special fury for 1 minute. While furious, you can't cast spells, can't verbally communicate, and are immune to the {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened} conditions. Each time you deal damage, you regain {@dice 2d8} hit points and may immediately remove a condition you currently suffer from or end this fury. Additionally, while in this fury, you may spend a spell slot before you make a melee attack. Doing so causes the attack to deal an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage per level of spell slot expended, if the attack hits. Once used you may not use this fury again until you finish a short or long rest.
entries_es: Ganas el poder de la furia interminable. Después de hacer un ataque de arma melee, automáticamente entras en una furia especial durante 1 minuto. Si bien es furioso, no puede emitir hechizos, no puede comunicarse verbalmente, y son inmunes a las condiciones {@condition charmed} y {@condition frightened}. Cada vez que se hace daño, se recupera {@dice 2d8} puntos de impacto y puede eliminar inmediatamente una condición que sufre actualmente o termina esta furia. Además, mientras que en esta furia, puede pasar una ranura de hechizo antes de hacer un ataque de melee. Hacerlo hace que el ataque trate un daño necrótico adicional 3 ([TAG3]] por nivel de ranura de hechizo gastado, si el ataque golpea. Una vez utilizado usted puede no utilizar esta furia de nuevo hasta que termine un breve o largo descanso.

item.name: Gavel of the Venn Rune
entries: This wooden gavel is small by giant reckoning but nearly the size of a warhammer in human hands. The venn (friend) rune is inscribed in mithral in the base of the haft. Among giants, this item is used as part of rituals to resolve disputes. The gavel has the following properties.

entries.name: Arbiters Shield
entries: At the start of every combat, attack rolls against you have disadvantage before the start of your first turn, provided that the gavel is on your person.
entries_es: Al comienzo de cada combate, los rollos de ataque contra usted tienen desventaja antes del comienzo de su primer turno, siempre que el dl está en su persona.

entries.name: Bond of Amity
entries: As an action, you can use the gavel to strike a point on a hard surface. The first time in the next minute that a creature within 60 feet of that point deals damage to another creature with an attack that hits, the attacker takes psychic damage equal to half the damage it dealt to the target. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Como acción, se puede utilizar el dil para golpear un punto en una superficie dura. La primera vez en el minuto siguiente que una criatura a menos de 60 pies de ese punto daña a otra criatura con un ataque que golpea, el atacante toma daño psíquico igual a la mitad del daño que trató al objetivo. Una vez que utilice esta propiedad, no puede utilizarla de nuevo hasta que termine un largo descanso.

entries.name: Gift of Truth
entries: You can transfer the gavel's magic to a place by tracing the venn rune on the ground with your finger. The point where you trace it becomes the center of a spherical area of magic that has a 30-foot radius and that is fixed to the place. The transfer takes 8 hours of work that requires the gavel to be within 5 feet of you. At the end, the gavel is destroyed, and the area gains the following property:
Whenever a creature utters a lie while within the 30-foot-radius sphere, that creature takes 5 psychic damage and flinches visibly.
entries_es: Puedes transferir la magia del diente a un lugar rastreando la runa del venno en el suelo con el dedo. El punto donde traza se convierte en el centro de una zona esférica de magia que tiene un radio de 30 pies y que se fija al lugar. El traslado lleva 8 horas de trabajo que requiere que el duelo esté a 5 pies de usted. Al final, el dil es destruido, y el área gana la siguiente propiedad:
Cada vez que una criatura dice una mentira mientras dentro de la esfera de 30 pies-radius, esa criatura toma 5 daños psíquicos y golpes visiblemente.

Este diente de madera es pequeño por la cuenta gigante pero casi el tamaño de un bárbaro en manos humanas. La runa de venno (amigo) está inscrita en mitra en la base del heft. Entre los gigantes, este artículo se utiliza como parte de rituales para resolver disputas. El duelo tiene las siguientes propiedades.

entries_es.name: Arbiters Shield
entries: At the start of every combat, attack rolls against you have disadvantage before the start of your first turn, provided that the gavel is on your person.
entries_es: Al comienzo de cada combate, los rollos de ataque contra usted tienen desventaja antes del comienzo de su primer turno, siempre que el dl está en su persona.

entries_es.name: Bond of Amity
entries: As an action, you can use the gavel to strike a point on a hard surface. The first time in the next minute that a creature within 60 feet of that point deals damage to another creature with an attack that hits, the attacker takes psychic damage equal to half the damage it dealt to the target. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Como acción, se puede utilizar el dil para golpear un punto en una superficie dura. La primera vez en el minuto siguiente que una criatura a menos de 60 pies de ese punto daña a otra criatura con un ataque que golpea, el atacante toma daño psíquico igual a la mitad del daño que trató al objetivo. Una vez que utilice esta propiedad, no puede utilizarla de nuevo hasta que termine un largo descanso.

entries_es.name: Gift of Truth
entries: You can transfer the gavel's magic to a place by tracing the venn rune on the ground with your finger. The point where you trace it becomes the center of a spherical area of magic that has a 30-foot radius and that is fixed to the place. The transfer takes 8 hours of work that requires the gavel to be within 5 feet of you. At the end, the gavel is destroyed, and the area gains the following property:
Whenever a creature utters a lie while within the 30-foot-radius sphere, that creature takes 5 psychic damage and flinches visibly.
entries_es: Puedes transferir la magia del diente a un lugar rastreando la runa del venno en el suelo con el dedo. El punto donde traza se convierte en el centro de una zona esférica de magia que tiene un radio de 30 pies y que se fija al lugar. El traslado lleva 8 horas de trabajo que requiere que el duelo esté a 5 pies de usted. Al final, el dil es destruido, y el área gana la siguiente propiedad:
Cada vez que una criatura dice una mentira mientras dentro de la esfera de 30 pies-radius, esa criatura toma 5 daños psíquicos y golpes visiblemente.

item.name: Gem Card
entries: This card holds one 6th-level spell (chosen by the DM). As an action, you can brandish this card and use it to cast the spell stored inside (spell attack bonus +9, save {@dc 17}). Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Esta tarjeta contiene un hechizo de 6o nivel (elegido por el DM). Como acción, puede marcar esta tarjeta y utilizarla para lanzar el hechizo almacenado en el interior (por favor, bonificación de ataque +9, guardar {@dc 17}). Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Gem of Brightness
entries: This prism has 50 charges. While you are holding it, you can use an action to speak one of three command words to cause one of the following effects:

items: The first command word causes the gem to shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. This effect doesn't expend a charge. It lasts until you use a bonus action to repeat the command word or until you use another function of the gem.

The second command word expends 1 charge and causes the gem to fire a brilliant beam of light at one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

The third command word expends 5 charges and causes the gem to flare with blinding light in a 30-foot cone originating from it. Each creature in the cone must make a saving throw as if struck by the beam created with the second command word.

entries: When all of the gem's charges are expended, the gem becomes a nonmagical jewel worth 50 gp.

entries_es: Cuando todos los cargos de la gema son gastados, la gema se convierte en una joya no mágica de 50 gp.

item.name: Gem of Seeing
entries: This gem has 3 charges. As an action, you can speak the gem's command word and expend 1 charge. For the next 10 minutes, you have {@sense truesight} out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem.
The gem regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: Esta gema tiene 3 cargos. Como acción, puede hablar la palabra de comando de la gema y gastar 1 cargo. Durante los próximos 10 minutos, usted tiene [[TAG0] a 120 pies cuando usted mira a través de la gema.
La gema recupera {@dice 1d3} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

entries: This gem has 3 charges. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 charge. For the next 10 minutes, you have {@sense Truesight|XPHB} out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem.

La gema recupera {@dice 1d3} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Genie Robe
entries: This robe appeals to Elementals associated with a particular Elemental Plane (Air, Earth, Fire, Water). While wearing a Genie Robe, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks made to influence Elementals associated with that plane.
entries_es: Esta túnica apela a Elementales asociados a un determinado Plano Elemental (Air, Tierra, Fuego, Agua). Mientras llevas un Genie Robe, tienes {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en cheques de habilidad hechos para influir en Elementos asociados con ese plano.

item.name: Ghost Lantern
entries: A restless spirit is trapped inside this lantern. While holding the lantern, you can command the spirit as a bonus action to shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

While holding the lantern, you can use an action to order the spirit to leave the lantern and duplicate the effect of the {@spell mage hand} spell. The spirit returns to the lantern when the spell ends.
If you fall {@condition unconscious} within 10 feet of the lantern, the spirit emerges from it, magically stabilizes you with a touch, and then quickly returns to the lantern.
The spirit is bound to the lantern and can't be harmed, turned, or raised from the dead.
Casting a {@spell dispel evil and good} spell on the lantern releases the spirit to the afterlife and renders the lantern nonmagical.
entries_es: Un espíritu inquieto está atrapado dentro de esta linterna. Mientras sostienes la linterna, puedes mandar al espíritu como una acción de bonificación para arrojar luz brillante en un radio de 30 pies y luz tenue para un adicional de 30 pies.

Mientras sostiene la linterna, puede utilizar una acción para ordenar al espíritu que abandone la linterna y duplicar el efecto del hechizo [[TAG0]. El espíritu vuelve a la linterna cuando el hechizo termina.
Si caes {@condition unconscious} dentro de 10 pies de la linterna, el espíritu emerge de ella, mágicamente te estabiliza con un toque, y luego vuelve rápidamente a la linterna.
El espíritu está ligado a la linterna y no puede ser dañado, convertido, o resucitado de los muertos.
Casting a [[TAG0] hechizo en la linterna libera el espíritu a la vida posterior y hace que la linterna no sea mágica.

item.name: Ghost Step Tattoo
entries: Produced by a special needle, this tattoo shifts and wavers on the skin, parts of it appearing blurred.

entries.name: Tattoo Attunement
entries: To attune to this item, you hold the needle to your skin where you want the tattoo to appear, pressing the needle there throughout the attunement process. When the attunement is complete, the needle turns into the ink that becomes the tattoo, which appears on the skin.
If your attunement to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes, and the needle reappears in your space.
entries_es: Para afinar a este artículo, usted sostiene la aguja a su piel donde desea que aparezca el tatuaje, presionando la aguja allí durante todo el proceso de atracción. Cuando el dispositivo está completo, la aguja se convierte en la tinta que se convierte en el tatuaje, que aparece en la piel.
Si su atontado al tatuaje termina, el tatuaje desaparece, y la aguja reaparece en su espacio.

entries.name: Ghostly Form
entries: The tattoo has 3 charges, and it regains all expended charges daily at dawn. As a bonus action while the tattoo is on your skin, you can expend 1 of the tattoo's charges to become incorporeal until the end of your next turn. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
You can't be {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained}.

You can move through creatures and solid objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. If you end your turn in a solid object, you take {@damage 1d10} force damage. If the effect ends while you are inside a solid object, you instead are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space, and you take {@damage 1d10} force damage for every 5 feet traveled.

entries_es: El tatuaje tiene 3 cargos, y recupera todos los cargos enviados diariamente al amanecer. Como una acción de bonificación mientras el tatuaje está en su piel, usted puede gastar 1 de los cargos del tatuaje para convertirse en incorporal hasta el final de su próximo turno. Durante la duración, usted obtiene los siguientes beneficios:

items: You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.
You can't be {@condition grappled} or {@condition restrained}.

If the effect ends while you are inside a solid object, you instead are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space, and you take {@damage 1d10} force damage for every 5 feet traveled.

item.name: Giant Trinket
entries: While exploring your home, you discovered some trivial remnant of the ancient inhabitants, as determined by rolling on the Giant Trinkets table. The items in parentheses are the normal-sized objects most analogous to the described giant trinkets.

entries.caption: Giant Trinkets
rows: A giant's toothpick (a {@item dagger|PHB})
A giant's handkerchief (a {@item blanket|PHB})
A giant's marble (a crystal orb)
A giant's match (a {@item torch|PHB})
A giant's letter opener (a {@item longsword|PHB})
A giant's thimble (an {@item iron pot|PHB})

entries_es: Mientras exploraba su casa, descubriste algún remanente trivial de los antiguos habitantes, determinado por rodar en la mesa de las Trinkets gigantes. Los elementos entre paréntesis son los objetos de tamaño normal más análogos a los trinkets gigantes descritos.

item.name: Glamoured Studded Leather
entries: While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC. You can also use a bonus action to speak the armor's command word and cause the armor to assume the appearance of a normal set of clothing or some other kind of armor. You decide what it looks like, including color, style, and accessories, but the armor retains its normal bulk and weight. The illusory appearance lasts until you use this property again or remove the armor.
entries_es: Mientras llevas esta armadura, ganas un bono +1 a AC. También puede utilizar una acción de bonificación para hablar la palabra de mando de la armadura y hacer que la armadura asuma la apariencia de un conjunto normal de ropa o algún otro tipo de armadura. Usted decide cómo se ve, incluyendo color, estilo y accesorios, pero la armadura conserva su volumen y peso normal. La apariencia ilusoria dura hasta que vuelva a usar esta propiedad o retire la armadura.

item.name: Glamoured Studded Leather
entries: While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}. You can also take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cause the armor to assume the appearance of a normal set of clothing or some other kind of armor. You decide what it looks like—including color, style, and accessories—but the armor retains its normal bulk and weight. The illusory appearance lasts until you use this property again or doff the armor.
entries_es: Mientras llevas esta armadura, ganas un bono +1 a {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}. También puede tomar un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} para hacer que la armadura asuma la apariencia de un conjunto normal de ropa o algún otro tipo de armadura. Usted decide lo que parece —incluyendo el color, el estilo y los accesorios— pero la armadura conserva su volumen y peso normales. La apariencia ilusoria dura hasta que vuelvas a usar esta propiedad o doff la armadura.

item.name: Glass Bottle
entries: A bottle holds 1½ pints of liquid.
entries_es: Una botella contiene 11⁄2 litros de líquido.

item.name: Glass Bottle
entries: A Glass Bottle holds up to 1½ pints.
entries_es: Una botella de vidrio tiene hasta 11⁄2 pintas.

item.name: Glassblower's Tools
additionalEntries: Someone who is proficient with glassblower's tools has not only the ability to shape glass, but also specialized knowledge of the methods used to produce glass objects.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: The tools include a blowpipe, a small marver, blocks, and tweezers. You need a source of heat to work glass.
entries_es: Las herramientas incluyen una sopa, un pequeño marver, bloques y pinzas. Necesitas una fuente de calor para trabajar vidrio.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, History
entries: Your knowledge of glassmaking techniques aids you when you examine glass objects, such as potion bottles or glass items found in a treasure hoard. For instance, you can study how a glass potion bottle has been changed by its contents to help determine a potion's effects. (A potion might leave behind a residue, deform the glass, or stain it.)
entries_es: Su conocimiento de técnicas de vidrio le ayuda cuando se examinan objetos de vidrio, como botellas de poción o elementos de vidrio encontrados en un tesoro. Por ejemplo, puede estudiar cómo ha cambiado una botella de poción de vidrio por su contenido para ayudar a determinar los efectos de una poción. (Una poción podría dejar atrás un residuo, deformar el vidrio, o mancharlo.)

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: When you study an area, your knowledge can aid you if the clues include broken glass or glass objects.
entries_es: Cuando estudias un área, tu conocimiento puede ayudarte si las pistas incluyen objetos de vidrio o vidrio rotos.

additionalEntries.name: Identify Weakness
entries: With 1 minute of study, you can identify the weak points in a glass object. Any damage dealt to the object by striking a weak spot is doubled.
entries_es: Con 1 minuto de estudio, puede identificar los puntos débiles en un objeto de vidrio. Cualquier daño causado al objeto golpeando un punto débil se duplica.

item.name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
entries: These gloves seem to almost meld into your hands when you don them. When a ranged weapon attack hits you while you're wearing them, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage by {@dice 1d10} + your Dexterity modifier, provided that you have a free hand. If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the missile if it is small enough for you to hold in that hand.
entries_es: Estos guantes parecen casi mezclarse en tus manos cuando los haces. Cuando un ataque de arma extendida te golpea mientras los llevas, puedes usar tu reacción para reducir el daño por {@dice 1d10} + tu modificador de Dexterity, siempre y cuando tengas una mano libre. Si reduces el daño a 0, puedes coger el misil si es lo suficientemente pequeño para que te mantengas en esa mano.

item.name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
entries: If you're hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon while wearing these gloves, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the damage by {@dice 1d10} plus your Dexterity modifier if you have a free hand. If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the ammunition or weapon if it is small enough for you to hold in that hand.
entries_es: Si usted es golpeado por un rollo de ataque hecho con un arma Ranged o lanzada mientras lleva estos guantes, usted puede tomar un {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} para reducir el daño por {@dice 1d10} más su modificador Dexterity si usted tiene una mano libre. Alternatively, instead of regaining hit points in this way, you can choose to gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw you make before the end of your next turn.

entries: This unique explosive can be primed and thrown up to 30 feet as an action. It explodes on impact. A {@condition restrained} creature can make a {@dc 12} Strength check as an action, escaping on a success.

item.name: Gnomengarde Grenade
entries: This small metallic object is comprised of rune-covered parts made from different metals, linked together with a variety of gears, bands, bits, and bobs. The metals are all different colors, making the grenade shine with a rainbow of color when held up in the light.

As a bonus action, a creature can turn a special key to arm the grenade. Once armed, the grenade explodes in a matter of seconds. As an action, the wielder can hurl the grenade up to 120 feet. At the end of their turn, the grenade explodes. All creatures within 60 feet of the grenade when it explodes suffer the following effects:

items: Each creature must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much fire damage on a successful one.

Each creature must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 28 ({@damage 8d6}) thunder damage and is {@condition stunned} until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much thunder damage and is not {@condition stunned}.

The wielder rolls on the chart* for the {@item wand of wonder|dmg} three times, rerolling any duplicate results. Any effects that specify a target affect all creatures in range of the grenade when it explodes. Any effects that would affect the wielder of the wand instead affect the closest creature to the grenade when it goes off.

entries: The grenade explodes immediately if a creature places it in an extradimensional space or teleports while in possession of it. The effects of the explosion will be felt at both the origin and terminus of the teleportation, but only affecting all creatures within 30 feet of either location.

In addition, you can cast the {@spell identify} spell using the googles. Once you do so, you can't do so again until the next dawn.

Además, puede lanzar el hechizo {@spell identify} usando los googles. Una vez que lo hagas, no puedes hacerlo de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Gold (gp)
entries: Common coins come in several different denominations based on the relative worth of the metal from which they are made. The three most common coins are the gold piece (gp), the silver piece (sp), and the copper piece (cp).

With one gold piece, a character can buy a belt pouch, 50 feet of good rope, or a goat. A skilled (but not exceptional) artisan can earn one gold piece a day. The gold piece is the standard unit of measure for wealth, even if the coin itself is not commonly used. When merchants discuss deals that involve goods or services worth hundreds or thousands of gold pieces, the transactions don't usually involve the exchange of individual coins. Rather, the gold piece is a standard measure of value, and the actual exchange is in gold bars, letters of credit, or valuable goods.
One gold piece is worth ten silver pieces, the most prevalent coin among commoners. A silver piece buys a laborer's work for a day, a flask of lamp oil, or a night's rest in a poor inn.
One silver piece is worth ten copper pieces, which are common among laborers and beggars. A single copper piece buys a candle, a torch, or a piece of chalk.

In addition, unusual coins made of other precious metals sometimes appear in treasure hoards. The electrum piece (ep) and the platinum piece (pp) originate from fallen empires and lost kingdoms, and they sometimes arouse suspicion and skepticism when used in transactions. An electrum piece is worth five silver pieces, and a platinum piece is worth ten gold pieces.
A standard coin weighs about a third of an ounce, so fifty coins weigh a pound.
entries_es: Las monedas comunes vienen en varias denominaciones diferentes basadas en el valor relativo del metal del que se hacen. Las tres monedas más comunes son la pieza de oro (gp), la pieza de plata (sp), y la pieza de cobre (cp).

Con una pieza de oro, un personaje puede comprar una bolsa de cinturón, 50 pies de buena cuerda, o una cabra. Un hábil (pero no excepcional) artesano puede ganar una pieza de oro al día. La pieza de oro es la unidad estándar de medida para la riqueza, incluso si la moneda en sí no se utiliza comúnmente. Cuando los comerciantes hablan de acuerdos que implican bienes o servicios valen cientos o miles de piezas de oro, las transacciones no suelen implicar el intercambio de monedas individuales. Más bien, la pieza de oro es una medida estándar de valor, y el intercambio real está en barras de oro, cartas de crédito o bienes valiosos.

Una pieza de oro vale diez piezas de plata, la moneda más frecuente entre los más comunes. Una pieza de plata compra el trabajo de un trabajador por un día, un frasco de aceite de lámpara, o un descanso nocturno en una pobre posada.
Una pieza de plata vale diez piezas de cobre, que son comunes entre obreros y mendigos. Una sola pieza de cobre compra una vela, una antorcha o un pedazo de tiza.

Además, las monedas inusuales hechas de otros metales preciosos a veces aparecen en tesoros. La pieza electrum (ep) y la pieza platino (pp) se originan de imperios caídos y reinos perdidos, y a veces despiertan sospecha y escepticismo cuando se utilizan en transacciones. Una pieza electrum vale cinco piezas de plata, y una pieza de platino vale diez piezas de oro.
Una moneda estándar pesa alrededor de un tercio de una onza, así que cincuenta monedas pesan una libra.

item.name: Gold Canary Figurine of Wondrous Power
entries: This gold statuette is carved in the likeness of a canary and is small enough to fit in a pocket. If you use an action to speak the command word and throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of you, the figurine becomes a living creature in one of two forms (you choose). If there isn't enough space for the creature where it would appear, the figurine doesn't become a creature. The two forms are as follows:

entries.name: Giant Canary Form
entries: The figurine becomes a {@creature giant canary|FTD} for up to 8 hours and can be ridden as a mount. Once the figurine has become a {@creature giant canary|FTD}, it can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
entries_es: La figura se convierte en un [[TAG0] por hasta 8 horas y se puede montar como montaje. Una vez que la figura se ha convertido en un {@creature giant canary|FTD}, no se puede utilizar de esta manera hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Gold Dragon Form
entries: While you are missing half or more of your hit points, you can speak a different command word and the figurine becomes an {@creature adult gold dragon} (see its stat block in the Monster Manual) for up to 1 hour. The dragon can't use any legendary actions or lair actions. Once the figurine has become an {@creature adult gold dragon}, it can't be used this way again until 1 year has passed.

In either form, the creature is friendly to you and your companions. It understands your languages and obeys your spoken commands. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each form. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if it drops to 0 hit points or if you use an action to speak the command word again while touching it. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified in the description.
entries_es: Mientras usted está perdiendo la mitad o más de sus puntos de éxito, usted puede hablar una palabra de comando diferente y la figura se convierte en un {@creature adult gold dragon} (ver su bloque de puestos en el Manual del Monstruo) por hasta 1 hora. El dragón no puede usar ninguna acción legendaria o acciones de lair. Una vez que la figura se ha convertido en un {@creature adult gold dragon}, no se puede utilizar de esta manera hasta que haya pasado 1 año.

En cualquier forma, la criatura es amistosa contigo y tus compañeros. Comprende tus idiomas y obedece tus mandamientos hablados. Si no emites órdenes, la criatura se defiende pero no toma ninguna otra acción.

La criatura existe por una duración específica a cada forma. Al final de la duración, la criatura vuelve a su forma de figura. Revierte a una figura temprano si cae a 0 puntos de éxito o si usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo mientras la toca. Cuando la criatura se convierte en una figura de nuevo, su propiedad no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta que una cierta cantidad de tiempo ha pasado, como se especifica en la descripción.

entries: Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids. Other times, hunters carefully skin and preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, dragon scale mail is highly valued. While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, you have advantage on saving throws against the Frightful Presence and breath weapons of dragons, and you have resistance to fire damage.

entries: This ring, adorned with the symbol of Golgari, allows you to cast {@spell entangle}. Aside from its magical properties, the ring is also an indicator of Golgari's recognition and favor.
A signet has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast the associated spell (save {@dc 13}).
entries_es: Este anillo, adornado con el símbolo de Golgari, le permite lanzar {@spell entangle}. Un guild signet es a veces otorgado a un miembro del gremio cuyo renombre puntuación en ese gremio es 5 o superior, como recompensa por realizar servicios especiales para el gremio. Aparte de sus propiedades mágicas, el anillo también es un indicador del reconocimiento y favor de Golgari.
Un letrero tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. Al llevarla, puede gastar 1 carga para lanzar el hechizo asociado (salvar {@dc 13}).

item.name: Golgari Keyrune
item.reqAttune: by a member of the Golgari guild
entries: Made from deep green jade with black veins, this keyrune has an insectile shape. It can transform into a {@creature giant scorpion} for up to 6 hours. The scorpion has an Intelligence of 4 and can communicate with you telepathically while it is within 60 feet of you, though its messages are largely limited to describing the passage of potential prey.

When you use an action to speak the item's command word and place the keyrune on the ground in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, the keyrune transforms into a {@creature giant scorpion}. If there isn't enough space for the creature, the keyrune doesn't transform.

The creature is friendly to you, your companions, and other members of your guild (unless those guild members are hostile to you). It understands your languages and obeys your spoken commands. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the {@action Dodge} action and moves to avoid danger.

At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its keyrune form. It reverts early if it drops to 0 hit points or if you use an action to speak the command word again while touching it. When the creature reverts to its keyrune form, it can't transform again until 36 hours have passed.
entries_es: Fabricado en jade verde profundo con venas negras, esta llavero tiene una forma insectil. Puede transformarse en un [[TAG0] por hasta 6 horas. El escorpión tiene una inteligencia de 4 y puede comunicarse con usted telepáticamente mientras que está a menos de 60 pies de usted, aunque sus mensajes se limitan en gran medida a describir el paso de la presa potencial.

Cuando usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando del artículo y colocas el llavero en el suelo en un espacio no ocupado a 5 pies de ti, el llavero se transforma en un {@creature giant scorpion}. Si no hay suficiente espacio para la criatura, la llave no se transforma.

La criatura es amistosa con usted, sus compañeros y otros miembros de su gremio (a menos que esos miembros del gremio sean hostiles a usted). Comprende tus idiomas y obedece tus mandamientos hablados. Si usted no emite comandos, la criatura toma la acción {@action Dodge} y se mueve para evitar el peligro.

Al final de la duración, la criatura vuelve a su forma de llave. Revierte temprano si cae a 0 puntos de éxito o si usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo mientras la toca. Cuando la criatura vuelve a su forma de llavero, no puede transformarse hasta que hayan pasado 36 horas.

item.name: Goose Egg Trinket
entries: Sometimes, an egg laid by a {@creature giant goose|BGG} inexplicably contains some kind of small trinket or minor magic item. Once it lays a golden egg, a giant goose can't do so again for a year and a day.

You can use the Goose Egg Trinket table to determine the contents of a golden egg. A giant goose's egg can be a great way to give characters an item that's important to the story of an adventure or your campaign.

entries.caption: Goose Egg Trinket
rows: The egg is empty, but the inside of the shell is inscribed with a poem or an intricate illustration.
The gold shell encloses a candy egg.
The egg holds a small toy goose that makes a loud honking noise when squeezed.
The egg contains a {@item Potion of Hill Giant Strength||potion of giant strength (hill giant)} with no container.
The egg holds a {@item pearl of power}.
The egg contains a {@item brooch of shielding}.

The egg contains a {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power, Silver Raven||figurine of wondrous power (silver raven)} that activates automatically as the egg is opened, releasing what appears to be a living bird.
The egg is empty.

entries_es: A veces, un huevo colocado por un {@creature giant goose|BGG} contiene inexplicablemente algún tipo de pequeño trinket o elemento mágico menor. Una vez que pone un huevo dorado, un ganso gigante no puede hacerlo de nuevo por un año y un día.

Puede utilizar la tabla Goose Egg Trinket para determinar el contenido de un huevo dorado. Un huevo de ganso gigante puede ser una gran manera de dar a los personajes un elemento que es importante para la historia de una aventura o su campaña.

entries_es.caption: Goose Egg Trinket
rows: The egg is empty, but the inside of the shell is inscribed with a poem or an intricate illustration.
The gold shell encloses a candy egg.
The egg holds a small toy goose that makes a loud honking noise when squeezed.
The egg contains a {@item Potion of Hill Giant Strength||potion of giant strength (hill giant)} with no container.
The egg holds a {@item pearl of power}.
The egg contains a {@item brooch of shielding}.

The egg contains a {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power, Silver Raven||figurine of wondrous power (silver raven)} that activates automatically as the egg is opened, releasing what appears to be a living bird.
The egg is empty.

item.name: Grappling Hook
entries: As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can throw the Grappling Hook at a railing, a ledge, or another catch within 50 feet of yourself, and the hook catches on if you succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check. If you tied a Rope to the hook, you can then climb it.
entries_es: Como una acción {@action Utilize|XPHB}, se puede lanzar el gancho de relleno a una barandilla, una cornisa u otra captura dentro de 50 pies de usted mismo, y los ganchos se pegan si usted tiene éxito en un {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}]) cheque. Si ataste una cuerda al gancho, entonces puedes subirla.

item.name: Grasping Whip
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic whip. When you hit a creature or object that is Large or smaller with this whip, you can pull that creature or object 5 feet toward you instead of dealing damage.
entries_es: Ganas un bono +1 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este látigo mágico. Cuando golpeas a una criatura o objeto que es grande o más pequeño con este látigo, puedes tirar de esa criatura o objeto 5 pies hacia ti en lugar de hacer daño.

item.name: Gravenhollow Compass Ring
entries: This gold ring is fitted with a star ruby worth 1,000 gp. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals that the gem radiates a faint aura of divination magic. The gem's star-shaped core is a magical compass that guides the ring's wearer along the safest, shortest route to Gravenhollow.
entries_es: Este anillo de oro está equipado con un rubí estrella vale 1000 gp. Un hechizo {@spell detect magic} revela que la gema irradia un débil aura de la magia de adivinación. El núcleo en forma de estrella de la gema es una brújula mágica que guía el portador del anillo a lo largo de la ruta más segura y corta a Gravenhollow.

item.name: Graz'tchar, the Decadent End
entries: This blade appears to be a beautiful cruciform sword of shining silver, inlaid with sparkling rubies. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, which has the following properties.

entries.name: Corrosive Submission
entries: When you hit a creature that has an Intelligence score of 4 or higher with an attack using this sword, the target takes an extra {@damage 3d6} acid damage and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be {@condition charmed} by you for 1 hour. If you attack the creature again while it is {@condition charmed} in this way, the extra acid damage increases to {@dice 10d6} and the {@condition charmed} condition ends. If the target succeeds on its {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or the charm ends for it, it can't be {@condition charmed} again in this way for 24 hours.
entries_es: Cuando golpeas a una criatura que tiene una puntuación de inteligencia de 4 o superior con un ataque usando esta espada, el objetivo toma un daño ácido extra [[TAG0] y debe tener éxito en un {@dc 17} Charisma {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}] o ser {@condition charmed} por ti durante 1 hora. Si atacas a la criatura de nuevo mientras es {@condition charmed} de esta manera, el daño al ácido extra aumenta a {@dice 10d6} y la condición {@condition charmed} termina. Si el objetivo tiene éxito en su {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} o el encanto termina por él, no puede ser [[TAG3] de nuevo de esta manera durante 24 horas.

entries.name: Hidden Nature
entries: The acid damage dealt by this greatsword appears to be radiant damage to all who perceive it. A {@spell true seeing} spell or similar magic reveals that the sword is actually a rusted, pitted blade dripping with acid.
entries_es: El daño ácido tratado por esta gran espada parece ser un daño radiante a todos los que lo perciben. Un hechizo {@spell true seeing} o magia similar revela que la espada es en realidad una espada oxidada y manchada goteando con ácido.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: {@deity Graz'tchar|Exandria|TDCSR|Graz'tchar} is a sentient neutral evil weapon with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 12, and a Charisma of 18. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.

The sword can speak, read, and understand {@language Common}, and can communicate with its wielder telepathically. Anyone who holds it hears the wise voice of a sorrowful king, beckoning the user to seize their destiny. A creature that succeeds on a {@dc 26} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check while listening to the blade's voice hears a sliver of malice that suggests the truth: the voice is a corrupting trick of the Demon Prince of Indulgence.
entries_es: {@deity Graz'tchar|Exandria|TDCSR|Graz'tchar} es un arma maligna sensible neutral con una Inteligencia de 14, una Sabiduría de 12, y una Charisma de 18. Tiene audiencia y {@sense darkvision} a una gama de 120 pies.

La espada puede hablar, leer y entender {@language Common}, y puede comunicarse con su wielder telepáticamente. Cualquiera que lo sostenga oye la voz sabia de un rey triste, avisando al usuario para apoderarse de su destino. Una criatura que tiene éxito en una {@dc 26} Sabiduría ([TAG2]]) comprobar mientras escucha la voz de la espada escucha una movida de malicia que sugiere la verdad: la voz es un truco corruptor del Príncipe de Indulgencia de Demonio.

entries.name: Personality
entries: {@deity Graz'tchar|Exandria|TDCSR|Graz'tchar} slowly attempts to sway its wielder to sow chaos in Exandria, telling lies and spreading malign truths about great leaders, and claiming that the {@book members of the Tal'Dorei Council|TDCSR|2|Tal'Dorei Council} are corrupt and must be overthrown. The voice of this blade is actually the Demon Prince of Indulgence, speaking from his Abyssal prison.

If the sword's attuned wielder disobeys the urges of the weapon for an extended period of time, {@deity Graz'tchar|Exandria|TDCSR|Graz'tchar} can attempt to control the wielder, who must succeed on a {@dc 17} Charisma {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or become {@condition charmed} by the sword for 24 hours. While the wielder is {@condition charmed} in this way, the sword can compel them to take an action of the sword's choice once per hour, though the wielder believes this action is taken of their own free will. If the chosen action leads to the harm of someone the wielder considers a trusted friend or ally, the {@condition charmed} condition immediately ends. On a successful {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or if the {@condition charmed} condition ends for the wielder, they are immune to this property of the sword for 24 hours.
entries_es: {@deity Graz'tchar|Exandria|TDCSR|Graz'tchar} trata lentamente de recortar su ingenio para sembrar el caos en Exandria, decir mentiras y difundir verdades malignos sobre grandes líderes, y afirmando que {@book members of the Tal'Dorei Council|TDCSR|2|Tal'Dorei Council} son corruptos y deben ser derrocados. La voz de esta espada es en realidad el Príncipe Demonio de la Indulgencia, hablando desde su prisión de Abyssal.

Si el ablandador afinado de la espada desobedece los impulsos del arma durante un largo período de tiempo, {@deity Graz'tchar|Exandria|TDCSR|Graz'tchar} puede intentar controlar el arañador, que debe tener éxito en un [[TAG1] Charisma {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} o convertirse {@condition charmed}] por la espada durante 24 horas. Mientras el pelador es {@condition charmed} de esta manera, la espada puede obligarlos a tomar una acción de la elección de la espada una vez por hora, aunque el pelador cree que esta acción es tomada de su propio libre albedrío. Si la acción elegida conduce al daño de alguien que el wielder considera un amigo de confianza o aliado, la condición {@condition charmed} termina inmediatamente. Con éxito {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} o si la condición {@condition charmed} termina para el pelador, son inmunes a esta propiedad de la espada durante 24 horas.

Esta espada parece ser una hermosa espada cruciforme de plata brillante, incrustada con rubíes brillantes. Ganas un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma mágica, que tiene las siguientes propiedades.

item.name: Greater Silver Sword
item.reqAttune: by a creature that has psionic ability
entries: This magic weapon grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While you hold the sword, you have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws, you are immune to being {@condition charmed}, and you have resistance to psychic damage. In addition, if you score a critical hit with it against a creature's astral body, you can cut the silvery cord that tethers the target to its material body, instead of dealing damage.
entries_es: Este arma mágica otorga un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con él. Mientras sostienes la espada, tienes ventaja en los lanzamientos de inteligencia, sabiduría y ahorro de Charisma, eres inmune a ser {@condition charmed}, y tienes resistencia al daño psíquico. Además, si usted marca un golpe crítico con él contra el cuerpo astral de una criatura, usted puede cortar el cordón plateado que tethers el objetivo a su cuerpo material, en lugar de tratar el daño.

item.name: Green Chromatic Rose
entries: {#itemEntry Chromatic Rose|WBtW}
entries_es: [[TAG0]

item.name: Green Copper Ewer
entries: Any poisonous liquid poured into the ewer is instantly transformed into an equal amount of sweet wine. Furthermore, a creature that grasps the ewer's handle can command the ewer to fill with 1 gallon of wine, and it can't produce more wine until the next dawn.
entries_es: Cualquier líquido venenoso derramado en la ewer se transforma instantáneamente en una cantidad igual de vino dulce. Además, una criatura que capta el mango de la ewer puede mandar a la ewer a llenar con 1 galón de vino, y no puede producir más vino hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Green Dragon Mask
entries: This mottled green mask is surmounted by a frilled crest and has leathery spiked plates along its jaw. The mask reshapes to fit a wearer attuned to it. While you are wearing the mask and attuned to it, you can access the following properties

entries.name: Damage Absorption
entries: You have resistance against poison damage. If you already have resistance to poison damage from another source, you instead have immunity to poison damage. If you already have immunity to poison damage from another source, whenever you are subjected to poison damage, you take none of that damage and regain a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt of that type.
entries_es: Tienes resistencia contra el daño venenoso. Si usted ya tiene resistencia al daño venenoso de otra fuente, usted tiene inmunidad para el daño venenoso. Si usted ya tiene inmunidad para envenenar el daño de otra fuente, cada vez que está sujeto a daño venenoso, usted no toma nada de ese daño y recuperar un número de puntos de impacto igual a la mitad del daño de ese tipo.

entries.name: Draconic Majesty
entries: While you are wearing no armor, you can add your Charisma bonus to your Armor Class.
entries_es: Mientras no llevas armadura, puedes añadir tu bono de Charisma a tu Clase Armor.

entries.name: Dragon Breath
entries: If you have a breath weapon that requires rest to recharge, it gains a recharge of 6.
entries_es: Si usted tiene un arma respiratoria que requiere descanso para recargar, gana una recarga de 6.

entries.name: Dragon Sight
entries: You gain {@sense darkvision} out to 60 feet, or to an additional 60 feet if you already have that sense. Once per day, you can gain {@sense blindsight} out to 30 feet for 5 minutes.
entries_es: Usted gana {@sense darkvision} a 60 pies, o a 60 pies adicionales si usted ya tiene ese sentido. Una vez por día, puede ganar [[TAG1] a 30 pies por 5 minutos.

entries.name: Dragon Tongue
entries: You can speak and understand Draconic. You also have advantage on any Charisma check you make against Green Dragons.
entries_es: Puedes hablar y entender Draconic. También tiene ventaja en cualquier cheque de Charisma que haga contra Dragón Verde.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: (1/Day) If you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.
entries_es: (1/Día) Si falla un tiro de ahorro, puede elegir tener éxito en su lugar.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries: You can breathe underwater.
entries_es: Puedes respirar bajo el agua.

item.name: Green Dragon Scale Mail
entries: Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids. Other times, hunters carefully skin and preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, dragon scale mail is highly valued. While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, you have advantage on saving throws against the Frightful Presence and breath weapons of dragons, and you have resistance to poison damage.

Additionally, you can focus your senses as an action to magically discern the distance and direction to the closest green dragon within 30 miles of you. This special action can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: El correo de escala de dragón está hecho de las escalas de un tipo de dragón. A veces los dragones recogen sus escamas desechables y les dan a los humanoides. Otras veces, los cazadores se pellejan cuidadosamente y preservan el escondite de un dragón muerto. En cualquier caso, el correo de escala de dragón es altamente valorado. Al usar esta armadura, usted gana un bono +1 a AC, usted tiene ventaja en ahorrar tiros contra la Presencia y las armas de aliento de los dragones, y usted tiene resistencia al daño venenoso.

Además, usted puede enfocar sus sentidos como una acción para discernir mágicamente la distancia y dirección al dragón verde más cercano dentro de 30 millas de usted. Esta acción especial no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

items.name: Awakened
entries: When the Grimoire Infinitus reaches an awakened state, it gains the following properties:

items: While you carry the spellbook, you have advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.
When you prepare wizard spells using the grimoire as your spellbook, the number of spells you can prepare increases by 1 again.

entries_es: Cuando el Grimoire Infinitus alcanza un estado despierto, gana las siguientes propiedades:

items: While you carry the spellbook, you have advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.
When you prepare wizard spells using the grimoire as your spellbook, the number of spells you can prepare increases by 1 again.

item.name: Grimoire Infinitus (Dormant)
entries: Several of these spellbooks with gilded pages and silver-plated covers were created during the Age of Arcanum, but only one has been found since the Calamity ended. The book has an infinite number of pages, is three inches thick, eight inches wide, twelve inches long, and weighs three pounds.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: Most of the book is blank, but the following spells are recorded in the first pages of the tome: {@spell alarm}, {@spell antimagic field}, {@spell Bigby's hand}, {@spell blight}, {@spell charm person}, {@spell confusion}, {@spell control weather}, {@spell create undead}, {@spell detect thoughts}, {@spell enlarge/reduce}, {@spell fear}, {@spell foresight}, {@spell gaseous form}, {@spell glyph of warding}, {@spell legend lore}, {@spell Leomund's tiny hut}, {@spell mass suggestion}, {@spell mislead}, {@spell misty step}, {@spell Mordenkainen's faithful hound}, {@spell prismatic spray}, {@spell ray of enfeeblement}, {@spell silent image}, {@spell teleport}, and {@spell thunderwave}.

You can use the grimoire as your spellbook, and you can scribe new spells into it as normal. When you prepare wizard spells using the grimoire, the number of wizard spells you can prepare increases by 1.
entries_es: [TAG] [24], [TAG] [12], [12], [V] [Acce] [G], [Acce] [Apartamento], [Apartamento], [Apartamento] [Apartamento] [Apartamento] [Apartamento]]

Usted puede utilizar el grimoire como su libro de hechizos, y puede escribir nuevos hechizos en él como normal. Cuando preparas hechizos magos usando el grimoire, el número de hechizos magos puedes preparar aumentos en 1.

Varios de estos libros de hechizos con páginas doradas y cubiertas plateadas fueron creados durante la Era de Arcanum, pero sólo uno se ha encontrado desde que la Calamidad terminó. El libro tiene un número infinito de páginas, es de tres pulgadas de espesor, ocho pulgadas de ancho, doce pulgadas de largo, y pesa tres libras.

items.name: Exalted
entries: When the Grimoire Infinitus reaches an exalted state, it gains the following properties:

items: You can now use your Arcane Recovery feature twice between long rests, rather than once.
When you prepare wizard spells using the grimoire as your spellbook, the number of spells you can prepare increases by 1 again.

entries_es: Cuando el Grimoire Infinitus alcanza un estado exaltado, gana las siguientes propiedades:

items: You can now use your Arcane Recovery feature twice between long rests, rather than once.

items.name: Awakened
entries: When the warhammer reaches an awakened state, it gains the following properties:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.
You gain a burrowing speed equal to your walking speed. You can use your burrowing speed to move through sand, loose earth, mud, or ice, not solid rock.

When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you hits you with an attack while you are wielding the warhammer, you can use your reaction to deal an amount of psychic damage to that creature equal to the damage you took from the attack. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries_es: Cuando el warhammer llega a un estado despierto, gana las siguientes propiedades:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.
You gain a burrowing speed equal to your walking speed. You can use your burrowing speed to move through sand, loose earth, mud, or ice, not solid rock.

When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you hits you with an attack while you are wielding the warhammer, you can use your reaction to deal an amount of psychic damage to that creature equal to the damage you took from the attack. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Grovelthrash (Dormant)
entries: Crafted from a single piece of obsidian, this warhammer of Torog hums with magical energy and is carved with the images of faces screaming in pain.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Grovelthrash is a sentient neutral evil weapon with an Intelligence of 18, a Wisdom of 15, and a Charisma of 19. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak, read, and understand Abyssal, Common, and Infernal.
entries_es: Grovelthrash es un arma maligna sensible neutral con una Inteligencia de 18, una Sabiduría de 15, y una Charisma de 19. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.
El arma se comunica telepáticamente con su wielder y puede hablar, leer y entender Abyssal, Común e Infernal.

entries.name: Personality
entries: A covetous {@creature ultroloth} named Ciria lives within Grovelthrash. The weapon values material possessions and doling out pain. It compliments its wielder whenever they claim treasure and takes pleasure in harming others.
entries_es: Un codicioso {@creature ultroloth} llamado Ciria vive dentro de Grovelthrash. El arma valora las posesiones materiales y elimina el dolor. Se complementa con su pelaje cuando reclaman tesoro y se complace en dañar a otros.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: The warhammer grants the following benefits in its dormant state:

items: You can speak, read, and write Abyssal and Infernal.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit with an attack using this warhammer, you can deal an extra {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage to the target. If you do, you take {@damage 1d6} psychic damage. The warhammer deals double damage to objects and structures.
While holding this weapon, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks made to discern a lie spoken in a language you understand.

entries.name: Betrayer Artifact Properties
entries: The Arms of the Betrayers advance in power in the same manner as the Vestiges of Divergence. In its dormant state, each of these artifacts has one {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property and one {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property. When the artifact attains an awakened state, it gains an additional {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property and an additional {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property. When the item reaches its exalted state, it gains a {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property. See "Artifact Properties" in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for more information.

items.name: Exalted
entries: When the warhammer reaches an exalted state, it gains the following properties:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +3.

When you have fewer hit points than half your hit point maximum, the warhammer deals an extra {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage on a hit. You can burrow through solid rock at half your burrowing speed and leave a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in your wake.

As an action, you can use the warhammer to cast one of the following spells from it (save {@dc 17}): {@spell earthquake}, {@spell meld into stone}, or {@spell stone shape}. Once a spell has been cast using the warhammer, that spell can't be cast from the warhammer again until the next dawn.

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +3.

When you have fewer hit points than half your hit point maximum, the warhammer deals an extra {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage on a hit. You can burrow through solid rock at half your burrowing speed and leave a 5-foot-diameter tunnel in your wake.

As an action, you can use the warhammer to cast one of the following spells from it (save {@dc 17}): {@spell earthquake}, {@spell meld into stone}, or {@spell stone shape}. Once a spell has been cast using the warhammer, that spell can't be cast from the warhammer again until the next dawn.

item.name: Gruul Guild Signet
entries: This ring, adorned with the symbol of Gruul, allows you to cast {@spell compelled duel}. A guild signet is sometimes awarded to a guild member whose renown score in that guild is 5 or higher, as a reward for performing special services for the guild. Aside from its magical properties, the ring is also an indicator of Gruul's recognition and favor.
A signet has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast the associated spell (save {@dc 13}).
entries_es: Este anillo, adornado con el símbolo de Gruul, le permite echar {@spell compelled duel}. Un guild signet es a veces otorgado a un miembro del gremio cuyo renombre puntuación en ese gremio es 5 o superior, como recompensa por realizar servicios especiales para el gremio. Aparte de sus propiedades mágicas, el anillo es también un indicador del reconocimiento y favor de Gruul.
Un letrero tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. Al llevarla, puede gastar 1 carga para lanzar el hechizo asociado (salvar {@dc 13}).

item.name: Gruul Keyrune
item.reqAttune: by a member of the Gruul guild
entries: This crude keyrune is cobbled together from bits of rubble, broken glass, bone, and animal hair. One end resembles a horned beast. On command, the keyrune transforms into a ceratok, a horned creature much like a {@creature rhinoceros} (and with the same statistics). It remains in its ceratok form for 1 hour.

When you use an action to speak the item's command word and place the keyrune on the ground in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, the keyrune transforms into a ceratok. If there isn't enough space for the creature, the keyrune doesn't transform.

The creature is friendly to you, your companions, and other members of your guild (unless those guild members are hostile to you). It understands your languages and obeys your spoken commands. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the {@action Dodge} action and moves to avoid danger.

At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its keyrune form. It reverts early if it drops to 0 hit points or if you use an action to speak the command word again while touching it. When the creature reverts to its keyrune form, it can't transform again until 36 hours have passed.
entries_es: Esta llavero crudo se mezcla entre pedazos de escombros, vidrio roto, hueso y pelo animal. Un extremo se parece a una bestia cachonda. Al mando, el llavero se transforma en un ceratok, una criatura cachonda como un {@creature rhinoceros} (y con las mismas estadísticas). Queda en su forma de ceratok durante 1 hora.

Cuando usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando del artículo y colocas el llavero en el suelo en un espacio no ocupado a 5 pies de ti, el llavero se transforma en un ceratok. Si no hay suficiente espacio para la criatura, la llave no se transforma.

La criatura es amistosa con usted, sus compañeros y otros miembros de su gremio (a menos que esos miembros del gremio sean hostiles a usted). Comprende tus idiomas y obedece tus mandamientos hablados. Si usted no emite comandos, la criatura toma la acción {@action Dodge} y se mueve para evitar el peligro.

Al final de la duración, la criatura vuelve a su forma de llave. Revierte temprano si cae a 0 puntos de éxito o si usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo mientras la toca. Cuando la criatura vuelve a su forma de llavero, no puede transformarse hasta que hayan pasado 36 horas.

item.name: Guardian Emblem
entries: This emblem is the symbol of a deity or a spiritual tradition. As an action, you can attach the emblem to a suit of armor or a shield or remove it.

The emblem has 3 charges. When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you suffers a critical hit while you're wearing the armor or wielding the shield that bears the emblem, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge to turn the critical hit into a normal hit instead.
The emblem regains all expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: Este emblema es el símbolo de una deidad o una tradición espiritual. Como acción, puede adjuntar el emblema a un traje de armadura o un escudo o quitarlo.

El emblema tiene 3 cargos. Cuando usted o una criatura puede ver dentro de 30 pies de usted sufre un golpe crítico mientras usted está usando la armadura o el escudo que lleva el emblema, usted puede utilizar su reacción a la expulsión 1 cargo para convertir el golpe crítico en un golpe normal en su lugar.
El emblema recupera todos los cargos enviados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Gulthias Staff
entries: Made from the branch of a Gulthias tree (see the {@creature twig blight||blights} entry of the Monster Manual), a Gulthias staff is a spongy, black length of wood. Its evil makes beasts visibly uncomfortable while within 30 feet of it. The staff has 10 charges and regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} of its expended charges daily at dusk.
If the staff is broken or burned to ashes, its wood releases a terrible, inhuman scream that can be heard out to a range of 300 feet. All blights that can hear the scream immediately wither and die.

entries.name: Vampiric Strike
entries: The staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff. On a hit, it deals damage as a normal quarterstaff, and you can expend 1 charge to regain a number of hit points equal to the damage dealt by the weapon. Each time a charge is spent, red blood oozes from the staff's pores, and you must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be afflicted with {@table Short-Term Madness|DMG|short term madness} (see "{@variantrule Madness|DMG}" in chapter 8 of the Dungeon Master's Guide).
entries_es: El personal puede ser manipulado como un quarterstaff mágico. En un golpe, se trata del daño como un quarterstaff normal, y se puede gastar 1 cargo para recuperar un número de puntos de impacto igual al daño causado por el arma. Cada vez que se gasta un cargo, la sangre roja se rezuma de los poros del personal, y usted debe tener éxito en un {@dc 12}] Sabiduría ahorrando lanzamiento o afligido con {@table Short-Term Madness|DMG|short term madness} (ver "[TAG2]]" en el capítulo 8 de la Guía del Maestro de Dungeon.

entries.name: Blight Bane
entries: While you are attuned to the staff, blights and other evil plant creatures don't regard you as hostile unless you harm them.
entries_es: Mientras estás afinado al personal, las plagas y otras criaturas de plantas malvadas no te consideran tan hostil a menos que las dañes.

Fabricado en la rama de un árbol de Gulthias (ver la entrada {@creature twig blight||blights} del Manual del Monstruo), un personal de Gulthias es una esponjosa y negra longitud de madera. Su mal hace que las bestias sean visiblemente incómodas mientras que dentro de 30 pies de ella. El personal tiene 10 cargos y recupera {@dice 1d6 + 4} de sus cargos enviados diariamente al atardecer.

Si el personal se rompe o se quema en cenizas, su madera libera un grito terrible e inhumano que se puede escuchar a una gama de 300 pies. Todas las plagas que pueden oír el grito inmediatamente se marchitan y mueren.

item.name: Gunpowder (keg)
entries: Setting fire to a keg full of Gunpowder causes it to explode. When a keg explodes, each creature in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the keg makes a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries_es: Poner fuego a un barril lleno de pólvora hace que explote. Cuando un barril explota, cada criatura en un radio de 10 pies {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centrado en el barril hace un {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 24 ([TAG2]) Daño al fuego en un ahorro fallido o la mitad de daño en uno exitoso.

item.name: Gunpowder (powder horn)
entries: Setting fire to a powder horn full of Gunpowder causes it to explode. When a powder horn explodes, each creature in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the powder horn makes a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries_es: Poner fuego a un cuerno de polvo lleno de pólvora hace que explote. Cuando un cuerno de polvo explota, cada criatura en un radio de 10 pies [[TAG0] centrado en el cuerno de polvo hace un {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ([TAG2]) Daño al fuego en un ahorro fallido o la mitad de daño en uno exitoso.

item.name: Gunpowder Horn
entries: Gunpowder is chiefly used to propel a bullet out of the barrel of a pistol or rifle, or it is formed into a bomb. Gunpowder is sold in small wooden kegs or in water-resistant powder horns.

Setting fire to a container full of gunpowder can cause it to explode, dealing fire damage to creatures within 10 feet of it ({@damage 3d6} for a powder horn). A successful {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw halves the damage. Setting fire to an ounce of gunpowder causes it to flare for 1 round, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.
entries_es: Gunpowder se usa principalmente para sacar una bala del cañón de una pistola o un rifle, o se forma en una bomba. Gunpowder se vende en barriles de madera pequeños o en cuernos de polvo resistentes al agua.

Poner fuego a un recipiente lleno de pólvora puede causar que explote, traficando daño de fuego a criaturas a menos de 10 pies de él ([TAG0]) para un cuerno de polvo. Un éxito {@dc 12} El ahorro de la destreza arroja a las mitades el daño. Poner fuego a una onza de pólvora hace que pare por 1 vuelta, arrojando luz brillante en un radio de 30 pies y luz de dim por 30 pies adicionales.

item.name: Gunpowder Keg
entries: Gunpowder is chiefly used to propel a bullet out of the barrel of a pistol or rifle, or it is formed into a bomb. Gunpowder is sold in small wooden kegs or in water-resistant powder horns.

Poner fuego a un contenedor lleno de pólvora puede causar que explote, traficando daño de fuego a criaturas a menos de 10 pies de ella ([TAG0] por un barril). Un éxito {@dc 12} El ahorro de la destreza arroja a las mitades el daño. Poner fuego a una onza de pólvora hace que pare por 1 vuelta, arrojando luz brillante en un radio de 30 pies y luz de dim por 30 pies adicionales.

item.name: Gurt's Greataxe
entries: In the Year of the Icy Axe (123 DR), the {@creature frost giant} Lord Gurt fell to Uthgar Gardolfsson—leader of the folk who would become the Uthgardt barbarians—in a battle that marked the ascendance of humankind over the giants in the Dessarin Valley. Gurt's greataxe was buried in Morgur's Mound until it was unearthed and brought back to Waterdeep. After laying in the city's vaults for decades, the axe was given to Harshnag, a {@creature frost giant} adventurer, in recognition of his service to Waterdeep. Uthgardt barbarians recognize the weapon on sight and attack any giant that wields it.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It is sized for a giant, weighs 325 pounds, and deals {@damage 3d12} slashing damage on a hit, plus an extra {@damage 2d12} slashing damage if the target is human.
The axe sheds light as a torch when the temperature around it drops below 0 degrees Fahrenheit. The light can't be shut off in these conditions.

As an action, you can cast a version of the {@spell heat metal} spell (save {@dc 13}) that deals cold damage instead of fire damage. Once this power is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: En el Año del Hacha Icy (123 DR), el Señor Gurt cayó a Uthgar Gardolfsson, líder del pueblo que se convertiría en los bárbaros Uthgardt, en una batalla que marcó el ascenso de la humanidad sobre los gigantes del Valle del Desarin. El gran hacha de Gurt fue enterrado en el montículo de Morgur hasta que fue desenterrado y llevado de vuelta a Waterdeep. Después de estar en las bóvedas de la ciudad durante décadas, el hacha fue dado a Harshnag, un aventurero [[TAG0], en reconocimiento de su servicio a Waterdeep. Los bárbaros Uthgardt reconocen el arma a la vista y atacan a cualquier gigante que lo empuña.

Ganas un bono +1 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma mágica. Es tamaño para un gigante, pesa 325 libras, y las ofertas [[TAG0] cortando el daño en un golpe, más un daño adicional {@damage 2d12} si el objetivo es humano.
El hacha arroja luz como antorcha cuando la temperatura alrededor baja 0 grados Fahrenheit. La luz no puede apagarse en estas condiciones.

Como acción, se puede lanzar una versión del hechizo {@spell heat metal} (salvar {@dc 13}]) que trata el daño frío en lugar de daño al fuego. Una vez que se utiliza este poder, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Hag Eye
entries: A hag coven can craft a magic item called a hag eye, which is made from a real eye coated in varnish and often fitted to a pendant or other wearable item. The hag eye is usually entrusted to a minion for safekeeping and transport. A hag in the coven can take an action to see what the hag eye sees if the hag eye is on the same plane of existence. A hag eye has AC 10, 1 hit point, and {@sense darkvision} with a radius of 60 feet. If it is destroyed, each coven member takes {@damage 3d10} psychic damage and is {@condition blinded} for 24 hours.

A hag coven can have only one hag eye at a time, and creating a new one requires all three members of the coven to perform a ritual. The ritual takes 1 hour, and the hags can't perform it while {@condition blinded}. During the ritual, if the hags take any action other than performing the ritual, they must start over.
entries_es: Un cuervo de cerdo puede elaborar un elemento mágico llamado ojo de bruja, que está hecho de un ojo real recubierto en barniz y a menudo equipado a un colgante u otro elemento utilizable. El ojo de la bruja es generalmente confiado a un minión para el cuidado y el transporte. Una bruja en el aquelarre puede tomar una acción para ver lo que el ojo de la bruja ve si el ojo de la bruja está en el mismo plano de la existencia. Un ojo de cerdo tiene AC 10, 1 punto de impacto, y [[TAG0] con un radio de 60 pies. Si se destruye, cada miembro del aquelarre toma {@damage 3d10} daño psíquico y es {@condition blinded} durante 24 horas.

Un aquelarre de cerdo puede tener solo un ojo de bruja a la vez, y crear uno nuevo requiere que los tres miembros del aquelarre realicen un ritual. El ritual lleva 1 hora, y los cerdos no pueden realizarlo mientras {@condition blinded}. Durante el ritual, si los cerdos toman cualquier acción que no sea realizar el ritual, deben comenzar de nuevo.

item.name: Hag Eye
entries: A Hag Eye has 3 charges. While wearing or holding this item, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Darkvision|XPHB} (targeting yourself only) or {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB}. The Hag Eye regains all expended charges daily at dawn.

entries.name: Coven Sensor
entries: The Hag Eye is usually entrusted to a hag's minion for safekeeping and transport. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, a hag who belongs to the coven that created the Hag Eye can see what the Hag Eye sees if the hag and the Hag Eye are on the same plane of existence. This effect lasts as long as the hag maintains {@status Concentration|XPHB}. Multiple hags in the coven can see through the Hag Eye simultaneously.
entries_es: El Ojo de Hag es generalmente confiado al minión de un cerdo para el cuidado y el transporte. Como una acción {@action Magic|XPHB}, un cerdo que pertenece al aquelarre que creó el Ojo de Hag puede ver lo que el Ojo de Hag ve si la bruja y el Ojo de Hag están en el mismo plano de la existencia. Este efecto dura tanto como el cerdo mantenga {@status Concentration|XPHB}. Múltiples cerdos en el aquelarre pueden ver a través del Ojo de Hag simultáneamente.

entries.name: Creating a Hag Eye
entries: Only a hag coven can craft this item, which is made from a real eye coated in varnish and often fitted to a pendant or another wearable item. A hag coven can have only one Hag Eye at a time, and creating a new one requires all three members of the coven to perform a special rite. This rite takes 1 hour, and the hags can't perform it if one or more of them has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. If the hags take any other actions during this rite, the rite fails and ends.

Este rito toma 1 hora, y los cerdos no pueden realizarlo si uno o más de ellos tiene la condición [[TAG0]. Si los cerdos toman cualquier otra acción durante este rito, el rito falla y termina.

A Hag Eye tiene 3 cargos. Mientras lleva o sostiene este artículo, puede gastar 1 carga para fundir {@spell Darkvision|XPHB} (se limita a ti mismo) o {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB}. El Ojo de Hag recupera todos los cargos enviados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Hammer of Runic Focus
entries: This magic hammer has 3 charges. As a bonus action, you can expend 1 charge and slam this hammer on the ground, creating a 15-foot-radius circle of glowing runes centered on the point of impact. While you're inside that area, your hammer glows with matching runes, and you gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this hammer. The rune circle disappears after 1 minute, when you create another rune circle, or when you dismiss the rune circle as a bonus action. This hammer regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: Este martillo mágico tiene 3 cargos. Como una acción de bonificación, puede gastar 1 carga y golpear este martillo en el suelo, creando un círculo de 15 pies-radius de carreras brillantes centrado en el punto de impacto. Mientras estás dentro de esa zona, tu martillo brilla con runas iguales, y ganas un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este martillo. El círculo de runa desaparece después de 1 minuto, cuando creas otro círculo de runa, o cuando desestimas el círculo de runa como una acción de bonificación. Este martillo recupera {@dice 1d3} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Hammer of Thunderbolts
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

entries.name: Giant's Bane (Requires Attunement)
entries: You must be wearing a {@italic belt of giant strength} (any variety) and {@item gauntlets of ogre power} to attune to this weapon. The attunement ends if you take off either of those items. While you are attuned to this weapon and holding it, your Strength score increases by 4 and can exceed 20, but not 30. When you roll a 20 on an attack roll made with this weapon against a giant, the giant must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or die.
entries_es: Usted debe estar usando un [[TAG0] (cualquier variedad) y {@item gauntlets of ogre power} para afinar a este arma. La entrada termina si se quita cualquiera de esos artículos. Mientras usted está afinado a este arma y sostenerlo, su puntaje de fuerza aumenta en 4 y puede superar 20, pero no 30. Cuando lanzas un 20 en un rollo de ataque hecho con este arma contra un gigante, el gigante debe tener éxito en un {@dc 17} Constitución salvando el tiro o la muerte.

entries: The hammer also has 5 charges. While attuned to it, you can expend 1 charge and make a ranged weapon attack with the hammer, hurling it as if it had the thrown property with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. If the attack hits, the hammer unleashes a thunderclap audible out to 300 feet. The target and every creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until the end of your next turn. The hammer regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn.
