Mientras está afinado, puede gastar 1 carga y hacer un ataque de arma con el martillo, abrazándolo como si tuviera la propiedad lanzada con un rango normal de 20 pies y una larga gama de 60 pies. Si el ataque golpea, el martillo desata un trueno audible a 300 pies. El objetivo y cada criatura dentro de 30 pies de él debe tener éxito en un {@dc 17} La Constitución salvando el lanzamiento o ser {@condition stunned} hasta el final de su próximo turno. El martillo recupera {@dice 1d4 + 1} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Hammerhead Ship
entries: Hammerhead ships are popular craft, especially among pirates and merchants carrying heavy cargo. They can float on water and sail across it, but they aren't built to land on the ground (their keels would cause them to tip to one side). Standard weapons on a hammerhead ship include fore and aft mangonels, a ballista, and a reinforced bow for ramming.
entries_es: Los buques martillo son artesanía popular, especialmente entre piratas y comerciantes que transportan carga pesada. Pueden flotar sobre el agua y navegar a través de ella, pero no están construidos para aterrizar en el suelo (sus keels harían que propinan a un lado). Las armas estándar en un barco de martillo incluyen mangonels de antena y popa, un balista, y un arco reforzado para ramming.

item.name: Hammock of Worlds
entries: The Hammock of Worlds is a colorful hammock woven with traditional Ataguan designs. It can be used only by a member of the order known as the Green Doctors.

You can use an action to unfold and place the Hammock of Worlds on a solid surface, whereupon it creates a two-way portal to the Ghost Orchid Tepui in the Feywild or to the Drought Elder in the Far Realm (the user's choice). You can use an action to close an open portal by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up. Once Hammock of Worlds has opened a portal, it can't do so again for {@dice 1d8} hours.
entries_es: La Hammock of Worlds es una hamaca colorida tejida con diseños tradicionales de Ataguan. Sólo puede ser utilizado por un miembro de la orden conocida como los Médicos Verdes.

Puede utilizar una acción para desplegar y colocar la Hammock of Worlds en una superficie sólida, en la que crea un portal bidireccional al Ghost Orchid Tepui en el Feywild o al Drought Elder en el Far Realm (la elección del usuario). Usted puede utilizar una acción para cerrar un portal abierto al agarrar los bordes del paño y doblarlo. Una vez que Hammock of Worlds ha abierto un portal, no puede hacerlo de nuevo por {@dice 1d8} horas.

item.name: Hand of Vecna
entries: Seldom is the name of Vecna spoken except in a hushed voice. Vecna was, in his time, one of the mightiest of all wizards. Through dark magic and conquest, he forged a terrible empire. For all his power, Vecna couldn't escape his own mortality. He began to fear death and take steps to prevent his end from ever coming about.

{@creature Orcus|MTF}, the demon prince of undeath, taught Vecna a ritual that would allow him to live on as a {@creature lich}. Beyond death, he became the greatest of all liches. Even though his body gradually withered and decayed, Vecna continued to expand his evil dominion. So formidable and hideous was his temper that his subjects feared to speak his name. He was the Whispered One, the Master of the Spider Throne, the Undying King, and the Lord of the Rotted Tower.

Some say that Vecna's lieutenant Kas coveted the Spider Throne for himself, or that the sword his lord made for him seduced him into rebellion. Whatever the reason, Kas brought the Undying King's rule to an end in a terrible battle that left Vecna's tower a heap of ash. Of Vecna, all that remained were one hand and one eye, grisly artifacts that still seek to work the Whispered One's will in the world.

The {@item Eye of Vecna} and the Hand of Vecna might be found together or separately. The eye looks like a bloodshot organ torn free from the socket. The hand is a mummified and shriveled left extremity.

To attune to the eye, you must gouge out your own eye and press the artifact into the empty socket. The eye grafts itself to your head and remains there until you die. Once in place, the eye transforms into a golden eye with a slit for a pupil, much like that of a cat. If the eye is ever removed, you die.

To attune to the hand, you must lop off your left hand at the wrist and the press the artifact against the stump. The hand grafts itself to your arm and becomes a functioning appendage. If the hand is ever removed, you die.

entries.name: Properties of the Hand
entries: Your alignment changes to neutral evil, and you gain the following benefits:

items: Your Strength score becomes 20, unless it is already 20 or higher.
Any melee spell attack you make with the hand, and any melee weapon attack made with a weapon held by it, deals an extra {@damage 2d8} cold damage on a hit.

The hand has 8 charges. You can use an action and expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 18}) from it: {@spell finger of death} (5 charges), {@spell sleep} (1 charge), {@spell slow} (2 charges), or {@spell teleport} (3 charges). The hand regains {@dice 1d4 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. Each time you cast a spell from the hand, it casts the {@spell suggestion} spell on you (save {@dc 18}), demanding that you commit an evil act. The hand might have a specific act in mind or leave it up to you.

entries_es: Tu alineación cambia al mal neutral, y obtienes los siguientes beneficios:

items: Your Strength score becomes 20, unless it is already 20 or higher.
Any melee spell attack you make with the hand, and any melee weapon attack made with a weapon held by it, deals an extra {@damage 2d8} cold damage on a hit.

The hand has 8 charges. You can use an action and expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 18}) from it: {@spell finger of death} (5 charges), {@spell sleep} (1 charge), {@spell slow} (2 charges), or {@spell teleport} (3 charges). The hand regains {@dice 1d4 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. Each time you cast a spell from the hand, it casts the {@spell suggestion} spell on you (save {@dc 18}), demanding that you commit an evil act. The hand might have a specific act in mind or leave it up to you.

entries.name: Properties of the Eye and Hand
entries: If you are attuned to both the hand and eye, you gain the following additional benefits:

items: You are immune to disease and poison.
Using the eye's X-ray vision never causes you to suffer {@condition exhaustion}.
You experience premonitions of danger and, unless you are {@condition incapacitated}, can't be {@status surprised}.
If you start your turn with at least 1 hit point, you regain {@dice 1d10} hit points.

If a creature has a skeleton, you can attempt to turn its bones to jelly with a touch of the Hand of Vecna. You can do so by using an action to make a melee attack against a creature you can reach, using your choice of your melee attack bonus for weapons or spells. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.
You can use an action to cast {@spell wish}. This property can't be used again until 30 days have passed.

entries.name_es: Propiedades del ojo y de la mano
entries_es: Si usted está al tanto de la mano y el ojo, usted gana los siguientes beneficios adicionales:

items: You are immune to disease and poison.
Using the eye's X-ray vision never causes you to suffer {@condition exhaustion}.
You experience premonitions of danger and, unless you are {@condition incapacitated}, can't be {@status surprised}.
If you start your turn with at least 1 hit point, you regain {@dice 1d10} hit points.

If a creature has a skeleton, you can attempt to turn its bones to jelly with a touch of the Hand of Vecna. You can do so by using an action to make a melee attack against a creature you can reach, using your choice of your melee attack bonus for weapons or spells. On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.
You can use an action to cast {@spell wish}. This property can't be used again until 30 days have passed.

entries.name: Destroying the Eye and Hand
entries: If the {@item Eye of Vecna} and the Hand of Vecna are both attached to the same creature, and that creature is slain by the {@item Sword of Kas}, both the eye and the hand burst into flame, turn to ash, and are destroyed forever. Any other attempt to destroy the eye or hand seems to work, but the artifact reappears in one of Vecna's many hidden vaults, where it waits to be rediscovered.
entries.name_es: Destruyendo el ojo y la mano
entries_es: Si el {@item Eye of Vecna} y la Mano de Vecna están ambos unidos a la misma criatura, y esa criatura es muerta por el {@item Sword of Kas}], tanto el ojo como la mano irrumpen en llamas, se convierten en ceniza, y son destruidos para siempre. Cualquier otro intento de destruir el ojo o la mano parece funcionar, pero el artefacto reaparece en una de las muchas bóvedas ocultas de Vecna, donde espera ser redescubierto.

raramente es el nombre de Vecna hablado excepto en una voz abrasada. Vecna era, en su tiempo, uno de los más poderosos de todos los magos. A través de magia oscura y conquista, forjó un imperio terrible. Por todo su poder, Vecna no pudo escapar de su propia mortalidad. Comenzó a temer a la muerte y tomó medidas para evitar que su fin llegara.

{@creature Orcus|MTF}, el príncipe demonio de la muerte, enseñó a Vecna un ritual que le permitiría vivir como un {@creature lich}. Más allá de la muerte, se convirtió en el más grande de todas las liras. A pesar de que su cuerpo gradualmente se marchitaba y decaía, Vecna continuó expandiendo su mal dominio. Tan formidable y horrible era su temperamento que sus súbditos temían hablar su nombre. Era el Whispered One, el Maestro del Trono Araña, el Rey Undying, y el Señor de la Torre Rotted.

Algunos dicen que el teniente Kas de Vecna codiciaba el Trono Araña por sí mismo, o que la espada que su señor hizo por él lo sedujo en rebelión. Sea cual sea la razón, Kas trajo la regla del Rey Undying a un fin en una terrible batalla que dejó la torre de Vecna un montón de ceniza. De Vecna, todo lo que quedaba era una mano y un ojo, artefactos grises que todavía buscan trabajar la voluntad del Whispered One en el mundo.

El {@item Eye of Vecna} y la Mano de Vecna pueden encontrarse juntos o por separado. El ojo parece un órgano de disparo de sangre arrancado de la toma. La mano es una extremidad izquierda momificada y arrugada.

Para afinar al ojo, debe sacar su propio ojo y presionar el artefacto en la toma vacía. El ojo se injerta en su cabeza y permanece allí hasta que mueras. Una vez en su lugar, el ojo se transforma en un ojo dorado con una abertura para un alumno, mucho como el de un gato. Si se quita el ojo, mueres.

Para afinar a la mano, debe arrancar la mano izquierda en la muñeca y la prensa el artefacto contra el bulto. La mano se injerta en su brazo y se convierte en un apéndice funcional. Si se quita la mano, mueres.

On a hit, the target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.
You can use an action to cast {@spell wish}. This property can't be used again until 30 days have passed.

entries_es.name: Destroying the Eye and Hand
entries: If the {@item Eye of Vecna} and the Hand of Vecna are both attached to the same creature, and that creature is slain by the {@item Sword of Kas}, both the eye and the hand burst into flame, turn to ash, and are destroyed forever. Any other attempt to destroy the eye or hand seems to work, but the artifact reappears in one of Vecna's many hidden vaults, where it waits to be rediscovered.
entries_es.name_es: Destruyendo el ojo y la mano
entries_es: Si el {@item Eye of Vecna} y la Mano de Vecna están ambos unidos a la misma criatura, y esa criatura es muerta por el {@item Sword of Kas}], tanto el ojo como la mano irrumpen en llamas, se convierten en ceniza, y son destruidos para siempre. Cualquier otro intento de destruir el ojo o la mano parece funcionar, pero el artefacto reaparece en una de las muchas bóvedas ocultas de Vecna, donde espera ser redescubierto.

item.name: Hand of Vecna
entries: {@book Vecna|XDMG|8|Vecna} was a mighty wizard who, through magic and conquest, forged a terrible empire. For all his power, however, Vecna feared death and took steps to prevent his demise by becoming a lich.

A treacherous lieutenant named Kas brought Vecna's rule to an end in a terrible battle. Of Vecna, all that remained were one hand and one eye, grisly Artifacts that still seek to work Vecna's will in the world.

The {@item Eye of Vecna|XDMG} and the Hand of Vecna are separate Artifacts that might be found together or separately. The eye looks like a bloodshot organ torn free from the socket. The hand is a shriveled left extremity.

entries.name: Attuning to the Hand
entries: To attune to the hand, you must press it against the stump where your left hand was. The hand grafts itself to your arm and becomes a functioning appendage. If the hand is ever removed, you die.
entries_es: Para afinar a la mano, debe presionarlo contra el bulto donde estaba su mano izquierda. La mano se injerta en su brazo y se convierte en un apéndice funcional. Si se quita la mano, mueres.

entries.name: Properties of the Hand
entries: When you are attuned to the hand, your alignment is Neutral Evil, and you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Great Strength
entries: Your Strength becomes 20 unless it is already 20 or higher.
entries_es: Su fuerza se convierte en 20 a menos que ya sea 20 o superior.

items.name: Icy Touch
entries: Any melee spell attack you make with the hand and any melee attack made with a weapon held by it deals an extra {@damage 2d8} Cold damage on a hit.
entries_es: Cualquier ataque de hechizo melee que usted hace con la mano y cualquier ataque de melee hecho con un arma sujeta por él trata un extra {@damage 2d8} Daño frío en un golpe.

items.name: Spellcasting
entries: The hand has 8 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. You can cast a spell on the {@item Hand of Vecna|XDMG} Spells table from the hand (save {@dc 18}). The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. Each time you cast a spell from it, the hand casts {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} on you (save {@dc 18}; no {@status Concentration|XPHB} required), demanding that you commit an evil act. The hand might have a specific act in mind or leave it up to you.

entries.caption: Hand of Vecna Spells
rows: {@spell Finger of Death|XPHB}
{@spell Sleep|XPHB}
{@spell Slow|XPHB}
{@spell Teleport|XPHB}

entries_es: La mano tiene 8 cargos y recupera {@dice 1d4 + 4} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Usted puede hacer un hechizo en el {@item Hand of Vecna|XDMG} Mesa de la mano (salvar {@dc 18}). La tabla indica cuántos cargos debe presentar para emitir el hechizo. Cada vez que le echas un hechizo, la mano te lanza {@spell Suggestion|XPHB}] (salvar {@dc 18}]; no {@status Concentration|XPHB} requerido), exigiendo que cometas un acto maligno. La mano podría tener un acto específico en mente o dejarlo a usted.

{@book Vecna|XDMG|8|Vecna} era un mago poderoso que, a través de la magia y la conquista, forjó un imperio terrible. Por todo su poder, sin embargo, Vecna temía la muerte y tomó medidas para prevenir su fallecimiento al convertirse en un litro.

Un teniente traicionero llamado Kas puso fin a la regla de Vecna en una terrible batalla. De Vecna, todo lo que quedaba era una mano y un ojo, objetos grises que todavía buscan trabajar la voluntad de Vecna en el mundo.

item.name: Harbor Moon
entries: Platinum crescent inset with electrum, about three inches long with a hole large enough for a {@item nib|wdh} to fit in (1 harbor moon = 5,000 {@item nib|wdh|nibs})
entries_es: Inset de crescente platino con el electrum, de unos tres pulgadas de largo con un agujero lo suficientemente grande para que un {@item nib|wdh} se ajuste en (1 luna portuaria = 5.000 {@item nib|wdh|nibs})

item.name: Harkon's Bite
entries: A dire wolf tooth dangles from this simple cord necklace. While you wear it, the necklace grants you a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.

entries.name: Curse
entries: Attuning to Harkon's Bite curses you until either Harkon Lukas removes the necklace from you or you are targeted by a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic. As long as you remain cursed, you cannot remove the necklace.

Upon donning or removing the necklace, whether you are attuned to it or not, you are afflicted with {@variantrule Player Characters as Lycanthropes|mm|werewolf lycanthropy} as detailed in the Monster Manual. The curse lasts until the dawn after the next full moon. If you are still wearing the necklace at this time, you are afflicted with the lycanthropy again.
entries_es: Attuning to Harkon's Bite te maldice hasta que Harkon Lukas te quite el collar o eres blanco de un hechizo o magia similar. Mientras permanezcas maldito, no puedes quitar el collar.

Al donar o quitar el collar, ya sea que esté afinado o no, usted está afligido con {@variantrule Player Characters as Lycanthropes|mm|werewolf lycanthropy} como se detalla en el Manual del Monstruo. La maldición dura hasta el amanecer después de la próxima luna llena. Si sigues usando el collar en este momento, estás afligido con la lintropía de nuevo.

item.name: Harp of Gilded Plenty
entries: This golden harp is sculpted in the image of the god Iallanis, depicted as a young cloud giant woman. When a creature comes within 5 feet of the harp, the instrument animates and is capable of speaking, singing, and playing by itself.

Whenever you attempt to attune to the harp, you must first make either a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Performance}) check or a {@dc 20} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check to convince the harp that you are worthy, attuning to the harp on a success. If you fail, you can't attempt to attune to the harp again until the next dawn. Once you have successfully attuned to the harp, the harp resizes to suit you.

entries.name: Stalwart Song
entries: Whenever you make a Charisma check while attuned to the harp, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the die as a 10.
entries_es: Cada vez que haces un cheque de Charisma mientras te fijas en el arpa, puedes tratar un rollo de 9 o inferior en la muerte como un 10.

entries.name: Feast of Plenty
entries: If you spend 10 minutes playing the harp, you can cast the {@spell heroes' feast} spell from it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until {@dice 1d10 + 10} days have passed.
entries_es: Si pasas 10 minutos jugando el arpa, puedes echarle el hechizo {@spell heroes' feast}. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta [[TAG1] días han pasado.

entries.name: Soothing Melody
entries: As an action, you can use the harp to cast the {@spell calm emotions} spell (save {@dc 19}). When the spell is cast using the harp, its duration increases to 1 hour, provided you maintain {@status concentration} on the spell. This property can be used five times, and it regains all uses at dawn.
entries_es: Como acción, puede utilizar el arpa para lanzar el hechizo {@spell calm emotions} (salvar {@dc 19}]). Cuando el hechizo se lanza utilizando el arpa, su duración aumenta a 1 hora, siempre que mantenga {@status concentration} en el hechizo. Esta propiedad se puede utilizar cinco veces, y recupera todos los usos al amanecer.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: The harp is a sentient, chaotic good object with an Intelligence of 13, a Wisdom of 15, and a Charisma of 20. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} to a range of 120 feet.
The harp can speak, read, and understand Common and Giant. It can also communicate telepathically with the creature attuned to it.
The harp has a dramatic and pompous personality, taking extreme pride in the quality of music produced from its strings. If the harp is shorter than 6 feet tall, it bemoans its height.
entries_es: El arpa es un objeto sensible y caótico bueno con una inteligencia de 13, una sabiduría de 15, y una Charisma de 20. Tiene audiencia y {@sense darkvision} a una gama de 120 pies.
El arpa puede hablar, leer y entender Común y Giant. También puede comunicarse telepáticamente con la criatura afinada a ella.
El arpa tiene una personalidad dramática y pomposa, tomando el orgullo extremo de la calidad de la música producida por sus cuerdas. Si el arpa es más corto que 6 pies de altura, se dobla su altura.

Este arpa dorado esculpido a imagen del dios Iallanis, representado como una joven mujer gigante de la nube. Cuando una criatura viene a 5 pies del arpa, el instrumento anima y es capaz de hablar, cantar y jugar por sí misma.

Cada vez que intentas afinar al arpa, primero debes hacer un {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Performance}) cheque o un {@dc 20} Charisma ([TAG3]]) cheque para convencer al arpa de que eres digno, aprendiendo al arpa sobre un éxito. Si fallas, no puedes intentar afinar el arpa otra vez hasta el siguiente amanecer. Una vez que hayas afinado con éxito al arpa, el arpa redimensiona para adaptarte.

item.name: Harper Pin
entries: When you attune to this pin, choose a Harper persona (see the {@book Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerûn|FRHoF|6|Harper Personas} for examples), including an alignment and a creature type. While wearing this pin, you register as that persona when targeted by magic to determine your creature type, alignment, or location.
The type of pin determines its rarity and effects.

entries.name: Silver Harper Pin
entries: When you attune to this pin, you can devise a general line of thought of 25 words or fewer. While you wear this pin, a creature that reads your thoughts detects your preprogrammed line of thought instead. A creature that takes the {@action Study|XPHB} action while reading your thoughts makes a DC 13 Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check. On a successful check, it becomes aware that the detected thoughts are preprogrammed.
entries_es: Cuando afinas a este pin, puedes diseñar una línea general de pensamiento de 25 palabras o menos. Mientras usas este pin, una criatura que lee tus pensamientos detecta tu línea de pensamiento preprogramada. Una criatura que toma la acción [[TAG0] mientras lee sus pensamientos hace un cheque DC 13 Intelligence ([TAG1]]). En un cheque exitoso, se vuelve consciente de que los pensamientos detectados están preprogramados.

entries.name: Golden Harper Pin
entries: While wearing this pin, you can cast the {@spell Nondetection|XPHB} spell on yourself. The duration of this spell is permanent until you disable the effect (no action required), you remove the pin, or you are no longer attuned to the pin.
entries_es: Mientras usas este pin, puedes lanzar el hechizo {@spell Nondetection|XPHB} en ti mismo. La duración de este hechizo es permanente hasta que se deshabilita el efecto (no se requiere acción), se elimina el pin, o ya no se afina al pin.

Cuando afinas a este pin, elige un Harper persona (ver {@book Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerûn|FRHoF|6|Harper Personas} para ejemplos), incluyendo una alineación y un tipo de criatura. Mientras lleva este pin, se registra como esa persona cuando es dirigida por la magia para determinar su tipo de criatura, alineación o ubicación.
El tipo de pin determina su rareza y sus efectos.

entries_es.name: Silver Harper Pin
entries: When you attune to this pin, you can devise a general line of thought of 25 words or fewer. While you wear this pin, a creature that reads your thoughts detects your preprogrammed line of thought instead. A creature that takes the {@action Study|XPHB} action while reading your thoughts makes a DC 13 Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check. On a successful check, it becomes aware that the detected thoughts are preprogrammed.
entries_es: Cuando afinas a este pin, puedes diseñar una línea general de pensamiento de 25 palabras o menos. Mientras usas este pin, una criatura que lee tus pensamientos detecta tu línea de pensamiento preprogramada. Una criatura que toma la acción [[TAG0] mientras lee sus pensamientos hace un cheque DC 13 Intelligence ([TAG1]]). En un cheque exitoso, se vuelve consciente de que los pensamientos detectados están preprogramados.

entries_es.name: Golden Harper Pin
entries: While wearing this pin, you can cast the {@spell Nondetection|XPHB} spell on yourself. The duration of this spell is permanent until you disable the effect (no action required), you remove the pin, or you are no longer attuned to the pin.

item.name: Hat of Many Spells
entries: This pointed hat has the following properties.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: While holding the hat, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your Wizard spells. Any spell you cast using the hat gains a special Somatic component: you must reach into the hat and "pull" the spell out of it.
entries_es: Mientras sostiene el sombrero, puede utilizarlo como un {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} para sus hechizos magos. Cualquier hechizo que hayas lanzado usando el sombrero gana un componente somático especial: debes alcanzar el sombrero y "pull" el hechizo.

entries.name: Unknown Spell
entries: While holding the hat, you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don't know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list, it must be of a level you can cast, and it can't have Material components costing more than 1,000 GP. Once you decide on the spell, you must expend a spell slot of the spell's level. Then, to determine whether you cast the spell, make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) check ({@dc 10} plus the spell's level). On a successful check, you cast the spell using its normal casting time, and you can't use this property again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. On a failed check, you fail to cast the spell and a random effect occurs instead, determined by rolling on the following table.
Any spell you cast from the hat uses your spell save DC and spell attack bonus.

rows: You cast a random spell determined by rolling {@dice 1d10}: on a {@b 1}, {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|XPHB} (enlarge effect); on a {@b 2}, {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|XPHB} (reduce effect); on a {@b 3}, {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}; on a {@b 4}, {@spell Fireball|XPHB}; on a {@b 5}, {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}; on a {@b 6}, {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} (cast on yourself); on a {@b 7}, {@spell Lightning Bolt|XPHB}; on an {@b 8}, {@spell Phantasmal Force|XPHB}; on a {@b 9}, {@spell Polymorph|XPHB}; on a {@b 10}, {@spell Stinking Cloud|XPHB}.
You have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn, believing something awesome just happened.
A harmless swarm of butterflies fills a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} within 30 feet of yourself. The swarm disperses after 1 minute.

You pull a nonmagical object out of the hat. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the object: on a {@b 1}, a vial of Acid; on a {@b 2}, a flask of Alchemist's Fire; on a {@b 3}, a Crowbar; on a {@b 4}, a lit Torch.
You suffer a bout of "magic sickness" and have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour.
You have the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn.

You pull a nonmagical object out of the hat. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the object: on a {@b 1}, a {@item Dagger|XPHB}; on a {@b 2}, a {@item Rope|XPHB} with a {@item Grappling Hook|XPHB} tied to one end; on a {@b 3}, a bag of {@item Caltrops|XPHB}; on a {@b 4}, a gem worth 50 GP.

A creature appears in an unoccupied space as close to you as possible. The creature isn't under your control and acts as it normally would, and it disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the creature: on a {@b 1}, a {@creature Camel|XMM}; on a {@b 2}, a {@creature Constrictor Snake|XMM}; on a {@b 3}, an {@creature Elephant|XMM}; on a {@b 4}, a {@creature Mule|XMM}.
A {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} {@creature Swarm of Bats|XMM} flies out of the hat, occupies your space, and attacks you.

A vertical, 10-foot-diameter, two-way portal to another plane of existence opens in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you and remains open until the end of your next turn. The DM determines where it leads.

You pull a magic item out of the hat. Roll {@dice 1d6} to determine the item's rarity: on a {@b 1-3}, {@filter Common|items|rarity=Common}; on a {@b 4-5}, {@filter Uncommon|items|rarity=Uncommon}; on a {@b 6}, {@filter Rare|items|rarity=Rare}. The DM chooses the item, which disappears after 1 hour if it's not consumed or destroyed before then.

entries_es: Mientras sostienes el sombrero, puedes intentar lanzar un hechizo nivel 1+ que no sabes. El hechizo debe estar en la lista de hechizos Wizard, debe ser de un nivel que se puede lanzar, y no puede tener componentes materiales que cuestan más de 1.000 GP. item.name: Hat of Vermin
entries: This hat has 3 charges. While holding the hat, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to expend 1 charge and summon your choice of a {@creature Bat|XMM}, a {@creature Frog|XMM}, or a {@creature Rat|XMM}. The summoned creature magically appears in the hat and tries to get away from you as quickly as possible. The creature is {@variantrule Indifferent [Attitude]|XPHB|Indifferent} toward you and other creatures, and it isn't under your control. It behaves as an ordinary creature of its kind and disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The hat regains all expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: Este sombrero tiene 3 cargos. Mientras sostiene el sombrero, puede tomar una [[TAG0] acción para gastar 1 cargo y convocar su elección de un {@creature Bat|XMM}, un {@creature Frog|XMM}, o un {@creature Rat|XMM}]. La criatura llamada aparece mágicamente en el sombrero y trata de alejarse de ti lo más rápido posible. La criatura está {@variantrule Indifferent [Attitude]|XPHB|Indifferent} hacia ti y otras criaturas, y no está bajo tu control. Se comporta como una criatura ordinaria de su tipo y desaparece después de 1 hora o cuando cae a 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. El sombrero recupera todos los cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Hat of Vermin
entries: This hat has 3 charges. While holding the hat, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges and speak a command word that summons your choice of a {@creature bat}, a {@creature frog}, or a {@creature rat}. The summoned creature magically appears in the hat and tries to get away from you as quickly as possible. The creature is neither friendly nor hostile, and it isn't under your control. It behaves as an ordinary creature of its kind and disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 hit points. The hat regains all expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Hazirawn
entries: A sentient (neutral evil) greatsword, Hazirawn is capable of speech in Common and Netherese. Even if you aren't attuned to the sword, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. If you are not attuned to Hazirawn, you deal an extra {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage when you hit with the weapon.

entries.name: Increased Potency
entries: While you are attuned to this weapon, its bonus on attack and damage rolls increases to +2, and a hit deals an extra {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage (instead of {@dice 1d6}).
entries_es: Mientras usted está afinado a este arma, su bonificación en los rollos de ataque y daños aumenta a +2, y un éxito trata un daño necrótico extra {@damage 2d6} (en lugar de [[TAG1]).

entries.name: Spells
entries: Hazirawn has 4 charges to cast spells. As long as the sword is attuned to you and you are holding it in your hand, you can cast {@spell detect magic} (1 charge), {@spell detect evil and good} (1 charge), or {@spell detect thoughts} (2 charges). Each night at midnight, Hazirawn regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges.

Un misterioso (maligno neutro), Hazirawn es capaz de hablar en Común y Netherese. Incluso si no estás afinado a la espada, ganas un bono +1 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma. Si usted no está afinado a Hazirawn, usted se ocupa de un daño necrótico extra [[TAG0] cuando usted golpeó con el arma.

entries_es.name: Increased Potency
entries: While you are attuned to this weapon, its bonus on attack and damage rolls increases to +2, and a hit deals an extra {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage (instead of {@dice 1d6}).
entries_es: Mientras usted está afinado a este arma, su bonificación en los rollos de ataque y daños aumenta a +2, y un éxito trata un daño necrótico extra {@damage 2d6} (en lugar de [[TAG1]).

item.name: Headband of Intellect
entries: Your Intelligence score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is already 19 or higher without it.
entries_es: Tu puntaje de Inteligencia es de 19 años mientras usas este brazalete. No tiene efecto en usted si su Inteligencia ya es 19 o superior sin ella.

item.name: Headband of Intellect
entries: Your Intelligence score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is 19 or higher without it.
entries_es: Tu puntaje de Inteligencia es de 19 años mientras usas este brazalete. No tiene efecto en usted si su Inteligencia es 19 o superior sin ella.

item.name: Healer's Kit
entries: This kit is a leather pouch containing bandages, salves, and splints. The kit has ten uses. As an action, you can expend one use of the kit to stabilize a creature that has 0 hit points, without needing to make a Wisdom ({@skill Medicine}) check.
entries_es: Este kit es una bolsa de cuero que contiene vendajes, salves y splints. El kit tiene diez usos. Como acción, usted puede gastar un uso del kit para estabilizar una criatura que tiene 0 puntos de éxito, sin necesidad de hacer un cheque de Sabiduría ([TAG0]).

item.name: Healer's Kit
entries: A Healer's Kit has ten uses. As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} creature that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} without needing to make a Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|XPHB}) check.
entries_es: El Kit de Sanadores tiene diez usos. Como acción {@action Utilize|XPHB}, puede gastar uno de sus usos para estabilizar una criatura {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} que tiene 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} sin necesidad de hacer un cheque de Sabiduría ([TAG3]]).

item.name: Heart Weaver's Primer
entries: This pristine book smells faintly of a random scent you find pleasing. When found, the book contains the following spells: {@spell antipathy/sympathy}, {@spell charm person}, {@spell dominate person}, {@spell enthrall}, {@spell hypnotic pattern}, {@spell modify memory}, and {@spell suggestion}. It functions as a spellbook for you.
While you are holding the book, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your wizard spells.
The book has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can use the charges in the following ways while holding it:

items: If you spend 1 minute studying the book, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your prepared wizard spells with a different spell in the book. The new spell must be of the enchantment school.
When you cast an enchantment spell, you can expend 1 charge to impose disadvantage on the first saving throw one target makes against the spell.

entries_es: Este libro prístino huele débilmente a un olor aleatorio que encuentra agradable. Cuando se encuentra, el libro contiene los siguientes hechizos: {@spell antipathy/sympathy}, {@spell charm person}], {@spell dominate person}, {@spell enthrall}, {@spell hypnotic pattern}, {@spell modify memory}, y {@spell suggestion}. Funciona como un libro de hechizos para ti.
Mientras sostienes el libro, puedes utilizarlo como un foco de ortografía para tus hechizos magos.
El libro tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Puede utilizar los cargos de las siguientes maneras mientras lo sostiene:

items: If you spend 1 minute studying the book, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your prepared wizard spells with a different spell in the book. The new spell must be of the enchantment school.
When you cast an enchantment spell, you can expend 1 charge to impose disadvantage on the first saving throw one target makes against the spell.

item.name: Heartstone
entries: This lustrous black gem allows a {@creature night hag} to become ethereal while it is in her possession. The touch of a heartstone also cures any disease. Crafting a heartstone takes 30 days.
entries_es: Esta brillante gema negra permite que un {@creature night hag} se vuelva etéreo mientras está en su posesión. El toque de una lápida también cura cualquier enfermedad. Realizar una lápida dura 30 días.

item.name: Hell Hound Cloak
entries: This dark cloak is made of cured {@creature hell hound} hide. As an action, you can command the cloak to transform you into a {@creature hell hound} for up to 1 hour. The transformation otherwise functions as the {@spell polymorph} spell, but you can use a bonus action to revert to your normal form.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This cloak is cursed with the essence of a {@creature hell hound}, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. Until the curse is broken with {@spell remove curse} or similar magic, you are unwilling to part with the cloak, keeping it within reach at all times.
entries_es: Este manto está maldecido con la esencia de un {@creature hell hound}, y al ser afinado a él extiende la maldición a ustedes. Hasta que la maldición se rompa con {@spell remove curse} o magia similar, no estás dispuesto a separarte del manto, manteniéndolo al alcance en todo momento.

entries: The sixth time you use the cloak, and each time thereafter, you must make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the transformation lasts until dispelled or until you drop to 0 hit points, and you can't willingly return to normal form. If you ever remain in {@creature hell hound} form for 6 hours, the transformation becomes permanent and you lose your sense of self. All your statistics are then replaced by those of a {@creature hell hound}. Thereafter, only {@spell remove curse} or similar magic allows you to regain your identity and return to normal. If you remain in this permanent form for 6 days, only a {@spell wish} spell can reverse the transformation.
entries_es: Este manto oscuro está hecho de piel curada [[TAG0]. Como acción, puede ordenar el manto para transformarlo en un [[TAG0] por hasta 1 hora. La transformación funciona de otra manera como el hechizo {@spell polymorph}, pero puede utilizar una acción de bonificación para volver a su forma normal.

entries_es.name: Curse
entries: This cloak is cursed with the essence of a {@creature hell hound}, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. Until the curse is broken with {@spell remove curse} or similar magic, you are unwilling to part with the cloak, keeping it within reach at all times.
entries_es: Este manto está maldecido con la esencia de un {@creature hell hound}, y al ser afinado a él extiende la maldición a ustedes. Hasta que la maldición se rompa con {@spell remove curse} o magia similar, no estás dispuesto a separarte del manto, manteniéndolo al alcance en todo momento.

La sexta vez que usas el manto, y cada vez después, debes hacer un {@dc 15} Charisma ahorro lanzamiento. En un fallido ahorro, la transformación dura hasta que se disipa o hasta que usted cae a 0 puntos de éxito, y no puede regresar voluntariamente a la forma normal. Si alguna vez permaneces en forma [[TAG1] durante 6 horas, la transformación se vuelve permanente y pierdes tu sentido de sí mismo. Todas sus estadísticas son reemplazadas por las de un {@creature hell hound}. Posteriormente, sólo {@spell remove curse} o magia similar le permite recuperar su identidad y volver a la normalidad. Si permanece en esta forma permanente durante 6 días, sólo un hechizo [TAG4] puede revertir la transformación.

item.name: Helm of Brilliance
entries: This dazzling helm is set with {@dice 1d10} diamonds, {@dice 2d10} rubies, {@dice 3d10} fire opals, and {@dice 4d10} opals. Any gem pried from the helm crumbles to dust. When all the gems are removed or destroyed, the helm loses its magic.
You gain the following benefits while wearing it:

items: You can use an action to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 18}), using one of the helm's gems of the specified type as a component: {@spell daylight} (opal), {@spell fireball} (fire opal), {@spell prismatic spray} (diamond), or {@spell wall of fire} (ruby). The gem is destroyed when the spell is cast and disappears from the helm.

As long as it has at least one diamond, the helm emits dim light in a 30-foot radius when at least one undead is within that area. Any undead that starts its turn in that area takes {@damage 1d6} radiant damage.
As long as the helm has at least one ruby, you have resistance to fire damage.

As long as the helm has at least one fire opal, you can use an action and speak a command word to cause one weapon you are holding to burst into flames. The flames emit bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The flames are harmless to you and the weapon. When you hit with an attack using the blazing weapon, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} fire damage. The flames last until you use a bonus action to speak the command word again or until you drop or stow the weapon.

entries: Roll a {@dice d20} if you are wearing the helm and take fire damage as a result of failing a saving throw against a spell. On a roll of 1, the helm emits beams of light from its remaining gems. Each creature within 60 feet of the helm other than you must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be struck by a beam, taking radiant damage equal to the number of gems in the helm. The helm and its gems are then destroyed.

El himno y sus gemas son entonces destruidas.

item.name: Helm of Comprehending Languages
entries: While wearing this helm, you can use an action to cast the {@spell comprehend languages} spell from it at will.
entries_es: Mientras usas este timón, puedes usar una acción para lanzar el hechizo {@spell comprehend languages} a voluntad.

item.name: Helm of Comprehending Languages
entries: While wearing this helm, you can cast {@spell Comprehend Languages|XPHB} from it.
entries_es: Mientras usas este timón, puedes echar {@spell Comprehend Languages|XPHB} de él.

item.name: Helm of Devil Command
item.reqAttune: by a creature that can speak Infernal
entries: This bulky, eyeless helmet is made for a {@creature pit fiend} but magically resizes to fit the heads of other wearers.

While wearing the helm, you can see out of it as though you weren't wearing it. In addition, you know the exact location and type of all devils within 1,000 feet of you. You can telepathically communicate with a devil within range, or you can broadcast your thoughts to all devils within range. The devils receiving your broadcasted thoughts have no special means of replying to them.

The helm has 3 charges. As an action, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell dominate monster} (save {@dc 21}), which affects devils only. (The spell fails and the charge is wasted if you target any creature that's not a devil.) If a devil can see you when you cast this spell on it, the devil knows you tried to charm it. The helm regains all its charges 24 hours after its last charge is expended.

If you are not a devil, using the helm's {@spell dominate monster} property in the Nine Hells has a {@chance 20} chance of attracting a {@creature narzugon|MTF}, which arrives on the back of a {@creature nightmare} mount in {@dice 1d4} hours. The narzugon tries to recover the helm, killing you if necessary to obtain it. If it gets the helm, the narzugon tries to deliver it to its infernal master.
entries_es: Este casco voluminoso y sin ojos está hecho para un {@creature pit fiend} pero mágicamente redimensiona para adaptarse a las cabezas de otros portadores.

Mientras llevas el timón, puedes verlo como si no lo llevaras. Además, usted conoce la ubicación exacta y el tipo de todos los demonios dentro de 1000 pies de usted. Puede comunicarse telepáticamente con un demonio dentro del rango, o puede transmitir sus pensamientos a todos los demonios dentro del rango. Los demonios que reciben tus pensamientos transmitidos no tienen medios especiales para responderles.

El helm tiene 3 cargos. Como acción, puede gastar 1 carga para fundir {@spell dominate monster} (salvar {@dc 21}]), que afecta solamente a los demonios. (El hechizo falla y el cargo es desperdiciado si usted apunta a cualquier criatura que no es un diablo.) Si un demonio puede verte cuando le echas este hechizo, el diablo sabe que trataste de encantarlo. El helm recupera todos sus cargos 24 horas después de su última carga es gastada.

Si usted no es un diablo, el uso de la propiedad [[TAG0] del himno en los Nueve Infiernos tiene una {@chance 20} oportunidad de atraer una {@creature narzugon|MTF}, que llega en la parte posterior de un {@creature nightmare} montaje en {@dice 1d4}] horas. El narzugon intenta recuperar el timón, matándolo si es necesario para obtenerlo. Si consigue el timón, el narzugon intenta entregarlo a su maestro infernal.

item.name: Helm of Disjunction
entries: The wizard Mordenkainen crafted this sleek, golden helmet. If he created other helms of disjunction, they have yet to be found.
As an action while wearing this helm, you can use it to emit an antimagic pulse in a 300-foot-radius sphere centered on yourself. The pulse has the following effects:

entries.name: Magic Item Disjunction
entries: Potions and scrolls in the area are destroyed. All other magic items in the area have their magical properties suppressed for 1 minute. Artifacts are unaffected by this property, as are magic items on your person.
entries_es: Pociones y pergaminos en el área son destruidos. Todos los demás elementos mágicos de la zona tienen sus propiedades mágicas suprimidas durante 1 minuto. Los artefactos no son afectados por esta propiedad, como son objetos mágicos en su persona.

entries.name: Spell Disjunction
entries: Any ongoing spell ends if the creature, object, or area affected by it is even partly in the pulse's area.
entries_es: Cualquier hechizo continuo termina si la criatura, el objeto o el área afectada por él es incluso en parte en el área del pulso.

entries.name: Wave of Force
entries: The antimagic pulse is strong enough to knock down creatures close to you. Each creature within 30 feet of you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or have the {@condition prone} condition.
Once you use the helm's property, it can't be used again until {@dice 1d4} days have passed.

El mago Mordenkainen preparó este elegante y dorado casco. Si creó otros himnos de disyunción, aún no se han encontrado.
Como acción mientras usas este timón, puedes usarlo para emitir un pulso antimagico en una esfera de 300 pies-radius centrada en ti mismo. El pulso tiene los siguientes efectos:

entries_es.name: Magic Item Disjunction
entries: Potions and scrolls in the area are destroyed. All other magic items in the area have their magical properties suppressed for 1 minute. Artifacts are unaffected by this property, as are magic items on your person.
entries_es: Pociones y pergaminos en el área son destruidos. Todos los demás elementos mágicos de la zona tienen sus propiedades mágicas suprimidas durante 1 minuto. Los artefactos no son afectados por esta propiedad, como son objetos mágicos en su persona.

entries_es.name: Spell Disjunction
entries: Any ongoing spell ends if the creature, object, or area affected by it is even partly in the pulse's area.
entries_es: Cualquier hechizo continuo termina si la criatura, el objeto o el área afectada por él es incluso en parte en el área del pulso.

item.name: Helm of Perfect Potential
entries: This copper-hued helm contains a shard of the Elemental Chaos embedded in its forehead, surrounded by a motif of a rising sun. Legend says Annam fashioned this helm for his daughter Diancastra to hold the fragment of chaos she used to prove her worth to her father.

entries.name: Random Properties

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} properties
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property

entries.name: Master of Guile
entries: While wearing the helm, you have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) and Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks.
entries_es: Mientras usas el timón, tienes ventaja en los cheques de Charisma ([TAG0]) y Sabiduría ([TAG1]).

entries.name: Arrow of Elemental Havoc
entries: As a bonus action while wearing the helm, you can launch a bolt of searing elemental energy toward a creature you can see within 90 feet of yourself. The target must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 4d6} acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (your choice). On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.
entries_es: Como una acción de bonificación al usar el timón, puedes lanzar un tornillo de energía elemental sellada hacia una criatura que puedes ver a menos de 90 pies de ti mismo. El objetivo debe hacer un {@dc 20} Un lanzamiento de ahorro de destreza. En un fallido ahorro, la criatura toma {@damage 4d6} ácido, frío, fuego, relámpagos o daños de trueno (su elección). Con un ahorro exitoso, la criatura toma la mitad de daño.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The helm has 6 charges and regains {@dice 1d6} charges each dawn. As an action while wearing the helm, you can expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 20}): {@spell elemental weapon} (1 charge), {@spell call lightning} (2 charges), {@spell wall of fire} (3 charges), {@spell conjure elemental} (4 charges), {@spell tsunami} (5 charges).
entries_es: El himno tiene 6 cargos y recupera [[TAG0] cargos cada amanecer. item.name: Helm of Telepathy
entries: While wearing this helm, you can use an action to cast the {@spell detect thoughts} spell (save {@dc 13}) from it. As long as you maintain {@status concentration} on the spell, you can use a bonus action to send a telepathic message to a creature you are focused on. It can reply—using a bonus action to do so—while your focus on it continues.

While focusing on a creature with {@spell detect thoughts}, you can use an action to cast the {@spell suggestion} spell (save {@dc 13}) from the helm on that creature. Once used, the suggestion property can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras usa este timón, puede usar una acción para lanzar el hechizo {@spell detect thoughts} (salvar {@dc 13}]) de él. Mientras usted mantenga {@status concentration} en el hechizo, usted puede utilizar una acción de bonificación para enviar un mensaje telepático a una criatura en la que usted está enfocado. Puede responder —usando una acción de bonificación para hacerlo— mientras su enfoque en ella continúa.

Si bien te concentras en una criatura con {@spell detect thoughts}, puedes usar una acción para lanzar el hechizo {@spell suggestion} (salvar {@dc 13}) del timón sobre esa criatura. Una vez utilizado, la propiedad de la sugerencia no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Helm of Telepathy
entries: While wearing this helm, you have telepathy with a range of 30 feet, and you can cast {@spell Detect Thoughts|XPHB} or {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} (save {@dc 13}) from the helm. Once either spell is cast from the helm, that spell can't be cast from it again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras usa este timón, usted tiene telepatía con una gama de 30 pies, y usted puede echar {@spell Detect Thoughts|XPHB} o {@spell Suggestion|XPHB}] (salvo {@dc 13}) del timón. Una vez que el hechizo es lanzado desde el timón, ese hechizo no puede ser lanzado de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Helm of Teleportation
entries: This helm has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cast the {@spell teleport} spell from it. The helm regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: Este helm tiene 3 cargos. Mientras la usas, puedes usar una acción y gastar 1 carga para echarle el hechizo {@spell teleport}. El himno recupera {@dice 1d3} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Helm of the Gods
entries: While wearing this helm, you know whether there is a celestial or fiend within 30 feet of you, as well as where the creature is located, provided the creature isn't behind {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}.

Whenever you finish a long rest while wearing the helm, you can pray to one of the gods listed on the Helm of the Gods table and store the listed spell in the helm, replacing any spell that is already stored there. The save DC for the spell is 13.
The helm has 3 charges. To cast a spell from the helm, you must expend 1 charge, and the helm regains {@dice 1d3} charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Helm of the Scavenger
entries: This ornate chair is designed to propel and maneuver a ship through space.

entries.name: Passive Properties
entries: The following properties of the helm come into play even when no creature is attuned to it:

items: When placed aboard a vessel weighing between 1 and 100 tons, the helm generates an envelope of fresh air around the ship while it is in the void of space (but not underwater). This envelope extends out from the edges of the hull in all directions for a distance equal in length to the vessel's beam, so that creatures aboard and near the ship can breathe normally in space. The temperature within the air envelope is 70 degrees Fahrenheit.

When placed aboard a vessel weighing between 1 and 100 tons, the helm generates an artificial gravity field while the ship is in the void of space, so that creatures can walk on the ship's decks as they normally would. Creatures and objects that fall overboard bob in a gravity plane that extends out from the main deck for a distance equal in length to the vessel's beam.

entries_es: Las siguientes propiedades del timón entran en juego incluso cuando ninguna criatura está atestada a ella:

items: When placed aboard a vessel weighing between 1 and 100 tons, the helm generates an envelope of fresh air around the ship while it is in the void of space (but not underwater). The temperature within the air envelope is 70 degrees Fahrenheit.

When placed aboard a vessel weighing between 1 and 100 tons, the helm generates an artificial gravity field while the ship is in the void of space, so that creatures can walk on the ship's decks as they normally would. Creatures and objects that fall overboard bob in a gravity plane that extends out from the main deck for a distance equal in length to the vessel's beam.

entries.name: Active Properties
entries: The sensation of being attuned to the helm is akin to being immersed in warm water. While attuned to the helm, you gain the following abilities while you sit in it:

items: You can use the helm to propel the vessel across or through water and other liquids at a maximum speed in miles per hour equal to your highest-level unexpended spell slot.
You can use the helm to propel the vessel through air or space at a maximum speed in miles per hour equal to your highest-level unexpended spell slot × 10.
Provided you have at least one unexpended spell slot, you can steer the vessel, albeit in a somewhat clumsy fashion, in much the same way that oars or a rudder can maneuver a seafaring ship.
Whenever you like, you can see what's happening on and around the vessel as though you were standing in a location of your choice aboard it.

entries_es: La sensación de estar afinada al timón es similar a estar inmersa en agua tibia. Mientras se atendió al timón, usted gana las siguientes habilidades mientras usted se sienta en él:

items: You can use the helm to propel the vessel across or through water and other liquids at a maximum speed in miles per hour equal to your highest-level unexpended spell slot.

Whenever you like, you can see what's happening on and around the vessel as though you were standing in a location of your choice aboard it.

entries.name: Drawback
entries: While attuned to the helm, you cannot expend your own spell slots.
entries_es: Mientras se ajusta al timón, no puedes gastar tus propias ranuras de hechizo.

item.name: Helm of Underwater Action
entries: While wearing this brass helmet, you can breathe underwater, you gain {@sense darkvision} with a range of 60 feet, and you gain a swimming speed of 30 feet.
entries_es: Mientras usa este casco de latón, puede respirar bajo el agua, usted gana {@sense darkvision} con una gama de 60 pies, y usted gana una velocidad de natación de 30 pies.

item.name: Hempen Rope (50 feet)
entries: Rope, whether made of hemp or silk, has 2 hit points and can be burst with a {@dc 17} Strength check.
entries_es: La cuerda, ya sea hecha de cáñamo o seda, tiene 2 puntos de impacto y se puede reventar con un {@dc 17} Comprobación de fuerza.

item.name: Herbalism Kit
entries: This kit contains a variety of instruments such as clippers, mortar and pestle, and pouches and vials used by herbalists to create remedies and potions. Proficiency with this kit lets you add your proficiency bonus to any ability checks you make to identify or apply herbs. Also, proficiency with this kit is required to create antitoxin and potions of healing.
additionalEntries: Proficiency with an herbalism kit allows you to identify plants and safely collect their useful elements.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: An herbalism kit includes pouches to store herbs, clippers and leather gloves for collecting plants, a mortar and pestle, and several glass jars.
entries_es: Un kit de herbalismo incluye bolsas para almacenar hierbas, clippers y guantes de cuero para recoger plantas, un mortero y pestle, y varios frascos de vidrio.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana
entries: Your knowledge of the nature and uses of herbs can add insight to your magical studies that deal with plants and your attempts to identify potions.
entries_es: Su conocimiento de la naturaleza y usos de las hierbas puede añadir una visión de sus estudios mágicos que tratan con las plantas y sus intentos de identificar las pociones.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: When you inspect an area overgrown with plants, your proficiency can help you pick out details and clues that others might miss.
entries_es: Cuando inspeccionas un área cultivada con plantas, tu competencia puede ayudarte a elegir detalles y pistas que otros podrían perder.

additionalEntries.name: Medicine
entries: Your mastery of herbalism improves your ability to treat illnesses and wounds by augmenting your methods of care with medicinal plants.
entries_es: Su dominio del herbalismo mejora su capacidad para tratar enfermedades y heridas aumentando sus métodos de cuidado con plantas medicinales.

additionalEntries.name: Nature and Survival
entries: When you travel in the wild, your skill in herbalism makes it easier to identify plants and spot sources of food that others might overlook.
entries_es: Cuando usted viaja en la naturaleza, su habilidad en el herbalismo hace más fácil identificar plantas y detectar fuentes de alimentos que otros podrían pasar por alto.

additionalEntries.name: Identify Plants
entries: You can identify most plants with a quick inspection of their appearance and smell.
entries_es: Usted puede identificar la mayoría de las plantas con una inspección rápida de su apariencia y olor.

item.name: Heretic
entries: The blasphemous weapon Heretic was created by a cult to steal power from good-aligned gods. The blade hungers to strike down servants of the Upper Planes and weaken the forces of good.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Heretic has 6 charges for the following properties; the sword regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} charges daily at dawn:

entries.name: Destroy Devotion
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with this weapon, you can expend 1 of its charges to attempt to render the target powerless. The target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition paralyzed} condition until the start of your next turn. Celestials have disadvantage on the save.
entries_es: Una vez por turno cuando golpeas a una criatura con este arma, puedes gastar 1 de sus cargos para intentar hacer que el objetivo sea impotente. El objetivo debe tener éxito en un {@dc 17} La Constitución ahorra el lanzamiento o tener la condición {@condition paralyzed} hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno. Los Celestiales tienen desventaja en la salvación.

entries.name: Faith Hunter
entries: While holding the sword, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it: {@spell Detect Evil and Good} (1 charge), {@spell Fly} (2 charges), or {@spell True Seeing} (3 charges).
entries_es: Mientras sostiene la espada, puede utilizar una acción para expulsar 1 o más de sus cargos para lanzar uno de los siguientes hechizos: {@spell Detect Evil and Good} (1 cargo), {@spell Fly}] (2 cargos), o {@spell True Seeing} (3 cargos).

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Heretic is a sentient, chaotic evil weapon with an Intelligence of 17, a Wisdom of 17, and a Charisma of 15. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.

The weapon can speak, read, and understand Common and Giant, and it can communicate with its wielder telepathically. Its voice is soft and deep but rises in a wild furor when it's aware Celestials or worshipers of good-aligned deities are present. While you are attuned to it, Heretic also understands every language you know.
entries_es: El hereje es un arma sensible y caótica malvada con una Inteligencia de 17, una Sabiduría de 17, y una Charisma de 15. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.

El arma puede hablar, leer y comprender Común y Gigante, y puede comunicarse con su wielder telepáticamente. Su voz es suave y profunda, pero se levanta en un furor salvaje cuando es consciente Celestiales o adoradores de deidades buenas alineadas están presentes. Mientras estás al tanto de ello, Heretic también entiende cada idioma que conoces.

entries.name: Personality
entries: Heretic craves the destruction of good-aligned gods and their supporters. The blade is condescending and snobby, especially in the company of priests and other pious folk, at whom it often directs sneering comments. When Heretic identifies its quarry, it erupts in a frenzied need for violence.
entries_es: Heretic anhela la destrucción de los dioses buenos alineados y sus partidarios. La espada es condescendiente y descuidada, especialmente en compañía de sacerdotes y otros piadosos, a quienes a menudo dirige comentarios persistentes. Cuando Heretic identifica su cantera, estalla en una frenética necesidad de violencia.

El arma blasfema Heretic fue creada por un culto para robar el poder de dioses de buena alineación. La espada tiene hambre de golpear a los sirvientes de los Planos Superiores y debilitar las fuerzas del bien.

item.name: Hew
entries: This +1 battleaxe deals maximum damage when the wielder hits a plant creature or an object made of wood. The axe's creator was a dwarf smith who feuded with the dryads of a forest where he cut firewood. Whoever carries the axe feels uneasy whenever he or she travels through a forest.
entries_es: Este juego de batalla +1 trata el máximo daño cuando el pelador golpea a una criatura de planta o un objeto hecho de madera. El creador del hacha era un herrero enano que fingía con las secas de un bosque donde cortaba leña. Quien lleva el hacha se siente incómodo cuando viaja a través de un bosque.

item.name: Hew
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
Hew is a +1 battleaxe that deals maximum damage when the wielder attacks a Plant creature or an object made of wood. The axe's creator used it for protection in the forest while he cut firewood.
entries_es: Usted tiene un bono +1 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma mágica.

Hew es un juego de batalla +1 que trata el máximo daño cuando el pelador ataca a una criatura de la planta o un objeto hecho de madera. El creador del hacha lo usó para protegerlo en el bosque mientras cortaba leña.

item.name: Heward's Handy Haversack
entries: This backpack has a central pouch and two side pouches, each of which is an extradimensional space. Each side pouch can hold up to 20 pounds of material, not exceeding a volume of 2 cubic feet. The large central pouch can hold up to 8 cubic feet or 80 pounds of material. The backpack always weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents.

Placing an object in the haversack follows the normal rules for interacting with objects. Retrieving an item from the haversack requires you to use an action. When you reach into the haversack for a specific item, the item is always magically on top.

The haversack has a few limitations. If it is overloaded, or if a sharp object pierces it or tears it, the haversack ruptures and is destroyed. If the haversack is destroyed, its contents are lost forever, although an artifact always turns up again somewhere. If the haversack is turned inside out, its contents spill forth, unharmed, and the haversack must be put right before it can be used again. If a breathing creature is placed within the haversack, the creature can survive for up to 10 minutes, after which time it begins to suffocate.

Placing the haversack inside an extradimensional space created by a {@item bag of holding}, {@item portable hole}, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10-feet of the gate is sucked through it and deposited in a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.
entries_es: Esta mochila tiene una bolsa central y dos bolsas laterales, cada una es un espacio extradimensional. Cada bolsa lateral puede contener hasta 20 libras de material, no excedendo un volumen de 2 pies cúbicos. La gran bolsa central puede contener hasta 8 pies cúbicos o 80 libras de material. La mochila siempre pesa 5 libras, independientemente de su contenido.

Colocar un objeto en el Haversack sigue las reglas normales para interactuar con los objetos. Recuperar un artículo del hasrsack requiere que uses una acción. Al llegar al hasrsack para un artículo específico, el artículo está siempre mágicamente encima.

El harsack tiene algunas limitaciones. Si es sobrecargado, o si un objeto afilado lo perfora o la desgarra, las rupturas del harsack y se destruye. Si el hasrsack es destruido, su contenido se pierde para siempre, aunque un artefacto siempre vuelve a aparecer en alguna parte. Si el hasrsack se apaga dentro, su contenido se derrame, sin dañar, y el hasrsack debe ser puesto justo antes de que pueda ser utilizado de nuevo. Si una criatura respiradora se coloca dentro del hasrsack, la criatura puede sobrevivir hasta 10 minutos, después de lo cual comienza a asfixiarse.

Colocar el hasrsack dentro de un espacio extradimensional creado por un {@item bag of holding}, {@item portable hole}], o elemento similar destruye instantáneamente ambos elementos y abre una puerta al Plano Astral. La puerta se origina donde el único elemento fue colocado dentro del otro. Cualquier criatura dentro de 10 pies de la puerta es succionada a través de ella y depositada en una ubicación al azar en el Plano Astral. La puerta se cierra. La puerta es de una sola dirección y no se puede reabrir.

item.name: Heward's Handy Spice Pouch
entries: This belt pouch appears empty and has 10 charges. While holding the pouch, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to expend 1 charge, name any nonmagical food seasoning (such as salt, pepper, saffron, or cilantro), and remove a pinch of the desired seasoning from the pouch. A pinch is enough to season a single meal. The pouch regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: Esta bolsa de cinturón aparece vacía y tiene 10 cargos. Mientras sostiene la bolsa, puede tomar una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para gastar 1 cargo, nombrar cualquier condimentación de alimentos no mágicos (como sal, pimienta, azafrán o cilantro), y quitar una pizca de la condimentación deseada de la bolsa. Una pizca es suficiente para sazonar una sola comida. La bolsa recupera {@dice 1d6 + 4} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Heward's Hireling Armor
entries: A number of Kwalish's experiments were attempts to research the works of the legendary mage Heward, who first crafted what he named hireling armor. While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC. In addition, the armor's animated straps can assist with the drawing and sheathing of weapons, such that you can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

This armor also has six pockets, each of which is an extradimensional space. Each pocket can hold up to 20 pounds of material, not exceeding a volume of 2 cubic feet. The armor always weighs 10 pounds, regardless of its pockets' contents. Placing an object into one of the armor's pockets follows the normal rules for interacting with objects. Retrieving an item from a pocket of the armor requires you to use an action. When you reach into a pocket for a specific item, the item is always magically on top.

Placing the armor inside an extradimensional space created by a {@item bag of holding}, a {@item Heward's handy haversack}, or a similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 feet of the gate is sucked through it and deposited in a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.
entries_es: Algunos de los experimentos de Kwalish fueron intentos de investigar las obras de la legendaria mage Heward, que primero creó lo que nombró armadura de alquiler. Mientras llevas esta armadura, ganas un bono +1 a AC. Además, las correas animadas de la armadura pueden ayudar con el dibujo y vaciado de armas, de tal manera que usted puede dibujar o picar dos armas de una sola mano cuando usted normalmente sería capaz de dibujar o stow sólo uno.

Esta armadura también tiene seis bolsillos, cada uno de los cuales es un espacio extradimensional. Cada bolsillo puede sostener hasta 20 libras de material, no excedendo un volumen de 2 pies cúbicos. La armadura pesa siempre 10 libras, independientemente del contenido de sus bolsillos. Colocar un objeto en uno de los bolsillos de la armadura sigue las reglas normales para interactuar con los objetos. Recuperar un artículo de un bolsillo de la armadura requiere que use una acción. Cuando se llega a un bolsillo para un artículo específico, el artículo está siempre mágicamente encima.

Colocar la armadura dentro de un espacio extradimensional creado por un {@item bag of holding}, un {@item Heward's handy haversack}], o un elemento similar destruye instantáneamente ambos elementos y abre una puerta al Plano Astral. La puerta se origina donde el único elemento fue colocado dentro del otro. Cualquier criatura dentro de 10 pies de la puerta es succionada a través de ella y depositada en una ubicación al azar en el Plano Astral. La puerta se cierra. La puerta es de una sola dirección y no se puede reabrir.

items.name: Awakened
entries: When the armor reaches an awakened state, it gains the following properties:

items: The AC bonus of the armor increases to +2.
While you are transformed by an effect that replaces any of your game statistics with those of another creature, your bonus to melee attack and damage rolls increases by 1 (to +2).
When you cast the {@spell polymorph} spell using this armor, you can transform into a {@creature cave bear}.

entries_es: Cuando la armadura alcanza un estado despierto, gana las siguientes propiedades:

items: The AC bonus of the armor increases to +2.
While you are transformed by an effect that replaces any of your game statistics with those of another creature, your bonus to melee attack and damage rolls increases by 1 (to +2).
When you cast the {@spell polymorph} spell using this armor, you can transform into a {@creature cave bear}.

item.name: Hide of the Feral Guardian (Dormant)
entries: It is believed that this polished and beautifully detailed leather armor was a gift from Melora, bestowed on a long-forgotten archdruid and champion of the natural world before the terrors of the Calamity.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While wearing the armor in its dormant state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The armor grants you a +1 bonus to AC.

While you are transformed by an effect that replaces any of your game statistics with those of another creature, you have a +1 bonus to melee attack and damage rolls, and you retain the benefits of this armor.

As an action, you can use the armor to cast {@spell polymorph} on yourself, transforming into a {@creature giant owl} while retaining your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries_es: Mientras lleva la armadura en su estado inactivo, obtiene los siguientes beneficios:

As an action, you can use the armor to cast {@spell polymorph} on yourself, transforming into a {@creature giant owl} while retaining your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries_es: Se cree que esta armadura de cuero pulida y bellamente detallada fue un regalo de Melora, otorgado en un arruido y campeón del mundo natural antes de los terrores de la Calamidad.

item.name: Hither-Thither Staff
entries: This walking stick has a brilliant gemstone fitted at the top. This staff has 4 charges and regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges daily at dawn.

As an action, you can expend 1 charge from the staff to create two linked teleportation portals, each one appearing on a flat surface of your choice that you can see within 1,500 feet of yourself. Alternatively, you can expend 1 charge as an action to relocate one or both portals, subject to the same limitation. The surface on which a portal appears must be big enough to accommodate it. Each portal is a two-dimensional, glowing oval ring, and together they create an open doorway up to 6 feet high and 4 feet wide. Any creature or object entering one portal exits from the other as if the two portals were a single opening that connects their locations.

A portal can appear on a moving surface, but the effect ends when the two portals move more than 1 mile apart. As a bonus action while holding the staff, you can close both portals (ending the effect) or suppress one portal, causing it to disappear until you relocate it (see above), during which time the remaining portal can't be used. The portals otherwise last for 24 hours.
entries_es: Este bastón tiene una gema brillante en la parte superior. Este personal tiene 4 cargos y recupera {@dice 1d4} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

Como acción, usted puede gastar 1 carga del personal para crear dos portales de teletransportación conectados, cada uno aparece en una superficie plana de su elección que usted puede ver dentro de 1.500 pies de usted mismo. Alternativamente, puede gastar 1 cargo como una acción para reubicar uno o ambos portales, sujeto a la misma limitación. La superficie en la que aparece un portal debe ser lo suficientemente grande para acomodarlo. Cada portal es un anillo ovalado bidimensional y brillante, y juntos crean una puerta abierta de hasta 6 pies de alto y 4 pies de ancho. Cualquier criatura o objeto que entra en un portal sale del otro como si los dos portales fueran una sola abertura que conecta sus ubicaciones.

Un portal puede aparecer en una superficie móvil, pero el efecto termina cuando los dos portales se mueven más de 1 milla. Como acción de bonificación mientras sostiene al personal, puede cerrar ambos portales (finiendo el efecto) o suprimir un portal, causando que desaparezca hasta que lo reubique (ver arriba), durante el cual el portal restante no puede ser utilizado. Los portales tienen una duración de 24 horas.
