Cualquier criatura dentro de 10 pies de la puerta y no detrás {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} es succionada a través de ella y depositada en una ubicación al azar en el Plano Astral. La puerta se cierra. La puerta es de una sola dirección y no se puede reabrir.

item.name: Holy Symbol of Ravenkind
item.reqAttune: by a cleric or paladin of good alignment
entries: The Holy Symbol of Ravenkind is a unique holy symbol sacred to the good-hearted faithful of Barovia. It predates the establishment of any church in Barovia. According to legend, it was delivered to a paladin named Lugdana by a giant raven—or an angel in the form of a giant raven. Lugdana used the holy symbol to root out and destroy nests of vampires until her death. The high priests of Ravenloft kept and wore the holy symbol after Lugdana's passing.
The holy symbol is a platinum amulet shaped like the sun, with a large crystal embedded in its center.
The holy symbol has 10 charges for the following properties. It regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} charges daily at dawn.

entries.name: Hold Vampires
entries: As an action, you can expend 1 charge and present the holy symbol to make it flare with holy power. Vampires and {@creature vampire spawn} within 30 feet of the holy symbol when it flares must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target is {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. It can repeat the saving throw at the end of its turns to end the effect on itself.
entries_es: Como acción, usted puede gastar 1 carga y presentar el símbolo santo para hacer que brille con el poder santo. Vampiros y {@creature vampire spawn} dentro de 30 pies del símbolo santo cuando bengalas deben hacer un {@dc 15} Sabiduría ahorrando lanzamiento. En un ahorro fallido, un objetivo es {@condition paralyzed} por 1 minuto. Puede repetir el lanzamiento de ahorro al final de sus turnos para terminar el efecto en sí mismo.

entries.name: Turn Undead
entries: If you have the Turn Undead or the Turn the Unholy feature, you can expend 3 charges when you present the holy symbol while using that feature. When you do so, undead have disadvantage on their saving throws against the effect.
entries_es: Si tiene el Turn Undead o la función Turn the Unholy, puede gastar 3 cargos cuando presente el símbolo santo mientras usa esa característica. Cuando lo haces, los no muertos tienen desventaja en sus lanzamientos de ahorro contra el efecto.

entries.name: Sunlight
entries: As an action, you can expend 5 charges while presenting the holy symbol to make it shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. The light is sunlight and lasts for 10 minutes or until you end the effect (no action required).
entries_es: Como acción, puede gastar 5 cargos mientras presenta el símbolo santo para hacer que derrama luz brillante en un radio de 30 pies y luz desmenuza para un adicional de 30 pies. La luz es la luz solar y dura 10 minutos o hasta que termine el efecto (no se requiere acción).

El Santo Símbolo de la Ravena es un símbolo santo único sagrado sagrado para los fieles de buen corazón de Barovia. Preda el establecimiento de cualquier iglesia en Barovia. Según la leyenda, fue entregado a un paladín llamado Lugdana por un cuervo gigante, o un ángel en forma de un cuervo gigante. Lugdana utilizó el símbolo santo para arrancar y destruir nidos de vampiros hasta su muerte. Los altos sacerdotes de Ravenloft guardaban y llevaban el santo símbolo después de la muerte de Lugdana.
El símbolo santo es un amuleto de platino en forma de sol, con un gran cristal incrustado en su centro.
El símbolo santo tiene 10 cargos por las siguientes propiedades. Recupera {@dice 1d6 + 4} cargos diarios al amanecer.

item.name: Holy Water
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a flask of Holy Water. Target one creature you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Dexterity modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or take {@damage 2d8} Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead.
entries_es: Cuando usted toma la [[TAG0] acción, usted puede reemplazar uno de sus ataques con lanzar un frasco de Agua Santa. Apunta a una criatura que puedes ver a menos de 20 pies de ti mismo. El objetivo debe tener éxito en un lanzamiento de ahorro de Dexteridad ([TAG1]] más su modificador de Dexteridad y {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) o tomar {@damage 2d8}] Daño radiante si es un Fiend o un Undead.

item.name: Holy Water (flask)
entries: As an action, you can splash the contents of this flask onto a creature within 5 feet of you or throw it up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. In either case, make a ranged attack against a target creature, treating the holy water as an improvised weapon. If the target is a fiend or undead, it takes {@damage 2d6} radiant damage.

A cleric or paladin may create holy water by performing a special ritual. The ritual takes 1 hour to perform, uses 25 gp worth of powdered silver, and requires the caster to expend a 1st-level spell slot.
entries_es: Como acción, se puede salpicar el contenido de este frasco sobre una criatura a 5 pies de usted o tirarlo hasta 20 pies, destrozándolo en el impacto. En cualquier caso, hacer un ataque extendido contra una criatura objetivo, tratando el agua bendita como un arma improvisada. Si el objetivo es un fiend o undead, toma [[TAG0] daño radiante.

Un clérigo o paladín puede crear agua bendita realizando un ritual especial. El ritual lleva 1 hora para realizar, utiliza 25 gp de plata en polvo, y requiere que la castra expendiera una ranura de hechizo de primer nivel.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When Honor's Last Stand reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The shield's bonus to AC increases to +2.
If you successfully {@action shove} a creature while holding this shield, that creature takes {@damage 2d6} force damage.
When a creature within 5 feet of you misses you with an attack, you can attempt to {@action shove} that creature as a reaction.

item.name: Honor's Last Stand (Dormant)
item.reqAttune: by a creature of non-evil alignment
entries: This massive silvered shield bears the crest of {@deity The Platinum Dragon|Exandria|TDCSR} and never tarnishes. Its metal is always warm to the touch.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While Honor's Last Stand is in a dormant state, you gain a +1 bonus to AC while holding the shield. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC. You also can't be knocked {@condition prone} while bearing this shield.
entries_es: Mientras que el último stand de Honor está en un estado inactivo, usted gana un bono +1 a AC mientras sostiene el escudo. Este bono es además del bono normal del escudo a AC. Tampoco se puede golpear {@condition prone} mientras lleva este escudo.
Este enorme escudo plateado lleva la cresta de {@deity The Platinum Dragon|Exandria|TDCSR} y nunca empaña. Su metal siempre es cálido al tacto.

entries: When Honor's Last Stand reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The shield's bonus to AC increases to +3.
When you successfully {@action shove} a creature while holding this shield, you can move it up to 15 feet away from you.
As a bonus action, you can protect an ally within 5 feet of you, granting that ally a +3 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn or until they are no longer within 5 feet of you.

item.name: Hooded Lantern
entries: A hooded lantern casts bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Once lit, it burns for 6 hours on a flask (1 pint) of oil. As an action, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to dim light in a 5-foot radius.
entries_es: Una linterna encapuchada arroja luz brillante en un radio de 30 pies y luz tenue para un adicional de 30 pies. Una vez encendido, quema durante 6 horas en un frasco (1 pint) de aceite. Como acción, se puede bajar la capucha, reduciendo la luz para disminuir la luz en un radio de 5 pies.

item.name: Hooded Lantern
entries: A Hooded Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 5-foot radius, or raise it again.
entries_es: A Hooded Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet. Como un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, se puede bajar la capucha, reduciendo la luz a {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} en un radio de 5 pies, o elevarla de nuevo.

item.name: Hook of Fisher's Delight
entries: This tiny silver fishhook has a little gold feather attached to it. For it to function, the feathered hook must be tied to the end of a fishing line and immersed in enough water to fill at least a 10-foot cube. At the end of each uninterrupted hour of immersion, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 6, a floppy, 6-inch-long magical fish appears on the end of the hook. The color and properties of the conjured fish are determined by rolling on the Hook of Fisher's Delight table. Once the hook conjures a fish, it can't do so again until the next dawn.

entries.caption: Hook of Fisher's Delight
rows: Green with copper bands
This tasty fish provides a day's worth of nourishment to one creature that eats it. The fish loses this property and rots if it's not eaten within 24 hours of being caught.
Yellow with black stripes

Once removed from the hook, this awful-tasting fish can be thrown up to 120 feet, targeting a creature the thrower can see. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. The fish then disappears.
Blue with white bands

When released from the hook, this fish squirms free, sprouts wings, follows you around, and sings a beautiful tune in Aquan. It disappears after {@dice 2d4} hours or when reduced to 0 hit points. The fish uses the {@creature quipper} stat block, except that it can breathe air and has a flying speed of 30 feet.
Gold with silver stripes

This tasty fish provides a day's worth of nourishment to one creature that eats it and grants {@dice 2d10} temporary hit points to that creature. The fish loses these properties and rots if it's not eaten within 24 hours of being caught.

item.name_es: Cuervo de la Deleite de Fisher
entries_es: Este pequeño pez de plata tiene una pluma de oro unida a ella. Para que funcione, el gancho emplumado debe estar atado al final de una línea de pesca y sumergido en suficiente agua para llenar por lo menos un cubo de 10 pies. Al final de cada hora ininterrumpida de inmersión, rodar un {@dice d6}. En un 6, un pez mágico de 6 pulgadas aparece al final del gancho. El color y las propiedades de los peces conjurados se determinan rodando sobre la mesa del placer de Fisher. Una vez que el gancho conjura a un pez, no puede hacerlo de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Horizon Puzzle Cube
entries: A Horizon puzzle cube is an 8-inch magical cube made of gold, iron, crystal, and copper, and it is worth 5,000 gp to a sage or collector. A functioning puzzle cube can be solved with 30 minutes of work and a successful {@dc 25} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. When the cube is solved, a 30-foot-diameter portal appears before the creature who solved the cube, leading to the northeastern platform of Horizon's Edge. The portal is two-way and remains open for 10 minutes or until a creature uses an action to change the puzzle's configuration. Puzzle cubes don't function while on Horizon's Edge, but a device somewhere in the demiplane allows a cube to function in reverse while the cube is fitted into it.
entries_es: Un cubo de rompecabezas Horizon es un cubo mágico de 8 pulgadas hecho de oro, hierro, cristal y cobre, y vale 5,000 gp a un sabio o coleccionista. Un cubo de rompecabezas funcional se puede resolver con 30 minutos de trabajo y un cheque exitoso {@dc 25} Inteligencia ([TAG1]]). Cuando se resuelve el cubo, aparece un portal de 30 pies de diámetro ante la criatura que resolvió el cubo, llevando a la plataforma noreste del Edge de Horizon. El portal es bidireccional y permanece abierto durante 10 minutos o hasta que una criatura utilice una acción para cambiar la configuración del rompecabezas. Los cubos de rompecabezas no funcionan mientras que en Horizon's Edge, pero un dispositivo en algún lugar en el demiplane permite que un cubo funcione en el revés mientras el cubo está instalado en él.

item.name: Horn of Beckoning Death
entries: Resembling a small dragon's horn, this arcane device glows with a hellish internal light when held. As an action while holding this horn, you can invoke a necromantic effect called the Beckoning Death.

The Beckoning Death arrives at the start of your next turn and manifests as a crimson cloud of smoke that fills a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the horn. The sphere doesn't move with the horn. At the start of each of your turns, the sphere's radius increases by 30 feet. The cloud disappears after 10 minutes or when your {@status concentration} on the effect ends. Any creature (including you) that has 9 or fewer hit points when it ends its turn in the cloud is slain by the Beckoning Death. A Humanoid killed in this way instantly transforms into a {@creature zombie} (see the Monster Manual). The zombie obeys the commands of the horn's creator, the lich Szass Tam.
Once you use the horn's property, it can't be used again for 1 year.
item.name_es: Cuerno de la muerte de Beckoning
entries_es: Al parecer el cuerno de un pequeño dragón, este dispositivo arcano brilla con una luz interna infernal cuando se sostiene. Como acción mientras sostiene este cuerno, puede invocar un efecto necromético llamado la muerte de Beckoning.

La muerte de Beckoning llega al comienzo de su próximo turno y se manifiesta como una nube de humo de crimson que llena una esfera de 30 pies-radius centrada en el cuerno. La esfera no se mueve con el cuerno. Al comienzo de cada uno de sus turnos, el radio de la esfera aumenta en 30 pies. La nube desaparece después de 10 minutos o cuando su {@status concentration} en el efecto termina. Cualquier criatura (incluido usted) que tiene 9 o menos puntos de éxito cuando termina su turno en la nube es asesinado por la muerte de Beckoning. Un Humanoid asesinado de esta manera se transforma instantáneamente en un {@creature zombie} (ver el Manual del Monstruo). El zombi obedece las órdenes del creador del cuerno, el lich Szass Tam.
Una vez que usas la propiedad del cuerno, no se puede utilizar de nuevo durante 1 año.

item.name: Horn of Blasting
entries: You can use an action to speak the horn's command word and then blow the horn, which emits a thunderous blast in a 30-foot cone that is audible 600 feet away. Each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d6} thunder damage and is {@condition deafened} for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition deafened}. Creatures and objects made of glass or crystal have disadvantage on the saving throw and take {@damage 10d6} thunder damage instead of {@damage 5d6}.
Each use of the horn's magic has a {@chance 20} chance of causing the horn to explode. The explosion deals {@damage 10d6} fire damage to the blower and destroys the horn.
entries_es: Usted puede utilizar una acción para hablar la palabra de mando del cuerno y luego soplar el cuerno, que emite un rayo trueno en un cono de 30 pies que está audible a 600 pies de distancia. Cada criatura en el cono debe hacer un {@dc 15} La Constitución salvando el tiro. En un fallido ahorro, una criatura toma {@damage 5d6} daño del trueno y es {@condition deafened} por 1 minuto. En un ahorro exitoso, una criatura toma la mitad de daño y no es {@condition deafened}. Las criaturas y los objetos hechos de vidrio o cristal tienen desventaja en el lanzamiento de ahorro y toman {@damage 10d6} daño del trueno en lugar de [[TAG1].
Cada uso de la magia del cuerno tiene una [[TAG0] oportunidad de hacer explotar el cuerno. La explosión trata {@damage 10d6} de disparar daño al soplador y destruye el cuerno.

item.name: Horn of Blasting
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to blow the horn, which emits a thunderous blast in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} that is audible out to 600 feet. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d8} Thunder damage and has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. Glass or crystal objects in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} that aren't being worn or carried take {@damage 10d8} Thunder damage.
Each use of the horn's magic has a {@chance 20} chance of causing the horn to explode. The explosion deals {@damage 10d6} Force damage to the user and destroys the horn.
entries_es: Se puede tomar una acción [[TAG0] para soplar el cuerno, que emite un rayo trueno en una explosión de 30 pies {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} que es audible a 600 pies. Cada criatura en el [[TAG1] hace un {@dc 15} La Constitución salvando el tiro. En un fallido ahorro, una criatura toma {@damage 5d8} Daño del trueno y tiene la condición {@condition Deafened|XPHB} por 1 minuto. En un ahorro exitoso, una criatura toma la mitad del daño sólo. Objetos de vidrio o cristal en el [[TAG1] que no están siendo usados o llevados tomar {@damage 10d8} Daño al Trueno.
Cada uso de la magia del cuerno tiene una [[TAG0] oportunidad de hacer explotar el cuerno. La explosión trata {@damage 10d6} Forzar daño al usuario y destruir el cuerno.

item.name: Horn of Silent Alarm
entries: This horn has 4 charges and regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges daily at dawn. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can blow the horn while expending 1 charge. One creature of your choice hears the horn's blare, provided that creature is within 600 feet of the horn. No other creature hears the horn.
entries_es: Este cuerno tiene 4 cargos y recupera {@dice 1d4} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Como acción {@action Magic|XPHB}, se puede soplar el cuerno mientras se gasta 1 cargo. Una criatura de tu elección escucha la culpa del cuerno, siempre y cuando la criatura esté a menos de 600 pies del cuerno. Ninguna otra criatura oye el cuerno.

item.name: Horn of Silent Alarm
entries: This horn has 4 charges. When you use an action to blow it, one creature of your choice can hear the horn's blare, provided the creature is within 600 feet of the horn and not {@condition deafened}. No other creature hears sound coming from the horn. The horn regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: Este cuerno tiene 4 cargos. Cuando usas una acción para soplarla, una criatura de tu elección puede oír la culpa del cuerno, siempre y cuando la criatura esté a menos de 600 pies del cuerno y no {@condition deafened}. Ninguna otra criatura oye sonido viniendo del cuerno. El cuerno recupera {@dice 1d4} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Horn of the Endless Maze
entries: You can use an action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the Abyss appear within 60 feet of you. These spirits look like minotaurs, and use the {@creature berserker} statistics. They return to Abyss after 1 hour or when they drop to 0 hit points. Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
The horn summons {@dice 3d4 + 3} {@creature berserker||berserkers}. To use the horn, you must be proficient with all simple weapons.

If you blow the horn without meeting its requirement, the summoned {@creature berserker||berserkers} attack you. If you meet the requirement, they are friendly to you and your companions and follow your commands.

item.name: Horror Trinket
entries: Before you finish making a character, roll once on the Horror Trinkets table for a unique object your character has with them at the start of their adventuring career. These trinkets hint toward various horrific tales and might lead to dreadful revelations or be nothing more than grim keepsakes. At the DM's discretion any of these trinkets might also be a Mist talisman (detailed in {@book chapter 3|VRGR|3|Mist Talismans}), a focal item that can lead the bearer through the Mists to a particular Domain of Dread.

entries_es: Antes de terminar de hacer un personaje, rodar una vez en la mesa de Horror Trinkets para un objeto único que su personaje tiene con ellos al comienzo de su carrera de aventura. Estos trinkets insinúan varios cuentos horribles y podrían llevar a revelaciones terribles o no ser nada más que ruidosos recuerdos. A discreción del DM cualquiera de estos trinkets también podría ser un talismán Mist (detallado en {@book chapter 3|VRGR|3|Mist Talismans}), un elemento focal que puede llevar al portador a través de los Mists a un Dominio particular de Dread.

item.name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
entries: These iron horseshoes come in a set of four. While all four shoes are affixed to the hooves of a horse or similar creature, they allow the creature to move normally while floating 4 inches above the ground. This effect means the creature can cross or stand above nonsolid or unstable surfaces, such as water or lava. The creature leaves no tracks and ignores {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. In addition, the creature can move at normal speed for up to 12 hours a day without suffering {@condition exhaustion} from a forced march.
entries_es: Estas herraduras de hierro vienen en un set de cuatro. Mientras que los cuatro zapatos están colocados en las pezuñas de un caballo o criatura similar, permiten a la criatura moverse normalmente mientras flotan 4 pulgadas sobre el suelo. Este efecto significa que la criatura puede cruzar o estar sobre superficies no sólidas o inestables, como agua o lava. La criatura no deja huellas e ignora [[TAG0]. Además, la criatura puede moverse a velocidad normal hasta 12 horas al día sin sufrir {@condition exhaustion} de una marcha forzada.

item.name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
entries: These horseshoes come in a set of four. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can touch one of the horseshoes to the hoof of a horse or similar creature, whereupon the horseshoe affixes itself to the hoof. Removing a horseshoe also takes a {@action Magic|XPHB} action.

While all four shoes are affixed to the hooves of a horse or similar creature, they allow the creature to move normally while floating 4 inches above a surface. This effect means the creature can cross or stand above nonsolid or unstable surfaces, such as water or lava. The creature leaves no tracks and ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. In addition, the creature can travel for up to 12 hours a day without gaining {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} levels from extended travel.
entries_es: Estas herraduras vienen en un set de cuatro. Como acción {@action Magic|XPHB}, se puede tocar una de las herraduras a la pezuña de un caballo o criatura similar, en la cual la herradura se afianza a sí misma al pezuña. La eliminación de una herradura también toma una acción [[TAG0].

Mientras que los cuatro zapatos están colocados en las pezuñas de un caballo o criatura similar, permiten a la criatura moverse normalmente mientras flotan 4 pulgadas sobre una superficie. Este efecto significa que la criatura puede cruzar o estar sobre superficies no sólidas o inestables, como agua o lava. La criatura no deja huellas e ignora [[TAG0]. Además, la criatura puede viajar hasta 12 horas al día sin obtener [[TAG1] niveles de viaje prolongado.

item.name: Horseshoes of Speed
entries: These iron horseshoes come in a set of four. While all four shoes are affixed to the hooves of a horse or similar creature, they increase the creature's walking speed by 30 feet.
entries_es: Estas herraduras de hierro vienen en un set de cuatro. Mientras que los cuatro zapatos están colocados a los cascos de un caballo o criatura similar, aumentan la velocidad de caminar de la criatura a 30 pies.

item.name: Horseshoes of Speed
entries: These horseshoes come in a set of four. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can touch one of the horseshoes to the hoof of a horse or similar creature, whereupon the horseshoe affixes itself to the hoof. Removing a horseshoe also takes a {@action Magic|XPHB} action.
While all four horseshoes are attached to the same creature, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is increased by 30 feet.
entries_es: Estas herraduras vienen en un set de cuatro. Como acción {@action Magic|XPHB}, se puede tocar una de las herraduras a la pezuña de un caballo o criatura similar, en la cual la herradura se afianza a sí misma al pezuña. La eliminación de una herradura también toma una acción [[TAG0].
Mientras que las cuatro herraduras están sujetas a la misma criatura, su {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} se aumenta en 30 pies.

item.name: House of Cards
entries: This deck of cards is decorated with geometric shapes that have a protective motif. While you're holding the deck, you can use an action to shuffle it and cause the cards to deal themselves out and transform into a shelter made of cards. The shelter can be shaped however you desire, but it must fit in a 40-foot cube centered on a point within 30 feet of you. The shelter has one door and up to four windows, and only you can open or close them. It has a floor and a roof, and it maintains a comfortable temperature inside.

The shelter has AC 15, 50 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. The shelter lasts for 24 hours, until you dismiss it as an action, or until it is reduced to 0 hit points. When the shelter's duration ends, it transforms back into a deck of cards and appears in your hand. Once the deck has transformed into a shelter, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Esta cubierta de tarjetas está decorado con formas geométricas que tienen un motivo protector. Mientras sostienes la cubierta, puedes usar una acción para eliminarla y hacer que las cartas se traten y se transformen en un refugio hecho de tarjetas. El refugio puede ser moldeado como quieras, pero debe caber en un cubo de 40 pies centrado en un punto a 30 pies de ti. El refugio tiene una puerta y hasta cuatro ventanas, y sólo usted puede abrir o cerrar. Tiene un suelo y un techo, y mantiene una temperatura cómoda dentro.

El refugio tiene AC 15, 50 puntos de impacto, e inmunidad para envenenar y daños psíquicos. El refugio dura 24 horas, hasta que lo despida como acción, o hasta que se reduce a 0 puntos de impacto. Cuando la duración del refugio termina, se transforma en una cubierta de tarjetas y aparece en tu mano. Una vez que la cubierta se ha transformado en un refugio, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Hunter's Coat
entries: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

The coat has 3 charges. When you hit a creature with an attack and that creature doesn't have all its hit points, you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra {@damage 1d10} necrotic damage to the target. The coat regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.
The breastplate and shoulder protectors of this armor are made of leather that has been stiffened by being boiled in oil. The rest of the armor is made of softer and more flexible materials.
entries_es: Usted tiene un +1 bono a AC mientras usa esta armadura.

El abrigo tiene 3 cargos. Cuando golpeas a una criatura con un ataque y esa criatura no tiene todos sus puntos de éxito, puedes gastar 1 carga para tratar un daño necrótico extra [[TAG0] al objetivo. El abrigo recupera {@dice 1d3} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.
Los protectores de pechuga y hombro de esta armadura están hechos de cuero que se ha endurecido al ser hervido en aceite. El resto de la armadura está hecha de materiales más suaves y flexibles.

item.name: Hunting Trap
entries: When you use your action to set it, this trap forms a saw-toothed steel ring that snaps shut when a creature steps on a pressure plate in the center. The trap is affixed by a heavy chain to an immobile object, such as a tree or a spike driven into the ground. A creature that steps on the plate must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} piercing damage and stop moving. Thereafter, until the creature breaks free of the trap, its movement is limited by the length of the chain (typically 3 feet long). A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 13} Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Each failed check deals 1 piercing damage to the trapped creature.
entries_es: Cuando usas tu acción para configurarla, esta trampa forma un anillo de acero con tacos de sierra que se cierra cuando una criatura pisa una placa de presión en el centro. La trampa es afianzada por una cadena pesada a un objeto inmóvil, como un árbol o un pico arrastrado al suelo. Una criatura que pisa el plato debe tener éxito en un {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} piercing damage and stop moving. A partir de entonces, hasta que la criatura se libera de la trampa, su movimiento está limitado por la longitud de la cadena (típicamente 3 pies de largo). Una criatura puede usar su acción para hacer un {@dc 13} Comprobación de fuerza, liberando a sí mismo u otra criatura a su alcance en un éxito. Cada cheque falló hace 1 daño a la criatura atrapada.

item.name: Hunting Trap
entries: As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can set a Hunting Trap, which is a sawtooth steel ring that snaps shut when a creature steps on a pressure plate in the center. The trap is affixed by a heavy chain to an immobile object, such as a tree or a spike driven into the ground. A creature that steps on the plate must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage and have its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. Thereafter, until the creature breaks free of the trap, its movement is limited by the length of the chain (typically 3 feet). A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics|XPHB}) check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Each failed check deals 1 Piercing damage to the trapped creature.
entries_es: Como acción {@action Utilize|XPHB}, se puede establecer una trampa de caza, que es un anillo de acero aserrado que se cierra cuando una criatura pisa sobre una placa de presión en el centro. La trampa es afianzada por una cadena pesada a un objeto inmóvil, como un árbol o un pico arrastrado al suelo. Una criatura que pisa el plato debe tener éxito en un {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage and have its [[TAG3] reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. En lo sucesivo, hasta que la criatura se libera de la trampa, su movimiento está limitado por la longitud de la cadena (típicamente 3 pies). Una criatura puede utilizar su acción para hacer un {@dc 13} Strength ([TAG5]]) cheque, liberando a sí mismo u otra criatura a su alcance en un éxito. Cada cheque fallado trata 1 Daño perforado a la criatura atrapada.

item.name: Icon of Ravenloft
item.reqAttune: by a creature of good alignment
entries: The Icon of Ravenloft is a 12-inch tall statuette made of the purest silver, weighing 10 pounds. It depicts a cleric kneeling in supplication.
The icon was given to Strahd by the archpriest Ciril Romulich, an old family friend, to consecrate the castle and its chapel.

While within 30 feet of the icon, a creature is under the effect of a {@spell protection from evil and good} spell against fiends and undead. Only a creature attuned to the icon can use its other properties.

entries.name: Augury
entries: You can use an action to cast an {@spell augury} spell from the icon, with no material components required. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Usted puede utilizar una acción para lanzar un [[TAG0] hechizo del icono, sin componentes materiales requeridos. Una vez utilizado, esta propiedad no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Bane of the Undead
entries: You can use the icon as a holy symbol while using the Turn Undead or Turn the Unholy feature. If you do so, increase the save DC by 2.
entries_es: Puedes usar el icono como símbolo santo mientras usas la función Turn Undead o Turn the Unholy. Si usted lo hace, aumentar el DC salvo en 2.

entries.name: Cure Wounds
entries: While holding the icon, you can take an action to heal one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. The target regains {@dice 3d8 + 3} hit points, unless it is an undead, a construct, or a fiend. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras sostienes el icono, puedes tomar una acción para sanar a una criatura que puedes ver a menos de 30 pies de ti. El objetivo recupera [[TAG0] puntos de éxito, a menos que sea un no-muerto, un constructo o un fiend. Una vez utilizado, esta propiedad no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.
El icono de Ravenloft es una estatuilla de 12 pulgadas de altura hecha de la plata más pura, pesando 10 libras. Representa un arrodillado clérigo en la súplica.
El icono fue dado a Strahd por el arzobispo Ciril Romulich, un viejo amigo de la familia, para consagrar el castillo y su capilla.

Mientras que a menos de 30 pies del icono, una criatura está bajo el efecto de un hechizo {@spell protection from evil and good} contra los amigos y no muertos. Sólo una criatura afinada al icono puede usar sus otras propiedades.

item.name: Iggwilv's Cauldron
entries: {@creature Iggwilv the Witch Queen|WBtW|Iggwilv} crafted this wondrous cauldron with the help of her adoptive mother, the archfey Baba Yaga. The cauldron has two forms. Only Iggwilv or Baba Yaga can change the cauldron from one form to another (by using an action to touch it), which either can do without being attuned to the item. In its first form, the cauldron is made of solid gold and embossed on the outside with images of bare-branched trees, falling leaves, and broomsticks. In its second form, the cauldron is made of iron and embossed on the outside with images of bats, toads, cats, lizards, and snakes—eight of each animal. In either form, the cauldron is roughly 3 feet in diameter and has a 2-foot-wide mouth, a round lid with a molded handle at the top, and eight clawed feet for stability. The cauldron weighs 80 pounds when empty, and it can hold up to 100 gallons of liquid.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: Any Humanoid creature that attunes to the cauldron must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be aged to the point of decrepitude. In this state, the creature's speed is halved, the range of its vision and hearing is reduced to 30 feet, and it has disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. The creature will reach the end of its natural life span in {@dice 3d8} days. Only a {@spell wish} spell or divine intervention can reverse this aging effect on the creature.
Three hags can attune to the cauldron simultaneously, provided they have formed a coven. If the coven disbands, the attunement ends for all three hags.
entries_es: Cualquier criatura Humanoide que attunes al caldero debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15} Constitución que salva el tiro o envejece hasta el punto de decrepitud. En este estado, la velocidad de la criatura es reducida, la gama de su visión y audición se reduce a 30 pies, y tiene desventaja en todos los controles de habilidad, los rollos de ataque y los tiros de ahorro. La criatura alcanzará el final de su vida natural en [[TAG1] días. Sólo un [[TAG2] hechizo o intervención divina puede revertir este efecto de envejecimiento en la criatura.
Tres cerdos pueden afinar al caldero simultáneamente, siempre que hayan formado un aquelarre. Si el aquelarre se desbanda, el attunement termina por los tres cerdos.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: Regardless of the form it takes, the cauldron has the following random properties:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property (determined by rolling on the {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|Minor Beneficial} Properties table in the Dungeon Master's Guide)

1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property (determined by rolling on the {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|Minor Detrimental} Properties table in the Dungeon Master's Guide)

entries_es: Independientemente de la forma que tome, el caldero tiene las siguientes propiedades aleatorias:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property (determined by rolling on the {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|Minor Beneficial} Properties table in the Dungeon Master's Guide)

1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property (determined by rolling on the {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|Minor Detrimental} Properties table in the Dungeon Master's Guide)

entries.name: Gold Cauldron
entries: The gold cauldron has the following properties:

items: If water is poured into the cauldron and stirred for 1 minute, it transforms into a hearty, hot stew that provides one nourishing meal for up to four people per gallon of water used. The stew remains hot while in the cauldron, then cools naturally after it is removed. The outside of the cauldron remains safe to touch despite the heat of the stew.

If wine is poured into the cauldron and stirred for 10 minutes, it transforms into a magical elixir that fortifies up to four people per gallon of wine used. Any creature that imbibes the elixir gains 10 temporary hit points. Any of the elixir that isn't consumed within 1 hour vanishes. Once used, this property of the cauldron can't be used again until the next dawn.

When the cauldron is filled with 90 gallons of water mixed with 10 gallons of wine, it can be used as the focus for a {@spell scrying} spell. When this spell is cast using the cauldron as its focus, the target of the spell fails its saving throw automatically, and the spell works even if its caster and the target are on different planes of existence. When the spell ends, all the liquid in the cauldron vanishes.

Dipping the bristles of an ordinary broom into the water-filled cauldron transforms the broom into a broom of flying for 3 days. Once used, this property of the cauldron can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Iron Cauldron
entries: The iron cauldron has the following properties:

items: You can use an action to scream into the empty cauldron, which magically summons a {@creature swarm of bats} that flies out of the cauldron and acts immediately after you in the initiative order. The swarm obeys your commands and disappears after 1 minute if it hasn't been destroyed by then. Once used, this property of the cauldron can't be used again until the next dawn.

If at least 1 gallon of blood is poured into the cauldron and stirred for 1 minute, it turns into a cloud of harmless black smoke that erupts from the cauldron and dissipates quickly. At the same time, all Humanoid creatures within a certain radius of the cauldron fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 hour, except those that are attuned to the cauldron or immune to being {@condition charmed}. The radius of the effect is 100 feet per gallon of blood used. An {@condition unconscious} creature awakens if it takes damage or if someone uses an action to shake or slap it. Once used, this property of the cauldron can't be used again until the next dawn.

Tying a dead frog or toad to the end of an ordinary branch and dipping it in the water-filled cauldron transforms the branch into a {@item wand of polymorph} with 3 charges. This wand can't recharge and crumbles to ashes when its final charge is expended. Once used, this property of the cauldron can't be used again for 8 days.

If you spend 1 minute touching the cauldron with a unicorn's horn while reciting the poem called "The Witch Queen's Cauldron" (see the accompanying sidebar), all creatures within 1,000 feet of the cauldron except those that are attuned to it become frozen in time. A time-frozen creature is {@condition incapacitated}, can't move or speak, doesn't age, and is unaware of its surroundings or the passage of time. Moreover, it can't be moved, harmed in any way, or affected by any other magic. All other conditions and effects on the creature are suppressed until it is no longer frozen in time. Destroying the cauldron, sending it to another plane of existence, or touching it with a unicorn's horn for 1 minute while reciting "The Witch Queen's Cauldron" ends the time-freezing effect on all creatures. The effect also ends on any creature that comes into contact with an antimagic field or is touched by a unicorn's horn.

entries.name: Destroying the Cauldron
entries: The cauldron is a Medium object with AC 19, 80 hit points, and immunity to damage from any source other than a flame tongue or frost brand weapon. Reducing the cauldron to 0 hit points with such a weapon shatters the cauldron into eight pieces of roughly equal size, whereupon all ongoing effects created by the cauldron end as it loses its magic.
The destruction of Iggwilv's Cauldron causes all hags in the multiverse to lose the Shared Spellcasting trait gained by being in a coven (see the "Hag Covens" sidebar in the Monster Manual).
entries_es: El caldero es un objeto mediano con AC 19, 80 puntos de impacto e inmunidad para dañar cualquier fuente que no sea una lengua de llama o arma de marca de heladas. Reducir el caldero a 0 puntos de impacto con tal arma destroza el caldero en ocho pedazos de tamaño aproximadamente igual, en los cuales todos los efectos continuos creados por el extremo del caldero pierde su magia.

La destrucción del caldero de Iggwilv causa que todos los cerdos en el multiverso pierdan el rasgo de Spellcasting compartido ganado por estar en un aquelarre (ver la barra lateral "Hag Covens" en el Manual del Monstruo).

entries.name: Reconstructing the Cauldron
entries: If all eight pieces of the shattered cauldron are within 5 feet of one another, a {@spell wish} spell can reassemble them, restoring the cauldron and all its properties. The cauldron's reconstruction also restores the Shared Spellcasting trait of hag covens throughout the multiverse.
entries_es: Si las ocho piezas del caldero destrozado están a 5 pies de uno de otro, un hechizo [TAG0] puede volver a montarlas, restaurando el caldero y todas sus propiedades. La reconstrucción del caldero también restablece el rasgo de espeluznamiento compartido de los cuervos a lo largo del multiverso.

{@creature Iggwilv the Witch Queen|WBtW|Iggwilv} creó este maravilloso caldero con la ayuda de su madre adoptiva, el arzobispo Baba Yaga. El caldero tiene dos formas. Sólo Iggwilv o Baba Yaga pueden cambiar el caldero de una forma a otra (utilizando una acción para tocarlo), que puede hacer sin ser afinado al objeto. En su primera forma, el caldero está hecho de oro sólido y encarnado en el exterior con imágenes de árboles de marca desnuda, hojas caídas y escobas. En su segunda forma, el caldero está hecho de hierro y encarnado en el exterior con imágenes de murciélagos, cuentas, gatos, lagartos y serpientes —ocho de cada animal. En cualquier forma, el caldero es de aproximadamente 3 pies de diámetro y tiene una boca de 2 pies de ancho, una tapa redonda con un mango moldeado en la parte superior, y ocho pies de garra para la estabilidad. El caldero pesa 80 libras cuando está vacío, y puede contener hasta 100 galones de líquido.

entries_es.name: Attunement
entries: Any Humanoid creature that attunes to the cauldron must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be aged to the point of decrepitude. In this state, the creature's speed is halved, the range of its vision and hearing is reduced to 30 feet, and it has disadvantage on all ability checks, attack rolls, and saving throws. The creature will reach the end of its natural life span in {@dice 3d8} days. Only a {@spell wish} spell or divine intervention can reverse this aging effect on the creature.
Three hags can attune to the cauldron simultaneously, provided they have formed a coven. If the coven disbands, the attunement ends for all three hags.
entries_es: Cualquier criatura Humanoide que attunes al caldero debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15} Constitución que salva el tiro o envejece hasta el punto de decrepitud. En este estado, la velocidad de la criatura es reducida, la gama de su visión y audición se reduce a 30 pies, y tiene desventaja en todos los controles de habilidad, los rollos de ataque y los tiros de ahorro. La criatura alcanzará el final de su vida natural en [[TAG1] días. Sólo un [[TAG2] hechizo o intervención divina puede revertir este efecto de envejecimiento en la criatura.
Tres cerdos pueden afinar al caldero simultáneamente, siempre que hayan formado un aquelarre. Si el aquelarre se desbanda, el attunement termina por los tres cerdos.

entries_es.name: Gold Cauldron
entries: The gold cauldron has the following properties:

items: If water is poured into the cauldron and stirred for 1 minute, it transforms into a hearty, hot stew that provides one nourishing meal for up to four people per gallon of water used. The stew remains hot while in the cauldron, then cools naturally after it is removed. The outside of the cauldron remains safe to touch despite the heat of the stew.

If wine is poured into the cauldron and stirred for 10 minutes, it transforms into a magical elixir that fortifies up to four people per gallon of wine used. Any creature that imbibes the elixir gains 10 temporary hit points. Any of the elixir that isn't consumed within 1 hour vanishes. Once used, this property of the cauldron can't be used again until the next dawn.

When the cauldron is filled with 90 gallons of water mixed with 10 gallons of wine, it can be used as the focus for a {@spell scrying} spell. When this spell is cast using the cauldron as its focus, the target of the spell fails its saving throw automatically, and the spell works even if its caster and the target are on different planes of existence. When the spell ends, all the liquid in the cauldron vanishes.

Dipping the bristles of an ordinary broom into the water-filled cauldron transforms the broom into a broom of flying for 3 days. Once used, this property of the cauldron can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries_es.name: Iron Cauldron
entries: The iron cauldron has the following properties:

items: You can use an action to scream into the empty cauldron, which magically summons a {@creature swarm of bats} that flies out of the cauldron and acts immediately after you in the initiative order. The swarm obeys your commands and disappears after 1 minute if it hasn't been destroyed by then. Once used, this property of the cauldron can't be used again until the next dawn.

If at least 1 gallon of blood is poured into the cauldron and stirred for 1 minute, it turns into a cloud of harmless black smoke that erupts from the cauldron and dissipates quickly. At the same time, all Humanoid creatures within a certain radius of the cauldron fall {@condition unconscious} for 1 hour, except those that are attuned to the cauldron or immune to being {@condition charmed}. The radius of the effect is 100 feet per gallon of blood used. An {@condition unconscious} creature awakens if it takes damage or if someone uses an action to shake or slap it. Once used, this property of the cauldron can't be used again until the next dawn.

Tying a dead frog or toad to the end of an ordinary branch and dipping it in the water-filled cauldron transforms the branch into a {@item wand of polymorph} with 3 charges. This wand can't recharge and crumbles to ashes when its final charge is expended. Once used, this property of the cauldron can't be used again for 8 days.

If you spend 1 minute touching the cauldron with a unicorn's horn while reciting the poem called "The Witch Queen's Cauldron" (see the accompanying sidebar), all creatures within 1,000 feet of the cauldron except those that are attuned to it become frozen in time. A time-frozen creature is {@condition incapacitated}, can't move or speak, doesn't age, and is unaware of its surroundings or the passage of time. Moreover, it can't be moved, harmed in any way, or affected by any other magic. All other conditions and effects on the creature are suppressed until it is no longer frozen in time. Destroying the cauldron, sending it to another plane of existence, or touching it with a unicorn's horn for 1 minute while reciting "The Witch Queen's Cauldron" ends the time-freezing effect on all creatures. The effect also ends on any creature that comes into contact with an antimagic field or is touched by a unicorn's horn.

entries_es.name: Destroying the Cauldron
entries: The cauldron is a Medium object with AC 19, 80 hit points, and immunity to damage from any source other than a flame tongue or frost brand weapon. Reducing the cauldron to 0 hit points with such a weapon shatters the cauldron into eight pieces of roughly equal size, whereupon all ongoing effects created by the cauldron end as it loses its magic.
The destruction of Iggwilv's Cauldron causes all hags in the multiverse to lose the Shared Spellcasting trait gained by being in a coven (see the "Hag Covens" sidebar in the Monster Manual).
entries_es: El caldero es un objeto mediano con AC 19, 80 puntos de impacto e inmunidad para dañar cualquier fuente que no sea una lengua de llama o arma de marca de heladas. Reducir el caldero a 0 puntos de impacto con tal arma destroza el caldero en ocho pedazos de tamaño aproximadamente igual, en los cuales todos los efectos continuos creados por el extremo del caldero pierde su magia.

La destrucción del caldero de Iggwilv causa que todos los cerdos en el multiverso pierdan el rasgo de Spellcasting compartido ganado por estar en un aquelarre (ver la barra lateral "Hag Covens" en el Manual del Monstruo).

entries_es.name: Reconstructing the Cauldron
entries: If all eight pieces of the shattered cauldron are within 5 feet of one another, a {@spell wish} spell can reassemble them, restoring the cauldron and all its properties. The cauldron's reconstruction also restores the Shared Spellcasting trait of hag covens throughout the multiverse.
entries_es: Si las ocho piezas del caldero destrozado están a 5 pies de uno de otro, un hechizo [TAG0] puede volver a montarlas, restaurando el caldero y todas sus propiedades. La reconstrucción del caldero también restablece el rasgo de espeluznamiento compartido de los cuervos a lo largo del multiverso.

item.name: Iggwilv's Horn
entries: You can use an action to blow this horn to cast one of the following spells from it: {@spell Arms of Hadar}, {@spell Fog Cloud}, {@spell Gust of Wind}, or {@spell Web}. If the spell requires a saving throw, the spell save DC is 13.
Once the horn has been used to cast a spell, it can't be used to cast that spell again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Puede utilizar una acción para soplar este cuerno para lanzar uno de los siguientes hechizos de él: {@spell Arms of Hadar}, {@spell Fog Cloud}, {@spell Gust of Wind}], o {@spell Web}. Si el hechizo requiere un lanzamiento de ahorro, el hechizo ahorra DC es 13.
Una vez que el cuerno ha sido usado para lanzar un hechizo, no se puede utilizar para lanzar ese hechizo de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Illuminator's Tattoo
entries: Produced by a special needle, this magic tattoo features beautiful calligraphy, images of writing implements, and the like.

entries.name: Tattoo Attunement
entries: To attune to this item, you hold the needle to your skin where you want the tattoo to appear, pressing the needle there throughout the attunement process. When the attunement is complete, the needle turns into the ink that becomes the tattoo, which appears on the skin.
If your attunement to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes, and the needle reappears in your space.
entries_es: Para afinar a este artículo, usted sostiene la aguja a su piel donde desea que aparezca el tatuaje, presionando la aguja allí durante todo el proceso de atracción. Cuando el dispositivo está completo, la aguja se convierte en la tinta que se convierte en el tatuaje, que aparece en la piel.
Si su atontado al tatuaje termina, el tatuaje desaparece, y la aguja reaparece en su espacio.

entries.name: Magical Scribing
entries: While this tattoo is on your skin, you can write with your fingertip as if it were an ink pen that never runs out of ink.

As an action, you can touch a piece of writing up to one page in length and speak a creature's name. The writing becomes {@condition invisible} to everyone other than you and the named creature for the next 24 hours. Either of you can dismiss the invisibility by touching the script (no action required). Once used, this action can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras este tatuaje está en su piel, usted puede escribir con su dedo como si fuera un lápiz de tinta que nunca se queda sin tinta.

Como acción, puedes tocar un pedazo de escritura hasta una página de longitud y hablar el nombre de una criatura. La escritura se convierte {@condition invisible} a todo el mundo que no sea usted y la criatura nombrada por las próximas 24 horas. Cualquiera de ustedes puede descartar la invisibilidad tocando el script (no se requiere acción). Una vez utilizado, esta acción no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.
Producido por una aguja especial, este tatuaje mágico cuenta con hermosa caligrafía, imágenes de los implementos de escritura, y similares.

item.name: Illusionist's Bracers
entries: A powerful illusionist of House Dimir originally developed these bracers, which enabled her to create multiple minor illusions at once. The bracers' power, though, extends far beyond illusions.
While wearing the bracers, whenever you cast a cantrip, you can use a bonus action on the same turn to cast that cantrip a second time.
entries_es: Un poderoso ilusionista de House Dimir desarrolló originalmente estos brujos, lo que le permitió crear múltiples ilusiones menores a la vez. Sin embargo, el poder de los brujos se extiende más allá de las ilusiones.
Mientras usas los sujetadores, siempre que echas un cantrip, puedes usar una acción de bonificación en el mismo turno para lanzar que puede ir una segunda vez.

item.name: Immovable Rod
entries: This flat iron rod has a button on one end. You can use an action to press the button, which causes the rod to become magically fixed in place. Until you or another creature uses an action to push the button again, the rod doesn't move, even if it is defying gravity. The rod can hold up to 8,000 pounds of weight. More weight causes the rod to deactivate and fall. A creature can use an action to make a {@dc 30} Strength check, moving the fixed rod up to 10 feet on a success.
entries_es: Esta varilla plana de hierro tiene un botón en un extremo. Puede utilizar una acción para pulsar el botón, lo que hace que la varilla se arregle mágicamente en su lugar. Hasta que usted u otra criatura use una acción para presionar el botón de nuevo, la varilla no se mueve, incluso si está desafiando la gravedad. La varilla puede soportar hasta 8.000 libras de peso. Más peso hace que la varilla desactive y caiga. Una criatura puede usar una acción para hacer un {@dc 30} Control de fuerza, moviendo la varilla fija hasta 10 pies en un éxito.

item.name: Inescapable Lash
entries: This braided cord is dull bronze in color, ends in a splayed set of three barbs, and gleams like metal under any light. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, which has a reach of 20 feet. When you hit a creature or object using this whip, you can attempt to {@action grapple} the target as a bonus action.

While you have a creature {@condition grappled} using this whip, you can use your action to either pull the creature up to 20 feet toward you, or cause the creature to be {@condition restrained} until you let go of the whip. A creature {@condition restrained} in this way can escape by making a successful Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check as an action. The DC of this check equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier.
entries_es: Este cordón trenzado es dull bronce en color, termina en un conjunto de tres langostinos, y brilla como metal bajo cualquier luz. Ganas un bono +1 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma mágica, que tiene un alcance de 20 pies. Cuando golpeas a una criatura o objeto usando este látigo, puedes intentar {@action grapple} el objetivo como una acción de bonificación.

Mientras tienes una criatura {@condition grappled} usando este látigo, puedes usar tu acción para tirar de la criatura hasta 20 pies hacia ti, o hacer que la criatura sea {@condition restrained}] hasta que dejes ir el látigo. Una criatura {@condition restrained} de esta manera puede escapar haciendo una fuerza exitosa ([TAG3]]) o Dexteridad ({@skill Acrobatics}) comprobar como una acción. El DC de este cheque es igual a 8 + su prima de competencia + su modificador de fuerza.

item.name: Infernal Amulet
entries: While wearing this amulet, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your spells, and it grants a +2 bonus to your spell save DC and spell attack bonus.

entries.name: Curse
entries: You're unwilling to part with this amulet while attuned to it and you wear it always. While wearing the amulet you have disadvantage on Strength saving throws and Strength checks. Only the {@spell Remove Curse} spell allows you to remove the item and end attunement.
entries_es: No estás dispuesto a separarte de este amuleto mientras estás al tanto y lo usas siempre. Mientras usas el amuleto tienes desventaja en tiras de ahorro de fuerza y controles de fuerza. Sólo el hechizo {@spell Remove Curse} le permite eliminar el elemento y la eliminación final.

entries: While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to AC.

entries.name: Curse
entries: Once you wear this armor, and are attuned to it, you can't remove it. Only the {@spell Remove Curse} spell allows you to end the attunement and finally doff it. While wearing the armor, you're vulnerable to the following damage types: force, lightning, psychic, radiant, and thunder.

Mientras llevas esta armadura, ganas un bono +2 a AC.

entries_es.name: Curse
entries: Once you wear this armor, and are attuned to it, you can't remove it. Only the {@spell Remove Curse} spell allows you to end the attunement and finally doff it. While wearing the armor, you're vulnerable to the following damage types: force, lightning, psychic, radiant, and thunder.
entries_es: Una vez que usas esta armadura, y estás afinada a ella, no puedes quitarla. Sólo el hechizo {@spell Remove Curse} le permite terminar el attunement y finalmente doff it. Mientras usas la armadura, eres vulnerable a los siguientes tipos de daños: fuerza, relámpago, psíquico, radiante y trueno.

entries_es.name: Corrupting
entries: This item corrupts. See the "{@adventure Infernal Item Corruption|CoA|16|Infernal Item Corruption}" section.
entries_es: Este artículo corrompe. Vea la sección "[TAG0]".

item.name: Infernal Puzzle Box
entries: An infernal puzzle box is a cube-shaped container 5 to 6 inches on a side, composed of airtight, interlocking parts made from materials found in the Nine Hells. Most of these boxes are made of infernal iron, though some are carved from bone or horn. Infernal puzzle boxes are used to safeguard diabolical contracts signed between devils and mortals, even after the terms of these contracts are fulfilled. An empty infernal puzzle box weighs 3 pounds regardless of the materials used to fashion it.

When an object small enough to fit inside an infernal puzzle box is placed in it, the container magically seals shut around the object, and no magic can force the box open. The sealed box becomes immune to all damage as well. Every infernal puzzle box is constructed with a unique means of opening it. The trick to solving the puzzle is always mundane, never magical. Once a creature figures out the trick or sequence of steps needed to open a particular infernal puzzle box, that creature can open the box as an action, allowing access to the box's contents.

A creature that spends 1 hour holding an infernal puzzle box while trying to open it can make a {@dc 30} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check. If the check succeeds, the creature figures out the trick or sequence of steps needed to open the box. If the check fails by 5 or more, the creature must make a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries_es: Una caja de rompecabezas infernal es un contenedor en forma de cubo de 5 a 6 pulgadas de un lado, compuesto de partes herméticas, entrelazadas hechas de materiales encontrados en los Nueve Infiernos. La mayoría de estas cajas están hechas de hierro infernal, aunque algunas están talladas de hueso o cuerno. Las cajas de rompecabezas infernal se utilizan para salvaguardar los contratos diabólicos firmados entre demonios y mortales, incluso después de que se cumplan los términos de estos contratos. Una caja de rompecabezas infernal vacía pesa 3 libras independientemente de los materiales utilizados para la moda.

Cuando un objeto lo suficientemente pequeño como para encajar dentro de una caja de rompecabezas infernal se coloca en ella, el contenedor mágicamente sella alrededor del objeto, y ninguna magia puede forzar la caja abierta. La caja sellada también se vuelve inmune a todo daño. Cada caja del rompecabezas infernal se construye con un medio único de abrirla. El truco para resolver el rompecabezas es siempre mundano, nunca mágico. Una vez que una criatura descubra el truco o la secuencia de pasos necesarios para abrir una caja de rompecabezas infernal en particular, esa criatura puede abrir la caja como una acción, permitiendo el acceso al contenido de la caja.

Una criatura que pasa 1 hora sosteniendo una caja de rompecabezas infernal mientras intenta abrirla puede hacer un cheque {@dc 30} Inteligencia ({@skill Investigation}). Si el cheque tiene éxito, la criatura descubre el truco o la secuencia de pasos necesarios para abrir la caja. Si el cheque falla en 5 o más, la criatura debe hacer un {@dc 18} Sabiduría ahorrando lanza, tomando 42 ({@damage 12d6}) daño psíquico en un ahorro fallido, o la mitad de daño en uno exitoso.

item.name: Infernal Tack
item.reqAttune: by a creature of evil alignment.
entries: A rider binds a {@creature nightmare} to its service with infernal tack, which consists of a bridle, bit, reins, saddle, and stirrups, along with spurs that are worn by the rider. A nightmare equipped with infernal tack must serve whoever wears the spurs until the wearer dies or the tack is removed.

You can use an action to call a nightmare equipped with infernal tack by clashing the spurs together or scraping them through blood. The nightmare appears at the start of your next turn, within 20 feet of you. It acts as your ally and takes its turn on your initiative count. It remains for 1 day, until you or it dies, or until you dismiss it as an action. If the nightmare dies, it reforms in the Nine Hells within 24 hours, after which you can summon it again.

The tack doesn't conjure a nightmare; one must first be subdued so the tack can be placed on it. No nightmare accepts this forced servitude willingly, but some eventually form strong loyalties to their masters and become true partners in evil.
entries_es: Un jinete se une a {@creature nightmare} a su servicio con taquilla infernal, que consiste en un bridle, bit, riendas, sillín y estribos, junto con espuelas que son usados por el jinete. Una pesadilla equipada con tack infernal debe servir a quien use los espuelas hasta que el usuario muera o se retire el tack.

Puedes usar una acción para llamar a una pesadilla equipada con tack infernal al chocar los espuelas juntos o rasparlos a través de sangre. La pesadilla aparece al comienzo de tu próximo turno, a menos de 20 pies de ti. Actúa como tu aliado y toma su turno en tu cuenta de iniciativa. Queda por 1 día, hasta que mueras o hasta que lo desestimes como una acción. Si la pesadilla muere, se reforma en los Nueve Infiernos dentro de 24 horas, después de lo cual se puede convocar de nuevo.

La taquilla no conjura una pesadilla; primero hay que someterse para que la taca se pueda colocar en ella. Ninguna pesadilla acepta esta servidumbre forzada voluntariamente, pero algunos eventualmente forman fuertes lealtades a sus maestros y se convierten en verdaderos socios en el mal.

items.name: Awakened
entries: When the Infiltrator's Key reaches an awakened state, it gains the following properties:

items: While holding the key, you can use a bonus action to transform the key into a magic dagger or back into a key. While the key is in the form of a dagger, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and it returns to your hand immediately after it is used to make a ranged attack.

While holding the key, you can use an action to cast one of the following spells from it: {@spell alter self}, {@spell invisibility}, {@spell knock}, or {@spell pass without trace}. Once a spell has been cast using the key, it can't be used to cast that spell again until the next dawn.

While holding the key, you can use an action to cast one of the following spells from it: {@spell alter self}, {@spell invisibility}, {@spell knock}, or {@spell pass without trace}. Once a spell has been cast using the key, it can't be used to cast that spell again until the next dawn.

item.name: Infiltrator's Key (Dormant)
entries: This mithral skeleton key was forged using the blood of twelve master thieves executed for trying to steal magic items during the Age of Arcanum.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: The Infiltrator's Key grants the following benefits in its dormant state:

items: The key can be used as {@item thieves' tools|phb} for the purpose of opening locks. When using the key, you are considered proficient in {@item thieves' tools|PHB} and you have advantage on ability checks made to open locks.
While holding the key, your steps are muffled, giving you advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks made to move silently.

items.name: Exalted
entries: When the Infiltrator's Key reaches an exalted state, it gains the following properties:

items: As a bonus action, you can touch the key to a floor, wall, or ceiling that is no more than 5 feet thick and cause a magical opening to appear in the surface. When you create the opening, you choose its length and width, up to 10 feet for each dimension. The opening lasts until the key passes through it to the other side, at which point it disappears (if a creature is in the opening when the doorway closes, the creature is safely shunted to the nearest unoccupied space). The key can't be used to create another opening until the next dawn.

While holding the key, you can use an action to cast one of the following spells from it: {@spell dimension door}, {@spell gaseous form}, or {@spell mislead}. Once a spell has been cast using the key, it can't be used to cast that spell again until the next dawn.

item.name: Ingot of the Skold Rune
entries: This appears to be a simple ingot of iron ore, about a foot long and a few inches across. Inspection of its surface reveals the faint, silvery outline of the skold (shield) rune. The ingot has the following properties, which work only while it's on your person.

entries.name: Runic Shield
entries: You have a +1 bonus to AC.
entries_es: Usted tiene un bono +1 a AC.

entries.name: Shield Bond
entries: As a bonus action, choose a creature that you can see within 30 feet of you, other than yourself. Until the end of your next turn, any damage the target takes is reduced to 1, but you take half the damage prevented in this way. The damage you take can't be reduced in any way. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
entries_es: Como una acción de bonificación, elige una criatura que puedes ver a menos de 30 pies de ti. Hasta el final de su próximo turno, cualquier daño que el objetivo tome se reduce a 1, pero usted toma la mitad del daño evitado de esta manera. El daño que tomas no se puede reducir de ninguna manera. Una vez que utilice esta propiedad, no puede utilizarla de nuevo hasta que termine un breve o largo descanso.

entries.name: Shield Ward
entries: You can transfer the ingot's magic to a nonmagical item—a shield or a two-handed melee weapon-by tracing the skold rune there with your finger. The transfer takes 8 hours of work that requires the two items to be within 5 feet of each other. At the end, the ingot is destroyed, and the rune appears in silver on the chosen item, which gains a benefit based on its form:

items.name: Shield
items.entry: The shield is now a rare magic item that requires attunement. Its magic gives you a +1 bonus to AC, and the first time after each of your long rests that damage reduces you to 0 hit points, you are instead reduced to 1 hit point. You must be wielding the shield to gain these benefits.

items.name: Weapon
items.entry: The weapon is now an uncommon magic weapon. It grants you a +1 bonus to AC while you're holding it.

entries_es: Usted puede transferir la magia del ingot a un elemento no mágico: un escudo o un arma de dos manos por rastrear la runa de skold allí con su dedo. El traslado lleva 8 horas de trabajo que requiere que los dos elementos estén a unos 5 pies. Al final, el enigma es destruido, y la runa aparece en plata sobre el objeto elegido, que gana un beneficio basado en su forma:
