entries_es: Con una sola piedra, se puede conjurar un espacio extradimensional en forma de cúpula o pirámide, hasta 1 milla a cada lado, con cualquier terreno que desee. Los bordes de este espacio son sólidos e impasibles, pero pueden ser {@condition invisible}, para que su espacio pueda aparecer para continuar para siempre si lo desea. Con tonos adicionales, puede añadir una milla cuadrada adicional a su creación, añadiendo o combinando tipos de terreno.

Cada milla cuadrada puede incluir una sola estructura hasta el tamaño de {@spell Mordenkainen's magnificent mansion}, con todos los sirvientes y fiestas asistentes, o cualquier número de estructuras más pequeñas que juntos equivalen a una magnífica mansión en el área total.

Usted no puede crear flora o fauna que traten daño o de otro modo dañar criaturas. Si usted crea acantilados, aguas u otras características naturales, sin embargo, las criaturas en el espacio podrían caer, ahogarse o dañarse de otra manera.

entries.name: Physical Structure Design
entries: With a single keystone, you can create a structure akin to a mighty fortress with the added flexibility to customize that fortress not only for cosmetic details but for substantive effects. With a single keystone, you can rearrange the walls, open spaces, floors, doors, and other features of the mighty fortress provided you do not exceed 150 10-foot-wide cubes of interior space. Your fortress can reach across a creek, river, or other waters. It can take reckless or even dangerous shapes to include deep pits, flooded chambers, and so on. Your design, once conjured, is not guaranteed to be capable of supporting its own weight or surviving the stresses of attacks, weather, or time.

You may post any number of your structure's servants as guards, if you wish. They have statistics identical to an unseen servant with the addition of a passive {@skill Perception} score equal to your own, though you cannot perceive through their senses. The servants can ring bells or otherwise manipulate the environment to raise an alarm.
entries_es: Con una sola piedra clave, puede crear una estructura similar a una fortaleza poderosa con la flexibilidad agregada para personalizar esa fortaleza no sólo para detalles cosméticos sino para efectos sustantivos. Con una sola piedra angular, puede reorganizar las paredes, espacios abiertos, suelos, puertas y otras características de la fortaleza poderosa siempre que no exceda 150 cubos de espacio interior de 10 pies de ancho. Su fortaleza puede llegar a través de un arroyo, río u otras aguas. Puede tomar formas imprudentes o incluso peligrosas para incluir pozos profundos, cámaras inundadas, etc. Su diseño, una vez conjurado, no está garantizado para ser capaz de soportar su propio peso o sobrevivir las tensiones de los ataques, el tiempo o el tiempo.

Puede publicar cualquier número de los sirvientes de su estructura como guardias, si lo desea. Tienen estadísticas idénticas a un sirviente invisible con la adición de una puntuación pasiva {@skill Perception} igual a la suya, aunque no se puede percibir a través de sus sentidos. Los sirvientes pueden sonar campanas o manipular el medio ambiente para levantar una alarma.

entries.name: Manifestations
entries: Each place or structure conjured by a keystone of creation has special, unforeseen manifestations that affect its makeup and appearance. Some manifestations are beneficial, some are detrimental. These manifestations change each time a keystone is used to conjure a structure or place. The DM may roll or choose from the following tables, or devise unique manifestations based on the specific creations being conjured.
entries_es: Cada lugar o estructura conjurada por una piedra clave de la creación tiene manifestaciones especiales, imprevistas que afectan su maquillaje y apariencia. Algunas manifestaciones son beneficiosas, algunas son perjudiciales. Estas manifestaciones cambian cada vez que se utiliza una piedra clave para conjurar una estructura o lugar. El DM puede rodar o elegir entre las tablas siguientes, o diseñar manifestaciones únicas basadas en las creaciones específicas que se están conjurando.

item.name: Khrusor, Spear of Heliod
entries: Heliod wields Khrusor, a spear blessed with the power of the sun. In his hands, it can be pitched from Nyx to any point on Theros. When Heliod lends his weapon to a mortal, it's typically so they can perform some great work in his name or as a test of their worthiness.

entries.name: Spear of the Sun
entries: This spear grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. When you hit with an attack using this spear, the target takes an extra {@damage 2d8} radiant damage.
entries_es: Esta lanza otorga un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con él. Cuando golpeas con un ataque usando esta lanza, el objetivo toma un daño radiante extra [[TAG0].

entries.name: Blessing of the Sun
entries: If you are a worshiper of Heliod, you gain all the following benefits for which you have the required piety:

items.name: Piety 3+
items.entry: You gain 15 temporary hit points each dawn.

items.name: Piety 10+
items.entry: The spear has 1 randomly determined {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property.

items.name: Piety 25+
items.entry: The spear has 1 additional randomly determined {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property.

items.name: Piety 50+
items.entry: The spear has 1 randomly determined {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property.

entries: If you aren't a worshiper of Heliod, the spear has 2 randomly determined {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|dmg|major detrimental} properties.
See "Artifacts" in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for details on randomly determined properties.
entries_es: Si usted es un adorador de Heliod, usted gana todos los siguientes beneficios para los cuales usted tiene la piedad requerida:

items.name: Piety 3+
items.entry: You gain 15 temporary hit points each dawn.

items.name: Piety 10+
items.entry: The spear has 1 randomly determined {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property.

items.name: Piety 25+
items.entry: The spear has 1 additional randomly determined {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property.

items.name: Piety 50+
items.entry: The spear has 1 randomly determined {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property.

entries_es: Si usted no es un adorador de Heliod, la lanza tiene 2 propiedades determinadas al azar {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|dmg|major detrimental}.
Ver "Artifacts" en el capítulo 7 de la Guía del Maestro Dungeon para obtener detalles sobre propiedades determinadas al azar.

entries.name: Luminous
entries: The spear sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. The light is sunlight.
entries_es: La lanza arroja luz brillante en un radio de 30 pies y luz tenue para 30 pies adicionales. La luz es luz solar.

entries.name: Sun's Retaliation
entries: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack with the spear against that creature. On a hit, the spear deals damage as normal, and the creature is {@condition blinded} until the start of its next turn. This property of the spear can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Cuando usted toma el daño de una criatura a menos de 5 pies de usted, usted puede utilizar su reacción para hacer un simple ataque con la lanza contra esa criatura. En un golpe, la lanza trata el daño como normal, y la criatura es {@condition blinded} hasta el comienzo de su siguiente turno. Esta propiedad de la lanza no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Spells
entries: The spear has 10 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 18}) from it: {@spell guiding bolt} (1 charge), {@spell daylight} (3 charges, targeting the tip of the spear only), {@spell sunbeam} (6 charges). The spear regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: La lanza tiene 10 cargos. Mientras lo sostiene, puede utilizar una acción para exponer 1 o más de sus cargos para lanzar uno de los siguientes hechizos (salvo {@dc 18}) de él: {@spell guiding bolt} (1 cargo), {@spell daylight} [3 cargos, dirigidos únicamente a la punta de la lanza]] {@spell sunbeam}] (6 cargos). La lanza recupera {@dice 1d6 + 4} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

entries.name: Destroying the Spear
entries: If taken to Erebos's palace in Tizerus, and used to sacrifice a champion of Heliod to Erebos, Khrusor is either destroyed or fundamentally twisted to Erebos's service.
entries_es: Si es llevado al palacio de Erebos en Tizerus, y usado para sacrificar un campeón de Heliod a Erebos, Khrusor es destruido o fundamentalmente retorcido al servicio de Erebos.

entries.caption: Trinkets from Khyber
rows: A pressed flower with vivid green petals; when you smell it, you hear eerie music
A tiny ball of putty; if you set it down, it begins to slowly crawl around
A perpetually warm disk of dark iron
A small journal with leathery pages; any words you write in it slowly disappear
A four-sided die carved with strange markings
A cameo with the silhouette of an unknown species
A preserved finger with purple flesh and four joints
A perfectly preserved eye; if you set it down, it rotates to follow your movement
A small box; when opened, you alone hear screaming
A preserved insect; you've never seen another like it

entries: When the Kiss of the Changebringer reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The bonus to {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} increases to +2.

item.name: Kiss of the Changebringer (Dormant)
entries: A beautiful, glittering emerald is set within this silver chain, humming with power and possibility. It is said that this amulet was stolen from the neck of {@deity The Changebringer|Exandria|TDCSR} herself by the {@deity The Lord of the Hells|Exandria|TDCSR}, and locked within the vaults of Bazzoxan in {@book Wildemount|TDCSR|3|Wildemount}. It was later claimed there by a group of Aurora Watch soldiers during an expedition into that grim fortress's abandoned temples.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While the Kiss of the Changebringer is in a dormant state, you have a +1 bonus to {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} and are immune to the {@condition grappled} condition while wearing it.
entries_es: Mientras el beso del cambio está en un estado inactivo, usted tiene un bono +1 a {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1}] y son inmunes a la condición {@condition grappled} mientras la usa.

Una esmeralda hermosa y brillante se encuentra dentro de esta cadena de plata, rebosando con poder y posibilidad. Se dice que este amuleto fue robado del cuello de [[TAG0] ella misma por {@deity The Lord of the Hells|Exandria|TDCSR}], y encerrado dentro de las bóvedas de Bazzoxan en {@book Wildemount|TDCSR|3|Wildemount}. Más tarde fue reclamado allí por un grupo de soldados de Aurora Watch durante una expedición en los templos abandonados de esa fortaleza.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When the Kiss of the Changebringer reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The bonus to {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} increases to +3.
You are immune to the {@condition paralyzed} and {@condition petrified} conditions.

When you make an attack roll, ability check, or {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, you can roll an additional {@dice d20}. You can choose to do so after you make the attack roll, ability check, or {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, but before the outcome is determined. You choose which of the {@dice 2d20|d20s} to use for your roll. This property of the amulet can't be used again until you finish a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|short or long rest}.

entries: When the Kiss of the Changebringer reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The bonus to {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1} increases to +3.
You are immune to the {@condition paralyzed} and {@condition petrified} conditions.

When you make an attack roll, ability check, or {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, you can roll an additional {@dice d20}. You can choose to do so after you make the attack roll, ability check, or {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, but before the outcome is determined. You choose which of the {@dice 2d20|d20s} to use for your roll. This property of the amulet can't be used again until you finish a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|short or long rest}.

item.name: Knave's Eye Patch
entries: While wearing this eye patch, you gain these benefits:

items: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
If you have the Sunlight Sensitivity trait, you are unaffected by the trait.
You are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts or determine whether you are lying. Creatures can communicate telepathically with you only if you allow it.

entries_es: Mientras usa este parche ocular, obtiene estos beneficios:

items: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
If you have the Sunlight Sensitivity trait, you are unaffected by the trait.
You are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts or determine whether you are lying. Creatures can communicate telepathically with you only if you allow it.

item.name: Knife of Stolen Resistance
entries: Using an action, you carve a single infernal rune into the flesh of an {@condition unconscious} Beast, Celestial, Dragon, Fey, or Giant with this knife. Over the next 10 minutes the creature dies an agonizing death that can't be prevented short of the {@spell Wish} spell. If the creature has any resistances or immunities, you gain those resistances and immunities until the creature dies or a {@spell Wish} spell is used to save the creature. The knife's power can't be used again until you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Usando una acción, usted talla una sola runa infernal en la carne de un {@condition unconscious} Bestia, Celestial, Dragon, Fey, o Giant con este cuchillo. En los próximos 10 minutos la criatura muere una muerte agonizante que no puede evitarse más allá del hechizo {@spell Wish}. Si la criatura tiene resistencias o inmunidades, usted gana esas resistencias e inmunidades hasta que la criatura muere o un hechizo {@spell Wish} se utiliza para salvar a la criatura. El poder del cuchillo no puede usarse hasta que termines un largo descanso.

item.name: Knight Card
entries: As an action, you can throw this card to an unoccupied space on the ground within 60 feet of yourself while speaking a command word, whereupon the card magically transforms into a {@creature deck defender|BMT} (see {@book chapter 9|BMT|8|Deck Defender} for its stat block) for up to 1 minute or until you use an action to speak the command word again, whereupon it transforms back into a card. The deck defender obeys your spoken commands. If you issue no commands, it takes the {@action Dodge} action and moves to avoid danger. The deck defender reverts to a card early if it drops to 0 hit points. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Como acción, puede lanzar esta tarjeta a un espacio no ocupado en el suelo a menos de 60 pies de usted mientras habla una palabra de comando, en la que la tarjeta se transforma mágicamente en un {@creature deck defender|BMT} (ver {@book chapter 9|BMT|8|Deck Defender}] para su bloque de puestos) por hasta 1 minuto o hasta que utilice una acción para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo, en la que se transforma de nuevo en una tarjeta. El defensor de cubierta obedece sus órdenes habladas. Si no emite comandos, toma la acción {@action Dodge} y se mueve para evitar el peligro. El defensor de cubierta se revierte a una tarjeta temprano si cae a 0 puntos de éxito. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Korolnor Scepter
entries: The Korolnor Scepter is one of ten Ruling Scepters of Shanatar, forged by the dwarven gods and given to the ruling houses of the ancient dwarven empire. The Korolnor Scepter's location was unknown for the longest time until a {@creature storm giant} queen, Neri, found it in a barnacle-covered shipwreck at the bottom of the Trackless Sea. The Ruling Scepters are all roughly the same size and shape, but their materials and properties vary.

The Korolnor Scepter is a tapered mithral rod as thick and long as a dwarf's forearm, with a small platinum knob at the bottom and a rounded disk adorned with a ring of seven tiny blue gems at the top.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this scepter, which can be wielded as a magic club.

You can use the properties of the {@item Wyrmskull Throne|SKT}, as well as the properties of the scepter itself. The scepter has 10 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expanded charges at dawn. Its properties are as follows:

items: If you are underground or underwater, you can use an action to expend 1 charge to determine the distance to the surface.
As an action: you can expend 2 charges to cast the {@spell sending} spell from the scepter.

As an action: you can expend 3 charges to cast the {@spell teleport} spell from the scepter. If the destination is within 60 feet of the {@item Wyrmskull Throne|SKT}, there is no chance of a teleport error or mishap occurring.

entries_es: El Esceptor Korolnor es uno de los diez Esceptores Ruling de Shanatar, forjado por los dioses enanos y dado a las casas dominantes del antiguo imperio enano. La ubicación de Korolnor Scepter fue desconocida durante mucho tiempo hasta que una reina {@creature storm giant}, Neri, la encontró en un naufragio cubierto por el barnáculo en la parte inferior del Mar sin rumbo. Los Esceptores de Ruling son todos aproximadamente del mismo tamaño y forma, pero sus materiales y propiedades varían.

El Korolnor Scepter es una vara mitra cónica tan gruesa y larga como el antebrazo de un enano, con un pequeño pomo platino en la parte inferior y un disco redondeado adornado con un anillo de siete pequeñas gemas azules en la parte superior.
Ganas un bono +3 para atacar y dañar los rollos hechos con este cetro, que se puede usar como un club mágico.

Usted puede utilizar las propiedades del {@item Wyrmskull Throne|SKT}, así como las propiedades del cetro en sí. El cetro tiene 10 cargos, y recupera {@dice 1d6 + 4} cargos ampliados al amanecer. Sus propiedades son las siguientes:

items: If you are underground or underwater, you can use an action to expend 1 charge to determine the distance to the surface.
As an action: you can expend 2 charges to cast the {@spell sending} spell from the scepter.

As an action: you can expend 3 charges to cast the {@spell teleport} spell from the scepter. If the destination is within 60 feet of the {@item Wyrmskull Throne|SKT}, there is no chance of a teleport error or mishap occurring.

item.name: Kyrzin's Ooze
entries: This opalescent, symbiotic goo comes sealed in a jar and slowly shifts and moves, as if endlessly exploring the jar's interior. To attune to this item, you must first drink the contents of the jar, unlocking the following properties.

entries.name: Resistant
entries: While attuned to Kyrzin's ooze, you have resistance to poison and acid damage, and you're immune to the {@condition poisoned} condition.
entries_es: Mientras se atenúa al ooze de Kyrzin, usted tiene resistencia al daño venenoso y ácido, y usted es inmune a la condición {@condition poisoned}.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries: As an action, you can speak a command word and cause your body to assume the amorphous qualities of an ooze. For the next minute, you (along with any equipment you're wearing or carrying) can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. Once you use this property, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Como acción, puede hablar una palabra de comando y hacer que su cuerpo asuma las cualidades amorosas de un ooze. Por el minuto siguiente, usted (junto con cualquier equipo que usted está usando o llevando) puede moverse a través de un espacio tan estrecho como 1 pulgada de ancho sin apretar. Una vez que usas esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Acid Breath
entries: As an action, you can exhale acid in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Once you use this property, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Como acción, puede exhalar ácido en una línea de 30 pies de ancho. Cada criatura en esa línea debe hacer un {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 ([TAG1]) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Una vez que usas esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Symbiotic Nature
entries: The ooze can't be removed from you while you're attuned to it, and you can't voluntarily end your attunement to it. If you're targeted by a spell that ends a curse, your attunement to the ooze ends, as it seeps out of you.
If you die while the ooze is inside you, it bursts out and engulfs you, turning your corpse into a {@creature black pudding} allied with the daelkyr.
entries_es: El ooze no puede ser quitado de ti mientras estás en sintonía con él, y no puedes terminar voluntariamente tu attunement a él. Si eres blanco de un hechizo que acaba con una maldición, tu attunement al ooze termina, como se ve fuera de ti.
Si mueres mientras el ooze está dentro de ti, sale y te envuelve, convirtiendo tu cuerpo en un aliado con el daelkyr.

Este goo opalescente, simbiótico viene sellado en un frasco y cambia lentamente y se mueve, como si sin fin explorara el interior del frasco. Para afinar a este artículo, primero debe beber el contenido del frasco, desbloqueando las siguientes propiedades.

item.name: Ladder
entries: A Ladder is 10 feet tall. You must climb to move up or down it.
entries_es: Una escalera es de 10 pies de altura. Debes subir para subir o bajar.

item.name: Ladder (10-foot)
entries: Ladder (10-foot)
entries_es: Escalera (10 pies)

item.name: Lamp
entries: A lamp casts bright light in a 15-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Once lit, it burns for 6 hours on a flask (1 pint) of oil.
entries_es: Una lámpara arroja luz brillante en un radio de 15 pies y luz tenue para 30 pies adicionales. Una vez encendido, quema durante 6 horas en un frasco (1 pint) de aceite.

item.name: Lamp
entries: A Lamp burns {@item Oil|XPHB} as fuel to cast {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 15-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet.
entries_es: Una lámpara quema {@item Oil|XPHB} como combustible para fundir {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} en un radio de 15 pies y {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} por 30 pies adicionales.

item.name: Lamprey Ship
entries: Lamprey ships are antiquated, being among the oldest spelljamming ships still in use. Psurlons (see Boo's Astral Menagerie) are particularly fond of them.

Using the metal grappling jaws built into its bow, a lamprey ship can attach itself to another ship, which is a critical feature during boarding actions. Other standard weapons include four ballistae on the main deck.

A lamprey can float on water, though it can't land safely on the ground. Lamprey ships that land on the ground have the distressing habit of rolling over, as more than a few crews have discovered to their dismay.
entries_es: Los barcos lamprey son anticuados, siendo uno de los barcos de ortografía más antiguos todavía en uso. Los psurlons (ver la Menagerie Astral de Boo) les gustan particularmente.

Usando las mandíbulas de metal que se forman en su arco, una nave de la luminosidad puede unirse a otra nave, que es una característica crítica durante las acciones de embarque. Otras armas estándar incluyen cuatro balas en la cubierta principal.

Una lamprea puede flotar en el agua, aunque no puede aterrizar con seguridad en el suelo. Los barcos lamprey que aterrizan en el suelo tienen el hábito de rodar, ya que más de unas pocas tripulaciones han descubierto a su consternación.

item.name: Lantern of Revealing
entries: While lit, this {@item hooded lantern|phb} burns for 6 hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. {@condition Invisible} creatures and objects are visible as long as they are in the lantern's bright light. You can use an action to lower the hood, reducing the light to dim light in a 5-foot radius.
entries_es: Mientras se enciende, esto {@item hooded lantern|phb} se quema durante 6 horas en 1 pinta de aceite, derramando luz brillante en un radio de 30 pies y luz dim por 30 pies adicionales. [[TAG1] criaturas y objetos son visibles mientras estén en la luz brillante de la linterna. Usted puede utilizar una acción para bajar la capucha, reduciendo la luz para disminuir la luz en un radio de 5 pies.

item.name: Lantern of Revealing
entries: While lit, this hooded lantern burns for 6 hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 30 feet. {@condition Invisible|XPHB} creatures and objects are visible as long as they are in the lantern's {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}. You can take a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to lower the hood, reducing the lantern's light to {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 5-foot radius.
entries_es: Mientras se enciende, esta linterna encapuchada se quema durante 6 horas en 1 pinta de aceite, recubriendo {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} en un radio de 30 pies y {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} por 30 pies adicionales. [[TAG2] criaturas y objetos son visibles mientras estén en la linterna {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}. Puede tomar una acción {@action Utilize|XPHB} para bajar la capucha, reduciendo la luz de la linterna a {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} en un radio de 5 pies.

item.name: Lantern of Tracking
entries: This hooded lantern burns for 6 hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

Each lantern of tracking is designed to track down a certain type of creature, which is determined by rolling on the Lantern of Tracking table. Once determined, this creature type can't be changed. While the lantern is within 300 feet of any creature of that type, its flame turns bright green. The lantern doesn't pinpoint the creature's exact location, however.

entries.caption: Lantern of Tracking
rows: Aberrations
Celestials
Constructs
Dragons
Elementals
Fey
Fiends
Giants
Monstrosities
Undead

entries_es: Esta linterna encapuchada se quema durante 6 horas en 1 pinta de aceite, derramando luz brillante en un radio de 30 pies y luz tenue para un adicional de 30 pies.

Cada linterna de seguimiento está diseñada para rastrear un cierto tipo de criatura, que se determina por rodar en la Linterna de la tabla de seguimiento. Una vez determinado, este tipo de criatura no puede ser cambiado. Mientras que la linterna está a 300 pies de cualquier criatura de ese tipo, su llama se vuelve verde brillante. La linterna no señala la ubicación exacta de la criatura, sin embargo.

item.name: Lapis Lazuli
entries: An opaque light and dark blue with yellow flecks gemstone.
entries_es: Una luz opaca y azul oscuro con gemas amarillas.

item.name: Lapis Lazuli
entries: A light and dark blue with yellow flecks gemstone.
entries_es: Un azul claro y oscuro con piedras preciosas amarillas.

item.name: Large gold bracelet (Legion of Dusk)
item.name_es: Pulsera de oro grande (Legion de Dusk)

item.name: Large well-made tapestry
reprintedAs: Well-made tapestry that is 10 feet by 10 feet|XDMG

item.name: Large well-made tapestry (Legion of Dusk)
item.name_es: Gran tapiz bien hecho (Legion de Dusk)

item.name: Lash of Immolation
entries: The handle of this dark leather whip bears the fire rune, and embers dance around the whip's tail.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon, and on a hit, the whip deals an extra {@damage 1d6} fire damage. When you score a critical hit with an attack using this whip, the target also has the restrained condition until the start of your next turn, as fiery bands lash around the target.

entries.name: Invoking the Rune
entries: When you make an attack with the whip and hit, you can use your reaction to invoke the whip's rune. Doing so increases the extra fire damage dealt by the whip to {@dice 2d6}.
Once the rune has been invoked, it can't be invoked again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Cuando usted hace un ataque con el látigo y golpe, puede utilizar su reacción para invocar la runa del látigo. Hacerlo aumenta el daño extra de fuego que el látigo a {@dice 2d6}.
Una vez invocada la runa, no puede ser invocada de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.
El mango de este látigo de cuero oscuro lleva la columna de fuego, y las brasas bailan alrededor de la cola del látigo.

Ganas un bono +1 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma, y en un golpe, el látigo trata un daño extra {@damage 1d6}. Cuando anotas un golpe crítico con un ataque usando este látigo, el objetivo también tiene la condición restringida hasta el comienzo de tu próximo turno, ya que bandas ardientes corren alrededor del objetivo.

entries_es.name: Invoking the Rune
entries: When you make an attack with the whip and hit, you can use your reaction to invoke the whip's rune. Doing so increases the extra fire damage dealt by the whip to {@dice 2d6}.
Once the rune has been invoked, it can't be invoked again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Cuando usted hace un ataque con el látigo y golpe, puede utilizar su reacción para invocar la runa del látigo. Hacerlo aumenta el daño extra de fuego que el látigo a {@dice 2d6}.
Una vez invocada la runa, no puede ser invocada de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

items.name: Awakened
entries: When the whip reaches an awakened state, it gains the following properties:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.
The saving throw DC for the weapon's poisons increases to 15.

The weapon gains a new poison option called Ghoul's Blood. A creature that fails the saving throw against this poison is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature is {@condition paralyzed}. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries_es: Cuando el látigo llega a un estado despierto, gana las siguientes propiedades:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.
The saving throw DC for the weapon's poisons increases to 15.

The weapon gains a new poison option called Ghoul's Blood. A creature that fails the saving throw against this poison is {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature is {@condition paralyzed}. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

item.name: Lash of Shadows (Dormant)
entries: This snakeskin whip is touched by the power of Zehir and ends in five animated serpent heads.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: The Lash of Shadows is a sentient chaotic evil weapon with an Intelligence of 18, a Wisdom of 16, and a Charisma of 20. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak, read, and understand Abyssal, Common, and Draconic.
entries_es: El Lash of Shadows es un arma caótica sensible con una Inteligencia de 18, una Sabiduría de 16, y una Charisma de 20. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.
El arma se comunica telepáticamente con su wielder y puede hablar, leer y entender Abyssal, Common y Draconic.

entries.name: Personality
entries: A mad {@creature marilith} named Sizlifeth lives within the Lash of Shadows. The weapon has a short temper and experiences only extreme emotions. It is most happy when dealing harm.
entries_es: Un loco [[TAG0] llamado Sizlifeth vive dentro del Lash of Shadows. El arma tiene un temperamento corto y experiencias sólo emociones extremas. Es muy feliz al tratar el daño.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: The whip grants the following benefits in its dormant state:

items: You can speak, read, and write Abyssal and Draconic.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You can attempt to poison any creature that is hit by the whip. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or suffer the effect of one of the following poisons of your choice; once a poison other than Serpent Venom has been used, that poison can't be used again until the next dawn:

items.name: Dead Eyes
items.entry: A creature that fails the saving throw against this poison is {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature is {@condition blinded}.

items.name: Serpent Venom
items.entry: A creature that fails the saving throw against this poison takes {@damage 3d6} poison damage, or half as much damage on a successful save.

entries_es: El látigo otorga los siguientes beneficios en su estado inactivo:

items: You can speak, read, and write Abyssal and Draconic.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You can attempt to poison any creature that is hit by the whip. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or suffer the effect of one of the following poisons of your choice; once a poison other than Serpent Venom has been used, that poison can't be used again until the next dawn:

items.name: Dead Eyes
items.entry: A creature that fails the saving throw against this poison is {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature is {@condition blinded}.

items.name: Serpent Venom
items.entry: A creature that fails the saving throw against this poison takes {@damage 3d6} poison damage, or half as much damage on a successful save.

entries.name: Betrayer Artifact Properties
entries: The Arms of the Betrayers advance in power in the same manner as the Vestiges of Divergence. In its dormant state, each of these artifacts has one {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property and one {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property. Este látigo de serpiente es tocado por el poder de Zehir y termina en cinco cabezas de serpiente animadas.

entries_es.name: Sentience
entries: The Lash of Shadows is a sentient chaotic evil weapon with an Intelligence of 18, a Wisdom of 16, and a Charisma of 20. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak, read, and understand Abyssal, Common, and Draconic.
entries_es: El Lash of Shadows es un arma caótica sensible con una Inteligencia de 18, una Sabiduría de 16, y una Charisma de 20. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.
El arma se comunica telepáticamente con su wielder y puede hablar, leer y entender Abyssal, Common y Draconic.

entries_es.name: Personality
entries: A mad {@creature marilith} named Sizlifeth lives within the Lash of Shadows. The weapon has a short temper and experiences only extreme emotions. It is most happy when dealing harm.
entries_es: Un loco [[TAG0] llamado Sizlifeth vive dentro del Lash of Shadows. El arma tiene un temperamento corto y experiencias sólo emociones extremas. Es muy feliz al tratar el daño.

entries_es.name: Dormant
entries: The whip grants the following benefits in its dormant state:

items: You can speak, read, and write Abyssal and Draconic.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You can attempt to poison any creature that is hit by the whip. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or suffer the effect of one of the following poisons of your choice; once a poison other than Serpent Venom has been used, that poison can't be used again until the next dawn:

items.name: Dead Eyes
items.entry: A creature that fails the saving throw against this poison is {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour. While {@condition poisoned} in this way, the creature is {@condition blinded}.

items.name: Serpent Venom
items.entry: A creature that fails the saving throw against this poison takes {@damage 3d6} poison damage, or half as much damage on a successful save.

items.name: Exalted
entries: When the whip reaches an exalted state, it gains the following additional properties:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +3.
The saving throw DC for the weapon's poisons increases to 17.

The weapon gains a new poison option called Cockatrice Tears. A creature that fails the saving throw against this poison begins to turn to stone and is {@condition restrained}. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is {@condition petrified} for 24 hours.

entries_es: Cuando el látigo llega a un estado exaltado, gana las siguientes propiedades adicionales:

item.name: Leather Golem Armor
entries: Strange rituals have repurposed the body of a flesh golem into this partially sentient suit of leather armor. While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells and other magical effects. In addition, you gain the following properties:

items.name: Immutable Form
entries: You are immune to any spell or effect that would alter your form.
entries_es: Usted es inmune a cualquier hechizo o efecto que altere su forma.

items.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: You gain resistance to lightning damage. Whenever you take lightning damage, you gain 5 temporary hit points.
entries_es: Ganas resistencia al rayo. Cada vez que tomas un rayo de daño, ganas 5 puntos de éxito temporales.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This armor is cursed, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. Until the curse is broken with a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic, you are unwilling to part with the armor. In addition, while you wear the cursed armor, you gain the following properties:

items.name: Aversion of Fire
entries: If you take fire damage, you have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of your next turn.
entries_es: Si usted toma daño al fuego, usted tiene desventaja en los rollos de ataque y controles de habilidad hasta el final de su próximo turno.

items.name: Berserk
entries: Whenever a critical hit is made against you, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 6, the armor causes you to go berserk. On each of your turns while berserk, you attack the nearest creature you can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, you attack an object, with preference for an object smaller than yourself. Once the armor causes you to go berserk, it cannot be removed. You continue to attack until you are {@condition incapacitated} or until another creature is able to calm you with appropriate magic (such as a {@spell calm emotions} spell) or a successful {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check.
entries_es: Cada vez que un golpe crítico se hace contra ti, rodar un {@dice d6}. En un 6, la armadura te hace ir a la basura. En cada uno de tus turnos mientras berserk, atacas a la criatura más cercana que puedas ver. Si ninguna criatura está lo suficientemente cerca para moverse y atacar, usted ataca un objeto, con preferencia por un objeto más pequeño que usted. Una vez que la armadura te hace caer en el culo, no se puede quitar. Sigues atacando hasta que estés {@condition incapacitated} o hasta que otra criatura pueda calmarte con la magia apropiada (como un {@spell calm emotions} hechizo) o un exitoso {@dc 15} Charisma ([TAG4]]) cheque.

Esta armadura está maldecida, y se afina a ella extiende la maldición a ustedes. Hasta que la maldición se rompa con un hechizo o magia similar, no estás dispuesto a separarte de la armadura. Además, mientras usted usa la armadura maldecida, usted gana las siguientes propiedades:

item.name: Leatherworker's Tools
additionalEntries: Knowledge of leatherworking extends to lore concerning animal hides and their properties. It also confers knowledge of leather armor and similar goods.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Leatherworker's tools include a knife, a small mallet, an edger, a hole punch, thread, and leather scraps.
entries_es: Las herramientas de cuero incluyen un cuchillo, un pequeño mazo, un borde, un agujero, rosca, y chatarras de cuero.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana
entries: Your expertise in working with leather grants you added insight when you inspect magic items crafted from leather, such as boots and some cloaks.
entries_es: Su experiencia en el trabajo con subsidios de cuero añadió información cuando usted inspecciona objetos mágicos elaborados de cuero, como botas y algunos mantos.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: You gain added insight when studying leather items or clues related to them, as you draw on your knowledge of leather to pick out details that others would overlook.
entries_es: Obtienes más información al estudiar artículos de cuero o pistas relacionadas con ellos, ya que te basas en tu conocimiento de cuero para elegir detalles que otros pasarían por alto.

additionalEntries.name: Identify Hides
entries: When looking at a hide or a leather item, you can determine the source of the leather and any special techniques used to treat it. For example, you can spot the difference between leather crafted using dwarven methods and leather crafted using halfling methods.
entries_es: Al mirar un escondite o un artículo de cuero, puede determinar la fuente del cuero y cualquier técnica especial utilizada para tratarlo. Por ejemplo, se puede detectar la diferencia entre el cuero elaborado utilizando métodos enanos y el cuero elaborados con métodos de mediador.

item.name: Lesser Hammock of Worlds
entries: The Hammock of Worlds is a colorful hammock woven with traditional Ataguan designs.

You can use an action to unfold and place the lesser version of the Hammock of Worlds on a solid surface, whereupon it creates a two-way portal to another world or plane of existence. Each time the item opens a portal, the DM decides where it leads or the user can cause it to always reliably connect to the Ghost Orchid Tepui. You can use an action to close an open portal by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up. Once the lesser version of the Hammock of Worlds has opened a portal, it can't do so again for {@dice 1d8} hours.
entries_es: La Hammock of Worlds es una hamaca colorida tejida con diseños tradicionales de Ataguan.

Puedes usar una acción para desplegar y colocar la versión más baja de la Hammock of Worlds en una superficie sólida, en la que crea un portal bidireccional a otro mundo o plano de existencia. Cada vez que el artículo abre un portal, el DM decide dónde conduce o el usuario puede hacer que se conecte siempre de forma fiable con el Ghost Orchid Tepui. Usted puede utilizar una acción para cerrar un portal abierto al agarrar los bordes del paño y doblarlo. Una vez que la versión menor de la Hammock of Worlds ha abierto un portal, no puede hacerlo de nuevo por [[TAG0] horas.

item.name: Libram of Souls and Flesh
entries: With covers made of skin and fittings of bone, this tome is cold to the touch, and it whispers faintly. When found, the book contains the following spells, which are wizard spells for you while you are attuned to the book: {@spell animate dead}, {@spell circle of death}, {@spell false life}, {@spell finger of death}, {@spell speak with dead}, {@spell summon undead|TCE}, and {@spell vampiric touch}. It functions as a spellbook for you.
While you are holding the book, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your wizard spells.
The book has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can use the charges in the following ways while holding it:

items: If you spend 1 minute studying the book, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your prepared wizard spells with a different spell in the book. The new spell must be of the necromancy school.

As an action, you can expend 1 charge to take on a semblance of undeath for 10 minutes. For the duration, you take on a deathly appearance, and undead creatures are indifferent to you, unless you have damaged them. You also appear undead to all outward inspection and to spells used to determine the target's status. The effect ends if you deal damage or force a creature to make a saving throw.

entries_es: Con cubiertas hechas de piel y accesorios de hueso, este tomo es frío al tacto, y susurra débilmente. Cuando se encuentra, el libro contiene los siguientes hechizos, que son hechizos magos para usted mientras usted está afinado al libro: {@spell animate dead}, {@spell circle of death}, {@spell false life}, {@spell finger of death}], {@spell speak with dead}], [[TAG5], y {@spell vampiric touch}. Funciona como un libro de hechizos para ti.
Mientras sostienes el libro, puedes utilizarlo como un foco de ortografía para tus hechizos magos.
El libro tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Puede utilizar los cargos de las siguientes maneras mientras lo sostiene:

items: If you spend 1 minute studying the book, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your prepared wizard spells with a different spell in the book. The new spell must be of the necromancy school.

As an action, you can expend 1 charge to take on a semblance of undeath for 10 minutes. For the duration, you take on a deathly appearance, and undead creatures are indifferent to you, unless you have damaged them. You also appear undead to all outward inspection and to spells used to determine the target's status. The effect ends if you deal damage or force a creature to make a saving throw.

item.name: Lifewell Tattoo
entries: Produced by a special needle, this magic tattoo features symbols of life and rebirth.

entries.name: Tattoo Attunement
entries: To attune to this item, you hold the needle to your skin where you want the tattoo to appear, pressing the needle there throughout the attunement process. When the attunement is complete, the needle turns into the ink that becomes the tattoo, which appears on the skin.
If your attunement to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes, and the needle reappears in your space.
entries_es: Para afinar a este artículo, usted sostiene la aguja a su piel donde desea que aparezca el tatuaje, presionando la aguja allí durante todo el proceso de atracción. Cuando el dispositivo está completo, la aguja se convierte en la tinta que se convierte en el tatuaje, que aparece en la piel.
Si su atontado al tatuaje termina, el tatuaje desaparece, y la aguja reaparece en su espacio.

entries.name: Necrotic Resistance
entries: You have resistance to necrotic damage.
entries_es: Tienes resistencia al daño necrótico.

entries.name: Life Ward
entries: When you would be reduced to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 hit point instead. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Cuando se reduciría a 0 puntos de éxito, se deja caer a 1 punto de éxito en su lugar. Una vez utilizado, esta propiedad no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Lightbringer
entries: This +1 mace was made for a cleric of Lathander, the god of dawn. The head of the mace is shaped like a sunburst and made of solid brass. Named Lightbringer, this weapon glows as bright as a {@item torch|phb} when its wielder commands. While glowing, the mace deals an extra {@damage 1d6} radiant damage to undead creatures.
entries_es: Esta maza +1 fue hecha para un clérigo de Lathander, el dios del amanecer. La cabeza del mace está formada como un sunburst y hecha de bronce sólido. Se llama Lightbringer, este arma brilla tan brillante como un {@item torch|phb} cuando sus comandos de control. Mientras brilla, el mace trata un daño radiante extra [[TAG1] a criaturas no muertas.

item.name: Lightbringer
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

item.name: Living Gloves
entries: These symbiotic gloves—made of thin chitin and sinew—pulse with a life of their own. To attune to them, you must wear them for the entire attunement period, during which the gloves bond with your skin.
While attuned to these gloves, you gain one of the following proficiencies (your choice when you attune to the gloves):

items: {@skill Sleight of Hand}
{@item Thieves' tools|PHB}
One kind of {@item artisan's tools|PHB} of your choice
One kind of {@item musical instrument|PHB} of your choice

entries: When you make an ability check using the chosen proficiency, you add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Symbiotic Nature
entries: The gloves can't be removed from you while you're attuned to them, and you can't voluntarily end your attunement to them. If you're targeted by a spell that ends a curse, your attunement to the gloves ends, and they can be removed.
entries_es: Los guantes no pueden ser quitados de ti mientras estás afinado a ellos, y no puedes terminar voluntariamente tu atontado a ellos. Si eres blanco de un hechizo que acaba con una maldición, tu atontado a los guantes termina, y pueden ser eliminados.

Estos guantes simbióticos —hecho de fino chitín y sinuevo— se aprisionan con una vida propia. Para afinar a ellos, debe usarlos durante todo el período de aislamiento, durante el cual los guantes se unen a su piel.
Mientras se ajusta a estos guantes, usted gana una de las siguientes competencias (su elección cuando usted afina a los guantes):

items: {@skill Sleight of Hand}
{@item Thieves' tools|PHB}
One kind of {@item artisan's tools|PHB} of your choice
One kind of {@item musical instrument|PHB} of your choice

entries_es: Cuando haces un cheque de habilidad usando la competencia elegida, agregas el doble de tu bonificación de competencia al cheque, en lugar de tu bonificación de competencia normal.

item.name: Living Loot Satchel
entries: As a rank 2 hoardsperson, you are granted the use of a living loot satchel, which is an uncommon magic item. It functions as a {@item bag of holding} and is available in a variety of colors and styles.

entries.caption: Class-Based Living Loot Satchel
rows: Barbarian
Broad belt with a dozen hanging pockets
Bard
Lute case
Cleric
Hollowed-out holy tome
Druid
Made from natural, organic, locally sourced woven fibers
Fighter
A thick, battle-scarred iron lockbox
Paladin
A metal case with fine engraving and scrollwork
Ranger
A fur-lined bindle
Rogue
A nondescript coin pouch
Sorcerer
A battered leather satchel, prone to spitting out multicolored sparks at the seams
Warlock
A patchwork monster-leather satchel with a "purely decorative" fanged mouth.
Wizard
A pocket dimension hidden up your sleeve or inside your hat

entries: The living loot satchel is a kind of magical being that safeguards the franchise's funds and valuables. Its innards are connected to a secure coffer within Head Office's vault in Waterdeep, to which the satchel periodically transfers the franchise's wealth. As an action, you can transfer any amount of your franchise funds back to your satchel with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check.

entries.name: Secret Satchel
entries: As a rank 3 hoardsperson, your living loot satchel gets an upgrade to function as the replica chest used for the {@spell Leomund's secret chest} spell, becoming a rare magic item. You can open the secret chest through your living loot satchel to deposit or withdraw items—even items that wouldn't normally fit in your satchel, but which fit within the chest. Thanks to Head Office striking deals you don't want to know about with extraplanar creatures you really don't want to know about, there is no chance for the spell to end.
entries_es: Como azafata de rango 3, su satchel de botín viviente obtiene una actualización para funcionar como el pecho réplica utilizado para el hechizo {@spell Leomund's secret chest}, convirtiéndose en un elemento mágico raro. Puedes abrir el pecho secreto a través de tu sábana de botín vivo para depositar o retirar objetos, incluso artículos que normalmente no encajan en tu sábana, pero que encajan dentro del pecho. Gracias a los acuerdos de Head Office que no quieres saber sobre criaturas extraplanar de las que realmente no quieres saber, no hay posibilidad de que el hechizo termine.

entries.name: That Thing You Need
entries: At rank 3, you can use a bonus action to reach into your living loot satchel and make a {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. On a success, you draw forth an item of your choice on the Adventuring Gear table in chapter 5 of the Player's Handbook. The item must be of a size that can fit into your secret chest and be worth no more than 15 gp. Once you attempt to draw five items from your satchel, you cannot draw forth any more items until the next dawn.
entries_es: En el rango 3, puede utilizar una acción de bonificación para llegar a su satchel de bonificación viviente y hacer un {@dc 15} cheque de la destreza ([TAG1]). En un éxito, usted dibuja un elemento de su elección en la tabla Adventuring Gear en el capítulo 5 del Manual del Jugador. El artículo debe ser de un tamaño que puede encajar en su pecho secreto y no vale más de 15 gp. Una vez que intentas sacar cinco elementos de tu satchel, no puedes sacar más elementos hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Portable Hole Satchel
entries: At rank 4, your living loot satchel receives another upgrade, becoming a very rare magic item. The secret chest accessed by your satchel now has the storage capacity of a {@item portable hole}—6 feet in diameter and 10 feet deep. As before, you can place any appropriately sized object into the portable-hole-sized chest, even if it wouldn't normally fit into your satchel.
entries_es: En el rango 4, su soltero de botín vivo recibe otra actualización, convirtiéndose en un elemento mágico muy raro. El pecho secreto accedido por su satchel ahora tiene la capacidad de almacenamiento de un {@item portable hole}—6 pies de diámetro y 10 pies de profundidad. Como antes, usted puede colocar cualquier objeto de tamaño adecuado en el pecho de tamaño portátil, incluso si no encaja normalmente en su satchel.

entries.name: That Expensive Thing You Need
entries: Also at rank 4, when you use your That Thing You Need feature, you can requisition any item of up to 250 gp in value, as long as it would fit into the confines of your satchel's portable hole.
entries_es: También en el rango 4, cuando usas tu función That Thing You Need, puedes solicitar cualquier artículo de hasta 250 gp en valor, siempre y cuando encajara en los confines del agujero portátil de tu satchel.

item.name: Living Ship
entries: Druids, rangers, and clerics devoted to gods of nature are often found aboard living ships, as are Wildspace explorers who don't want to have to worry about their ship's air envelope becoming fouled during a long voyage.

This ship's main distinctive feature is the fully grown {@creature treant} on the aft deck. The treant has a speed of 0 because its roots are woven into the deck; it and the ship are inseparable. If the ship is reduced to 0 hit points, the treant dies of shock. The ship can function if its treant dies, but the treant can never be replaced with another.

When the treant finishes a long rest, it repairs the ship's hull, enabling the ship to regain {@dice 4d12} hit points, and refreshes the ship's air envelope (turning deadly air into foul air, or foul air into fresh air).
A living ship can float on water and sail across it, but it can't land safely on the ground (its keel would cause it to roll on its side). Its standard weaponry is an aft-mounted ballista.
entries_es: Druids, rangers, y clérigos dedicados a dioses de la naturaleza se encuentran a bordo de barcos vivos, como son exploradores Wildspace que no quieren tener que preocuparse por que el sobre aéreo de su nave se enfurezca durante un largo viaje.

La principal característica distintiva de esta nave es la totalmente cultivada [[TAG0] en la cubierta de popa. El treant tiene una velocidad de 0 porque sus raíces se tejen en la cubierta; ella y el barco son inseparables. Si el barco se reduce a 0 puntos de impacto, el treant muere de shock. El barco puede funcionar si su treant muere, pero el treant nunca puede ser reemplazado por otro.

Cuando el treant termina un largo descanso, repara el casco de la nave, permitiendo que la nave recupere los puntos de impacto {@dice 4d12}, y refresca el sobre aéreo de la nave (volviendo el aire mortal en el aire sucio, o el aire sucio en el aire fresco).

Un barco viviente puede flotar sobre el agua y navegar a través de él, pero no puede aterrizar con seguridad en el suelo (su keel causaría que rodara en su lado). Su armamento estándar es un balista montado en popa.

item.name: Loadstone
entries: This stone is a large gem worth 150 gp.

entries.name: Curse
entries: The stone is cursed, but its magical nature is hidden; {@spell detect magic} doesn't detect it. An {@spell identify} spell reveals the stone's true nature. If you use the {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} action while the stone is on your person, its curse activates. Until the curse is broken with {@spell remove curse} or similar magic, your speed is reduced by 5 feet, and your maximum load and maximum lift capacities are halved. You also become unwilling to part with the stone.
entries_es: La piedra está maldecida, pero su naturaleza mágica está oculta; {@spell detect magic} no la detecta. Un hechizo {@spell identify} revela la verdadera naturaleza de la piedra. Si usas la acción {@action Dash} o {@action Disengage} mientras la piedra está sobre tu persona, su maldición activa. Hasta que la maldición se rompa con {@spell remove curse} o magia similar, su velocidad se reduce en 5 pies, y sus capacidades máximas de carga y elevación máxima se reducen a la mitad. También te vuelves poco dispuesto a separarte de la piedra.
Esta piedra es una gran joya que vale 150 gp.

item.name: Lock
entries: A key is provided with the lock. Without the key, a creature proficient with {@item thieves' tools|phb} can pick this lock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check. Your DM may decide that better locks are available for higher prices.
entries_es: Se proporciona una llave con el bloqueo. Sin la llave, una criatura competente con {@item thieves' tools|phb} puede elegir este bloqueo con un éxito {@dc 15} Verificación de la destreza. Su DM puede decidir que mejores cerraduras están disponibles para precios más altos.

item.name: Lock
entries: A Lock comes with a key. Without the key, a creature can use {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB} to pick this Lock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) check.
entries_es: Una cerradura viene con una llave. Sin la llave, una criatura puede usar {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB} para escoger esta cerradura con un cheque exitoso {@dc 15}] Dexteridad ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}).

item.name: Lock of Trickery
entries: This lock appears to be an ordinary {@item Lock|XPHB} (of the type described in chapter 6 of the {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}) and comes with a single key. The tumblers in this lock magically adjust to thwart burglars. Dexterity checks made to pick the lock have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.
entries_es: Esta cerradura parece ser ordinaria {@item Lock|XPHB} (del tipo descrito en el capítulo 6 de la {@book Player's Handbook|XPHB}) y viene con una sola llave. Los tumblers de esta cerradura se ajustan mágicamente a los ladrones frustrados. Los cheques de destreza realizados para recoger la cerradura tienen {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

Los tumblers de esta cerradura se ajustan mágicamente a los ladrones frustrados. Los cheques de destreza realizados para recoger la cerradura tienen desventaja.

item.name: Locking Spellbook
entries: This 100-page leather-bound tome can be used as a Spellbook. It is closed with a lock that comes with a key. As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, a creature can try to pick the lock using {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}, doing so with a successful DC 15 Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) check.
entries_es: Este tomo de 100 páginas de piel se puede utilizar como Spellbook. Está cerrado con una cerradura que viene con una llave. Como una acción {@action Utilize|XPHB}, una criatura puede intentar elegir la cerradura usando {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB}], haciéndolo con un exitoso cheque DC 15 Dexterity ([[TAG2]).

item.name: Lolth's Sting
entries: A creature subjected to Lolth's Sting must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. If the creature fails the save by 5 or more, the creature also has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition while {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
entries_es: Una criatura sometida al Sting de Lolth debe tener éxito en un {@dc 13} La Constitución salvando el tiro o tener la condición {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} durante 1 hora. Si la criatura falla por 5 o más, la criatura también tiene la condición {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} mientras {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}] de esta manera. La criatura despierta si se necesita daño o si otra criatura toma una acción para sacudirlo despierto.

item.name: Longbow of the Healing Hearth
entries: This ivory longbow is inscribed with a prayer to the god Hiatea, the runes of which are entwined with gilded engravings of wheat stalks and deer antlers.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon. If you load no ammunition in the weapon, it produces its own, automatically creating one magic arrow when you pull back the string. The arrow created by the bow vanishes the instant after it hits or misses a target.
The bow has 8 charges for the following properties, which you can use while wielding the bow. The bow regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} charges daily at dawn.

entries.name: Curative Arrow
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action using the bow, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your attacks with a blazing arrow of curative magic, which automatically hits one creature you can see within 150 feet of you. The target can then immediately spend and roll one of its unspent Hit Dice and regain a number of hit points equal to the roll plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1).
If the target has no unspent Hit Dice remaining, nothing happens. You can use a curative arrow only once per turn.
entries_es: Cuando tomas la acción [[TAG0] usando el arco, puedes gastar 1 carga para reemplazar uno de tus ataques con una flecha ardiente de magia curativa, que automáticamente golpea a una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 150 pies de ti. El objetivo puede entonces pasar inmediatamente y rodar uno de sus dados sin abrir y recuperar un número de puntos de éxito igual al rollo más su modificador de Sabiduría (mínimo de +1).
Si el objetivo no tiene pendientes Hit Dice, no pasa nada. Usted puede utilizar una flecha curativa sólo una vez por turno.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: While holding the bow, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it (save {@dc 18}): {@spell create food and water} (1 charge), {@spell warding bond} (2 charges), {@spell guardian of faith} (3 charges).
entries_es: Mientras sostiene el arco, puede utilizar una acción para exponer 1 o más de sus cargos para lanzar uno de los siguientes hechizos de él (salvo {@dc 18}): {@spell create food and water}] (1 cargo), {@spell warding bond}] (2 cargos), {@spell guardian of faith}] (3 cargos).
Este arco largo de marfil está inscrito con una oración al dios Hiatea, cuyas runas están entrelazadas con grabados dorados de tallos de trigo y hortalizas de ciervo.

Ganas un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma. Si no cargas munición en el arma, produce su propia, creando automáticamente una flecha mágica cuando tiras de la cuerda. La flecha creada por el arco desaparece al instante después de que golpee o pierda un objetivo.
El arco tiene 8 cargos por las siguientes propiedades, que puede utilizar mientras se limpia el arco. El arco recupera [[TAG0] cargos diarios al amanecer.

item.name: Lord's Ensemble
item.reqAttune: by a creature with a humanoid build
entries: The Masked Lords of Waterdeep don this ensemble when meeting with one another. This raiment renders each lord indistinguishable from the others. The ensemble consists of three pieces—a helm, an amulet, and a robe—that function as a single magic item when worn together, but only within the city of Waterdeep and its sewers. You become attuned to the ensemble as a single item.

entries.name: Lord's Helm
entries: This bucket helm covers your head and conceals your face. Screens over the eyes help to shroud your identity without blinding you. While you wear the helm, your voice is magically altered to sound genderless, and you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, to determine whether you are lying, to know your alignment, or to know your creature type. Creatures can communicate telepathically with you only if you allow it.
entries_es: Este timón cubre tu cabeza y oculta tu cara. Las pantallas sobre los ojos ayudan a encoger tu identidad sin cegarte. Mientras usas el timón, tu voz está mágicamente alterada para sonar sin género, y eres inmune a la magia que permite a otras criaturas leer tus pensamientos, determinar si estás mintiendo, conocer tu alineación, o conocer tu tipo de criatura. Las criaturas pueden comunicarse telepáticamente con usted sólo si lo permite.

entries.name: Lord's Amulet
entries: This amulet bears the crest of Waterdeep. It functions as an {@item amulet of proof against detection and location}.
entries_es: Este amuleto lleva la cresta de Waterdeep. Funciona como {@item amulet of proof against detection and location}.

entries.name: Lord's Robe
entries: This elegant robe functions as a {@item ring of free action}, and it creates the illusion that you have a nondescript, androgynous humanoid build and stand 6 feet tall.
entries_es: Esta elegante túnica funciona como un {@item ring of free action}, y crea la ilusión de que tienes una construcción humanoide nondescripta, andrógina y de pie 6 pies de altura.

Los Señores Masked de Waterdeep donan este conjunto cuando se reúnen entre sí. Este vestido hace que cada señor indistinguible de los otros. El conjunto consta de tres piezas —un timón, un amuleto y una túnica— que funcionan como un solo elemento mágico cuando se usan juntos, pero sólo dentro de la ciudad de Waterdeep y sus alcantarillas. Te conviertes en una pieza única.

entries_es.name: Lord's Helm
entries: This bucket helm covers your head and conceals your face. Screens over the eyes help to shroud your identity without blinding you. While you wear the helm, your voice is magically altered to sound genderless, and you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, to determine whether you are lying, to know your alignment, or to know your creature type. Creatures can communicate telepathically with you only if you allow it.

item.name: Lorehold Primer
entries: The Lorehold Primer is a magic textbook created at Strixhaven's Lorehold College. The primer has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. If you make an Intelligence ({@skill History}) or Intelligence ({@skill Religion}) check while holding the primer, you can expend 1 charge to give yourself {@dice 1d4} bonus to the check, immediately after you roll the {@dice d20}.

In addition, if you study the primer at the end of a long rest, you can choose one 1st-level spell from the cleric or wizard spell list. Before you finish your next long rest, you can cast the chosen spell once without a spell slot if you are holding the primer. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is your choice of Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma.
entries_es: El Lorehold Primer es un libro de texto mágico creado en el Lorehold College de Strixhaven. El primer tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Si usted hace un registro de inteligencia ([TAG1]]) o Inteligencia ([TAG2]]) comprobar mientras mantiene la imprenta, puede gastar 1 cargo para darse el bono {@dice 1d4} al cheque, inmediatamente después de rodar el {@dice d20}].

Además, si estudias la imprimación al final de un largo descanso, puedes elegir un hechizo de primer nivel de la lista de hechizos clérigos o magos. Antes de terminar su próximo descanso largo, usted puede lanzar el hechizo elegido una vez sin una ranura de hechizo si usted está sosteniendo la cartilla. Su habilidad de ortografía para este hechizo es su elección de Inteligencia, Sabiduría o Charisma.

entries: When you make your character, you may roll once on the Lorehold Trinkets table, instead of on the {@item trinket|phb|Trinkets table} in the {@book Player's Handbook|PHB}, for your starting trinket.

item.name: Lost Crown of Besilmer
entries: This dwarven battle-helm consists of a sturdy open-faced steel helmet, decorated with a golden circlet above the brow from which seven small gold spikes project upward. You gain the following benefits while wearing the crown:

items: You have resistance to psychic damage.
You have advantage on saving throws against effects that would charm you.

You can use a bonus action to inspire one creature you can see that is within 60 feet of you and that can see or hear you. Once before the end of your next turn, the inspired creature can roll a {@dice d6} and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. This uses 1 charge from the crown. It has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.

entries_es: Este enano equipo de batalla consiste en un robusto casco de acero de cara abierta, decorado con un círculo dorado sobre la frente desde el que se proyectan siete pequeñas espigas de oro hacia arriba. Ganas los siguientes beneficios mientras llevas la corona:

items: You have resistance to psychic damage.
You have advantage on saving throws against effects that would charm you.

You can use a bonus action to inspire one creature you can see that is within 60 feet of you and that can see or hear you. Once before the end of your next turn, the inspired creature can roll a {@dice d6} and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes. This uses 1 charge from the crown. It has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Luba's Tarokka of Souls
entries: Not all lingering spirits are tragic souls, lost on their way to the hereafter. Some languish as prisoners, souls so wicked mortals dare not free them upon an unsuspecting afterlife.

Created by a figure of Vistani legend, Luba's Tarokka of Souls shaped the destiny of countless heroes. The prophecies of this deck of cards also revealed great evils and guided its creator into the path of nefarious forces. Untold times the deck's creator, Mother Luba, narrowly escaped doom, spared only by her keen insights. But even for her, not all wickedness could be escaped. In the most dire cases, Mother Luba managed to ensnare beings of pure evil amid the strands of fate, imprisoning them within her {@deck tarokka deck|CoS}. There these foul spirits dwell still, trapped within a nether-realm hidden amid shuffling cards, waiting for fate to turn foul—as it inevitably will.

Like all {@deck Tarokka Deck|CoS|tarokka decks}, the {@i Tarokka of Souls} is a lavishly illustrated collection of fifty-four cards, comprising the fourteen cards of the high deck and forty other cards divided into four suits: coins, glyphs, stars, and swords.

Once you use the deck to cast a spell, you can't cast that spell again from it until the next dawn.

Una vez que usas la cubierta para lanzar un hechizo, no puedes volver a lanzar ese hechizo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Shuffling Fate
entries: If you go 7 days without using the Twist of Fate property, your attunement to Luba's Tarokka of Souls ends, and you can't attune to it again until after another creature uses Twist of Fate on you.

entries.name: Destroying the Deck
entries: Luba's Tarokka of Souls can be destroyed only if all fourteen souls within are released and destroyed. This reveals a fifteenth soul, a {@creature lich}, that inhabits the Nether card, which appears only when the fourteen souls are defeated. If this ancient entity is destroyed, the Nether card vanishes and the deck becomes a normal {@deck tarokka deck|CoS}, with no special properties, but it includes a new card of the DM's design.

entries.name: Mother Luba and the Vistani
entries: The creator of the Tarokka of Souls, Mother Luba was one of the most influential leaders of the Vistani. For untold generations, the Vistani have wandered the Shadowfell, which includes terrifying demiplanes like the vampire-haunted realm of Barovia. These travelers have learned many secrets of these domains and encountered countless others wandering amid the Shadowfell's horrors. Most Vistani bands accept well-intentioned wayfarers from diverse walks and of disparate origins, embracing any who seek to find a home amid the endless roads and vistas hidden amid the mists.

A halfling Vistani, Mother Luba led one of the largest groups of Vistani in the Shadowfell. She hailed from the same world that Count Strahd von Zarovich and Madam Eva came from, and she created a community of kindness and resilience-ever rare to find in the Plane of Shadow. She led her people in welcoming strangers, feeding the hungry, and defying the cruel. She and Madam Eva were once friends, until Madam Eva began bargaining with the creatures of the night. "We may wander amid the shadows," Mother Luba said. "But we must ever serve as a light to our fellow travelers."
Some years ago, Mother Luba disappeared into the mists, leaving behind only the Tarokka of Souls. It is said that if you draw the Mists card from it, you can hear the whispers of her kind voice.
entries_es: El creador de la Tarokka de Almas, Madre Luba fue uno de los líderes más influyentes de los Vistani. Para las generaciones incontables, los Vistani han vagado el Shadowfell, que incluye terribles demiplanes como el reino de Barovia. Estos viajeros han aprendido muchos secretos de estos dominios y han encontrado a muchos otros vagando entre los horrores de la Sombra. La mayoría de las bandas Vistani aceptan caminantes bien intencionados de diversos paseos y de orígenes dispares, abrazando a cualquiera que busque encontrar un hogar en medio de las interminables carreteras y vistas escondidas entre las nieblas.

Mediante Vistani, la madre Luba dirigió uno de los grupos más grandes de Vistani en el Shadowfell. Ella aclamó desde el mismo mundo que el Conde Strahd von Zarovich y la Señora Eva vinieron, y creó una comunidad de bondad y resiliencia-nunca rara para encontrar en el Plane de Sombra. Ella llevó a su gente a acoger extraños, alimentar a los hambrientos y desafiar a los crueles. Ella y la señora Eva fueron una vez amigos, hasta que la señora Eva comenzó a negociar con las criaturas de la noche. "Podemos pasear entre las sombras", dijo la madre Luba. "Pero debemos servir como una luz para nuestros compañeros de viaje."
Hace unos años, la madre Luba desapareció en las nieblas, dejando atrás sólo la Tarokka de Almas. Se dice que si sacas la tarjeta Mists de ella, puedes escuchar los susurros de su amable voz.

La Tarokka de Almas de Luba puede ser destruida sólo si las catorce almas dentro son liberadas y destruidas. Esto revela una quincena alma, una {@creature lich}, que habita la tarjeta del Nather, que aparece sólo cuando las catorce almas son derrotadas. Si esta antigua entidad es destruida, la tarjeta Nether desaparece y la cubierta se convierte en normal {@deck tarokka deck|CoS}, sin propiedades especiales, pero incluye una nueva tarjeta del diseño del DM.

item.name_es: La Tarokka de las Almas de Luba
entries_es: No todos los espíritus persistentes son almas trágicas, perdidas en su camino al más allá. Algunos languidecen como prisioneros, almas mortales tan malvadas no se atreven a liberarlos en una vida después de la insospechada.

Creado por una figura de la leyenda de Vistani, el Tarokka de Almas de Luba moldeó el destino de innumerables héroes. Las profecías de esta cubierta de cartas también revelaron grandes males y guiaron a su creador en el camino de las fuerzas nefastas. Untold times the deck's Creator, Mother Luba, narrowly escaped doom, perdonado sólo por sus agudas ideas. Pero incluso para ella, no toda maldad podría escaparse. En los casos más terribles, la Madre Luba logró encadenar seres de maldad pura en medio de los hilos del destino, encarcelándolos dentro de ella [[TAG0]. Allí habitan todavía estos espíritus nefastos, atrapados dentro de un reino nether oculto en medio de barrigas, esperando que el destino se vuelva impotente, como inevitablemente lo hará.

Como todos {@deck Tarokka Deck|CoS|tarokka decks}, la {@i Tarokka of Souls} es una colección de cincuenta y cuatro cartas, que comprende las catorce cartas de la cubierta alta y otras cuarenta cartas divididas en cuatro trajes: monedas, glifos, estrellas y espadas.
