item.name: Oil of Taggit
entries: A creature subjected to Oil of Taggit must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 24 hours. The creature also has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition while {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} in this way. It wakes up if it takes damage.
entries_es: Una criatura sometida al Óleo de Taggit debe tener éxito en un {@dc 13} La Constitución ahorra o tiene la condición [[TAG1] por 24 horas. La criatura también tiene la condición {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} mientras {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} de esta manera. Se despierta si se necesita daño.

item.name: Olisuba Leaf
entries: These dried leaves of the Olisuba tree, when steeped to make a tea, can help a body recover from strenuous activity. If you drink a dose of Olisuba tea during a long rest, your {@condition exhaustion} level is reduced by 2 instead of 1 at the end of that long rest.
entries_es: Estas hojas secas del árbol de Olisuba, cuando están empinadas para hacer un té, pueden ayudar a un cuerpo a recuperarse de la actividad vigorosa. Si toma una dosis de té Olisuba durante un largo descanso, su nivel {@condition exhaustion} se reduce en 2 en lugar de 1 al final de ese largo descanso.

item.name: Oloore Root Teabag
entries: This root is typically {@item Oloore Root Teabag|TDCSR|sold in teabags} for 100 gp per dose. It was originally a ritualistic tool used by the followers of many gods, but now sees more recreational use. Oracles used it to enhance their divinations, for it helped them leave their physical bodies behind and become closer to gods and spirits. Drinking tea brewed from the root causes intense hallucinations, which feel like they have granted perfect clarity of mind to the imbiber.

After drinking {@item Oloore Root Teabag|TDCSR|oloore tea} as an action, you must succeed on a {@dc 19} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or experience vivid hallucinations for {@dice 1d4} hours. During this time, you have {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage} on attack rolls and {@quickref ability checks|PHB|2|0}. If you fail the {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} by 10 or more, your hallucinations become horrific visions and you gain a level of {@condition exhaustion}. On a success, you gain preternatural clarity, allowing you to cast the {@spell scrying} spell once within the next {@dice 1d4} hours.
entries_es: Esta raíz es típicamente {@item Oloore Root Teabag|TDCSR|sold in teabags} para 100 gp por dosis. Fue originalmente una herramienta ritualista utilizada por los seguidores de muchos dioses, pero ahora ve más uso recreativo. Los Oráculos lo utilizaron para mejorar sus adivinaciones, porque les ayudó a dejar sus cuerpos físicos atrás y a acercarse a dioses y espíritus. Beber té elaborado a partir de la raíz causa alucinaciones intensas, que sienten que han concedido la claridad perfecta de la mente al imbiber.

Después de beber {@item Oloore Root Teabag|TDCSR|oloore tea} como acción, debe tener éxito en una {@dc 19} Constitución {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}] o experimentar alucinaciones vivas durante [[TAG3] horas. Durante este tiempo, usted tiene {@quickref Advantage and Disadvantage|PHB|2|0|disadvantage} sobre los rollos de ataque y {@quickref ability checks|PHB|2|0}. Si fallas el {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} por 10 o más, tus alucinaciones se convierten en visiones horribles y ganas un nivel de {@condition exhaustion}. En un éxito, obtienes claridad preternatural, permitiéndote lanzar el hechizo {@spell scrying} una vez dentro de las próximas [[TAG3] horas.

item.name: Onyx
entries: An opaque black and white banded, or pure black or white gemstone.
entries_es: Un negro opaco y blanco bandido, o gema blanca o negra pura.

item.name: Onyx
entries: A bands of black and white, or pure black or white gemstone.
entries_es: Bandas de blanco y negro, o gema blanca o negra pura.

item.name: Opal
entries: A translucent pale blue with green and golden mottling gemstone.
entries_es: Un azul pálido translúcido con gema verde y dorada.

item.name: Opal
entries: A pale blue with green and golden mottling gemstone.
entries_es: Un azul pálido con piedras preciosas verdes y doradas.

item.name: Opal of the Ild Rune
entries: This triangular fire opal measures about three inches on each side and is half an inch thick. The ild (fire) rune shimmers within its core, causing it to be slightly warm to the touch. The opal has the following properties, which work only while it's on your person.

entries.name: Ignite
entries: As an action, you can ignite an object within 10 feet of you. The object must be flammable, and the fire starts in a circle no larger than 1 foot in diameter.
entries_es: Como acción, puedes encender un objeto a menos de 10 pies de ti. El objeto debe ser inflamable, y el fuego comienza en un círculo no mayor de 1 pie de diámetro.

entries.name: Fires Friend
entries: You have resistance to cold damage.
entries_es: Tienes resistencia al daño frío.

entries.name: Fire Tamer
entries: As an action, you can extinguish any open flame within 10 feet of you. You choose how much fire to extinguish in that radius.
entries_es: Como acción, puedes apagar cualquier llama abierta a menos de 10 pies de ti. Usted elige cuánto fuego para extinguir en ese radio.

entries.name: Gift of Flame
entries: You can transfer the opal's magic to a nonmagical item—a weapon or a suit of armor—by tracing the ild rune there with your finger. The transfer takes 8 hours of work that requires the two items to be within 5 feet of each other. At the end, the opal is destroyed, and the rune appears in red on the chosen item, which gains a benefit based on its form:

items.name: Weapon
items.entry: The weapon is now an uncommon magic weapon. It deals an extra {@damage 1d6} fire damage to any target it hits.

items.name: Armor
items.entry: The armor is now a rare magic item that requires attunement. You have resistance to cold damage while wearing the armor.

entries_es: Usted puede transferir la magia del ópalo a un elemento no mágico —un arma o un traje de armadura— rastreando la runa iluminada allí con su dedo. El traslado lleva 8 horas de trabajo que requiere que los dos elementos estén a unos 5 pies. Al final, el ópalo se destruye, y la runa aparece en rojo sobre el objeto elegido, que gana un beneficio basado en su forma:

items.name: Weapon
items.entry: The weapon is now an uncommon magic weapon. It deals an extra {@damage 1d6} fire damage to any target it hits.

items.name: Armor
items.entry: The armor is now a rare magic item that requires attunement. You have resistance to cold damage while wearing the armor.

entries_es: Este ópalo de fuego triangular mide alrededor de tres pulgadas a cada lado y es de media pulgada de espesor. La capa ild (fuego) brilla dentro de su núcleo, causando que sea ligeramente caliente al tacto. El ópalo tiene las siguientes propiedades, que funcionan sólo mientras está en su persona.

item.name: Orb of Damara
entries: A wizard named Damara created this orb while devising a way to become a dragon. Aided by a mysterious magician (actually an aspect of Tiamat in disguise), Damara eventually created an Artifact that would enable him to achieve his dream. Yet the potential power of his creation terrified Damara so much that he dared not use the orb. Instead, the wizard entombed himself with the Artifact to seal it away.

The Orb of Damara is about 6 inches in diameter and is made of a glassy, iridescent material that's like obsidian but incredibly hard. If held to one's own lips with the intention of consuming it, the orb shrinks to the size of a grape.

entries.name: Properties of the Orb
entries: While attuned to the orb, you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Dragon's Breath
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to exhale a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. When you do, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 6d6} damage of the chosen type on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries_es: Puede tomar una acción [[TAG0] para exhalar una acción de 15 pies {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Cuando lo haces, elige ácido, frío, fuego, relámpago o veneno. Cada criatura en el {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} hace un lanzamiento de ahorro DC 18 Dexterity, tomando {@damage 6d6} daño del tipo elegido en un ahorro fallido o la mitad de daño en un éxito.

items.name: Fear Aura
entries: You exude a terrifying aura in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} while you don't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to disable or enable this aura. Any enemy that starts its turn in the aura must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. A creature that succeeds on this save is immune to the aura's effects for 24 hours.
entries_es: Exudes un aura aterrador en un aura de 20 pies {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} mientras no tienes la condición [[TAG1]. Puede tomar una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para desactivar o habilitar este aura. Cualquier enemigo que comience su turno en el aura debe tener éxito en un DC 18 Sabiduría ahorrando lanzamiento o tener la condición {@condition Frightened|XPHB} hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno. Una criatura que tiene éxito en este ahorro es inmune a los efectos del aura durante 24 horas.

items.name: Flight
entries: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet and can hover.
entries_es: Usted tiene un [[TAG0] de 60 pies y puede hover.

entries: The orb has 6 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn. While attuned to the orb, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it (+10 spell attack modifier, spell save DC 18). The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

{@spell Fire Shield|XPHB}
{@spell Hold Person|XPHB}

{@spell Summon Dragon|XPHB} (level 9 version)

Si bien está afinado en el orbe, puede lanzar uno de los hechizos en la siguiente tabla de él (+10 modificador de ataque de hechizo, guardar el hechizo DC 18). La tabla indica cuántos cargos debe presentar para emitir el hechizo.

entries.name: Dragon Transformation
entries: If you swallow the orb, you transform into an adult chromatic dragon under the DM's control. The type of chromatic dragon depends on your alignment and personality and is left to the DM to decide. The transformation is permanent, but if the dragon is slain, its body reverts to its original form and the orb reappears outside its body.
entries_es: Si se traga el orbe, se transforma en un dragón cromático adulto bajo el control del DM. El tipo de dragón cromático depende de su alineación y personalidad y se deja al DM para decidir. La transformación es permanente, pero si el dragón es asesinado, su cuerpo vuelve a su forma original y el orbe reaparece fuera de su cuerpo.

entries.name: Destroying the Orb
entries: If an {@creature Ancient Gold Dragon|XMM} willingly swallows the orb, the orb and the dragon are both destroyed.
entries_es: Si un [[TAG0] voluntariamente traga el orbe, el orbe y el dragón son ambos destruidos.

Un mago llamado Damara creó este orbe mientras pensaba una manera de convertirse en un dragón. Ayudado por un misterioso mago (realmente un aspecto de Tiamat disfrazado), Damara finalmente creó un artefacto que le permitiría alcanzar su sueño. Sin embargo, el poder potencial de su creación aterrorizó tanto a Damara que no se atrevió a usar el orbe. En lugar de eso, el mago se acostó con el artefacto para sellarlo.

El Orbo de Damara tiene alrededor de 6 pulgadas de diámetro y está hecho de un material vidrioso e iridiscente que es como obsidiano pero increíblemente duro. Si se sostiene a los propios labios con la intención de consumirlo, el orbe se contrae al tamaño de una uva.

item.name: Orb of Direction
entries: This orb can be used as an Arcane Focus.
While holding this orb, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to determine which way is magnetic north. Nothing happens if the orb is used in a location that has no magnetic north.
entries_es: Este orb se puede utilizar como un foco Arcane.

Mientras sostiene este orbe, puede tomar una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para determinar de qué manera es el norte magnético. Nada sucede si el orbe se utiliza en un lugar que no tiene norte magnético.

item.name: Orb of Direction
entries: While holding this orb, you can use an action to determine which way is north. This property functions only on the Material Plane.
entries_es: Mientras sostiene este orb, puede utilizar una acción para determinar qué manera es norte. Esta propiedad sólo funciona en el Plano Material.

item.name: Orb of Dragonkind
entries: Ages past, on the world of Krynn, elves and humans waged a terrible war against evil dragons. When the world seemed doomed, the wizards of the Towers of High Sorcery came together and worked their greatest magic, forging five Orbs of Dragonkind (or Dragon Orbs) to help them defeat the dragons. One orb was taken to each of the five towers, and there they were used to speed the war toward a victorious end. The wizards used the orbs to lure dragons to them, then destroyed the dragons with powerful magic.

As the Towers of High Sorcery fell in later ages, the orbs were destroyed or faded into legend, and only three are thought to survive. Their magic has been warped and twisted over the centuries, so although their primary purpose of calling dragons still functions, they also allow some measure of control over dragons.
Each orb contains the essence of an evil dragon, a presence that resents any attempt to coax magic from it. Those lacking in force of personality might find themselves enslaved to an orb.
An orb is an etched crystal globe about 10 inches in diameter. When used, it grows to about 20 inches in diameter, and mist swirls inside it.

While attuned to an orb, you can use an action to peer into the orb's depths and speak its command word. You must then make a {@dc 15} Charisma check. On a successful check, you control the orb for as long as you remain attuned to it. On a failed check, you become {@condition charmed} by the orb for as long as you remain attuned to it.

While you are {@condition charmed} by the orb, you can't voluntarily end your attunement to it, and the orb casts {@spell suggestion} on you at will (save {@dc 18}), urging you to work toward the evil ends it desires. The dragon essence within the orb might want many things: the annihilation of a particular people, freedom from the orb, to spread suffering in the world, to advance the worship of Takhisis ({@creature Tiamat|RoT|Tiamat's} name on Krynn), or something else the DM decides.

entries.name: Call Dragons
entries: While you control the orb, you can use an action to cause the artifact to issue a telepathic call that extends in all directions for 40 miles. Evil dragons in range feel compelled to come to the orb as soon as possible by the most direct route. Dragon deities such as {@creature Tiamat|RoT} are unaffected by this call. Dragons drawn to the orb might be hostile toward you for compelling them against their will. Once you have used this property, it can't be used again for 1 hour.

Los dragones malignos en rango se sienten obligados a venir al orbe tan pronto como sea posible por la ruta más directa. Deidades Dragón como {@creature Tiamat|RoT} no son afectadas por esta llamada. Los dragones atraídos al orbe podrían ser hostiles hacia ti por obligarlos contra su voluntad. Una vez que hayas utilizado esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo durante 1 hora.

entries.name: Destroying an Orb
entries: An Orb of Dragonkind appears fragile but is impervious to most damage, including the attacks and breath weapons of dragons. A {@spell disintegrate} spell or one good hit from a +3 magic weapon is sufficient to destroy an orb, however.
entries_es: Un Orbo de Dragonkind parece frágil pero es impermeable a la mayoría de los daños, incluyendo los ataques y las armas de aliento de los dragones. Un hechizo {@spell disintegrate} o un buen golpe de un arma mágica +3 es suficiente para destruir un orbe, sin embargo.

Las edades pasadas, en el mundo de Krynn, elfos y humanos libraron una guerra terrible contra los malvados dragones. Cuando el mundo parecía condenado, los magos de las torres de la alta brujería se juntaron y trabajaron su mayor magia, forjando cinco orbes de Dragonkind (o Dragon Orbs) para ayudarlos a derrotar a los dragones. Una orbe fue tomada a cada una de las cinco torres, y allí estaban acostumbrados a acelerar la guerra hacia un final victorioso. Los magos usaron los orbes para atraer dragones a ellos, luego destruyeron a los dragones con poderosa magia.

A medida que las torres de la alta brujería cayeron en edades posteriores, los orbes fueron destruidos o desvanecidos en la leyenda, y sólo tres se piensan sobrevivir. Su magia ha sido retorcida y retorcida a lo largo de los siglos, así que aunque su propósito principal de llamar a los dragones todavía funciona, también permiten cierta medida de control sobre los dragones.

Cada orbe contiene la esencia de un dragón maligno, una presencia que resentirá cualquier intento de sacarle la magia. Aquellos que carecen de la fuerza de la personalidad pueden encontrarse esclavizados a un orbe.
Un orb es un globo de cristal grabado alrededor de 10 pulgadas de diámetro. Cuando se utiliza, crece a unos 20 pulgadas de diámetro, y la niebla gira dentro de ella.

Mientras está afinado a un orbe, puede utilizar una acción para examinar las profundidades del orbe y hablar su palabra de comando. Entonces debes hacer un cheque de Charisma. En un cheque exitoso, controlas el orbe durante el tiempo que te quedes sintonizado con él. En un cheque fallido, te conviertes en {@condition charmed} por el orbe durante el tiempo que permanezcas en sintonía con él.

Mientras usted es [[TAG0] por el orbe, usted no puede terminar voluntariamente su attunement a él, y los moldes orb {@spell suggestion} en usted a voluntad (salvar {@dc 18}), instándole a trabajar hacia los fines malos que desea. La esencia del dragón dentro del orbe podría querer muchas cosas: la aniquilación de un pueblo en particular, la libertad del orbe, la propagación del sufrimiento en el mundo, para avanzar en la adoración de Takhisis ([TAG3] nombre en Krynn), o algo más que el DM decide.

item.name: Orb of Dragonkind
entries: Long ago, in the Dragonlance setting, elves and humans waged a terrible war against chromatic dragons. When the world seemed doomed, the wizards of the Towers of High Sorcery came together and forged five Orbs of Dragonkind to help defeat the dragons. One orb was taken to each of the five towers, and there they were used to speed the war toward a victorious end. The wizards used the orbs to lure dragons to them, then destroyed the dragons with powerful magic.

As the Towers of High Sorcery fell in later ages, the orbs were destroyed or faded into legend, and only three are thought to survive. Their magic has been warped over the centuries. Their primary purpose of calling dragons still functions, but they also allow some measure of control over dragons.

Each orb contains the essence of an evil dragon, a presence that resents any attempt to coax magic from it. Those who try to wield an orb's magic but lack sufficient force of personality might find themselves under the orb's control.
An orb is an etched crystal globe about 10 inches in diameter. When used, it grows to about 20 inches in diameter, and mist swirls inside it.

While attuned to an orb, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to peer into the orb's depths. You must then make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, you control the orb for as long as you remain attuned to it. On a failed save, the orb imposes the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition on you for as long as you remain attuned to it.

While you are {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by the orb, you can't voluntarily end your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to it, and the orb casts {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} on you at will (save {@dc 18}), urging you to work toward the evil ends it desires. The dragon essence within the orb might want many things: the annihilation of a particular society or organization, freedom from the orb, to spread suffering in the world, to advance the worship of {@book Tiamat|XDMG|8|Tiamat}, or something else the DM decides.

item.name: Orb of Gonging
entries: This common wondrous item is a hollow, 5-inch-diameter orb that weighs 5 pounds. Its outer shell is composed of notched bronze rings, which can be turned so that the notches line up. Aligning the notches requires an action, and doing so causes the orb to gong loudly until the notches are no longer aligned. The sounds are spaced 6 seconds apart and can be heard out to a range of 600 feet.
entries_es: Este artículo maravilloso común es un orbe hueco, de 5 pulgadas de diámetro que pesa 5 libras. Su caparazón exterior se compone de anillos de bronce grabados, que se pueden girar para que las muescas se formen. Alinear las muescas requiere una acción, y hacerlo hace que el orbe se enganche fuerte hasta que las muescas ya no estén alineadas. Los sonidos están separados 6 segundos y se pueden escuchar a una gama de 600 pies.

item.name: Orb of Skoraeus
entries: Said to be infused with the wisdom and power of the god Skoraeus, this polished stone orb is veined with iridescent crystal that seems to glow from within. The orb is 8 inches in diameter and weighs 8 pounds, making it a palm-sized trinket for a stone giant but a more unwieldy item for a Medium creature to use.
While holding this orb, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your spells. You also gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Abundant Components
entries: The orb has 3 charges and regains all expended charges at dawn. When you cast a spell while holding this orb, you can expend up to 3 charges to ignore the spell's material components with a gold piece cost, up to 300 gp per charge expended.

entries.name: Astute Mind
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to any Constitution saving throw you make to maintain your {@status concentration} on a spell.

entries: You can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet.

item.name: Orb of the Stein Rune
entries: This orb of granite is about the size of an adult human's fist. The stein (stone) rune appears on it in the form of crystalline veins that run across the surface. The orb has the following properties, which work only while it's on your person.

entries.name: Indomitable Stand
entries: As an action, you can channel the orb's magic to hold your ground. For the next minute or until you move any distance, you have advantage on all checks and saving throws to resist effects that force you to move. In addition, any enemy that moves to a space within 10 feet of you must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be unable to move any farther this turn.
entries_es: Como acción, puedes canalizar la magia del orbe para mantener tu tierra. Por el minuto siguiente o hasta que se mueva cualquier distancia, usted tiene ventaja en todos los cheques y ahorro de los tiros para resistir los efectos que fuerza a moverse. Además, cualquier enemigo que se mueva a un espacio dentro de 10 pies de usted debe tener éxito en un {@dc 12} Fuerza ahorrando lanzamiento o ser incapaz de mover más lejos este giro.

entries.name: Stone Soul
entries: You can't be {@condition petrified}.
entries_es: No puedes ser {@condition petrified}.

entries.name: Earthen Step
entries: You can cast {@spell meld into stone} as a bonus action. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
entries_es: Usted puede lanzar {@spell meld into stone} como una acción de bonificación. Una vez que utilice esta propiedad, no puede utilizarla de nuevo hasta que termine un breve o largo descanso.

entries.name: Gift of Stone
entries: You can transfer the orb's magic to a nonmagical item—a shield or a pair of boots—by tracing the stein rune there with your finger. The transfer takes 8 hours of work that requires the two items to be within 5 feet of each other. At the end, the orb is destroyed, and the rune appears in silver on the chosen item, which gains a benefit based on its form:

items.name: Shield
items.entry: The shield is now a rare magic item that requires attunement. While you wield it, you have resistance to all damage dealt by ranged weapon attacks.

items.name: Boots
items.entry: The pair of boots is now an uncommon magic item that requires attunement. While you wear the boots, you have advantage on Strength saving throws, and you can use your reaction to avoid being knocked {@condition prone}.

entries_es: Usted puede transferir la magia del orbe a un elemento no mágico —un escudo o un par de botas— rastreando la runa de stein allí con su dedo. El traslado lleva 8 horas de trabajo que requiere que los dos elementos estén a unos 5 pies. Al final, el orbe se destruye, y la runa aparece en plata sobre el objeto elegido, que gana un beneficio basado en su forma:

items.name: Shield
items.entry: The shield is now a rare magic item that requires attunement. While you wield it, you have resistance to all damage dealt by ranged weapon attacks.

items.name: Boots
items.entry: The pair of boots is now an uncommon magic item that requires attunement. While you wear the boots, you have advantage on Strength saving throws, and you can use your reaction to avoid being knocked {@condition prone}.

entries_es: Este orbe de granito es alrededor del tamaño del puño de un humano adulto. La runa stein (piedra) aparece en ella en forma de venas cristalinas que atraviesan la superficie. El orb tiene las siguientes propiedades, que funcionan sólo mientras está en su persona.

entries_es.name: Indomitable Stand
entries: As an action, you can channel the orb's magic to hold your ground. For the next minute or until you move any distance, you have advantage on all checks and saving throws to resist effects that force you to move. In addition, any enemy that moves to a space within 10 feet of you must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be unable to move any farther this turn.
entries_es: Como acción, puedes canalizar la magia del orbe para mantener tu tierra. Por el minuto siguiente o hasta que se mueva cualquier distancia, usted tiene ventaja en todos los cheques y ahorro de los tiros para resistir los efectos que fuerza a moverse. Además, cualquier enemigo que se mueva a un espacio dentro de 10 pies de usted debe tener éxito en un {@dc 12} Fuerza ahorrando lanzamiento o ser incapaz de mover más lejos este giro.

entries_es.name: Stone Soul
entries: You can't be {@condition petrified}.
entries_es: No puedes ser {@condition petrified}.

entries_es.name: Earthen Step
entries: You can cast {@spell meld into stone} as a bonus action. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
entries_es: Usted puede lanzar {@spell meld into stone} como una acción de bonificación. Una vez que utilice esta propiedad, no puede utilizarla de nuevo hasta que termine un breve o largo descanso.

entries_es.name: Gift of Stone
entries: You can transfer the orb's magic to a nonmagical item—a shield or a pair of boots—by tracing the stein rune there with your finger. The transfer takes 8 hours of work that requires the two items to be within 5 feet of each other. At the end, the orb is destroyed, and the rune appears in silver on the chosen item, which gains a benefit based on its form:

items.name: Shield
items.entry: The shield is now a rare magic item that requires attunement. While you wield it, you have resistance to all damage dealt by ranged weapon attacks.

items.name: Boots
items.entry: The pair of boots is now an uncommon magic item that requires attunement. While you wear the boots, you have advantage on Strength saving throws, and you can use your reaction to avoid being knocked {@condition prone}.

entries_es: Usted puede transferir la magia del orbe a un elemento no mágico —un escudo o un par de botas— rastreando la runa de stein allí con su dedo. El traslado lleva 8 horas de trabajo que requiere que los dos elementos estén a unos 5 pies. Al final, el orbe se destruye, y la runa aparece en plata sobre el objeto elegido, que gana un beneficio basado en su forma:

items.name: Shield
items.entry: The shield is now a rare magic item that requires attunement. While you wield it, you have resistance to all damage dealt by ranged weapon attacks.

items.name: Boots
items.entry: The pair of boots is now an uncommon magic item that requires attunement. While you wear the boots, you have advantage on Strength saving throws, and you can use your reaction to avoid being knocked {@condition prone}.

item.name: Orb of the Veil
entries: This onyx sphere bears deep, spiraling grooves and dangles from an iron chain. While the orb is on your person, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, as does your maximum for that score.
You gain {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense darkvision}, the orb increases its range by 60 feet.
You have advantage on Wisdom checks to find hidden doors and paths.

entries.name: Curse
entries: The orb is cursed, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. As long as you remain cursed, you are unwilling to part with the orb, keeping it on your person at all times. All nonmagical flames within 30 feet of you automatically extinguish, and fire damage dealt by you is halved.
entries_es: El orbe está maldecido, y ser afinado a él extiende la maldición a ustedes. Mientras permanezcas maldito, no estás dispuesto a separarte del orbe, manteniéndolo en tu persona en todo momento. Todas las llamas no mágicas dentro de 30 pies de usted apagan automáticamente, y el daño al fuego tratado por usted es a la mitad.
Esta esfera del ónix lleva surcos profundos, en espiral y ángulos de una cadena de hierro. Mientras que el orbe está en su persona, usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: Your Wisdom score increases by 2, as does your maximum for that score.
You gain {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense darkvision}, the orb increases its range by 60 feet.
You have advantage on Wisdom checks to find hidden doors and paths.

All nonmagical flames within 30 feet of you automatically extinguish, and fire damage dealt by you is halved.

Todas las llamas no mágicas dentro de 30 pies de usted apagan automáticamente, y el daño al fuego tratado por usted es a la mitad.

item.name: Orb of Time
entries: This orb can be used as an Arcane Focus.
While holding the orb, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to determine whether it is morning, afternoon, evening, or nighttime. This property functions only on the Material Plane.
entries_es: Este orb se puede utilizar como un foco Arcane.
Mientras sostiene el orbe, puede tomar una [[TAG0] acción para determinar si es por la mañana, por la tarde, por la noche o por la noche. Esta propiedad sólo funciona en el Plano de Materiales.

item.name: Orb of Time
entries: While holding this orb, you can use an action to determine whether it is morning, afternoon, evening, or nighttime outside. This property functions only on the Material Plane.
entries_es: Mientras sostiene este orbe, puede utilizar una acción para determinar si es mañana, tarde, noche o noche fuera. Esta propiedad sólo funciona en el Plano de Materiales.

item.name: Orc Stone
entries: I saved the life of an orc, who gave me a stone with the symbol of the Many-Arrows tribe (a humanoid skull pierced by three arrows) carved into it. The stone is an uncommon magic item that requires attunement, and only I can attune to it.

As an action, I can use the stone to summon the spirit of an orc warrior, which appears within 30 feet of me. The spirit uses the {@creature orc war chief} stat block in the Monster Manual and disappears after 10 minutes or when reduced to 0 hit points. The spirit understands any language I speak and obeys my commands.
After the stone is used three times, it turns to dust. (See Appendix B of Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden)
entries_es: Salvé la vida de un orco, que me dio una piedra con el símbolo de la tribu de muchos flechas (un cráneo humanoide perforado por tres flechas) tallado en ella. La piedra es un elemento mágico poco común que requiere attunement, y sólo puedo sintonizarlo.

Como acción, puedo usar la piedra para convocar el espíritu de un guerrero orc, que aparece a 30 pies de mí. El espíritu utiliza el bloque [[TAG0] del Monster Manual y desaparece después de 10 minutos o cuando se reduce a 0 puntos de impacto. El espíritu entiende cualquier idioma que hablo y obedece mis mandamientos.
Después de que la piedra se utiliza tres veces, se convierte en polvo. (Ver Apéndice B de Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden)

item.name: Orcsplitter
item.reqAttune: by a dwarf, fighter, or paladin of good alignment
entries: A mighty axe wielded long ago by the dwarf king Torhild Flametongue, Orcsplitter is a battered weapon that appears unremarkable at first glance. Its head is graven with the Dwarvish runes for "orc," but the runes are depicted with a gap or slash through the markings; the word "orc" is literally split in two.
You gain the following benefits while holding this magic weapon:

items: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.
When you roll a 20 on an attack roll with this weapon against an {@creature orc}, that {@creature orc} must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.

You can't be {@status surprised} by {@creature orc||orcs} while you're not {@condition incapacitated}. You are also aware when {@creature orc||orcs} are within 120 feet of you and aren't behind {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}, although you don't know their location.
You and any of your friends within 30 feet of you can't be {@condition frightened} while you're not {@condition incapacitated}.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Orcsplitter is a sentient, lawful good weapon with an Intelligence of 6, a Wisdom of 15, and a Charisma of 10. It can see and hear out to 120 feet and has {@sense darkvision}. It communicates by transmitting emotions to its wielder, although on rare occasions it uses a limited form of telepathy to bring to the wielder's mind a couplet or stanza of ancient Dwarvish verse.
entries_es: Orcsplitter es una buena arma sensible y lícita con una Inteligencia de 6, una Sabiduría de 15, y una Charisma de 10. Puede ver y escuchar a 120 pies y tiene {@sense darkvision}. Se comunica mediante la transmisión de emociones a su wielder, aunque en raras ocasiones utiliza una forma limitada de telepatía para llevar a la mente del wielder un par o estrofa de verso antiguo Dwarvish.

entries.name: Personality
entries: Orcsplitter is grim, taciturn, and inflexible. It knows little more than the desire to face {@creature orc||orcs} in battle and serve a courageous, just wielder. It disdains cowards and any form of duplicity, deception, or disloyalty. The weapon's purpose is to defend dwarves and to serve as a symbol of dwarven resolve. It hates the traditional foes of dwarves—giants, goblins, and, most of all, {@creature orc||orcs}—and silently urges its possessor to meet such creatures in battle.
entries_es: Orcsplitter es sombrío, taciturn e inflexible. Sabe poco más que el deseo de enfrentarse {@creature orc||orcs} en la batalla y servir a un valiente, simplemente más inteligente. Desactúa los cobardes y cualquier forma de duplicidad, engaño o deslealtad. El propósito del arma es defender enanos y servir como símbolo de resolución enana. Aborrece a los enemigos tradicionales de los enanos, los donantes, los duendes y, sobre todo, {@creature orc||orcs}— e insta silenciosamente a su poseedor a que conozca a tales criaturas en la batalla.

Un poderoso hacha marchitado hace mucho tiempo por el enano rey Torhild Flametongue, Orcsplitter es un arma batida que parece irremarcable a primera vista. Su cabeza es grava con las runas de Dwarvish para "orc", pero las runas se muestran con una brecha o barra a través de las marcas; la palabra "orc" está literalmente dividida en dos.
Ganas los siguientes beneficios mientras sostienes este arma mágica:

items: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.
When you roll a 20 on an attack roll with this weapon against an {@creature orc}, that {@creature orc} must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.

You can't be {@status surprised} by {@creature orc||orcs} while you're not {@condition incapacitated}. You are also aware when {@creature orc||orcs} are within 120 feet of you and aren't behind {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}, although you don't know their location.
You and any of your friends within 30 feet of you can't be {@condition frightened} while you're not {@condition incapacitated}.

item.name: Orcus Figurine
entries: Carved from an ogre's {@condition petrified} heart, the gray figurine depicts the Demon Prince of Undeath in ghastly detail, clutching his skull-topped wand in one hand and three severed heads by the hair in the other. The figurine smells like decaying flesh, and this scent is detectable out to a range of 5 feet.

The figurine is a Tiny object with AC 17, 3 hit points, and immunity to all types of damage except radiant damage. A {@spell detect evil and good} spell or similar magic reveals that the figurine has been desecrated. As long as it has at least 1 hit point, the figurine has the following magical properties:

items: Undead within 30 feet of the figurine can't be turned.
Dead creatures within 30 feet of the figurine can't be brought back to life.

A creature that holds the figurine while praying to Orcus for at least 1 hour has a {@chance 10} chance of summoning a smoky avatar of the demon lord. Once this avatar is summoned, it can't be summoned again for 30 days. Orcus's avatar has the statistics of a {@creature wraith} except that it's chaotic evil. It attacks all non-undead creatures it encounters, and it disappears after 1 hour or when reduced to 0 hit points.

entries_es: Esculpido del corazón [[TAG0] de un ogro, la figura gris representa al Príncipe de Demonio de la Muerte en detalle, agarrando su varita coronada por el cráneo en una mano y tres cabezas cortadas por el pelo en la otra. La figura huele a carne descompuesta, y este olor es detectable a un rango de 5 pies.

La figura es un objeto pequeño con AC 17, 3 puntos de impacto, e inmunidad a todo tipo de daño excepto daños radiantes. Un hechizo o magia similar revela que la figura ha sido profanada. Mientras tenga al menos 1 punto de llegada, la figura tiene las siguientes propiedades mágicas:

items: Undead within 30 feet of the figurine can't be turned.
Dead creatures within 30 feet of the figurine can't be brought back to life.

A creature that holds the figurine while praying to Orcus for at least 1 hour has a {@chance 10} chance of summoning a smoky avatar of the demon lord. Once this avatar is summoned, it can't be summoned again for 30 days. Orcus's avatar has the statistics of a {@creature wraith} except that it's chaotic evil. It attacks all non-undead creatures it encounters, and it disappears after 1 hour or when reduced to 0 hit points.

rows: A white feather as heavy as lead
An empty vial made from stained glass
A single cone of gold-flecked incense
A silken blindfold
One half of a pair of manacles
A tarnished aspergillum

item.name: Ornithopter of Flying
entries: You can use this contraption to fly, provided your weight (including whatever you are wearing or carrying) doesn't exceed 300 pounds. The ornithopter has a flying speed of 30 feet, and it moves according to your spoken directions while you are riding it. It can't hover. If the ornithopter loses its rider while airborne, it falls and can't fly again for {@dice 1d6 + 4} days.
The ornithopter is 8 feet long, has a 14-foot wingspan, and weighs 25 pounds.
entries_es: Usted puede utilizar esta contrapción para volar, siempre que su peso (incluyendo lo que usted está usando o llevando) no exceda 300 libras. El ornithopter tiene una velocidad de vuelo de 30 pies, y se mueve de acuerdo a sus direcciones habladas mientras usted está montando. No puede pasar. Si el ornitóptero pierde su jinete mientras se respira, cae y no puede volar de nuevo por {@dice 1d6 + 4} días.
El ornitopter tiene 8 pies de largo, tiene un ala de 14 pies y pesa 25 libras.

item.name: Orrery of the Wanderer
entries: This delicate and exquisitely crafted clockwork orrery features multiple geared components whose sweeping hands and dials represent the complex interplay of planar and magical realms. Standing two feet high, the orrery housing is a wondrous device imbued with magic of its own, but the power of its six clockwork components makes the artifact even more potent.

The Orrery of the Wanderer was created by a renowned clockwork mage known only as Lottie. She crafted the relic as a means of tapping into the power of the planes, and to channel the divination and foretelling powers of the stars. But Lottie soon realized that her creation was far more powerful than she had intended. As it tapped into planar magic, the orrery began to manifest the darkness and malevolence inherent to some of the planes. Eventually, it would impress upon its owner a desire to open portals into the most cursed and dangerous worlds, including the Far Realm.

To prevent the orrery from ever being so used, Lottie scattered the components that powered it, secreting them across the world. But the orrery's instinct for survival is strong, and its components have a way of inexorably coming together over decades or centuries, found by treasure hunters, stolen by monsters, found and stolen again—and moving closer to each other all the time.
Random Properties. The orrery has the following randomly determined properties:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial properties}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial property}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|dmg|major detrimental properties}

entries: The random properties of the orrery might function only when all its components are installed, or might function sporadically if any components are missing.

entries.name: The Sum of Its Parts
entries: Each of the six components that powers the Orrery of the Wanderer is a powerful magic relic in its own right:

items: The {@item chronolometer|AI}
The {@item dimensional loop|AI}
The {@item far gear|AI}
The {@item rotor of return|AI}
The {@item timepiece of travel|AI}
The {@item wheel of stars|AI}

entries: Creatures can attune to the orrery's components individually. If attuned to an individual component, a creature must hold the component to make use of its features. A creature can also attune to the orrery and all the components installed in it. Attuning to an installed component doesn't count against the number of magic items you can normally attune to.
While a component is not installed in the orrery, its magic might function sporadically or with unpredictable side effects, as determined by the DM.
entries_es: Cada uno de los seis componentes que potencian la Orrería del Wanderer es una poderosa reliquia mágica en su propio derecho:

items: The {@item chronolometer|AI}
The {@item dimensional loop|AI}
The {@item far gear|AI}
The {@item rotor of return|AI}
The {@item timepiece of travel|AI}
The {@item wheel of stars|AI}

entries_es: Las criaturas pueden ajustarse a los componentes de la orrería individualmente. Si se ajusta a un componente individual, una criatura debe mantener el componente para hacer uso de sus características. Una criatura también puede afinar la orrería y todos los componentes instalados en ella. Attuarse a un componente instalado no cuenta con el número de elementos mágicos a los que normalmente se puede sintonizar.
Aunque un componente no se instala en la orrería, su magia puede funcionar esporádicamente o con efectos secundarios impredecibles, según lo determinado por el DM.

entries.name: Future Echoes
entries: With or without its components, the orrery lets you catch momentary glimpses of the future that warn you of danger. As long as the orrery is within 30 feet of you, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.
entries_es: Con o sin sus componentes, la orrería le permite captar vislumbres momentáneas del futuro que le advierten de peligro. Mientras la orrería esté a menos de 30 pies de usted, usted gana un bono +1 a AC.

entries.name: Into the Void
entries: With or without its components, the attuned orrery infuses your spirit with the tumultuous energy of the planes. Over time, your alignment changes to chaotic neutral, and you are compelled to engage with and explore the most dangerous planar realms.
entries_es: Con o sin sus componentes, la orrería afinada infunde su espíritu con la energía tumultuosa de los planos. Con el tiempo, su alineación cambia a neutral caótico, y usted se ve obligado a comprometerse con y explorar los reinos planares más peligrosos.

entries.name: Master of Travel
entries: While all six components of the Orrery of the Wanderer are installed, the artifact has 7 charges. While touching the orrery, you can use an action and expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 17}): {@spell contact other plane} (3 charges), {@spell demiplane} (6 charges), {@spell gate} (7 charges), {@spell plane shift} (5 charges), or {@spell teleportation circle} (3 charges). The orrery regains {@dice 1d4 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: Mientras se instalan los seis componentes de la Orrería del Wanderer, el artefacto tiene 7 cargos. Al tocar la orrería, puede utilizar una acción y gastar 1 o más cargos para emitir uno de los siguientes hechizos (salvar {@dc 17}): [{@spell contact other plane}] (3 cargos), {@spell demiplane}] (6 cargos), {@spell gate}] (7 cargos), [[TAG4] (5 cargos), o {@spell teleportation circle} (3 cargos). La orrería recupera [[TAG6] cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

Esta delicada y exquisitamente elaborada orrería de relojería cuenta con múltiples componentes engranados cuyas manos y diales de barrido representan la compleja interacción de los reinos planos y mágicos. De pie a dos pies de altura, la carcasa de orrería es un maravilloso dispositivo imbuido con magia propia, pero el poder de sus seis componentes de relojería hace que el artefacto sea aún más potente.

La Orrería del Wanderer fue creada por un famoso magisterio de relojería conocido sólo como Lottie. Elaboró la reliquia como un medio de penetrar en el poder de los aviones, y canalizar los poderes adivinatorios y falsificadores de las estrellas. Pero Lottie pronto se dio cuenta de que su creación era mucho más poderosa de lo que había pensado. Al tocar en la magia planar, la orrería comenzó a manifestar la oscuridad y la malevolencia inherentes a algunos de los aviones. Eventualmente, impresionaría a su dueño el deseo de abrir portales en los mundos más malditos y peligrosos, incluyendo el Reino Extremo.

Para evitar que la orrería sea tan utilizada, Lottie dispersó los componentes que la alimentaban, secretándolos en todo el mundo. Pero el instinto de supervivencia de la orrería es fuerte, y sus componentes tienen una manera de unirse inexorablemente durante décadas o siglos, encontrados por cazadores de tesoros, robados por monstruos, encontrados y robados de nuevo, y acercarse mutuamente todo el tiempo.
Propiedades aleatorias. La orrería tiene las siguientes propiedades determinadas al azar:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial properties}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial property}
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|dmg|major detrimental properties}

entries_es: Las propiedades aleatorias de la orrería sólo pueden funcionar cuando todos sus componentes están instalados, o pueden funcionar esporádicamente si falta algún componente.

Al tocar la orrería, puede utilizar una acción y gastar 1 o más cargos para emitir uno de los siguientes hechizos (salvar {@dc 17}): [{@spell contact other plane}] (3 cargos), {@spell demiplane}] (6 cargos), {@spell gate}] (7 cargos), [[TAG4] (5 cargos), o {@spell teleportation circle} (3 cargos). La orrería recupera [[TAG6] cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Orzhov Guild Signet
entries: This ring, adorned with the symbol of Orzhov, allows you to cast {@spell command}. A guild signet is sometimes awarded to a guild member whose renown score in that guild is 5 or higher, as a reward for performing special services for the guild. Aside from its magical properties, the ring is also an indicator of Orzhov's recognition and favor.
A signet has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast the associated spell (save {@dc 13}).
entries_es: Este anillo, adornado con el símbolo de Orzhov, le permite echar {@spell command}. Un guild signet es a veces otorgado a un miembro del gremio cuyo renombre puntuación en ese gremio es 5 o superior, como recompensa por realizar servicios especiales para el gremio. Aparte de sus propiedades mágicas, el anillo es también un indicador del reconocimiento y el favor de Orzhov.
Un letrero tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargas gastadas diariamente al amanecer. Al llevarla, puede gastar 1 carga para lanzar el hechizo asociado (salvar {@dc 13}).

item.name: Orzhov Keyrune
item.reqAttune: by a member of the Orzhov guild
entries: This keyrune is carved from white marble with veins of black. The end is shaped like a thrull's head, with a gold faceplate affixed. On command, the keyrune transforms into a {@creature winged thrull|GGR} for up to 2 hours. If you don't come from an Orzhov oligarch family, it serves you grudgingly, clownishly aping your movements and mannerisms while carrying out your orders.

When you use an action to speak the item's command word and place the keyrune on the ground in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, the keyrune transforms into a {@creature winged thrull|GGR}. If there isn't enough space for the creature, the keyrune doesn't transform.

The creature is friendly to you, your companions, and other members of your guild (unless those guild members are hostile to you). It understands your languages and obeys your spoken commands. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the {@action Dodge} action and moves to avoid danger.

At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its keyrune form. It reverts early if it drops to 0 hit points or if you use an action to speak the command word again while touching it. When the creature reverts to its keyrune form, it can't transform again until 36 hours have passed.
entries_es: Esta llavero está tallada de mármol blanco con venas de negro. El final se forma como la cabeza de un thrull, con una placa de oro mezclada. Al mando, el llavero se transforma en {@creature winged thrull|GGR} por hasta 2 horas. Si no vienes de una familia de Orzhov oligarch, te sirve con regocijo, sobornando ligeramente tus movimientos y modales mientras realizas tus órdenes.

Cuando usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando del artículo y colocas el llavero en el suelo en un espacio no ocupado a 5 pies de ti, el llavero se transforma en un {@creature winged thrull|GGR}. Si no hay suficiente espacio para la criatura, la llave no se transforma.

La criatura es amistosa con usted, sus compañeros y otros miembros de su gremio (a menos que esos miembros del gremio sean hostiles a usted). Comprende tus idiomas y obedece tus mandamientos hablados. Si usted no emite comandos, la criatura toma la acción {@action Dodge} y se mueve para evitar el peligro.

Al final de la duración, la criatura vuelve a su forma de llave. Revierte temprano si cae a 0 puntos de éxito o si usas una acción para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo mientras la toca. Cuando la criatura vuelve a su forma de llavero, no puede transformarse hasta que hayan pasado 36 horas.

entries: This flickering crystal holds the essence of an Outer Plane. As an action, you can attach the shard to a Tiny object (such as a weapon or a piece of jewelry) or detach it. It falls off if your attunement to it ends. You can use the shard as a spellcasting focus while you hold or wear it.

Roll a {@dice d4} and consult the Outer Essence Shards table to determine the shard's essence and property. When you use a Metamagic option on a spell while you are holding or wearing the shard, you can use that property.

entries: This unique weapon can be used only by a Medium or larger creature that has a Strength of 18 or higher. The bow shoots oversized arrows that deal piercing damage equal to {@dice 2d6} + the wielder's Strength modifier.

item.name: Painter's Supplies
additionalEntries: Proficiency with painter's supplies represents your ability to paint and draw. You also acquire an understanding of art history, which can aid you in examining works of art.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Painter's supplies include an easel, canvas, paints, brushes, charcoal sticks, and a palette.
entries_es: Los suministros de Pintor incluyen un caballete, lienzo, pinturas, pinceles, palos de carbón y una paleta.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, History, Religion
entries: Your expertise aids you in uncovering lore of any sort that is attached to a work of art, such as the magical properties of a painting or the origins of a strange mural found in a dungeon.
entries_es: Su experiencia le ayuda a descubrir el loro de cualquier tipo que se adjunta a una obra de arte, como las propiedades mágicas de una pintura o los orígenes de un extraño mural encontrado en una mazmorra.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation, Perception
entries: When you inspect a painting or a similar work of visual art, your knowledge of the practices behind creating it can grant you additional insight.
entries_es: Cuando inspeccionas una pintura o una obra similar de arte visual, tu conocimiento de las prácticas detrás de la creación puede darte una visión adicional.

additionalEntries.name: Painting and Drawing
entries: As part of a short or long rest, you can produce a simple work of art. Although your work might lack precision, you can capture an image or a scene, or make a quick copy of a piece of art you saw.
entries_es: Como parte de un breve o largo descanso, se puede producir una simple obra de arte. Aunque su trabajo podría carecer de precisión, puede capturar una imagen o una escena, o hacer una copia rápida de una pieza de arte que vio.

item.name: Pale Tincture
entries: A creature subjected to this poison must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage and become {@condition poisoned}. The {@condition poisoned} creature must repeat the saving throw every 24 hours, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) poison damage on a failed save. Until this poison ends, the damage the poison deals can't be healed by any means. After seven successful saving throws, the effect ends and the creature can heal normally.
entries_es: Una criatura sometida a este veneno debe tener éxito en una {@dc 16} Constitución que salva la lanza o toma 3 ([TAG1]]) daño venenoso y convertirse en {@condition poisoned}. La criatura {@condition poisoned} debe repetir el lanzamiento de ahorro cada 24 horas, tomando 3 ([TAG1]) daño venenoso en un ahorro fallido. Hasta que este veneno termine, el daño que los tratos de veneno no pueden ser curados por ningún medio. Después de siete exitosos lanzamientos de ahorro, el efecto termina y la criatura puede sanar normalmente.

item.name: Pale Tincture
entries: A creature subjected to Pale Tincture must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage and have the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition. The {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} creature repeats the save every 24 hours, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage on a failed save. The damage the poison deals can't be healed by any means while the creature remains {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}. After seven successful saves against the poison, the creature is no longer {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.
entries_es: Una criatura sometida a Pale Tincture debe tener éxito en una [[TAG0] Constitución que salva el lanzamiento o toma 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Daño en veneno y tener la condición [[TAG2]. La criatura [[TAG2] repite el ahorro cada 24 horas, tomando 3 ([TAG1]]) Daño venenoso en un ahorro fallido. El daño que los tratos de veneno no pueden ser curados por ningún medio mientras la criatura permanece {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}. Después de siete exitosas salvas contra el veneno, la criatura ya no es {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}.

item.name: Paper
entries: One sheet of Paper can hold about 250 handwritten words.
entries_es: Una hoja de papel puede contener alrededor de 250 palabras escritas a mano.

item.name: Paper Bird
entries: After you write a message of fifty words or fewer on this magic sheet of parchment and speak a creature's name, the parchment magically folds into a Tiny paper bird and flies to the recipient whose name you uttered. The recipient must be on the same plane of existence as you, otherwise the bird turns into ash as it takes flight.

The bird is an object that has 1 hit point, an Armor Class of 13, a flying speed of 60 feet, a Dexterity of 16 (+3), and a score of 1 (−5) in all other abilities, and it is immune to poison and psychic damage.

It travels to within 5 feet of its intended recipient by the most direct route, whereupon it turns into a nonmagical and inanimate sheet of parchment that can be unfolded only by the intended recipient. If the bird's hit points or speed is reduced to 0 or if it is otherwise immobilized, it turns into ash.
Paper birds usually come in small, flat boxes containing {@dice 1d6 + 3} sheets of the parchment.
entries_es: Después de escribir un mensaje de cincuenta palabras o menos en esta hoja mágica de pergamino y hablar el nombre de una criatura, el pergamino se dobla mágicamente en un pajarito de papel pequeño y vuela al destinatario cuyo nombre pronunciaste. El receptor debe estar en el mismo plano de la existencia que tú, de lo contrario el pájaro se convierte en ceniza mientras toma el vuelo.

El pájaro es un objeto que tiene 1 punto de impacto, una Clase Armor de 13, una velocidad voladora de 60 pies, una Dexteridad de 16 (+3), y una puntuación de 1 (−5) en todas las demás habilidades, y es inmune al daño venenoso y psíquico.

Viaja a menos de 5 pies de su destinatario previsto por la ruta más directa, en la que se convierte en una hoja de pergamino no mágica e inanimada que sólo puede ser desplegada por el destinatario previsto. Si los puntos de impacto o la velocidad del pájaro se reducen a 0 o si se inmoviliza de otro modo, se convierte en ceniza.
Las aves de papel generalmente vienen en pequeñas cajas planas que contienen [[TAG0] hojas del pergamino.

item.name: Paralysis Pistol
entries: This curious-looking pistol is shaped like a large, glass bulb with a handle on the bottom and brass prongs protruding from its front. The weapon is powered by an {@item energy cell} stored in its grip. Placing a full {@item energy cell} in the pistol gives the pistol 6 charges.

As an action while holding this pistol, you can expend 1 of its charges to fire a ray of crackling energy at a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition paralyzed} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the target's turns, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Replacing the Energy Cell
entries: While the pistol has charges remaining, its {@item energy cell} can't be removed. Once the pistol has 0 charges, you can replace the {@item energy cell} with a new cell by using an action or a bonus action.
entries_es: Mientras la pistola tiene cargos restantes, su {@item energy cell} no puede ser eliminado. Una vez que la pistola tiene 0 cargos, puede reemplazar el {@item energy cell} con una nueva célula utilizando una acción o una acción de bonificación.

Esta curiosa pistola está formada como una gran bombilla de cristal con un mango en la parte inferior y las pinzas de latón que corren desde su frente. El arma es alimentada por un [[TAG0] almacenado en su agarre. Colocar un [[TAG0] completo en la pistola da la pistola 6 cargos.

Como acción mientras sostienes esta pistola, puedes gastar 1 de sus cargos para disparar un rayo de energía crujiente a una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 60 pies de ti mismo. El objetivo debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15} Constitución ahorrando o tener la condición [[TAG1] por 1 minuto. Al final de cada turno del objetivo, puede repetir el lanzamiento de ahorro, terminando el efecto en sí mismo en un éxito.

entries_es.name: Replacing the Energy Cell
entries: While the pistol has charges remaining, its {@item energy cell} can't be removed. Once the pistol has 0 charges, you can replace the {@item energy cell} with a new cell by using an action or a bonus action.

item.name: Parchment
entries: One sheet of Parchment can hold about 250 handwritten words.
entries_es: Una hoja de Parchment puede contener unas 250 palabras escritas a mano.

item.name: Pariah's Shield
entries: Soldiers of the Boros Legion consider it an honor to bear this shield, even knowing that it might be the last honor they receive. The front of the shield is sculpted to depict a grieving human face.
You gain a +1 bonus to AC for every two allies within 5 feet of you (up to a maximum of +3) while you wield this shield. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC.
When a creature you can see within 5 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to take that damage, instead of the creature taking it. When you do so, the damage type changes to force.
entries_es: Soldados de la Legión Boros consideran un honor soportar este escudo, incluso sabiendo que podría ser el último honor que reciben. El frente del escudo es esculpido para representar un rostro humano afligido.
Usted gana un bono +1 a AC por cada dos aliados a menos de 5 pies de usted (hasta un máximo de +3) mientras que el pelaje de este escudo. Este bono es además del bono normal del escudo a AC.
Cuando una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 5 pies de ti daña, puedes usar tu reacción para tomar ese daño, en lugar de que la criatura lo tome. Cuando lo hace, el tipo de daño cambia a la fuerza.

item.name: Pathfinder's Greataxe
entries: When you wield this +1 greataxe, you always know the way to the nearest passage leading from underground toward the surface, as well as the approximate depth the axe is underground.
entries_es: Cuando empuñas este +1 granaxe, siempre conoces el camino hacia el pasaje más cercano que conduce desde el metro hacia la superficie, así como la profundidad aproximada del hacha está bajo tierra.

entries_es: Una gema blanca opaca lustrosa, amarilla o rosa.

item.name: Pearl of Power
entries: While this pearl is on your person, you can use an action to speak its command word and regain one expended spell slot. If the expended slot was of 4th level or higher, the new slot is 3rd level. Once you have used the pearl, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras esta perla está en su persona, puede utilizar una acción para hablar su palabra de comando y recuperar una ranura de hechizo gastado. Si la ranura gastada era de 4to nivel o superior, la nueva ranura es 3er nivel. Una vez que hayas usado la perla, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Pearl of Power
entries: While this pearl is on your person, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. Once you use the pearl, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras que esta perla está en su persona, usted puede tomar una [[TAG0] acción para recuperar una ranura de hechizo gastado del nivel 3 o inferior. Una vez que usas la perla, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Pearl of Undead Detection
entries: This black pearl glows faintly when undead are within 120 feet of it.
entries_es: Esta perla negra brilla débilmente cuando los muertos están a 120 pies de ella.

item.name: Pennant of the Vind Rune
entries: This blue pennant is crafted from silk and is five feet long and whips about as if buffeted by a wind. The vind (wind) rune appears on its surface, looking almost like a cloud. The pennant has the following properties, which work only while it's on your person.

entries.name: Wind Step
entries: As an action, you fly up to 20 feet. If you don't land at the end of this flight, you fall unless you have another means of staying aloft.
entries_es: Como acción, vuelas hasta 20 pies. Si no aterrizas al final de este vuelo, caerás a menos que tengas otro medio de permanecer alojado.

entries.name: Comforting Wind
entries: You can't suffocate.
entries_es: No puedes sofocarte.

entries.name: Winds Grasp
entries: As a reaction when you fall, you can cause yourself to take no damage from the fall. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
entries_es: Como reacción cuando caes, puedes causar que no te dañes de la caída. Una vez que utilice esta propiedad, no puede utilizarla de nuevo hasta que termine un breve o largo descanso.

entries.name: Wind Walker
entries: While you are attuned to this rune, you can cast {@spell levitate} as a bonus action. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
entries_es: Mientras usted está afinado a esta runa, usted puede fundir {@spell levitate} como una acción de bonificación. Una vez que utilice esta propiedad, no puede utilizarla de nuevo hasta que termine un breve o largo descanso.

entries.name: Gift of Wind
entries: You can transfer the pennant's magic to a nonmagical item—a suit of armor, a pair of boots, or a cloak—by tracing the vind rune there with your finger. The transfer takes 8 hours of work that requires the two items to be within 5 feet of each other. At the end, the pennant is destroyed, and the rune appears in silver on the chosen item, which gains a benefit based on its form:

items.name: Armor
items.entry: The armor is now an uncommon magic item that requires attunement. You gain a bonus to speed of 5 feet while you wear the armor, and if it normally imposes disadvantage on {@skill Stealth} checks, it no longer does so.

items.name: Boots/Cloak
items.entry: The pair of boots or cloak is now a rare magic item that requires attunement. While wearing the item, you can convert up to 20 feet of your movement on each of your turns into flight. If you don't land at the end of this flight, you fall unless you have another means of staying aloft. You can also cast {@spell feather fall} once from the item, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest.

entries_es: Usted puede transferir la magia del colgante a un elemento no mágico —un traje de armadura, un par de botas, o un manto— rastreando la columna de vind allí con su dedo. El traslado lleva 8 horas de trabajo que requiere que los dos elementos estén a unos 5 pies. Al final, el colgante es destruido, y la runa aparece en plata sobre el objeto elegido, que gana un beneficio basado en su forma:

items.name: Armor

You can also cast {@spell feather fall} once from the item, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest.
