item.name: Red Wizard Blade
entries: Forged by Red Wizards using a secret process known only to them, this grim steel dagger draws its power from the Negative Plane. When you hit a creature with a melee attack using this magic dagger, the target takes an extra {@damage 3d12} necrotic damage.

A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this weapon dies and can't be raised from the dead except by a deity or by a creature using a {@item tablet of reawakening|HAT-LMI} to cast the {@spell true resurrection} spell.
entries_es: Forjado por Magos Rojos usando un proceso secreto conocido sólo para ellos, esta daga de acero mullido saca su poder del Plano Negativo. Cuando golpeas a una criatura con un ataque de melee usando esta daga mágica, el objetivo toma un daño necrótico extra.

Una criatura reducida a 0 puntos de impacto por este arma muere y no puede ser levantada de los muertos excepto por una deidad o por una criatura usando un {@item tablet of reawakening|HAT-LMI} para lanzar el hechizo {@spell true resurrection}.

item.name: Reincarnation Dust
entries: When this small pouch of purple dust is sprinkled on a dead humanoid or a piece of a dead humanoid, the dust is absorbed by the remains. If willing, the dead creature returns to life with a new body as if the {@spell reincarnate} spell had been cast on the remains.
entries_es: Cuando esta pequeña bolsa de polvo púrpura es rociada sobre un humanoide muerto o un pedazo de un humanoide muerto, el polvo es absorbido por los restos. Si está dispuesto, la criatura muerta vuelve a la vida con un nuevo cuerpo como si el hechizo {@spell reincarnate} hubiera sido lanzado sobre los restos.

item.name: Reliquary
entries: For a Reliquary to be an effective Holy Symbol, it must be held.
entries_es: Para que un Reliquary sea un Símbolo Santo eficaz, debe ser sostenido.

item.name: Residuum
entries: The sheer amount of leftover arcane power within the {@item whitestone|TDCSR} of the mountains is incredibly receptive to enchantment. Magic items that incorporate at least an ounce of {@item whitestone|TDCSR} into their construction require only one-quarter the creation time of other magic items. Some alchemists in {@book Emon|TDCSR|3|Emon, the City of Fellowship} have discovered that dissolving {@item whitestone|TDCSR} with specific acids can leave behind pure residuum, which can substitute for expensive spell components when such materials are not readily available.

If a spell has a component cost that consumes the component, its caster can substitute the required component for an amount of residuum of an equal value. One pound of pure residuum is worth approximately 500 gp in most markets, though it becomes extremely expensive and difficult to find outside of {@book Emon|TDCSR|3|Emon, the City of Fellowship} or the city of {@book Whitestone|TDCSR|3|Whitestone} itself.

Residuum can also be heated and blown into glass, forming a shimmering, greenish surface. Residuum slates or orbs can be used in stationary enchanting tables. Archmages willing to pay exorbitant rates—easily 20,000 gp or more—may acquire an {@item Residuum enchanting slate|TDCSR|enchanting slate} that can be used to expedite the creation of all magic items. Using such a table allows anyone crafting a magic item to do so in one-quarter of the usual time.
entries_es: La gran cantidad de poder arcano sobrante dentro del [[TAG0] de las montañas es increíblemente receptivo al encantamiento. Los elementos mágicos que incorporan al menos una onza de {@item whitestone|TDCSR} en su construcción requieren sólo una cuarta parte del tiempo de creación de otros elementos mágicos. Algunos alquimistas en {@book Emon|TDCSR|3|Emon, the City of Fellowship} han descubierto que disolver {@item whitestone|TDCSR} con ácidos específicos puede dejar atrás el residuo puro, que puede sustituir componentes de hechizo caros cuando tales materiales no están disponibles fácilmente.

Si un hechizo tiene un costo de componente que consume el componente, su fundición puede sustituir el componente requerido por una cantidad de residuo de un valor igual. Una libra de residuo puro vale aproximadamente 500 gp en la mayoría de los mercados, aunque se vuelve extremadamente costoso y difícil encontrar fuera de {@book Emon|TDCSR|3|Emon, the City of Fellowship} o la ciudad de [[TAG1] en sí mismo.

El residuo también puede ser calentado y soplado en vidrio, formando una superficie brillante y verdosa. Las pizarras o orbes residuales se pueden utilizar en mesas intercambiadoras estacionarias. Las arquemas dispuestas a pagar tarifas exorbitantes —con frecuencia 20.000 gp o más— pueden adquirir un [[TAG0] que se puede utilizar para acelerar la creación de todos los elementos mágicos. Usar una tabla de este tipo permite que cualquier persona que elabore un elemento mágico lo haga en una cuarta parte del tiempo habitual.

item.name: Residuum Enchanting Slate
entries: {@item Residuum|TDCSR} can also be heated and blown into glass, forming a shimmering, greenish surface. Residuum slates or orbs can be used in stationary enchanting tables. Archmages willing to pay exorbitant rates—easily 20,000 gp or more—may acquire an {@item Residuum enchanting slate|TDCSR|enchanting slate} that can be used to expedite the creation of all magic items. Using such a table allows anyone crafting a magic item to do so in one-quarter of the usual time.

Las pizarras o orbes residuales se pueden utilizar en mesas intercambiadoras estacionarias. Las arquemas dispuestas a pagar tarifas exorbitantes —con frecuencia 20.000 gp o más— pueden adquirir un {@item Residuum enchanting slate|TDCSR|enchanting slate} que se puede utilizar para acelerar la creación de todos los elementos mágicos. Usar una tabla de este tipo permite que cualquier persona que elabore un elemento mágico lo haga en una cuarta parte del tiempo habitual.

item.name: Reszur
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon, which doesn't make noise when it hits or cuts something.

The name "Reszur" is graven on the dagger's pommel. If the wielder speaks the name, the blade gives off a faint, cold glow, shedding dim light in a 10-foot radius until the wielder speaks the name again.
entries_es: Usted tiene un bono +1 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma, que no hace ruido cuando golpea o corta algo.

El nombre "Reszur" es grava en el pomelo de la daga. Si el wielder habla el nombre, la espada da un resplandor débil y frío, derramando luz en un radio de 10 pies hasta que el wielder vuelva a hablar el nombre.

item.name: Reveler's Concertina
entries: While holding this concertina, you gain a +2 bonus to the saving throw DC of your bard spells.
As an action, you can use the concertina to cast {@spell Otto's irresistible dance} from the item. This property of the concertina can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras sostiene esta concertina, usted gana un bono +2 al lanzamiento de ahorro DC de sus hechizos desnudos.
Como acción, puede utilizar la concertina para fundir {@spell Otto's irresistible dance} del artículo. Esta propiedad de la concertina no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Ring of Air Elemental Command
entries: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on attack rolls against elementals from the Elemental Plane of Air, and they have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, you have access to properties based on the Elemental Plane of Air.
The ring has 5 charges. It regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. Spells cast from the ring have a save DC of 17.

You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast {@spell dominate monster} on an {@creature air elemental}. In addition, when you fall, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling. You can also speak and understand Auran.
If you help slay an {@creature air elemental} while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:

items: You have resistance to lightning damage.
You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: {@spell chain lightning} (3 charges), {@spell gust of wind} (2 charges), or {@spell wind wall} (1 charge).

item.name_es: Anillo del Comando Elemental del Aire
entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, usted tiene ventaja en los rollos de ataque contra elementales del Plano Elemental de Aire, y tienen desventaja en los rollos de ataque contra usted. Además, tiene acceso a propiedades basadas en el Plano Elemental de Aire.
El anillo tiene 5 cargos. Recupera {@dice 1d4 + 1} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Los discursos lanzados del anillo tienen un DC salvo de 17.

Usted puede gastar 2 de los cargos del anillo para lanzar {@spell dominate monster} en un {@creature air elemental}. Además, cuando caes, bajas 60 pies por ronda y no te dañas de caer. También puedes hablar y entender a Auran.
Si ayuda a matar un {@creature air elemental} mientras se ajusta al anillo, obtiene acceso a las siguientes propiedades adicionales:

items: You have resistance to lightning damage.
You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: {@spell chain lightning} (3 charges), {@spell gust of wind} (2 charges), or {@spell wind wall} (1 charge).

item.name: Ring of Amity
entries: This ring is carved from hematite and bears an engraving of the friend rune.

When you first attune to this ring, you can touch one willing creature and form a magical bond between the two of you. While this bond lasts, whenever you are subjected to a spell or magical effect that restores hit points, the bonded creature also receives the benefits of the spell or effect.
You can bond with a different creature whenever you finish a long rest, provided that you can touch the creature and the creature is willing.

A creature can benefit from only one ring of amity's bond at a time. The bond ends if either you or the creature travels to a different plane of existence, if you bond with a different creature at the end of a long rest, or if you sever the bond as a bonus action.

entries.name: Invoking the Rune
entries: When the bonded creature hits a target with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to invoke the ring's rune if you are within 60 feet of the bonded creature. The bonded creature's attack is then turned into a critical hit.
Once the rune has been invoked, it can't be invoked again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Cuando la criatura atada golpea un blanco con un rollo de ataque, puedes usar tu reacción para invocar la runa del anillo si estás a menos de 60 pies de la criatura atada. El ataque de la criatura ligada se convierte en un golpe crítico.
Una vez invocada la runa, no puede ser invocada de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.
Este anillo está tallado de hematita y lleva un grabado de la runa amiga.

Cuando te afinas por primera vez a este anillo, puedes tocar una criatura dispuesta y formar un vínculo mágico entre los dos. Mientras que este vínculo dura, cada vez que se somete a un hechizo o efecto mágico que restaura puntos de éxito, la criatura atada también recibe los beneficios del hechizo o efecto.
Puedes unirte con una criatura diferente cuando termines un descanso largo, siempre que puedas tocar a la criatura y la criatura esté dispuesta.

Una criatura puede beneficiarse de un solo anillo de vínculo de amidad a la vez. El vínculo termina si usted o la criatura viajan a un plano diferente de la existencia, si se unen con una criatura diferente al final de un descanso largo, o si sever el vínculo como una acción de bonificación.

Una vez invocada la runa, no puede ser invocada de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Ring of Animal Influence
entries: This ring has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast one of the following spells:

items: {@spell Animal friendship} (save {@dc 13})
{@spell Fear} (save {@dc 13}), targeting only beasts that have an Intelligence of 3 or lower
{@spell Speak with animals}

item.name: Ring of Collecting
entries: While wearing this ring you can use it to cast the {@spell Leomund's Tiny Hut} spell as an action. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn. Additionally, as a bonus action, you can use the ring to disintegrate any nonmagical piece of art (drawing, painting, or sculpture) within 60 feet that is no larger than Medium-sized. That art now appears inside the tiny hut, for you to appreciate whenever you desire. If you try to remove this art from the tiny hut, it vanishes forever. You can steadily improve this space, but only be denying such beauty to the rest of the world. For every 1,000 gp of art acquired, the tiny hut increases in size by adding another foot to its radius and lasts one additional hour.
entries_es: Mientras usas este anillo puedes usarlo para lanzar el hechizo {@spell Leomund's Tiny Hut} como una acción. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer. Además, como una acción de bonificación, puede utilizar el anillo para desintegrar cualquier pieza de arte no mágica (drawing, pintura o escultura) dentro de 60 pies que no es más grande que el tamaño mediano. Ese arte aparece ahora dentro de la pequeña cabaña, para que aprecies cada vez que lo deseas. Si tratas de quitar este arte de la pequeña cabaña, desaparece para siempre. Usted puede mejorar constantemente este espacio, pero sólo está negando tal belleza al resto del mundo. Por cada 1.000 gp de arte adquirido, la pequeña cabaña aumenta en tamaño añadiendo otro pie a su radio y dura una hora adicional.

item.name: Ring of Djinni Summoning
entries: While wearing this ring, you can speak its command word as an action to summon a particular {@creature djinni} from the Elemental Plane of Air. The {@creature djinni} appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 120 feet of you. It remains as long as you concentrate (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell), to a maximum of 1 hour, or until it drops to 0 hit points. It then returns to its home plane.

While summoned, the {@creature djinni} is friendly to you and your companions. It obeys any commands you give it, no matter what language you use. If you fail to command it, the {@creature djinni} defends itself against attackers but takes no other actions.
After the {@creature djinni} departs, it can't be summoned again for 24 hours, and the ring becomes nonmagical if the {@creature djinni} dies.
entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, puede hablar su palabra de comando como una acción para convocar a un particular {@creature djinni} del Plano Elemental del Aire. El {@creature djinni} aparece en un espacio no ocupado que elijas a 120 pies de ti. Queda mientras se concentre (como si {@status concentration||concentrating} en un hechizo), a un máximo de 1 hora, o hasta que caiga a 0 puntos de éxito. Luego regresa a su avión.

Mientras se llama, el {@creature djinni} es amistoso para usted y sus compañeros. Obedece cualquier orden que le des, no importa el idioma que utilices. Si no lo mandas, el {@creature djinni} se defiende contra los atacantes pero no toma ninguna otra acción.
Después de que el [[TAG0] sale, no puede ser convocado de nuevo por 24 horas, y el anillo se convierte en no mágico si el {@creature djinni} muere.

item.name: Ring of Djinni Summoning
entries: While wearing this ring, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to summon a particular {@creature Djinni|XMM} from the Elemental Plane of Air. The djinni appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 120 feet of yourself. It remains as long as you maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}, to a maximum of 1 hour, or until it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

While summoned, the djinni is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your allies, and it obeys your commands. If you fail to command it, the djinni defends itself against attackers but takes no other actions.
After the djinni departs, it can't be summoned again for 24 hours, and the ring becomes nonmagical if the djinni dies.
Rings of Djinni Summoning are often created by the djinn they summon and given to mortals as gifts of friendship or tokens of esteem.
entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, puede tomar una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para convocar a un particular {@creature Djinni|XMM} del Plano Elemental del Aire. El djinni aparece en un espacio no ocupado que elijas a 120 pies de ti mismo. Queda mientras mantenga {@status Concentration|XPHB}, hasta un máximo de 1 hora, o hasta que caiga a 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

Mientras se llama, el djinni es {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} a usted y sus aliados, y obedece sus órdenes. Si no lo mandas, el djinni se defiende contra los atacantes pero no toma ninguna otra acción.
Después de que el djinni sale, no puede ser convocado de nuevo por 24 horas, y el anillo se convierte en no mágico si el djinni muere.
Los anillos de Djinni Summoning son creados a menudo por el djinn que llaman y dan a los mortales como regalos de amistad o fichas de estima.

item.name: Ring of Earth Elemental Command
entries: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on attack rolls against elementals from the Elemental Plane of Earth and they have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, you have access to properties based on the Elemental Plane of Earth.
The ring has 5 charges. It regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. Spells cast from the ring have a save DC of 17.

You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast {@spell dominate monster} on an {@creature earth elemental}. In addition, you can move in {@quickref difficult terrain||3} that is composed of rubble, rocks, or dirt as if it were normal terrain. You can also speak and understand Terran.
If you help slay an {@creature earth elemental} while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:

items: You have resistance to acid damage.
You can move through solid earth or rock as if those areas were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. If you end your turn there, you are shunted out to the nearest unoccupied space you last occupied.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: {@spell stone shape} (2 charges), {@spell stoneskin} (3 charges), or {@spell wall of stone} (3 charges).

item.name_es: Anillo del Mando Elemental de la Tierra

El anillo tiene 5 cargos. Recupera {@dice 1d4 + 1} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Los discursos lanzados del anillo tienen un DC salvo de 17.

Si ayuda a matar un {@creature earth elemental} mientras se ajusta al anillo, obtiene acceso a las siguientes propiedades adicionales:

entries: While wearing the ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against Elementals and they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against you.

On a failed save, the Elemental has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.

items.name: Elemental Bane
entries: While wearing the ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against Elementals and they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against you.

entries: While wearing the ring, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 feet of yourself. The Elemental makes a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. entries.name: Elemental Focus
entries: While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane:

items.name: Earth
entries: You know Terran, and you have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Acid damage. Terrain composed of rubble, rocks, or dirt isn't {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for you. In addition, you can move through solid earth or rock as if those areas were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} without disturbing the matter through which you pass. If you end your turn in solid earth or rock, you are shunted out to the nearest unoccupied space you last occupied.
entries_es: Conoces a Terran, y tienes {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} a daño ácido. El terreno compuesto de escombros, rocas o suciedad no es {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} para usted. Si terminas tu turno en tierra firme o roca, eres removido hacia el espacio no ocupado más cercano que ocupaste.

item.name: Ring of Fire Elemental Command
entries: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on attack rolls against elementals from the Elemental Plane of Fire and they have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, you have access to properties based on the Elemental Plane of Fire.
The ring has 5 charges. It regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. Spells cast from the ring have a save DC of 17.
You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast {@spell dominate monster} on a {@creature fire elemental}. In addition, you have resistance to fire damage. You can also speak and understand Ignan.
If you help slay a {@creature fire elemental} while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:

items: You are immune to fire damage.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: {@spell burning hands} (1 charge), {@spell fireball} (2 charges), and {@spell wall of fire} (3 charges).

entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, usted tiene ventaja en los rollos de ataque contra elementales del Plano Elemental de Fuego y tienen desventaja en los rollos de ataque contra usted. Además, tiene acceso a propiedades basadas en el Plano Elemental de Fuego.
El anillo tiene 5 cargos. Recupera {@dice 1d4 + 1} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Los discursos lanzados del anillo tienen un DC salvo de 17.

Usted puede gastar 2 de los cargos del anillo para lanzar {@spell dominate monster} en un {@creature fire elemental}. Además, usted tiene resistencia al daño al fuego. También puedes hablar y entender Ignan.
Si ayuda a matar un {@creature fire elemental} mientras se ajusta al anillo, obtiene acceso a las siguientes propiedades adicionales:

items: You are immune to fire damage.
You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: {@spell burning hands} (1 charge), {@spell fireball} (2 charges), and {@spell wall of fire} (3 charges).

entries: While wearing this ring, you can turn {@condition invisible} as an action. Anything you are wearing or carrying is {@condition invisible} with you. You remain {@condition invisible} until the ring is removed, until you attack or cast a spell, or until you use a bonus action to become visible again.

Quedas {@condition invisible} hasta que el anillo sea eliminado, hasta que atacas o lanzas un hechizo, o hasta que uses una acción de bonificación para volverte visible.

item.name: Ring of Invisibility

item.name: Ring of Jumping
entries: While wearing this ring, you can cast the {@spell jump} spell from it as a bonus action at will, but can target only yourself when you do so.

item.name: Ring of Mind Shielding
entries: While wearing this ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type. Creatures can telepathically communicate with you only if you allow it.
You can use an action to cause the ring to become {@condition invisible} until you use another action to make it visible, until you remove the ring, or until you die.

If you die while wearing the ring, your soul enters it, unless it already houses a soul. You can remain in the ring or depart for the afterlife. As long as your soul is in the ring, you can telepathically communicate with any creature wearing it. A wearer can't prevent this telepathic communication.
entries_es: Mientras usas este anillo, eres inmune a la magia que permite a otras criaturas leer tus pensamientos, determinar si estás mintiendo, conocer tu alineación o conocer tu tipo de criatura. Las criaturas pueden comunicarse telepáticamente con usted sólo si lo permite.

item.name: Ring of Red Fury
entries: This ring has a stripe of ruidium running through it. While wearing the ring, you gain the following benefits:

items: You can breathe water.
You gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

entries.name: Ruidium Rage
entries: As a bonus action, you can use the ring to gain the following benefits, which last for 1 minute or until you are {@condition incapacitated}:

items: You have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
When you hit with an attack, you can add your proficiency bonus to the damage roll.
Difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement, and you are immune to the {@condition paralyzed} and {@condition restrained} conditions.

entries: You can't use this property of the ring again until you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Como acción de bonificación, puede utilizar el anillo para obtener los siguientes beneficios, que duran 1 minuto o hasta que usted sea {@condition incapacitated}:

items: You have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
When you hit with an attack, you can add your proficiency bonus to the damage roll.
Difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement, and you are immune to the {@condition paralyzed} and {@condition restrained} conditions.

entries_es: No puedes usar esta propiedad del anillo hasta que termines un largo descanso.

entries.name: Ruidium Corruption
entries: When you use the Ruidium Rage property of the ring, you must make a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, you gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}. If you are not already suffering from ruidium corruption, you become corrupted when you fail this save.
entries_es: Cuando utiliza la propiedad Ruidium Rage del anillo, debe hacer un {@dc 20} Charisma ahorrando. En un ahorro fallido, usted gana 1 nivel de {@condition exhaustion}. Si usted no está ya sufriendo de corrupción ruidium, usted se corrompe cuando falla este ahorro.

entries.name: If Ruidium Is Destroyed
entries: If the Apotheon is killed or redeemed, all the ruidium in Exandria is destroyed instantly, and the ring of red fury becomes a {@item ring of free action}.
entries_es: Si el apoteón es asesinado o redimido, todo el ruidium en Exandria es destruido instantáneamente, y el anillo de piel roja se convierte en un {@item ring of free action}.

item.name: Ring of Regeneration
entries: While wearing this ring, you regain {@dice 1d6} hit points every 10 minutes, provided that you have at least 1 hit point. If you lose a body part, the ring causes the missing part to regrow and return to full functionality after {@dice 1d6 + 1} days if you have at least 1 hit point the whole time.
entries_es: Al llevar este anillo, usted recupera [[TAG0] puntos de éxito cada 10 minutos, siempre que tenga al menos 1 punto de encuentro. Si pierdes una parte del cuerpo, el anillo hace que la parte que falta vuelva a aparecer y vuelva a la funcionalidad completa después de [[TAG1] días si tienes al menos 1 punto de impacto todo el tiempo.

item.name: Ring of Shooting Stars
entries: While wearing this ring in dim light or darkness, you can cast {@spell dancing lights} and {@spell light} from the ring at will. Casting either spell from the ring requires an action.
The ring has 6 charges for the following other properties. The ring regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges daily at dawn.

entries.name: Faerie Fire
entries: You can expend 1 charge as an action to cast {@spell faerie fire} from the ring.
entries_es: Usted puede gastar 1 cargo como una acción para lanzar {@spell faerie fire} del anillo.

entries.name: Ball Lightning
entries: You can expend 2 charges as an action to create one to four 3-foot-diameter spheres of lightning. The more spheres you create, the less powerful each sphere is individually.

Each sphere appears in an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet of you. The spheres last as long as you concentrate (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell), up to 1 minute. Each sphere sheds dim light in a 30-foot radius.

As a bonus action, you can move each sphere up to 30 feet, but no farther than 120 feet away from you. When a creature other than you comes within 5 feet of a sphere, the sphere discharges lightning at that creature and disappears. That creature must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes lightning damage based on the number of spheres you created. (4 spheres = {@damage 2d4}, 3 spheres = {@damage 2d6}, 2 spheres = {@damage 5d4}, 1 sphere = {@damage 4d12})
entries_es: Puedes gastar 2 cargos como acción para crear una a cuatro esferas de rayos de 3 pies de diámetro. Cuanto más esferas creas, menos poderosa es cada esfera individualmente.

Cada esfera aparece en un espacio no ocupado que se puede ver a menos de 120 pies de usted. Las esferas duran tanto como se concentre (como si {@status concentration||concentrating} en un hechizo), hasta 1 minuto. Cada esfera arroja luz en un radio de 30 pies.

Como una acción de bonificación, puede mover cada esfera hasta 30 pies, pero no más de 120 pies de distancia de usted. Cuando una criatura que no sea tú viene a 5 pies de una esfera, la esfera descarga el relámpago a esa criatura y desaparece. Esa criatura debe hacer un {@dc 15} Un lanzamiento de ahorro de destreza. En un fallido ahorro, la criatura toma daños relámpagos basados en el número de esferas que creó. (4 esferas = {@damage 2d4}, 3 esferas = {@damage 2d6}, 2 esferas = {@damage 5d4}], 1 esfera = {@damage 4d12})

entries.name: Shooting Stars
entries: You can expend 1 to 3 charges as an action. For every charge you expend, you launch a glowing mote of light from the ring at a point you can see within 60 feet of you. Each creature within a 15-foot cube originating from that point is showered in sparks and must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d4} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries_es: Puedes gastar 1 a 3 cargos como acción. Por cada carga que gastas, lanzas una brillante muda de luz desde el anillo en un punto que puedes ver dentro de 60 pies de ti. Cada criatura dentro de un cubo de 15 pies proveniente de ese punto se ducha en chispas y debe hacer un {@dc 15}] Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d4}] fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Cada criatura de 15 pies {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} originada desde ese punto se ducha en chispas y hace un {@dc 15}] Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d4} Daño radiante en un ahorro fallido o la mitad de daño en uno exitoso.

item.name: Ring of Spell Storing
entries: This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 5 levels worth of spells at a time. When found, it contains {@dice 1d6 - 1} levels of stored spells chosen by the DM.

Any creature can cast a spell of 1st through 5th level into the ring by touching the ring as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect, other than to be stored in the ring. If the ring can't hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.

While wearing this ring, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster, but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the ring is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.
entries_es: Este anillo almacena hechizos lanzados en él, sosteniendolos hasta que el usuario afinado los utiliza. El anillo puede almacenar hasta 5 niveles de hechizos a la vez. Cuando se encuentra, contiene [[TAG0] niveles de hechizos almacenados elegidos por el DM.

Cualquier criatura puede lanzar un hechizo de 1o a 5o nivel en el anillo tocando el anillo como el hechizo es lanzado. El hechizo no tiene efecto, aparte de ser almacenado en el anillo. Si el anillo no puede contener el hechizo, el hechizo se gasta sin efecto. El nivel de la ranura utilizada para lanzar el hechizo determina cuánto espacio utiliza.

Mientras usa este anillo, puede lanzar cualquier hechizo almacenado en él. El hechizo utiliza el nivel de ranura, hechizo ahorro DC, bonificación de ataque de hechizo, y habilidad de ortografía de la casta original, pero se trata de otra manera como si usted lanzó el hechizo. El hechizo lanzado desde el anillo ya no está almacenado en él, liberando espacio.

item.name: Ring of Spell Storing
entries: This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 5 levels worth of spells at a time. When found, it contains {@dice 1d6 - 1} levels of stored spells chosen by the DM.

Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 5 into the ring by touching the ring as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect other than to be stored in the ring. If the ring can't hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.

While wearing this ring, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the ring is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.
entries_es: Este anillo almacena hechizos lanzados en él, sosteniendolos hasta que el usuario afinado los utiliza. El anillo puede almacenar hasta 5 niveles de hechizos a la vez. Cuando se encuentra, contiene [[TAG0] niveles de hechizos almacenados elegidos por el DM.

Cualquier criatura puede lanzar un hechizo de nivel 1 a 5 en el anillo tocando el anillo como el hechizo es lanzado. El hechizo no tiene ningún efecto aparte de ser almacenado en el anillo. Si el anillo no puede contener el hechizo, el hechizo se gasta sin efecto. El nivel de la ranura utilizada para lanzar el hechizo determina cuánto espacio utiliza.

Mientras usa este anillo, puede lanzar cualquier hechizo almacenado en él. El hechizo utiliza el nivel de ranura, hechizo ahorro DC, bonificación de ataque de hechizos, y habilidad de ortografía de la casta original pero se trata de otra manera como si usted lanzó el hechizo. El hechizo lanzado desde el anillo ya no está almacenado en él, liberando espacio.

item.name: Ring of Spell Turning
entries: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on saving throws against any spell that targets only you (not in an area of effect). In addition, if you roll a 20 for the save and the spell is 7th level or lower, the spell has no effect on you and instead targets the caster, using the slot level, spell save DC, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the caster.
entries_es: Al usar este anillo, usted tiene ventaja en el ahorro de tiros contra cualquier hechizo que se dirige sólo a usted (no en un área de efecto). Además, si usted roda un 20 para el ahorro y el hechizo es 7o nivel o inferior, el hechizo no tiene ningún efecto en usted y en lugar de destino el caster, utilizando el nivel de ranura, hechizo ahorrar DC, ataque de bonificación, y la habilidad de la castra.

item.name: Ring of Spell Turning
entries: While wearing this ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells. If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you. If that spell targeted only you and didn't create an area of effect, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster; the caster must make a saving throw against the spell using their own spell save DC.
entries_es: Mientras llevas este anillo, tienes {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en lanzamientos de ahorro contra hechizos. Si tienes éxito en el ahorro para un hechizo de nivel 7 o inferior, el hechizo no tiene efecto en ti. Si ese hechizo solo te apuntaba y no creaste un área de efecto, puedes tomar un {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}] para desviar el hechizo de nuevo en la casta del hechizo; la castra debe hacer un lanzamiento de ahorro contra el hechizo usando su propio hechizo salvo DC.

item.name: Ring of Swimming
entries: You have a swimming speed of 40 feet while wearing this ring.
entries_es: Tienes una velocidad de natación de 40 pies mientras usas este anillo.

item.name: Ring of Swimming
entries: You have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} of 40 feet while wearing this ring.
entries_es: Usted tiene un {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} de 40 pies mientras usa este anillo.

item.name: Ring of Telekinesis
entries: While wearing this ring, you can cast the {@spell telekinesis} spell at will, but you can target only objects that aren't being worn or carried.
entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, puede lanzar el hechizo {@spell telekinesis} a voluntad, pero sólo se pueden apuntar objetos que no están siendo usados o llevados.

item.name: Ring of Telekinesis
entries: While wearing this ring, you can cast {@spell Telekinesis|XPHB} from it.
entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, puede echar {@spell Telekinesis|XPHB} de él.

item.name: Ring of Temporal Salvation
entries: If you die while wearing this gray crystal ring, you vanish and reappear in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the space you left (or the nearest unoccupied space). You have a number of hit points equal to {@dice 3d6} + your Constitution modifier. If your hit point maximum is lower than the number of hit points you regain, your hit point maximum rises to a similar amount. If you have any levels of {@condition exhaustion}, reduce your level of {@condition exhaustion} by 1. Once the ring is used, it turns to dust and is destroyed.
entries_es: Si mueres mientras llevas este anillo de cristal gris, desapareces y vuelves a aparecer en un espacio no ocupado a 5 pies del espacio que dejaste (o el espacio no ocupado más cercano). Usted tiene una serie de puntos de éxito iguales a {@dice 3d6} + su modificador de la Constitución. Si el máximo de su punto de impacto es menor que el número de puntos de éxito que recupera, el máximo de su punto de impacto aumenta a una cantidad similar. Si tiene algún nivel de {@condition exhaustion}, reduzca su nivel de {@condition exhaustion} por 1. Una vez que se utiliza el anillo, se convierte en polvo y se destruye.

item.name: Ring of the Copycat
entries: You gain the ability to channel energy from allies to cast spells, even if you normally can't. When an ally within 60 feet of you casts a spell that you normally can't cast and that requires 10 gp or fewer in material components, you may use a reaction to cast that spell. When cast in this way, the spell is cast using your ally's spellcasting ability, spell save DC, and spell attack bonus, as needed. You decide this cloned spell's target, as specified in the spell's description, and the spell originates from you. After you use this ability, your ally can't cast this spell again until they finish a long rest.
entries_es: Ganas la capacidad de canalizar energía de los aliados para lanzar hechizos, incluso si normalmente no puedes. Cuando un aliado dentro de 60 pies de usted lanza un hechizo que normalmente no puede fundir y que requiere 10 gp o menos en componentes materiales, puede utilizar una reacción para lanzar ese hechizo. Cuando se lanza de esta manera, el hechizo es lanzado usando la habilidad de deletrear de tu aliado, ahorrar hechizo DC, y bonificación de ataque de hechizo, según sea necesario. Usted decide el objetivo de este hechizo clonado, como se especifica en la descripción del hechizo, y el hechizo se origina de usted. Después de usar esta habilidad, su aliado no puede volver a lanzar este hechizo hasta que terminen un largo descanso.

item.name: Ring of the Orator
entries: This ring has 6 charges. While you wear it, you can expend 1 of its charges to project your voice to be heard clearly by all creatures within 1 mile of yourself, regardless of intervening noise, for 1 minute. Magical silence, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood blocks this projection. If you project your voice while speaking a language the listening creatures don't understand, you can make the creatures understand what you're saying. You must be able to see the creatures to make them understand. The ring regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges daily at dawn.
entries_es: Este anillo tiene 6 cargos. Mientras lo usas, puedes gastar 1 de sus cargos para proyectar tu voz para ser escuchada claramente por todas las criaturas dentro de 1 milla de ti mismo, independientemente del ruido interveniente, durante 1 minuto. El silencio mágico, 1 pie de piedra, 1 pulgada de metal común, una hoja delgada de plomo, o 3 pies de madera bloquea esta proyección. Si proyectas tu voz mientras hablas un idioma, las criaturas que escuchan no entienden, puedes hacer que las criaturas entiendan lo que estás diciendo. Debes poder ver a las criaturas para hacerles comprender. El anillo recupera {@dice 1d6} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer.

item.name: Ring of the Ram
entries: This ring has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can use an action to expend 1 to 3 of its charges to make a ranged spell attack against one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The ring produces a spectral ram's head and makes its attack roll with a +7 bonus. On a hit, for each charge you spend, the target takes {@damage 2d10} force damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Alternatively, you can expend 1 to 3 of the ring's charges as an action to try to break an object you can see within 60 feet of you that isn't being worn or carried. The ring makes a Strength check with a +5 bonus for each charge you spend.
entries_es: Este anillo tiene 3 cargos, y recupera [[TAG0] cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Mientras usas el anillo, puedes usar una acción para gastar 1 a 3 de sus cargos para hacer un ataque de hechizos contra una criatura que puedes ver a menos de 60 pies de ti. El anillo produce la cabeza de un carnero espectral y hace su rollo de ataque con un bono +7. En un golpe, por cada carga que gastas, el objetivo toma [[TAG1] daño de fuerza y es empujado a 5 pies de distancia de ti.

Alternativamente, puede gastar 1 a 3 de los cargos del anillo como una acción para intentar romper un objeto que puede ver dentro de 60 pies de usted que no está siendo usado o llevado. El anillo hace una comprobación de fuerza con un bono +5 por cada cargo que gastas.

item.name: Ring of the Ram
entries: This ring has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to expend 1 to 3 charges to make a ranged spell attack against one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The ring produces a spectral ram's head and makes its attack roll with a +7 bonus. On a hit, for each charge you spend, the target takes {@damage 2d10} Force damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Alternatively, you can expend 1 to 3 of the ring's charges as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to try to break a nonmagical object you can see within 60 feet of yourself that isn't being worn or carried. The ring makes a Strength check with a +5 bonus for each charge you spend.
entries_es: Este anillo tiene 3 cargos y recupera {@dice 1d3} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Mientras usas el anillo, puedes tomar una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para gastar 1 a 3 cargos para hacer un ataque de hechizo extendido contra una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 60 pies de ti mismo. El anillo produce la cabeza de un carnero espectral y hace su rollo de ataque con un bono +7. En un golpe, por cada carga que gastas, el objetivo toma {@damage 2d10} Daño de la fuerza y es empujado a 5 pies de distancia de usted.

Alternativamente, puedes gastar 1 a 3 de los cargos del anillo como una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para intentar romper un objeto no mágico que puedes ver dentro de 60 pies de ti mismo que no está siendo usado o llevado. El anillo hace una comprobación de fuerza con un bono +5 por cada cargo que gastas.

item.name: Ring of Three Wishes
entries: While wearing this ring, you can use an action to expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast the {@spell wish} spell from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.
entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, puede utilizar una acción para gastar 1 de sus 3 cargos para emitir el hechizo {@spell wish} de él. El anillo no es mágico cuando usas la última carga.

item.name: Ring of Three Wishes
entries: While wearing this ring, you can expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast {@spell Wish|XPHB} from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.
entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, puede expulsar 1 de sus 3 cargos para echar {@spell Wish|XPHB} de él. El anillo no es mágico cuando usas la última carga.

item.name: Ring of Thunder Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance}
entries_es: [[TAG0]

item.name: Ring of Thunder Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|XDMG}
entries_es: [[TAG0]

item.name: Ring of Treachery
entries: This ring has 3 charges. While wearing this ring, when you're damaged, you may use a reaction to expend a charge and transfer that damage to a random creature (which could include an ally) within 60 feet. All charges are restored when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Este anillo tiene 3 cargos. Mientras usa este anillo, cuando está dañado, puede usar una reacción para gastar un cargo y transferir ese daño a una criatura al azar (que podría incluir un aliado) a menos de 60 pies. Todos los cargos son restaurados cuando terminas un largo descanso.

item.name: Ring of Truth Telling
entries: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks to determine whether someone is lying to you.
entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, usted tiene ventaja en la Sabiduría ( {@skill Insight}) cheques para determinar si alguien está mintiendo a usted.

item.name: Ring of Warmth
entries: While wearing this ring, you have resistance to cold damage. In addition, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit.
entries_es: Mientras llevas este anillo, tienes resistencia al daño frío. Además, tú y todo lo que llevas y llevas no están dañados por temperaturas tan bajas como -50 grados Fahrenheit.

item.name: Ring of Warmth
entries: If you take Cold damage while wearing this ring, the ring reduces the damage you take by {@dice 2d8}.
In addition, while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.
entries_es: Si usted toma daño frío mientras lleva este anillo, el anillo reduce el daño que usted toma por {@dice 2d8}.
Además, mientras llevas este anillo, tú y todo lo que llevas y llevas no están dañados por temperaturas de 0 grados Fahrenheit o inferior.

item.name: Ring of Water Elemental Command
entries: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on attack rolls against elementals from the Elemental Plane of Water and they have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. In addition, you have access to properties based on the Elemental Plane of Water.
The ring has 5 charges. It regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. Spells cast from the ring have a save DC of 17.

You can expend 2 of the ring's charges to cast {@spell dominate monster} on a {@creature water elemental}. In addition, you can stand on and walk across liquid surfaces as if they were solid ground. You can also speak and understand Aquan.
If you help slay a {@creature water elemental} while attuned to the ring, you gain access to the following additional properties:

items: You can breathe underwater and have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: {@spell create or destroy water} (1 charge), {@spell control water} (3 charges), {@spell ice storm} (2 charges), or {@spell wall of ice} (3 charges).

item.name_es: Anillo del Mando Elemental del Agua
entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, usted tiene ventaja en los rollos de ataque contra elementales del Plano Elemental del Agua y tienen desventaja en los rollos de ataque contra usted. Además, tiene acceso a propiedades basadas en el Plano Elemental de Agua.
El anillo tiene 5 cargos. Recupera {@dice 1d4 + 1} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Los discursos lanzados del anillo tienen un DC salvo de 17.

Usted puede gastar 2 de los cargos del anillo para lanzar {@spell dominate monster} en un {@creature water elemental}. Además, puede ponerse de pie y caminar a través de superficies líquidas como si fueran terreno sólido. También puede hablar y entender Aquan.
Si ayuda a matar un {@creature water elemental} mientras se ajusta al anillo, obtiene acceso a las siguientes propiedades adicionales:

items: You can breathe underwater and have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

You can cast the following spells from the ring, expending the necessary number of charges: {@spell create or destroy water} (1 charge), {@spell control water} (3 charges), {@spell ice storm} (2 charges), or {@spell wall of ice} (3 charges).

item.name: Ring of Water Walking
entries: While wearing this ring, you can stand on and move across any liquid surface as if it were solid ground.
entries_es: Mientras lleva este anillo, puede ponerse de pie y moverse a través de cualquier superficie líquida como si fuera tierra sólida.

item.name: Ring of Water Walking
entries: While wearing this ring, you cast {@spell Water Walk|XPHB} from it, targeting only yourself.
entries_es: Mientras llevas este anillo, echas {@spell Water Walk|XPHB} de él, apuntando sólo a ti mismo.

item.name: Ring of Winter
entries: {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} has kept this item in his possession for over a century. The Ring of Winter is a golden band that resizes to fit snugly on the finger of its wearer. A thin layer of frost coats the outside of the ring, which normal heat can't melt. The ring feels ice cold to the touch and initially numbs the hand that wears it, but this cold ceases to be felt by one who is attuned to this ring.

The Ring of Winter is sentient and tries to take control of any creature that wears it (see "Sentient Magic Items" chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master's Guide). If it succeeds, the ring compels its wearer to cause undue harm to everyone and everything around it, in a cold-hearted attempt to incur the wrath of enemies and bring the wearer's doom.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: The Ring of Winter is a sentient chaotic evil item with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 14, and a Charisma of 17. The ring communicates by transmitting emotion to the creature carrying or wielding it, and it has hearing and normal vision out to a range of 60 feet. The ring craves destruction, and it likes inflicting indiscriminate harm on others.
entries_es: El Anillo de Invierno es un elemento caótico sensible con una Inteligencia de 14, una Sabiduría de 14, y una Charisma de 17. El anillo se comunica transmitiendo emoción a la criatura que la lleva o la manipula, y tiene oído y visión normal a una gama de 60 pies. El anillo anhela la destrucción, y le gusta infligir daño indiscriminado a otros.

entries.name: Nondetection
entries: The Ring of Winter defies attempts to magically locate it. Neither the ring nor its wearer can be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.
entries_es: El Anillo de Invierno intenta ubicarlo mágicamente. Ni el anillo ni su portador pueden ser atacados por cualquier magia de adivinación o percibidos a través de sensores mágicos.

entries.name: Frozen Time
entries: As long as you wear the ring, you don't age naturally. This effect is similar to suspended animation, in that your age doesn't catch up to you once the ring is removed. The ring doesn't protect its wearer from magical or supernatural aging effects, such as the Horrifying Visage of a {@creature ghost}.
entries_es: Mientras lleves el anillo, no envejeces naturalmente. Este efecto es similar a la animación suspendida, ya que tu edad no te alcanza una vez que se quita el anillo. El anillo no protege a su portador de efectos de envejecimiento mágicos o sobrenaturales, como el Visado Horrible de un [[TAG0].

entries.name: Cold Immunity
entries: While attuned to and wearing the ring, you have immunity to cold damage and don't suffer any ill effects from extreme cold (see chapter 5 of the Dungeon's Master Guide).
entries_es: Mientras se atrevía a y llevaba el anillo, usted tiene inmunidad a daños fríos y no sufre ningún efecto malo del frío extremo (véase el capítulo 5 de la Guía Maestro de Dungeon).

entries.name: Magic
entries: The Ring of Winter has 12 charges and regains all its expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can expend the necessary number of charges to activate one of the following properties:

items: You can expend 1 charge as an action and use the ring to lower the temperature in a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within 300 feet of you. The temperature in that area drops 20 degrees per minute, to a minimum of -30 degrees Fahrenheit. Frost and ice begin to form on surfaces once the temperature drops below 32 degrees. This effect is permanent unless you use the ring to end it as an action, at which point the temperature in the area returns to normal at a rate of 10 degrees per minute.

You can cast one of the following spells from the ring (spell save {@dc 17}) by expending the necessary number of charges: {@spell Bigby's hand} (2 charges; the hand is made of ice, is immune to cold damage, and deals bludgeoning damage instead of force damage as a clenched fist), {@spell cone of cold} (2 charges), flesh to ice (3 charges; as {@spell flesh to stone} except that the target turns to solid ice with the density and durability of stone), {@spell ice storm} (2 charges), {@spell Otiluke's freezing sphere} (3 charges), {@spell sleet storm} (1 charge), {@spell spike growth} (1 charge; the spikes are made of ice), or {@spell wall of ice} (2 charges).

You can expend the necessary number of charges as an action and use the ring to create either an inanimate ice object (2 charges) or an animated ice creature (4 charges). The ice object can't have any moving parts, must be able to fit inside a 10-foot cube, and has the density and durability of metal or stone (your choice). The ice creature must be modeled after a beast with a challenge rating of 2 or less. The ice creature has the same statistics as the beast it models, with the following changes: the creature is a construct with vulnerability to fire damage, immunity to cold and poison damage, and immunity to the following conditions: {@condition charmed}, {@condition exhaustion}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, and {@condition poisoned}. The ice creature obeys only its creator's commands. The ice object or creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of you. It melts into a pool of normal water after 24 hours or when it drops to 0 hit points. In extreme heat, it loses 5 ({@dice 1d10}) hit points per minute as it melts. Use the guidelines in chapter 8 of the Dungeon Master's Guide to determine the hit points of an inanimate object if they become necessary.

entries_es: El Anillo de Invierno tiene 12 cargos y recupera todos sus cargos enviados diariamente al amanecer. Al usar el anillo, puede enviar el número necesario de cargos para activar una de las siguientes propiedades:

items: You can expend 1 charge as an action and use the ring to lower the temperature in a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within 300 feet of you. The temperature in that area drops 20 degrees per minute, to a minimum of -30 degrees Fahrenheit. Frost and ice begin to form on surfaces once the temperature drops below 32 degrees. This effect is permanent unless you use the ring to end it as an action, at which point the temperature in the area returns to normal at a rate of 10 degrees per minute.

You can cast one of the following spells from the ring (spell save {@dc 17}) by expending the necessary number of charges: {@spell Bigby's hand} (2 charges; the hand is made of ice, is immune to cold damage, and deals bludgeoning damage instead of force damage as a clenched fist), {@spell cone of cold} (2 charges), flesh to ice (3 charges; as {@spell flesh to stone} except that the target turns to solid ice with the density and durability of stone), {@spell ice storm} (2 charges), {@spell Otiluke's freezing sphere} (3 charges), {@spell sleet storm} (1 charge), {@spell spike growth} (1 charge; the spikes are made of ice), or {@spell wall of ice} (2 charges).

You can expend the necessary number of charges as an action and use the ring to create either an inanimate ice object (2 charges) or an animated ice creature (4 charges). The ice object can't have any moving parts, must be able to fit inside a 10-foot cube, and has the density and durability of metal or stone (your choice). The ice creature must be modeled after a beast with a challenge rating of 2 or less. The ice creature has the same statistics as the beast it models, with the following changes: the creature is a construct with vulnerability to fire damage, immunity to cold and poison damage, and immunity to the following conditions: {@condition charmed}, {@condition exhaustion}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, and {@condition poisoned}. The ice creature obeys only its creator's commands. The ice object or creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of you. It melts into a pool of normal water after 24 hours or when it drops to 0 hit points. In extreme heat, it loses 5 ({@dice 1d10}) hit points per minute as it melts. Use the guidelines in chapter 8 of the Dungeon Master's Guide to determine the hit points of an inanimate object if they become necessary.

entries.name: Other Properties
entries: The Ring of Winter is rumored to possess other properties that can be activated only by an evil being whose will the ring can't break. Frost giants have long believed that the ring can be used to freeze entire worlds, while a {@creature djinni} in the service of a Calishite pasha once claimed that the ring could be used to summon and control white dragons, as well as the mighty ice primordial named Cryonax.
entries_es: El Anillo del Invierno se rumorea que posee otras propiedades que sólo pueden ser activadas por un ser maligno cuya voluntad el anillo no puede romper. Los gigantes Frost han creído durante mucho tiempo que el anillo se puede utilizar para congelar mundos enteros, mientras que un {@creature djinni} al servicio de un pasha Calishite una vez afirmó que el anillo podría ser usado para convocar y controlar dragones blancos, así como el poderoso hielo primordial llamado Cryonax.

entries.name: Destroying the Ring
entries: The ring is nigh indestructible, resisting even the most intense magical heat. If it is placed on the finger of the powerful archfey known as the Summer Queen, the ring melts away and is destroyed forever.
entries_es: El anillo es casi indestructible, resistiendo incluso el calor mágico más intenso. Si se coloca en el dedo del poderoso arquero conocido como la Reina del Verano, el anillo se derrite y es destruido para siempre.

{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} ha mantenido este artículo en su posesión durante más de un siglo. El Anillo de Invierno es una banda de oro que se redimensiona para encajar con el dedo de su portador. Una capa delgada de heladas cubre el exterior del anillo, que el calor normal no puede derretirse. El anillo siente hielo frío al tacto e inicialmente adormece la mano que la lleva, pero este frío deja de ser sentido por uno que está afinado a este anillo.

El Anillo del Invierno es sensible y trata de tomar el control de cualquier criatura que lo use (ver "Sentient Magic Items" capítulo 7 de la Guía del Maestro de Dungeon). Si tiene éxito, el anillo obliga a su portador a causar daño indebido a todo el mundo y todo lo que lo rodea, en un intento frío de incurrir en la ira de los enemigos y traer la condena del portador.

entries_es.name: Sentience
entries: The Ring of Winter is a sentient chaotic evil item with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 14, and a Charisma of 17. The ring communicates by transmitting emotion to the creature carrying or wielding it, and it has hearing and normal vision out to a range of 60 feet. The ring craves destruction, and it likes inflicting indiscriminate harm on others.
entries_es: El Anillo de Invierno es un elemento caótico sensible con una Inteligencia de 14, una Sabiduría de 14, y una Charisma de 17. El anillo se comunica transmitiendo emoción a la criatura que la lleva o la manipula, y tiene oído y visión normal a una gama de 60 pies. El anillo anhela la destrucción, y le gusta infligir daño indiscriminado a otros.

entries_es.name: Nondetection
entries: The Ring of Winter defies attempts to magically locate it. Neither the ring nor its wearer can be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.
entries_es: El Anillo de Invierno intenta ubicarlo mágicamente. Ni el anillo ni su portador pueden ser atacados por cualquier magia de adivinación o percibidos a través de sensores mágicos.

entries_es.name: Frozen Time
entries: As long as you wear the ring, you don't age naturally. This effect is similar to suspended animation, in that your age doesn't catch up to you once the ring is removed. The ring doesn't protect its wearer from magical or supernatural aging effects, such as the Horrifying Visage of a {@creature ghost}.
entries_es: Mientras lleves el anillo, no envejeces naturalmente. Este efecto es similar a la animación suspendida, ya que tu edad no te alcanza una vez que se quita el anillo. El anillo no protege a su portador de efectos de envejecimiento mágicos o sobrenaturales, como el Visado Horrible de un [[TAG0].

entries_es.name: Cold Immunity
entries: While attuned to and wearing the ring, you have immunity to cold damage and don't suffer any ill effects from extreme cold (see chapter 5 of the Dungeon's Master Guide).
entries_es: Mientras se atrevía a y llevaba el anillo, usted tiene inmunidad a daños fríos y no sufre ningún efecto malo del frío extremo (véase el capítulo 5 de la Guía Maestro de Dungeon).

entries_es.name: Magic
entries: The Ring of Winter has 12 charges and regains all its expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can expend the necessary number of charges to activate one of the following properties:

items: You can expend 1 charge as an action and use the ring to lower the temperature in a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within 300 feet of you. The temperature in that area drops 20 degrees per minute, to a minimum of -30 degrees Fahrenheit. Frost and ice begin to form on surfaces once the temperature drops below 32 degrees. This effect is permanent unless you use the ring to end it as an action, at which point the temperature in the area returns to normal at a rate of 10 degrees per minute.

You can cast one of the following spells from the ring (spell save {@dc 17}) by expending the necessary number of charges: {@spell Bigby's hand} (2 charges; the hand is made of ice, is immune to cold damage, and deals bludgeoning damage instead of force damage as a clenched fist), {@spell cone of cold} (2 charges), flesh to ice (3 charges; as {@spell flesh to stone} except that the target turns to solid ice with the density and durability of stone), {@spell ice storm} (2 charges), {@spell Otiluke's freezing sphere} (3 charges), {@spell sleet storm} (1 charge), {@spell spike growth} (1 charge; the spikes are made of ice), or {@spell wall of ice} (2 charges).

You can expend the necessary number of charges as an action and use the ring to create either an inanimate ice object (2 charges) or an animated ice creature (4 charges). The ice object can't have any moving parts, must be able to fit inside a 10-foot cube, and has the density and durability of metal or stone (your choice). The ice creature must be modeled after a beast with a challenge rating of 2 or less. The ice creature has the same statistics as the beast it models, with the following changes: the creature is a construct with vulnerability to fire damage, immunity to cold and poison damage, and immunity to the following conditions: {@condition charmed}, {@condition exhaustion}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, and {@condition poisoned}. The ice creature obeys only its creator's commands. The ice object or creature appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of you. It melts into a pool of normal water after 24 hours or when it drops to 0 hit points. In extreme heat, it loses 5 ({@dice 1d10}) hit points per minute as it melts. Use the guidelines in chapter 8 of the Dungeon Master's Guide to determine the hit points of an inanimate object if they become necessary.

entries_es.name: Other Properties
entries: The Ring of Winter is rumored to possess other properties that can be activated only by an evil being whose will the ring can't break. Frost giants have long believed that the ring can be used to freeze entire worlds, while a {@creature djinni} in the service of a Calishite pasha once claimed that the ring could be used to summon and control white dragons, as well as the mighty ice primordial named Cryonax.
entries_es: El Anillo del Invierno se rumorea que posee otras propiedades que sólo pueden ser activadas por un ser maligno cuya voluntad el anillo no puede romper. Los gigantes Frost han creído durante mucho tiempo que el anillo se puede utilizar para congelar mundos enteros, mientras que un {@creature djinni} al servicio de un pasha Calishite una vez afirmó que el anillo podría ser usado para convocar y controlar dragones blancos, así como el poderoso hielo primordial llamado Cryonax.

entries_es.name: Destroying the Ring
entries: The ring is nigh indestructible, resisting even the most intense magical heat. If it is placed on the finger of the powerful archfey known as the Summer Queen, the ring melts away and is destroyed forever.
entries_es: El anillo es casi indestructible, resistiendo incluso el calor mágico más intenso. Si se coloca en el dedo del poderoso arquero conocido como la Reina del Verano, el anillo se derrite y es destruido para siempre.

item.name: Ring of X-ray Vision
entries: While wearing this ring, you can use an action to speak its command word. When you do so, you can see into and through solid matter for 1 minute. This vision has a radius of 30 feet. To you, solid objects within that radius appear transparent and don't prevent light from passing through them. The vision can penetrate 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or up to 3 feet of wood or dirt. Thicker substances block the vision, as does a thin sheet of lead.
Whenever you use the ring again before taking a long rest, you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain one level of {@condition exhaustion}.
item.name_es: Anillo de visión de rayos X
entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, puede usar una acción para hablar su palabra de comando. Cuando lo haces, puedes ver dentro y a través de materia sólida durante 1 minuto. Esta visión tiene un radio de 30 pies. Para usted, objetos sólidos dentro de ese radio parecen transparentes y no impiden que la luz pase a través de ellos. La visión puede penetrar 1 pie de piedra, 1 pulgada de metal común, o hasta 3 pies de madera o suciedad. Las sustancias delgadas bloquean la visión, al igual que una hoja delgada de plomo.
Cada vez que usas el anillo de nuevo antes de tomar un descanso largo, debes tener éxito en una [[TAG0] Constitución ahorrando lanzamiento o ganando un nivel de {@condition exhaustion}.

item.name: Ring of X-ray Vision
entries: While wearing this ring, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to gain X-ray vision with a range of 30 feet for 1 minute. To you, solid objects within that radius appear transparent and don't prevent light from passing through them. The vision can penetrate 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or up to 3 feet of wood or dirt. Thicker substances or a thin sheet of lead block the vision.
Whenever you use the ring again before taking a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level.
item.name_es: Anillo de visión de rayos X
entries_es: Mientras usa este anillo, puede tomar una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para ganar visión de rayos X con una gama de 30 pies por 1 minuto. Para usted, objetos sólidos dentro de ese radio parecen transparentes y no impiden que la luz pase a través de ellos. La visión puede penetrar 1 pie de piedra, 1 pulgada de metal común, o hasta 3 pies de madera o suciedad. Las sustancias delgadas o una hoja delgada de plomo bloquean la visión.
Cada vez que usas el anillo de nuevo antes de tomar un {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, debes tener éxito en un {@dc 15} Constitución que ahorra lanza o gana 1 nivel {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}.

item.name: Rival Coin
entries: This gold coin has a creature embossed on each side. The two depicted creatures must be famous rivals or enemies of each other. For example, a Rival Coin might show {@book Iggwilv|XDMG|8|Iggwilv} on one side and {@book Mordenkainen|XDMG|8|Mordenkainen} on the other, or {@book Venger|XDMG|8|Venger} on one side and {@book Tiamat|XDMG|8|Tiamat} on the other. One of these figures is on the "heads" side of the coin, the other on the "tails" side.

The coin has 1 charge and regains its expended charge daily at dawn. You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to toss the coin, expending its charge. Roll any die to determine whether the coin comes up heads (on an even number) or tails (on an odd number). The roll also determines the effect:

items.name: Heads
entries: Target one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The target makes a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes {@damage 2d4} Psychic damage and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.
entries_es: Apunta a una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 60 pies de ti mismo. El objetivo hace un {@dc 13} Sabiduría ahorrando lanzamiento. En un ahorro fallido, el objetivo toma {@damage 2d4} Daño psíquico y tiene {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} en el próximo rollo de ataque que hace antes del final de su próximo turno. En un ahorro exitoso, el objetivo sólo tiene la mitad de daño.

items.name: Tails
entries: You take {@damage 1d4} Psychic damage.
entries_es: Usted toma {@damage 1d4} Daño psíquico.

Esta moneda de oro tiene una criatura encarnada en cada lado. Las dos criaturas representadas deben ser rivales famosos o enemigos entre sí. Por ejemplo, un Rival Coin podría mostrar {@book Iggwilv|XDMG|8|Iggwilv} de un lado y {@book Mordenkainen|XDMG|8|Mordenkainen} del otro, o {@book Venger|XDMG|8|Venger} de un lado y {@book Tiamat|XDMG|8|Tiamat} del otro. Una de estas figuras está en el lado "cabezas" de la moneda, la otra en el lado "talles".

La moneda tiene 1 carga y recupera su carga gastada diariamente al amanecer. Usted puede tomar una [[TAG0] acción para tirar la moneda, gastando su carga. Revise cualquier muerte para determinar si la moneda aparece cabezas (en un número uniforme) o colas (en un número impar). El rollo también determina el efecto:

On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

item.name: Robe
entries: A Robe has vocational or ceremonial significance. Some events and locations admit only people wearing a Robe bearing certain colors or symbols.
entries_es: Un Robe tiene significado profesional o ceremonial. Algunos eventos y ubicaciones admiten solamente personas que llevan un Robe con ciertos colores o símbolos.

item.name: Robe of Eyes
entries: This robe is adorned with eyelike patterns. While you wear the robe, you gain the following benefits:

items: The robe lets you see in all directions, and you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
You have {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.
You can see {@condition invisible} creatures and objects, as well as see into the Ethereal Plane, out to a range of 120 feet.

entries: The eyes on the robe can't be closed or averted. Although you can close or avert your own eyes, you are never considered to be doing so while wearing this robe.

A {@spell light} spell cast on the robe or a {@spell daylight} spell cast within 5 feet of the robe causes you to be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. At the end of each of your turns, you can make a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 11} for {@spell light} or {@dc 15} for {@spell daylight}), ending the blindness on a success.
entries_es: Esta túnica está adornada con patrones oculares. Mientras usas la bata, obtienes los siguientes beneficios:

items: The robe lets you see in all directions, and you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
You have {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.
You can see {@condition invisible} creatures and objects, as well as see into the Ethereal Plane, out to a range of 120 feet.

entries_es: Los ojos en el manto no pueden ser cerrados o evitados. Aunque puede cerrar o evitar sus propios ojos, nunca se considera que lo esté haciendo mientras usa esta bata.

Un hechizo [[TAG0] lanzado en la túnica o un hechizo {@spell daylight} lanzado a 5 pies de la túnica hace que seas {@condition blinded} por 1 minuto. Al final de cada uno de sus turnos, se puede hacer un lanzamiento de ahorro de la Constitución ([TAG3]] para {@spell light} o {@dc 15} para {@spell daylight}), terminando la ceguera en un éxito.

item.name: Robe of Eyes
entries: This robe is adorned with eyelike patterns. While you wear the robe, you gain the following benefits:

items.name: All-Around Vision
entries: The robe gives you {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on sight.
entries_es: La bata te da {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en las comprobaciones de Sabiduría ([TAG1]]) que dependen de la vista.

items.name: Special Senses
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} and {@sense Truesight|XPHB}, both with a range of 120 feet.
entries_es: Usted tiene {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} y {@sense Truesight|XPHB}, ambos con una gama de 120 pies.

entries.name: Drawbacks
entries: A {@spell Light|XPHB} spell cast on the robe or a {@spell Daylight|XPHB} spell cast within 5 feet of the robe gives you the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of your turns, you make a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 11} for Light or {@dc 15} for Daylight), ending the condition on yourself on a success.

Al final de cada uno de sus turnos, usted hace un lanzamiento de ahorro de la Constitución ([TAG3]] para Luz o {@dc 15} para la luz del día), terminando la condición sobre usted mismo en un éxito.
