item.name: Sphere of Annihilation
entries: This 2-foot-diameter black sphere is a hole in the multiverse, hovering in space and stabilized by a magical field surrounding it.

The sphere obliterates all matter it passes through and all matter that passes through it. Artifacts are the exception. Unless an artifact is susceptible to damage from a sphere of annihilation, it passes through the sphere unscathed. Anything else that touches the sphere but isn't wholly engulfed and obliterated by it takes {@damage 4d10} force damage.

The sphere is stationary until someone controls it. If you are within 60 feet of an uncontrolled sphere, you can use an action to make a {@dc 25} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. On a success, the sphere levitates in one direction of your choice, up to a number of feet equal to 5 × your Intelligence modifier (minimum 5 feet). On a failure, the sphere moves 10 feet toward you. A creature whose space the sphere enters must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be touched by it, taking {@damage 4d10} force damage.

If you attempt to control a sphere that is under another creature's control, you make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check contested by the other creature's Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. The winner of the contest gains control of the sphere and can levitate it as normal.

If the sphere comes into contact with a planar portal, such as that created by the {@spell gate} spell, or an extradimensional space, such as that within a {@item portable hole}, the DM determines randomly what happens, using the following table.

rows: The sphere is destroyed.
The sphere moves through the portal or into the extradimensional space.
A spatial rift sends each creature and object within 180 feet of the sphere, including the sphere, to a random plane of existence.

entries_es: Esta esfera negra de 2 metros de diámetro es un agujero en el multiverso, flotando en el espacio y estabilizado por un campo mágico que la rodea.

La esfera borra toda la materia que pasa y toda la materia que pasa a través de ella. Los artefactos son la excepción. A menos que un artefacto sea susceptible al daño de una esfera de aniquilación, pasa a través de la esfera sin mancha. Cualquier otra cosa que toque la esfera pero no está totalmente envuelta y borrada por ella toma {@damage 4d10} daño de la fuerza.

La esfera es estacionaria hasta que alguien la controle. Si usted está a menos de 60 pies de una esfera incontrolada, puede utilizar una acción para hacer un {@dc 25} Inteligencia ({@skill Arcana}) cheque. En un éxito, la esfera levita en una dirección de su elección, hasta un número de pies igual a 5 × su modificador de inteligencia (mínimo 5 pies). En un fracaso, la esfera se mueve 10 pies hacia ti. Una criatura cuyo espacio entra la esfera debe tener éxito en un {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or be touch by it, taking [[TAG3] force damage.

Si usted intenta controlar una esfera que está bajo el control de otra criatura, usted hace un control de Inteligencia ([TAG0]]) impugnado por el cheque de la otra criatura ([TAG0]). El ganador del concurso gana el control de la esfera y puede levitarla como normal.

Si la esfera entra en contacto con un portal planar, como el creado por el hechizo {@spell gate}], o un espacio extradimensional, como el dentro de un {@item portable hole}, el DM determina aleatoriamente lo que sucede, utilizando la tabla siguiente.

rows: The sphere is destroyed.
The sphere moves through the portal or into the extradimensional space.
A spatial rift sends each creature and object within 180 feet of the sphere, including the sphere, to a random plane of existence.

item.name: Sphere of Annihilation
entries: This 2-foot-diameter black sphere is a hole in the multiverse, hovering in space and stabilized by a magical field surrounding it.

The sphere obliterates all matter it passes through and all matter that passes through it. Artifacts are the exception. Unless an Artifact is susceptible to damage from a Sphere of Annihilation, it passes through the sphere unscathed. Anything else that touches the sphere but isn't wholly engulfed and obliterated by it takes {@damage 8d10} Force damage.

entries.name: Controlling the Sphere
entries: A Sphere of Annihilation is stationary until someone takes control of it. If you are within 60 feet of a sphere, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to make a {@dc 25} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) check. On a successful check, you control the sphere until the start of your next turn, and if it was under another creature's control, that creature loses control of the sphere. On a failed check, the sphere moves 10 feet toward you in a straight line.

While in control of the sphere, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cause it to move in one direction of your choice, up to a number of feet equal to 5 times your Intelligence modifier (minimum 5 feet). Any creature whose space the sphere enters must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be touched by it, taking {@damage 8d10} Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} by this damage is obliterated, leaving its possessions behind but no other physical remains.
entries_es: Una Esfera de Aniquilación es estacionaria hasta que alguien tome el control de ella. Si usted está a menos de 60 pies de una esfera, puede tomar una [[TAG0] acción para hacer un {@dc 25}] Inteligencia ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}). En un cheque exitoso, controlas la esfera hasta el comienzo de tu próximo turno, y si estaba bajo el control de otra criatura, esa criatura pierde el control de la esfera. En un cheque fallido, la esfera se mueve 10 pies hacia ti en una línea recta.

Mientras controla la esfera, puede tomar un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} para hacer que se mueva en una dirección de su elección, hasta un número de pies iguales a 5 veces su modificador de Inteligencia (mínimo 5 pies). Cualquier criatura cuyo espacio entra la esfera debe tener éxito en un {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be touch by it, taking {@damage 8d10} Daño de la fuerza. Una criatura reducida a 0 [[TAG3] por este daño es borrada, dejando sus posesiones atrás pero no otros restos físicos.

rows: The sphere is destroyed.
The sphere moves through the portal or into the extradimensional space.
A spatial rift sends the sphere and each creature and object within 180 feet of the sphere to a random plane of existence.

item.name: Spider Staff
entries: The top of this black, adamantine staff is shaped like a spider. The staff weighs 6 pounds. You must be attuned to the staff to gain its benefits and cast its spells. The staff can be wielded as a quarterstaff. It deals {@damage 1d6} extra poison damage on a hit when used to make a weapon attack.

The staff has 10 charges, which are used to fuel the spells within it. With the staff in hand, you can use your action to cast one of the following spells from the staff if the spell is on your class's spell list: {@spell spider climb} (1 charge) or {@spell web} (2 charges, spell save {@dc 15}). No components are required.
The staff regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges each day at dusk. If you expend the staff's last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the staff crumbles to dust and is destroyed.
entries_es: La parte superior de este personal negro de adamantina está formada como una araña. El personal pesa 6 libras. Usted debe ser afinado al personal para obtener sus beneficios y lanzar sus hechizos. El personal puede ser manipulado como quarterstaff. Se trata [[TAG0] de daño tóxico extra en un golpe cuando se utiliza para hacer un ataque de arma.

El personal tiene 10 cargos, que se utilizan para alimentar los hechizos dentro de él. Con el personal a la mano, puede utilizar su acción para lanzar uno de los siguientes hechizos del personal si el hechizo está en la lista de hechizos de su clase: {@spell spider climb} (1 cargo) o {@spell web} (2 cargos, salvo hechizo {@dc 15}]). No se requieren componentes.

El personal recupera {@dice 1d6 + 4} cargos gastados cada día al atardecer. Si usted expulsa la última carga del personal, enrolle un {@dice d20}. En un 1, el personal se desmorona al polvo y es destruido.

item.name: Spider Staff
item.reqAttune: by a bard, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: The top of this magic quarterstaff is shaped like a spider. It deals an extra {@damage 1d6} poison damage on a hit when used to make a weapon attack.

entries: The staff has 10 charges. While holding it, you can expend the requisite number of charges to cast one of the following spells from the staff: {@spell spider climb} (1 charge) or {@spell web} (2 charges; spell save {@dc 15}).
The staff regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dusk. If you expend the staff's last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the staff crumbles to dust and is destroyed.

item.name: Spies' Murmur
entries: This headpiece, crafted from dark metal, is worn curved around the ear. If you know a creature wearing another Spies' Murmur and that creature is within 1 mile of you, you can communicate telepathically with each other. As a bonus action, you can allow that creature to hear everything you hear for 1 hour. You can end this effect as a bonus action, and it ends if you're {@condition incapacitated}.
entries_es: Este cabezal, elaborado con metal oscuro, se lleva curvado alrededor de la oreja. Si conoces a una criatura usando otro Murmur de Spies y esa criatura está a 1 kilómetro de ti, puedes comunicarte telepáticamente entre sí. Como una acción de bonificación, puedes permitir que esa criatura escuche todo lo que escuchas durante 1 hora. Usted puede terminar este efecto como una acción de bonificación, y termina si usted es {@condition incapacitated}.

item.name: Spiked Shield
entries: Crude metal spikes adorn this magic Shield. It has the following properties that you can use while holding it.

entries.name: Shield Bash
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can make one of the attack rolls using the Shield against a target within 5 feet of yourself. Apply your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and Strength modifier to the attack roll. On a hit, the Shield deals Piercing damage equal to {@dice 2d6} plus your Strength modifier.
entries_es: Cuando usted toma la acción {@action Attack|XPHB}, usted puede hacer uno de los rollos de ataque utilizando el escudo contra un objetivo dentro de 5 pies de usted mismo. Aplique su {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} y modificador de fuerza al rollo de ataque. En un golpe, el escudo se ocupa de perforar daño igual a {@dice 2d6} más su modificador de fuerza.

entries.name: Spike Salvo
entries: As a Magic action, you can cause spikes to erupt from the Shield in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Como acción Mágica, usted puede causar picos para erupción del escudo en un 30 pies {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Cada criatura en el [[TAG0] hace un lanzamiento de ahorro DC 13 Dexterity, tomando {@damage 3d6}] Perforar el daño en un ahorro fallido o la mitad del daño en uno exitoso. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Spindle of Fate
entries: This wand is shaped like a drop spindle wrapped in red thread. The wand has 6 charges that can be used for the following properties:

items.name: Battle Foreknowledge
entries: When you roll initiative, you can expend 1 charge to add or subtract your proficiency bonus from the total roll.
entries_es: Cuando ruede la iniciativa, puede gastar 1 cargo para añadir o restar su prima de competencia del rollo total.

items.name: Doom Foretold
entries: As an action, you can expend 2 charges to target a creature within 30 feet of yourself and invoke that creature's doom. While the target is on the same plane of existence as you, you can sense the direction to its location, and you know the direction of its movement if it's in motion. Additionally, once per turn when you deal damage to the doomed creature, you can roll {@dice 1d6} and add the number rolled to the damage roll. These benefits persist for 1 hour or until you target another creature with this effect.
entries_es: Como acción, puedes gastar 2 cargos para apuntar a una criatura dentro de 30 pies de ti mismo e invocar la condena de esa criatura. Mientras el objetivo está en el mismo plano de la existencia como usted, usted puede sentir la dirección a su ubicación, y usted sabe la dirección de su movimiento si está en movimiento. Además, una vez por turno cuando se hace daño a la criatura condenada, se puede rodar {@dice 1d6} y añadir el número rodado al rollo de daño. Estos beneficios persisten durante 1 hora o hasta que usted apunta a otra criatura con este efecto.

items.name: Twist of Fate
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of you makes a saving throw or an attack roll, you can use your reaction to expend 3 charges and alter the outcome, turning a failed saving throw into a successful one, a missed attack roll into a hit, or vice versa.
entries_es: Cuando una criatura a menos de 60 pies de usted hace un lanzamiento de ahorro o un rollo de ataque, puede utilizar su reacción para gastar 3 cargos y alterar el resultado, convirtiendo un tiro de ahorro fallido en un exitoso, un rollo de ataque perdido en un golpe, o viceversa.

entries: The wand regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Spire of Conflux (Dormant)
entries: A powerful relic passed down from generation to generation of Ashari leaders, the Spire of Conflux was lost over three centuries ago when Joran the Sea-Speaker, a respected leader of {@book the Water Ashari|TDCSR|2|The Ashari}, was devoured by a demon of the Abyss. It was rediscovered by the legendary druid {@creature Keyleth, Voice of the Tempest|TDCSR|Keyleth of Zephrah, Voice of the Tempest}. However, rumors swirl that she is seeking another hero to wield it—one who can travel the land and do good in small ways as she once did.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While the Spire of Conflux is in a dormant state, the staff has 8 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn. While holding the staff, you can expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: {@spell burning hands} (1 charge) or {@spell fireball} (3 charges).
Additionally, while holding this staff, you have a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC increases by 1.
entries_es: Mientras el Spire de Conflux está en un estado inactivo, el personal tiene 8 cargos y recupera {@dice 1d4 + 2} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Mientras mantiene al personal, puede gastar 1 o más de sus cargos para lanzar uno de los siguientes hechizos de él, utilizando su hechizo salvo DC: {@spell burning hands} (1 cargo) o {@spell fireball} (3 cargos).
Además, mientras mantiene a este personal, tiene un bono +1 para los rollos de ataque de hechizo y su hechizo ahorrar DC aumenta en 1.

Una poderosa reliquia pasó de generación en generación de líderes Ashari, el Spire de Conflux fue perdido hace tres siglos cuando Joran el Sea-Speaker, un respetado líder de {@book the Water Ashari|TDCSR|2|The Ashari}, fue devorado por un demonio del Abismo. Fue redescubierto por el legendario druid {@creature Keyleth, Voice of the Tempest|TDCSR|Keyleth of Zephrah, Voice of the Tempest}. Sin embargo, rumores swirl que ella está buscando otro héroe para manejarlo - uno que puede viajar la tierra y hacer el bien de pequeñas maneras como ella una vez lo hizo.

item.name: Spirit Board
entries: This ornate wooden board has the letters of the Common alphabet printed on one side, alongside the words "Yes" and "No" and symbols representing "Weal" and "Woe." The board comes with a heart-shaped, wooden planchette. This planchette must be resting on the lettered side of the board for the board's magic to function.

This board has 3 charges and regains 1 expended charge daily at dawn. While touching the planchette, you can take 1 minute to cast one of the spells on the table below. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. As you cast the spell, you call on the spirits of the dead to help guide the planchette across the board's surface, answering your questions by pointing to the letters or words on the board.

rows: {@spell Augury|XPHB}
{@spell Commune|XPHB}

entries_es: Esta tabla de madera ornamentada tiene las letras del alfabeto común impreso en un lado, junto con las palabras "Sí" y "No" y símbolos que representan "Weal" y "Woe". La tabla viene con un plano de madera en forma de corazón. Este planchette debe estar descansando en el lado escrito del tablero para que la magia del tablero funcione.

Esta junta tiene 3 cargos y recupera 1 cargo gastado diariamente al amanecer. Al tocar el planchette, puede tomar 1 minuto para lanzar uno de los hechizos en la tabla de abajo. La tabla indica cuántos cargos debe presentar para emitir el hechizo. Al lanzar el hechizo, usted llama a los espíritus de los muertos para ayudar a guiar el planchette a través de la superficie del tablero, respondiendo sus preguntas señalando las letras o palabras en el tablero.

item.name: Spyglass
entries: Objects viewed through a spyglass are magnified to twice their size.
entries_es: Los objetos vistos a través de una lente de espionaje se magnifican al doble de su tamaño.

item.name: Spyglass of Clairvoyance
entries: At rank 2, your Head Office-supplied spyglass becomes a common magic item. As an action, you can look through the spyglass of clairvoyance at a location within 1 mile of you that is obstructing your view, such as a mountain, castle, or forest. You must then succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom check using {@item cartographer's tools|phb} to map the natural terrain found within three miles of that chosen point. You do not gain any knowledge of creatures, structures, or anything other than natural terrain. This property of the spyglass cannot be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: En el rango 2, su Head Office-supplied spyglass se convierte en un elemento mágico común. Como acción, puede mirar a través de la lente de espionaje de clarividencia en un lugar dentro de 1 milla de usted que está obstruyendo su vista, como una montaña, castillo o bosque. Entonces debes tener éxito en un {@dc 15} Verificación de la sabiduría utilizando {@item cartographer's tools|phb} para mapear el terreno natural encontrado en tres millas de ese punto elegido. Usted no obtiene ningún conocimiento de criaturas, estructuras, o cualquier otra cosa que no sea el terreno natural. Esta propiedad de la lente de espionaje no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Squid Ship
entries: Among the oldest types of spelljamming vessels, squid ships are popular with privateers and are often used as patrol ships. Standard weapons on a squid ship include a forward-mounted mangonel, two aft-mounted ballistae, and a reinforced bow for ramming. The tentacles that extend from the bow account for nearly half the ship's keel length.
Squid ships can float and sail on water, and they can land on the ground.
entries_es: Entre los tipos más antiguos de buques de ortografía, los barcos de calamar son populares con los particulares y se utilizan a menudo como buques de patrulla. Las armas estándar en un barco de calamar incluyen un mangonel montado en el futuro, dos balistas montados en popa, y un arco reforzado para ramming. Los tentáculos que se extienden desde el arco representan casi la mitad de la longitud de la quilla del barco.
Los barcos de calamar pueden flotar y navegar en el agua, y pueden aterrizar en el suelo.

item.name: Staff of Adornment
entries: If you place a Tiny object weighing no more than 1 pound (such as a shard of crystal, an egg, or a stone) above the tip of this staff while holding it, the object floats an inch from the staff's tip and remains there until it is removed or until the staff is no longer in your possession. The staff can have up to three such objects floating over its tip at any given time. While holding the staff, you can make one or more of the objects slowly spin or turn in place.
entries_es: Si colocas un objeto pequeño que pesa no más de 1 libra (como un fragmento de cristal, un huevo o una piedra) por encima de la punta de este personal mientras la sostiene, el objeto flota una pulgada de la punta del personal y permanece allí hasta que se retira o hasta que el personal ya no está en tu posesión. El personal puede tener hasta tres objetos tales flotando sobre su punta en cualquier momento dado. Mientras sostiene el personal, puede hacer que uno o más de los objetos gire lentamente o gire en su lugar.

item.name: Staff of Adornment
entries: If you place an object weighing no more than 1 pound (such as a shard of crystal, an egg, or a stone) above the tip of the staff while holding it, the object floats an inch from the staff's tip and remains there until it is removed or until the staff is no longer in your possession. The staff can have up to three such objects floating over its tip at any given time. While holding the staff, you can make one or more of the objects slowly spin or turn in place.

item.name: Staff of Charming
item.reqAttune: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: While holding this staff, you can use an action to expend 1 of its 10 charges to cast {@spell charm person}, {@spell command}, or {@spell comprehend languages} from it using your spell save DC. The staff can also be used as a magic quarterstaff.

If you are holding the staff and fail a saving throw against an enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one. You can't use this property of the staff again until the next dawn. If you succeed on a save against an enchantment spell that targets only you, with or without the staff's intervention, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge from the staff and turn the spell back on its caster as if you had cast the spell.
The staff regains {@dice 1d8 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical quarterstaff.
entries_es: Mientras mantiene este personal, puede utilizar una acción para expulsar 1 de sus 10 cargos para lanzar {@spell charm person}], {@spell command}, o {@spell comprehend languages} de él utilizando su hechizo guardar DC. El personal también puede ser utilizado como un quarterstaff mágico.

Si usted está sosteniendo al personal y falla un lanzamiento de ahorro contra un hechizo de encantamiento que sólo se dirige a usted, usted puede convertir su fallido ahorro en un éxito. No puedes usar esta propiedad del personal hasta el siguiente amanecer. Si tienes éxito en un ahorro contra un hechizo de encantamiento que sólo te dirige, con o sin la intervención del personal, puedes usar tu reacción para gastar 1 cargo del personal y devolver el hechizo a su caster como si hubieras lanzado el hechizo.
El personal recupera {@dice 1d8 + 2} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Si usted expulsa el último cargo, enrolle un {@dice d20}. En un 1, el personal se convierte en un quarterstaff no mágico.

item.name: Staff of Defense
entries: This slender, hollow staff is made of glass yet is as strong as oak. It weighs 3 pounds. You must be attuned to the staff to gain its benefits and cast its spells.
While holding the staff, you have a +1 bonus to your Armor Class.

The staff has 10 charges, which are used to fuel the spells within it. With the staff in hand, you can use your action to cast one of the following spells from the staff if the spell is on your class's spell list: {@spell mage armor} (1 charge) or {@spell shield} (2 charges). No components are required.
The staff regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges each day at dawn. If you expend the staff's last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the staff shatters and is destroyed.

entries: This transparent crystal staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

entries.name: Altered Outcome
entries: The staff has 6 charges. As a bonus action, you can expend 1 of the staff's charges to give yourself or one other creature that you can see a {@dice d4}. The recipient can roll this {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to one ability check, attack roll, damage roll, or saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn. If this extra die is not used before then, it is lost.

If you expend the staff's last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a roll of 9 or lower, the staff becomes a nonmagical quarterstaff that breaks the first time it scores a hit and deals damage. On a roll of 10 or higher, the staff regains {@dice 1d6} of its expended charges.

item.name: Staff of Power
item.reqAttune: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls.

The staff has 20 charges for the following properties. The staff regains {@dice 2d8 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack and damage roll but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regain {@dice 1d8 + 2} charges.

entries.name: Power Strike
entries: When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage to the target.
entries_es: Cuando usted golpeó con un ataque de melee usando el personal, usted puede gastar 1 carga para tratar un daño adicional [[TAG0] fuerza al objetivo.

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding this staff, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and spell attack bonus: {@spell cone of cold} (5 charges), {@spell fireball} (5th-level version, 5 charges), {@spell globe of invulnerability} (6 charges), {@spell hold monster} (5 charges), {@spell levitate} (2 charges), {@spell lightning bolt} (5th-level version, 5 charges), {@spell magic missile} (1 charge), {@spell ray of enfeeblement} (1 charge), or {@spell wall of force} (5 charges).

entries.name: Retributive Strike
entries: You can use an action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface, performing a retributive strike. The staff is destroyed and releases its remaining magic in an explosion that expands to fill a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on it.

You have a {@chance 50} chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take force damage equal to 16 × the number of charges in the staff. Every other creature in the area must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes an amount of damage based on how far away it is from the point of origin, as shown in the following table. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

item.name: Staff of Ruling
entries: An ornate carving of a serpent adorned with a coursing river spirals down the length of this red-and-gold staff. While you're holding it, you can use an action to produce one of the following effects. Once the staff has produced an effect, it can't produce that effect again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Orb of Lightning
entries: You create a Small orb of lightning in an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of yourself. You concentrate on this orb as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell. As a bonus action, you can move the orb up to 20 feet in any direction.

When your {@status concentration} ends, or when a creature enters the orb's space or starts its turn there, the orb detonates in a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking lightning damage equal to the total accumulated damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one; the orb's base damage is {@damage 6d6}, and if at the end of your turn the orb hasn't detonated, its damage increases by {@damage 2d6}, to a maximum of {@damage 10d6}.
entries_es: Usted crea un pequeño orbe de relámpago en un espacio no ocupado que se puede ver dentro de 60 pies de usted mismo. Usted se concentra en este orb como si {@status concentration||concentrating} en un hechizo. Como una acción de bonificación, puede mover el orbe hasta 20 pies en cualquier dirección.

Cuando su {@status concentration} termina, o cuando una criatura entra en el espacio del orbe o comienza su turno allí, el orbe detona en una esfera de 20 pies-radius. Cada criatura en ese área debe hacer un {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking lightning damage equal to the total acumulad damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one; the orb's base damage is {@damage 6d6}, and if at the end of your turn the orb has not detonated, its damage increases by {@damage 2d6}, to a maximum of {@damage 10d6}.

entries.name: Staff to Snake
entries: You throw the staff to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you, and the staff becomes a {@creature giant poisonous snake}. The snake is under your control and shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours.

On your turn, you can mentally command the snake if it is within 60 feet of you and you don't have the {@condition incapacitated} condition. You decide what action the snake takes and where it moves during its turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location.
If you use a bonus action to speak the command word again, or if the snake is reduced to 0 hit points, the snake reverts to staff form in its current space.
entries_es: Usted lanza el personal a un espacio no ocupado dentro de 10 pies de usted, y el personal se convierte en un {@creature giant poisonous snake}. La serpiente está bajo su control y comparte su cuenta de iniciativa, pero toma su turno inmediatamente después de la suya.

A su vez, puede ordenar mentalmente la serpiente si está a menos de 60 pies de usted y no tiene la condición {@condition incapacitated}. Usted decide qué acción toma la serpiente y dónde se mueve durante su turno, o puede emitir una orden general, como atacar a sus enemigos o guardar un lugar.

Si utilizas una acción de bonificación para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo, o si la serpiente se reduce a 0 puntos de éxito, la serpiente se revierte a la forma del personal en su espacio actual.

entries.name: Thunderclap
entries: You point the staff skyward, producing a fearsome thunderclap. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition deafened} and {@condition frightened} conditions until the end of your next turn.
entries_es: Tú apuntas al personal hacia el cielo, produciendo un temible trueno. Cada criatura de su elección en una esfera de 30 pies-radius centrada en usted debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15} La Constitución ahorra o tiene las condiciones {@condition deafened} y {@condition frightened} hasta el final de su próximo turno.

Una escultura ornamentada de una serpiente adornada con un río coursing en espiral por la longitud de este personal rojo y dorado. Mientras lo sostienes, puedes usar una acción para producir uno de los siguientes efectos. Una vez que el personal haya producido un efecto, no puede producir ese efecto de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries_es: Usted lanza el personal a un espacio no ocupado dentro de 10 pies de usted, y el personal se convierte en un {@creature giant poisonous snake}. La serpiente está bajo su control y comparte su cuenta de iniciativa, pero toma su turno inmediatamente después de la suya.

A su vez, puede ordenar mentalmente la serpiente si está a menos de 60 pies de usted y no tiene la condición {@condition incapacitated}. Usted decide qué acción toma la serpiente y dónde se mueve durante su turno, o puede emitir una orden general, como atacar a sus enemigos o guardar un lugar.

Si utilizas una acción de bonificación para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo, o si la serpiente se reduce a 0 puntos de éxito, la serpiente se revierte a la forma del personal en su espacio actual.

entries_es.name: Thunderclap
entries: You point the staff skyward, producing a fearsome thunderclap. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition deafened} and {@condition frightened} conditions until the end of your next turn.
entries_es: Tú apuntas al personal hacia el cielo, produciendo un temible trueno. Cada criatura de su elección en una esfera de 30 pies-radius centrada en usted debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15} La Constitución ahorra o tiene las condiciones {@condition deafened} y {@condition frightened} hasta el final de su próximo turno.

item.name: Staff of Striking
entries: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

The staff has 10 charges. When you hit with a melee attack using it, you can expend up to 3 of its charges. For each charge you expend, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage. The staff regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical quarterstaff.
entries_es: Este personal puede ser manipulado como un quarterstaff mágico que otorga un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con él.

El personal tiene 10 cargos. Cuando golpeas con un ataque de melee usándolo, puedes gastar hasta 3 de sus cargos. Por cada cargo que usted expulsa, el objetivo toma un daño adicional [[TAG0] fuerza. El personal recupera {@dice 1d6 + 4} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Si usted expulsa la última carga, enrolle un {@dice d20}. En un 1, el personal se convierte en un quarterstaff no mágico.

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding the staff, you can use an action to expend some of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: {@spell giant insect} (4 charges) or {@spell insect plague} (5 charges).

entries.name: Insect Cloud
entries: While holding the staff, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cause a swarm of harmless flying insects to spread out in a 30-foot radius from you. The insects remain for 10 minutes, making the area heavily obscured for creatures other than you. The swarm moves with you, remaining centered on you. A wind of at least 10 miles per hour disperses the swarm and ends the effect.

Los insectos permanecen durante 10 minutos, haciendo que el área esté fuertemente oscurecida para criaturas que no sean tú. El enjambre se mueve contigo, permaneciendo centrado en ti. item.name: Staff of the Adder
item.reqAttune: by a cleric, druid, or warlock
entries: You can use a bonus action to speak this staff's command word and make the head of the staff become that of an animate poisonous snake for 1 minute. By using another bonus action to speak the command word again, you return the staff to its normal inanimate form.

You can make a melee attack using the snake head, which has a reach of 5 feet. Your proficiency bonus applies to the attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d6} piercing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 3d6} poison damage.

The snake head can be attacked while it is animate. It has an Armor Class of 15 and 20 hit points. If the head drops to 0 hit points, the staff is destroyed. As long as it's not destroyed, the staff regains all lost hit points when it reverts to its inanimate form.
entries_es: Puedes usar una acción de bonificación para hablar la palabra de mando de este personal y hacer que la cabeza del personal se convierta en la de una serpiente venenosa animada durante 1 minuto. Al utilizar otra acción de bonificación para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo, usted devuelve el personal a su forma inanimada normal.

Usted puede hacer un ataque de melee usando la cabeza de la serpiente, que tiene un alcance de 5 pies. Su bonificación de competencia se aplica al rollo de ataque. En un golpe, el objetivo toma {@damage 1d6} perforando daños y debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15}] Constitución salvando la lanza o tomar {@damage 3d6} daño venenoso.

La cabeza de la serpiente puede ser atacada mientras está animada. Tiene una Clase Armor de 15 y 20 puntos de impacto. Si la cabeza cae a 0 puntos de impacto, el personal es destruido. Mientras no se destruya, el personal recupera todos los puntos perdidos cuando vuelve a su forma inanimada.

item.name: Staff of the Adder
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can turn the head of this staff into that of an animate, venomous snake for 1 minute or revert the staff to its inanimate form.

When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can make one of the attack rolls using the animated snake head, which has a reach of 5 feet. Apply your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} and Wisdom modifier to the attack roll. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage and {@damage 3d6} Poison damage.

The snake head can be attacked while it is animate. It has AC 15, HP 20, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage. If the head drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the staff is destroyed. As long as it's not destroyed, the staff regains all lost {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} when it reverts to its inanimate form.
entries_es: Como un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, se puede convertir la cabeza de este personal en la de una serpiente animada y venenosa durante 1 minuto o volver al personal a su forma inanimada.

Cuando usted toma la acción {@action Attack|XPHB}, usted puede hacer uno de los rollos de ataque utilizando la cabeza de serpiente animada, que tiene un alcance de 5 pies. Aplique su {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} y modificador de sabiduría al rollo de ataque. En un golpe, el objetivo toma {@damage 1d6} Piercing damage and {@damage 3d6} Daño al veneno.

La cabeza de la serpiente puede ser atacada mientras está animada. Tiene AC 15, HP 20, y {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} al veneno y daño psíquico. Si la cabeza cae a 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, el personal es destruido. Mientras no se destruya, el personal recupera todo perdido {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} cuando vuelve a su forma inanimada.

item.name: Staff of the Forgotten One
item.reqAttune: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: This crooked staff is carved from bone and topped with the skull of a forgotten {@creature archmage} whom {@creature Acererak|ToA} destroyed long ago. Etched into the skull's forehead is {@creature acererak|ToA|Acererak's} rune, which is known on many worlds as a sign of death.

entries.name: Beneficial Properties
entries: While the staff is on your person, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your proficiency bonus to Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) and Intelligence ({@skill History}) checks is doubled.
You can't be {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition petrified}, or {@condition stunned}.
Undead with a challenge rating of 2 or lower will neither threaten nor attack you unless you harm them.
You can wield the staff as a +3 quarterstaff that deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage on a hit.

entries_es: Mientras el personal está en su persona, usted obtiene los siguientes beneficios:

items: Your proficiency bonus to Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) and Intelligence ({@skill History}) checks is doubled.
You can't be {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition petrified}, or {@condition stunned}.
Undead with a challenge rating of 2 or lower will neither threaten nor attack you unless you harm them.
You can wield the staff as a +3 quarterstaff that deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage on a hit.

entries.name: Invoke Curse
entries: The Staff of the Forgotten One has 7 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 3} expended charges daily at dawn. While holding the staff, you can use an action to expend 1 charge and target one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (using your spell save DC) or be cursed. While cursed in this way, the target can't regain hit points and has vulnerability to necrotic damage. A {@spell greater restoration}, {@spell remove curse}, or similar spell ends the curse on the target.
entries_es: El personal del olvidado tiene 7 cargos y recupera {@dice 1d4 + 3} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Mientras sostiene al personal, puede utilizar una acción para gastar 1 carga y apuntar a una criatura que puede ver dentro de 60 pies de usted. El objetivo debe tener éxito en un lanzamiento de ahorro de la Constitución (utilizando su hechizo salvo DC) o ser maldito. Mientras está maldecido de esta manera, el objetivo no puede recuperar puntos de éxito y tiene vulnerabilidad a daños necróticos. A {@spell greater restoration}, {@spell remove curse}, o hechizo similar termina la maldición sobre el objetivo.

entries.name: The Forgotten One
entries: The bodiless life force of a dead {@creature archmage} empowers the staff and is imprisoned within it. The rune carved into the staff's skull protects {@creature Acererak|ToA} from this spirit's vengeance. Each time a creature other than {@creature Acererak|ToA} expends any of the staff's charges, there is a {@chance 50} chance that the life force tries to possess the staff wielder. The wielder must succeed on a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw or be possessed, becoming an NPC under the DM's control. If the intruding life force is targeted by magic such as a {@spell dispel evil and good} spell, it becomes trapped in the staff once more. Once it takes control of another creature, the insane spirit of the dead {@creature archmage} attempts to destroy the staff.
entries_es: La fuerza de vida sin piedad de un muerto {@creature archmage} faculta al personal y está encarcelado dentro de él. La runa tallada en el cráneo del personal protege {@creature Acererak|ToA} de la venganza de este espíritu. Cada vez que una criatura que no sea {@creature Acererak|ToA} expende cualquiera de los cargos del personal, hay una posibilidad [[TAG3] de que la fuerza de vida trate de poseer el mando del personal. El wielder debe tener éxito en un {@dc 20} Charisma ahorro lanzamiento o ser poseído, convirtiéndose en un NPC bajo el control del DM. Si la fuerza de vida intrusa es dirigida por la magia como un hechizo {@spell dispel evil and good}, se queda atrapada una vez más en el personal. Una vez que toma el control de otra criatura, el espíritu loco de los muertos {@creature archmage} intenta destruir al personal.

entries.name: Destroying the Staff
entries: A creature in possession of the staff can use an action to break it over one knee or a solid surface. The staff is destroyed and releases its remaining magic in an explosion that expands to fill a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on it. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 132 ({@damage 24d10}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. When the staff is destroyed, the life force of the Forgotten One is released to the afterlife. Where it goes is anyone's guess.
entries_es: Una criatura en posesión del personal puede usar una acción para romperla sobre una rodilla o una superficie sólida. El personal es destruido y libera su magia restante en una explosión que se expande para llenar una esfera de 30 pies-radius centrada en ella. Cada criatura en el área debe hacer un {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 132 ([TAG1]) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Cuando el personal es destruido, la fuerza de vida del Olvidado es liberada a la otra vida. Donde va es la suposición de alguien.

Este personal torcido es tallado de hueso y rematado con el cráneo de un olvidado {@creature archmage} que [[TAG1] destruyó hace mucho tiempo. Enganchado en la frente del cráneo está [[TAG2] runa, que se conoce en muchos mundos como signo de muerte.

entries: This gray-and-cerulean staff is topped with a small dragon claw carved from ivory. While holding the staff, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. Whenever you score a critical hit with a spell attack, the target takes an extra {@damage 3d6} radiant damage.
entries_es: Este personal gris y curuleano está cubierto con una pequeña garra de dragón tallada de marfil. Mientras mantiene al personal, usted gana un bono +1 para los rollos de ataque de hechizo. Cada vez que marca un golpe crítico con un ataque de hechizo, el objetivo toma un daño radiante extra [[TAG0].

item.name: Staff of the Magi
item.reqAttune: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. While you hold it, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.

The staff has 50 charges for the following properties. It regains {@dice 4d6 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 20, the staff regains {@dice 1d12 + 1} charges.

entries.name: Spell Absorption
entries: While holding the staff, you have advantage on saving throws against spells. In addition, you can use your reaction when another creature casts a spell that targets only you. If you do, the staff absorbs the magic of the spell, canceling its effect and gaining a number of charges equal to the absorbed spell's level. However, if doing so brings the staff's total number of charges above 50, the staff explodes as if you activated its retributive strike (see below).

item.name: Staff of the Python
item.reqAttune: by a cleric, druid, or warlock
entries: You can use an action to speak this staff's command word and throw the staff on the ground within 10 feet of you. The staff becomes a {@creature giant constrictor snake} under your control and acts on its own initiative count. By using a bonus action to speak the command word again, you return the staff to its normal form in a space formerly occupied by the snake.

On your turn, you can mentally command the snake if it is within 60 feet of you and you aren't {@condition incapacitated}. You decide what action the snake takes and where it moves during its next turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location.

If the snake is reduced to 0 hit points, it dies and reverts to its staff form. The staff then shatters and is destroyed. If the snake reverts to staff form before losing all its hit points, it regains all of them.
entries_es: Puedes usar una acción para hablar de la palabra de mando del personal y tirar el personal al suelo a menos de 10 pies de ti. El personal se convierte en un [[TAG0] bajo su control y actúa en su cuenta de iniciativa. Al utilizar una acción de bonificación para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo, usted devuelve el personal a su forma normal en un espacio anteriormente ocupado por la serpiente.

En tu turno, puedes mandar mentalmente a la serpiente si está a menos de 60 pies de ti y no eres {@condition incapacitated}. Usted decide qué acción toma la serpiente y dónde se mueve durante su próximo turno, o puede emitir un comando general, como atacar a sus enemigos o guardar un lugar.

Si la serpiente se reduce a 0 puntos de impacto, muere y vuelve a su forma de personal. El personal se rompe y se destruye. Si la serpiente vuelve a formar personal antes de perder todos sus puntos de éxito, recupera todos ellos.

item.name: Staff of the Python
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can throw this staff so that it lands in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you, causing the staff to become a {@creature Giant Constrictor Snake|XMM} in that space. The snake is under your control and shares your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count, taking its turn immediately after yours.

On your turn, you can mentally command the snake (no action required) if it is within 60 feet of you and you don't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. You decide what action the snake takes and where it moves during its turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location. Absent commands from you, the snake defends itself.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can command the snake to revert to staff form in its current space, and you can't use the staff's property again for 1 hour. If the snake is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it dies and reverts to its staff form; the staff then shatters and is destroyed. If the snake reverts to staff form before losing all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it regains all of them.
entries_es: Como acción {@action Magic|XPHB}, usted puede tirar este personal para que aterrice en un espacio no ocupado dentro de 10 pies de usted, causando que el personal se convierta en un {@creature Giant Constrictor Snake|XMM} en ese espacio. La serpiente está bajo su control y comparte su cuenta {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, tomando su turno inmediatamente después de la suya.

A su vez, puede ordenar mentalmente la serpiente (sin necesidad de acción) si está a menos de 60 pies de usted y no tiene la condición {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}. Usted decide qué acción toma la serpiente y dónde se mueve durante su turno, o puede emitir una orden general, como atacar a sus enemigos o guardar un lugar. Absent te ordena, la serpiente se defiende.

Como un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, puede ordenar a la serpiente que vuelva a formar personal en su espacio actual, y no puede utilizar la propiedad del personal de nuevo durante 1 hora. Si la serpiente se reduce a 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, muere y revierte a su forma de personal; el personal entonces se rompe y es destruido. Si la serpiente vuelve a formar personal antes de perder todo su {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, recupera todos ellos.

item.name: Staff of the Rooted Hills
entries: The hill rune is carved into this gnarled wooden staff. The staff magically resizes to match the height of any creature that attunes to it.

The staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. The first time you hit any creature with the staff on your turn, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 12} Strength saving throw or be restrained by spectral vines until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Invoking the Rune
entries: As an action, you can invoke the staff's rune to cast either {@spell hold person} (save {@dc 12}) or {@spell speak with plants} with the staff. When you cast {@spell hold person} using the staff, the target is wreathed in spectral vines.
Once the rune has been invoked to cast either spell, it can't be invoked again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Como acción, puede invocar la runa del personal para fundir {@spell hold person} (salvar {@dc 12}]) o {@spell speak with plants}] con el personal. Cuando usted lanza {@spell hold person} utilizando el personal, el objetivo está coronado en vides espectral.
Una vez que la runa ha sido invocada para lanzar cualquier hechizo, no puede ser invocada de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.
La runa de la colina está tallada en este basurero de madera. El personal mágicamente redimensiona para que coincida con la altura de cualquier criatura que lo atune.

La primera vez que golpeas a cualquier criatura con el personal en tu turno, la criatura debe tener éxito en un {@dc 12} Lanzamiento de ahorro de fuerza o ser restringido por vides espectral hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno.

entries: You can use an action to expend 1 or more of the staff's charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: {@spell animal friendship} (1 charge), {@spell awaken} (5 charges), {@spell barkskin} (2 charges), {@spell locate animals or plants} (2 charges), {@spell speak with animals} (1 charge), {@spell speak with plants} (3 charges), or {@spell wall of thorns} (6 charges).

item.name: Staff of Thunder and Lightning
entries: This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. It also has the following additional properties. When one of these properties is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Lightning
entries: When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the target to take an extra {@damage 2d6} lightning damage.
entries_es: Cuando golpeas con un ataque de melee usando el personal, puedes hacer que el objetivo tome un daño extra {@damage 2d6}.

entries.name: Thunder
entries: When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the staff to emit a crack of thunder, audible out to 300 feet. The target you hit must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition stunned} until the end of your next turn.
entries_es: Cuando golpeas con un simple ataque usando el personal, puedes hacer que el personal emita una grieta de truenos, audible a 300 pies. El objetivo que golpeó debe tener éxito en un {@dc 17} La Constitución ahorra el lanzamiento o se convierte en {@condition stunned} hasta el final de su próximo turno.

entries.name: Lightning Strike
entries: You can use an action to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from the staff's tip in a line that is 5 feet wide and 120 feet long. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 9d6} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
entries_es: Puede utilizar una acción para hacer que un rayo salte de la punta del personal en una línea de 5 pies de ancho y 120 pies de largo. Cada criatura en esa línea debe hacer un {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 9d6} rayo de daño en un ahorro fallido, o la mitad de daño en uno exitoso.

entries.name: Thunderclap
entries: You can use an action to cause the staff to issue a deafening thunderclap, audible out to 600 feet. Each creature within 60 feet of you (not including you) must make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d6} thunder damage and becomes {@condition deafened} for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't {@condition deafened}.
entries_es: Puede utilizar una acción para hacer que el personal emita un trueno ensordecedor, audible hasta 600 pies. Cada criatura dentro de 60 pies de usted (no incluido usted) debe hacer un {@dc 17} La Constitución salvando el tiro. En un fallido ahorro, una criatura toma {@damage 2d6} daño del trueno y se convierte {@condition deafened} por 1 minuto. En un ahorro exitoso, una criatura toma medio daño y no es {@condition deafened}.

entries.name: Thunder and Lightning
entries: You can use an action to use the Lightning Strike and Thunderclap properties at the same time. Doing so doesn't expend the daily use of those properties, only the use of this one.

item.name: Star Card
entries: As a bonus action, you can speak a command word while holding this card aloft to gain advantage on all saving throws you make for the next 10 minutes. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Star Moth
entries: Star moths are ships constructed and flown by astral elves, who don't like it when these ships end up in the hands of others.

A star moth's hull is fashioned from a grown and sculpted organic substance, and its enormous, decorative wings are made of shimmering crystal. The vessel is built for space travel, but its design does enable it to float on water or land safely on the ground. Standard weaponry includes two ballistae nestled in the star moth's eye holes and a mangonel mounted above the bridge.
entries_es: Las polillas de estrellas son naves construidas y fluidas por elfos astrales, que no les gusta cuando estas naves terminan en manos de otros.

El casco de una polilla estrella está decorado con una sustancia orgánica cultivada y esculpida, y sus enormes alas decorativas están hechas de cristal resplandeciente. El buque está construido para viajes espaciales, pero su diseño le permite flotar en agua o tierra de forma segura en el suelo. El armamento estándar incluye dos balistas enclavados en los agujeros oculares de la polilla y un mangonel montado sobre el puente.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When Star Razor reaches an awakened state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.
When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to create a burst of radiance from the sword, dealing {@damage 1d8} radiant damage to the attacker.
You can cast the {@spell see invisibility} spell from the sword as an action, and the save DC for spells cast using the sword increases to 15.

item.name: Star Razor (Dormant)
entries: The thick, grooved blade of this shining silver {@item longsword|PHB} is lined with etched runes that sparkle blue in the light. Star Razor—known also as Dwueth'var—was thought to have been destroyed or lost after the {@book Calamity|TDCSR|1|The Calamity}, but new rumors suggest that it might be wielded by a half-orc somewhere in {@book Wildemount|TDCSR|3|Wildemount}.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While Star Razor is in a dormant state, you can hold this magic longsword and use a bonus action to speak the command word {@i Galas-var}, causing the sword to emit a pale blue glow that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. This glow lasts until you use a bonus action to speak the command word again, or until you drop or sheathe the sword.

items: While this longsword is glowing, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with the weapon, and you have resistance to radiant damage.

You can cast the {@spell faerie fire} spell from the weapon as an action, requiring no components (save {@dc 13}). Once a spell has been cast using Star Razor, that spell can't be cast from the sword until the next dawn.

entries_es: Mientras Star Razor está en un estado adormecido, se puede sostener esta espada de larga duración mágica y utilizar una acción de bonificación para hablar la palabra de comando {@i Galas-var}, causando que la espada emita un brillo azul pálido que arroja luz brillante en un radio de 20 pies y luz tenue por un adicional de 20 pies. Este resplandor dura hasta que utilices una acción de bonificación para hablar la palabra de comando de nuevo, o hasta que caigas o derrames la espada.

You can cast the {@spell fly} spell from the sword as an action, and the save DC for spells cast using the sword increases to 17.

item.name: Statuette of Augury
entries: This gold statuette of an elf is worth 100 gp, and is imbued with divination magic. A non-evil creature grasping the statue can ask it a question and receive a telepathic response, as though the creature had cast {@spell augury}. Once a creature has asked its question and received a response, it can never activate the statuette again.
entries_es: Esta estatua de oro de un elfo vale 100 gp, y está impregnada de magia divina. Una criatura no malvada que capta la estatua puede hacerle una pregunta y recibir una respuesta telepática, como si la criatura hubiera lanzado [[TAG0]. Una vez que una criatura ha hecho su pregunta y ha recibido una respuesta, nunca puede activar la estatuilla de nuevo.

item.name: Statuette of Saint Markovia
entries: This golden statuette grants any good-aligned creature that carries it a +1 bonus to saving throws.
entries_es: Esta estatuilla dorada otorga a cualquier criatura buena alineada que lo lleva un bono +1 para salvar los lanzamientos.

item.name: Steel
entries: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

entries.name: Revivify
entries: You can use an action to cast the {@spell revivify} spell from the sword. You must touch the target with the sword to cast the spell. Once this property of the weapon is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Puedes usar una acción para lanzar el hechizo {@spell revivify} de la espada. Debes tocar el objetivo con la espada para lanzar el hechizo. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad del arma, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Steel is a sentient, lawful good longsword with an Intelligence of 8, a Wisdom of 11, and a Charisma of 15. It can see and hear out to a range of 60 feet. The sword can speak, read, and understand Common and Draconic. It frets over your well-being while you are attuned to it, and it doesn't like to back down from a fight.
entries_es: El acero es un honorable y legal con una inteligencia de 8, una sabiduría de 11 y una Charisma de 15. Puede ver y escuchar a un rango de 60 pies. La espada puede hablar, leer y entender Common y Draconic. Se preocupa por tu bienestar mientras estás al tanto de él, y no le gusta retroceder de una pelea.
Usted tiene un bono +2 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma mágica.

item.name: Stink Bomb
entries: This smelly explosive can be primed and thrown up to 30 feet as an action. It explodes at the start of your next turn. Creatures within 20 feet of it must make a {@dc 12} Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat this save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
entries_es: Este explosivo oloroso puede ser preparado y lanzado hasta 30 pies como una acción. Explota al comienzo de tu próximo turno. Las criaturas a menos de 20 pies de ella deben hacer una [[TAG0] Constitución {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}] o ser {@condition poisoned} por 1 minuto. Una criatura puede repetir este ahorro al final de cada uno de sus turnos, terminando el efecto sobre sí misma en un éxito.

item.name: Stirring Dragon Vessel
entries: This vessel can be a potion bottle, drinking horn, or other container meant to hold a liquid.

As a bonus action, if the vessel is empty, you can speak the command word to fill the vessel with one of the following (your choice): ale, olive oil, mead, a {@item potion of healing}, a {@item potion of greater healing}, a {@item potion of climbing}, or a {@item potion of fire breath}. Once this property is used, it can't be used until the next dawn. A potion you create in this way loses its magical properties if it isn't imbibed within 24 hours.
entries_es: Este recipiente puede ser una botella de poción, cuerno para beber u otro recipiente destinado a sostener un líquido.

Como acción de bonificación, si el recipiente está vacío, puede hablar la palabra de comando para llenar el recipiente con una de las siguientes (su elección): ale, aceite de oliva, mead, a {@item potion of healing}, a {@item potion of greater healing}], a {@item potion of climbing}, o a {@item potion of fire breath}]. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad, no se puede utilizar hasta el siguiente amanecer. Una poción que creas de esta manera pierde sus propiedades mágicas si no está impregnada dentro de 24 horas.

item.name: Stirring Dragon-Touched Focus
entries: This wondrous item can be a scepter, an orb, an amulet, a crystal, or another finely crafted object. It typically incorporates imagery of dragons' wings, claws, teeth, or scales.
You have advantage on initiative rolls. While you are holding the focus, it can function as a spellcasting focus for all your spells.
The focus gains an additional property determined by the family of the dragon in whose hoard it became Stirring:

items.name: Chromatic
entries: Whenever you use a spell slot to cast a spell that deals acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage, roll a {@dice d6}, and you gain a bonus equal to the number rolled to one of the spell's damage rolls.
entries_es: Cada vez que usas una ranura de hechizo para lanzar un hechizo que trata ácido, frío, fuego, relámpago o daño venenoso, rodar un {@dice d6}, y ganas un bono igual al número rodado a uno de los rollos de daño del hechizo.

items.name: Gem
entries: Whenever you use a spell slot to cast a spell, you can immediately teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of you.
entries_es: Cada vez que usas una ranura de hechizos para lanzar un hechizo, puedes inmediatamente teletransportar a un espacio no ocupado que puedes ver a menos de 15 pies de ti.

items.name: Metallic
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes a saving throw, you can use your reaction to give that creature advantage on the saving throw.
entries_es: Cuando una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 30 pies de ti hace un lanzamiento de ahorro, puedes usar tu reacción para darle ventaja a esa criatura en el lanzamiento de ahorro.
Este maravilloso artículo puede ser un cetro, un orbe, un amuleto, un cristal u otro objeto finamente elaborado. Normalmente incorpora imágenes de alas, garras, dientes o escamas de dragones.
Usted tiene ventaja en los rollos de iniciativa. Mientras usted está manteniendo el foco, puede funcionar como un foco de ortografía para todos sus hechizos.
El enfoque gana una propiedad adicional determinada por la familia del dragón en cuyo acaparamiento se convirtió en Stirring:

items.name: Chromatic
entries: Whenever you use a spell slot to cast a spell that deals acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison damage, roll a {@dice d6}, and you gain a bonus equal to the number rolled to one of the spell's damage rolls.
entries_es: Cada vez que usas una ranura de hechizo para lanzar un hechizo que trata ácido, frío, fuego, relámpago o daño venenoso, rodar un {@dice d6}, y ganas un bono igual al número rodado a uno de los rollos de daño del hechizo.

items.name: Gem
entries: Whenever you use a spell slot to cast a spell, you can immediately teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet of you.
entries_es: Cada vez que usas una ranura de hechizos para lanzar un hechizo, puedes inmediatamente teletransportar a un espacio no ocupado que puedes ver a menos de 15 pies de ti.

items.name: Metallic
entries: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes a saving throw, you can use your reaction to give that creature advantage on the saving throw.
entries_es: Cuando una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 30 pies de ti hace un lanzamiento de ahorro, puedes usar tu reacción para darle ventaja a esa criatura en el lanzamiento de ahorro.

item.name: Stirring Scaled Ornament
entries: This ornament can be jewelry, a cloak, or another wearable accessory. It appears to be fashioned from a dragon's scale, tooth, or claw, or it incorporates images in those shapes.

You gain a +1 bonus to AC, and you can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}. Moreover, each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you has advantage on saving throws it makes to avoid being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} or to end those conditions on itself.
entries_es: Este ornamento puede ser joyería, un manto u otro accesorio usable. Parece estar de moda a partir de la escala, diente o garra de un dragón, o incorpora imágenes en esas formas.

Usted gana un bono +1 a AC, y no puede ser {@condition charmed} o {@condition frightened}]. Por otra parte, cada criatura de su elección dentro de 30 pies de usted tiene ventaja en salvar los lanzamientos que hace para evitar ser {@condition charmed} o {@condition frightened} o para terminar esas condiciones en sí mismo.

item.name: Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals
entries: If the stone is touching the ground, you can use an action to speak its command word and summon an {@creature earth elemental}, as if you had cast the {@spell conjure elemental} spell. The stone can't be used this way again until the next dawn. The stone weighs 5 pounds.
item.name_es: Piedra de control de elementos de la Tierra
entries_es: Si la piedra está tocando el suelo, puede utilizar una acción para hablar su palabra de comando y convocar un {@creature earth elemental}, como si hubieras lanzado el hechizo {@spell conjure elemental}. La piedra no se puede utilizar de esta manera hasta el siguiente amanecer. La piedra pesa 5 libras.

item.name: Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals
entries: While touching this 5-pound stone to the ground, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to summon an {@creature Earth Elemental|XMM}. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. The stone can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
item.name_es: Piedra de control de elementos de la Tierra
entries_es: Al tocar esta piedra de 5 libras al suelo, puede tomar una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para convocar una {@creature Earth Elemental|XMM}. El elemental aparece en un espacio no ocupado que eliges a menos de 30 pies de ti mismo, obedece tus mandamientos, y toma su turno inmediatamente después de que cuentes. El elemental desaparece después de 1 hora, cuando muere, o cuando lo despide como un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. La piedra no se puede utilizar de esta manera hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Stone of Creation
entries: Rare legends and lore that speak of the Stone of Creation claim it fell to the Material Plane like a meteor from some distant edge of the Outer Planes or the Far Realm. Similar legends across various worlds, all describing stones that grow buildings and islands from magic, like a house from a seed, suggest the Stone of Creation is not a unique artifact—or that all the various pieces of it are derived from a single source of stone even larger than sages imagine.

The raw, black stone appears flaky like slate but is as hard as granite and marbled with veins of gold and platinum. The original, complete Stone of Creation took the form of a blocky slab like a standing stone, but it may be impossible to know the Stone's true size, or if the concept of a "whole" Stone of Creation even applies to the artifact. Perhaps other slabs and boulders made from the Stone have been scattered across the multiverse, being cut down and recombed through interplanar movements and the magic of the artifacts themselves.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: The Stone of Creation has the following random properties:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} properties
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property

entries_es: La Piedra de la Creación tiene las siguientes propiedades aleatorias:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} properties
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property

entries.name: Stone Smithing
entries: While attuned to the Stone of Creation, you are proficient with {@item mason's tools|PHB} and can use them to cut pieces from the Stone's slab, thereby creating lesser artifacts.
entries_es: Mientras se afina a la Piedra de la Creación, usted es competente con {@item mason's tools|PHB} y puede utilizarlos para cortar piezas de la losa de la Piedra, creando así artefactos menores.

entries.name: Cut into Pieces
entries: The Stone of Creation is a source for smaller artifacts that derive their power from it. These pieces allow you to shape and bestow a portion of the slab's power for yourself or others.
You can cut pieces in two general sizes: a {@item chip of creation|AitFR-AVT} or a {@item keystone of creation|AitFR-AVT}. These lesser artifacts require their own attunement.

Up to eleven chips of creation can be created from the existing slab, plus up to nine keystones. A chip resembles a flake of rock about the size of an adult human's hand. A keystone is at least five times that thickness.

When all chips and keystones have been cut away, a portion of the Stone remains but proves impervious to additional attempts to cut or chisel pieces from it. This smallest version of the Stone is the same size as a Tiny creature.
entries_es: La Piedra de la Creación es una fuente de artefactos más pequeños que derivan de ella su poder. Estas piezas le permiten formar y otorgar una parte del poder de la losa para usted o para otros.
Puede cortar piezas en dos tamaños generales: un {@item chip of creation|AitFR-AVT} o un {@item keystone of creation|AitFR-AVT}. Estos artefactos menores requieren su propia attunement.

Hasta once fichas de creación se pueden crear desde la losa existente, más hasta nueve teclas. Un chip se asemeja a un golpe de roca sobre el tamaño de la mano de un humano adulto. Una piedra clave es al menos cinco veces ese espesor.

Cuando se han cortado todas las fichas y las llaves, una parte de la Piedra permanece pero resulta impermeable a intentos adicionales de cortar o desvelar piezas de ella. Esta versión más pequeña de la Piedra es del mismo tamaño que una pequeña criatura.

entries.name: Raze or Reshape Creations
entries: Although the Stone of Creation cannot create structures or demiplanes of its own, while you are attuned to it you can revise or renovate any structure or demiplane created by a keystone or chip, provided you are within 1 mile of the Stone and you can see or otherwise perceive the structure or demiplane. For example, you may add doors, seal windows, change the arrangement of rooms, or even dispel a structure created by a keystone. To do so, you must concentrate for 1 minute, as if on a spell, while picturing the changes you wish to make in your mind; over the course of that minute, the changes slowly occur. These changes cannot deal damage or directly harm a creature. A dispelled structure gradually recedes and diminishes to nothing, leaving creatures unharmed.
entries_es: Aunque la Piedra de la Creación no puede crear estructuras o demiplanes propios, mientras que usted está en sintonía con ella puede revisar o renovar cualquier estructura o demiplano creado por una piedra clave o chip, siempre que usted está dentro de 1 milla de la Piedra y usted puede ver o percibir de otra manera la estructura o demiplane. Por ejemplo, puede añadir puertas, sellar ventanas, cambiar la disposición de las habitaciones, o incluso disipar una estructura creada por una piedra angular. Para hacerlo, debes concentrarte por 1 minuto, como si estuvieras en un hechizo, mientras pictúas los cambios que deseas hacer en tu mente; durante ese momento, los cambios se producen lentamente. Estos cambios no pueden dañar o dañar directamente a una criatura. Una estructura disipulada gradualmente retrocede y disminuye a nada, dejando a las criaturas sin dañar.

entries.name: Destroying the Stone
entries: The Stone of Creation is a strange artifact that can be divided into smaller artifacts, yet the Stone is impervious to most damage. Only the smith attuned to the Stone can carve it. Destroying the Stone's lesser, derived artifacts (and their creations) does no damage to the Stone itself.

The Stone of Creation is destroyed if it reaches the Elemental Chaos or is struck with a forked metal rod attuned to the Elemental Chaos (as per the {@spell plane shift} spell). The Stone then shatters into harmless, inert shards of rock. Places created by the slab's chips and keystones crumble, decay, or fade away to nothing after the Stone of Creation is destroyed. Whether the Stone of Creation is itself a piece of a larger artifact remains unknown.
entries_es: La Piedra de la Creación es un artefacto extraño que puede dividirse en artefactos más pequeños, pero la Piedra es impermeable a la mayoría de los daños. Sólo el herrero afinado a la Piedra puede tallarla. Destruir los artefactos menores y derivados de la Piedra (y sus creaciones) no daña la Piedra misma.

La Piedra de la Creación es destruida si alcanza el Caos Elemental o es golpeada con una varilla de metal forcada afinada al Caos Elemental (como por el hechizo [[TAG0]). La Piedra entonces se rompe en pedazos inofensivos e inertes de roca. Lugares creados por los chips y las teclas de la losa se desmoronan, decaen o se desvanecen a nada después de que la Piedra de la Creación sea destruida. Si la Piedra de la Creación es en sí misma una pieza de un artefacto más grande permanece desconocida.

Las leyendas raras y lore que hablan de la Piedra de la Creación afirman que cayó al Plano Materiales como un meteoro de algún borde distante de los Planos Exterior o del Reino Lejano. leyendas similares a través de varios mundos, todas las piedras descriptivas que cultivan edificios e islas de la magia, como una casa de una semilla, sugieren que la Piedra de la Creación no es un artefacto único, o que todas las piezas de ella se derivan de una única fuente de piedra incluso más grande que los sabios imaginan.

La piedra cruda y negra aparece agitada como pizarra, pero es tan dura como granito y de mármol con venas de oro y platino. La Piedra original y completa de la Creación tomó la forma de una losa cuadrada como una piedra de pie, pero puede ser imposible conocer el verdadero tamaño de la Piedra, o si el concepto de una Piedra de Creación "todo" se aplica incluso al artefacto. Tal vez otras placas y rocas hechas de la Piedra han sido dispersadas a través del multiverso, siendo cortadas y recomendadas a través de movimientos interplanar y la magia de los mismos artefactos.

entries_es.name: Stone Smithing
entries: While attuned to the Stone of Creation, you are proficient with {@item mason's tools|PHB} and can use them to cut pieces from the Stone's slab, thereby creating lesser artifacts.
entries_es: Mientras se afina a la Piedra de la Creación, usted es competente con {@item mason's tools|PHB} y puede utilizarlos para cortar piezas de la losa de la Piedra, creando así artefactos menores.

entries_es.name: Cut into Pieces
entries: The Stone of Creation is a source for smaller artifacts that derive their power from it. These pieces allow you to shape and bestow a portion of the slab's power for yourself or others.
You can cut pieces in two general sizes: a {@item chip of creation|AitFR-AVT} or a {@item keystone of creation|AitFR-AVT}. These lesser artifacts require their own attunement.

Up to eleven chips of creation can be created from the existing slab, plus up to nine keystones. A chip resembles a flake of rock about the size of an adult human's hand. A keystone is at least five times that thickness.

When all chips and keystones have been cut away, a portion of the Stone remains but proves impervious to additional attempts to cut or chisel pieces from it. This smallest version of the Stone is the same size as a Tiny creature.
