item.name: Taol
entries: Brass coin, about two inches square with a hold large enough for a {@item nib|wdh} to fit in (1 taol = 200 {@item nib|wdh|nibs})
entries_es: Moneda de latón, cerca de dos pulgadas cuadrados con un soporte suficientemente grande para un {@item nib|wdh} para caber en (1 taol = 200 {@item nib|wdh|nibs})

item.name: Tasha's Creeping Keelboat
entries: This magic vehicle is a boat 10 feet wide and 30 feet long. It has four legs that propel it across land and water. It has a walking and swimming speed of 20 feet, but it can't travel underwater. The boat moves according to your spoken directions while you are riding it, and creatures of your choice gain a +1 bonus to their Armor Class while on the boat.
The boat can transport up to 1,000 pounds without hindrance. It can carry up to twice this weight, but it moves at half speed if it carries more than its normal capacity.
entries_es: Este vehículo mágico es un barco de 10 pies de ancho y 30 pies de largo. Tiene cuatro patas que lo empujan a través de tierra y agua. Tiene una velocidad de caminar y nadar de 20 pies, pero no puede viajar bajo el agua. El barco se mueve de acuerdo a sus direcciones habladas mientras usted está montando, y las criaturas de su elección ganar un bono +1 a su Clase Armor mientras que en el barco.
El barco puede transportar hasta 1.000 libras sin obstáculos. Puede llevar hasta el doble de este peso, pero se mueve a media velocidad si lleva más de su capacidad normal.

item.name: Tearulai
entries: The longsword, Tearulai, is a sentient, neutral good {@item sword of sharpness} with an emerald-colored blade and precious gemstones embedded in its hilt and pommel. The sword's magical properties are suppressed until it is removed from Valdemar's skull.

Evil creatures can't attune to Tearulai; any evil creature that tries to do so takes 20 psychic damage. The weapon's emerald blade can't be damaged or dulled, and the sword can't be teleported anywhere without its wielder while the two are attuned to one another.

entries.name: Spells
entries: The sword has 6 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn. A creature attuned to the sword can use an action and expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells from it without material components: {@spell fly} (2 charges), {@spell polymorph} (3 charges), or {@spell transport via plants} (4 charges).
entries_es: La espada tiene 6 cargos y recupera {@dice 1d4 + 2} cargos gastados diariamente al amanecer. Una criatura atada a la espada puede utilizar una acción y gastar 1 o más cargos para lanzar uno de los siguientes hechizos sin componentes materiales: {@spell fly} (2 cargos), {@spell polymorph} (3 cargos), o {@spell transport via plants} (4 cargos).

entries.name: Sentience
entries: The sword has an Intelligence of 17, a Wisdom of 12, and a Charisma of 20. It has hearing and {@sense truesight} out to a range of 120 feet. It communicates telepathically with its attuned wielder and can speak, read, and understand Common, Draconic, Elvish, and Sylvan. In addition, the sword can ascertain the true value of any gemstone brought within 5 feet of it.
entries_es: La espada tiene una Inteligencia de 17, una Sabiduría de 12, y una Charisma de 20. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies. Se comunica telepáticamente con su wielder afinado y puede hablar, leer y entender Common, Draconic, Elvish y Sylvan. Además, la espada puede determinar el verdadero valor de cualquier gema traída dentro de 5 pies de ella.

entries.name: Personality
entries: Tearulai admires great beauty, music, fine art, and poetry. Vain, the weapon strives to improve its appearance. It craves gemstones and seeks out better ones with which to adorn itself. Most of all, it longs to return to the forests around Myth Drannor, where it was created. If its wielder's goals run counter to its own, Tearulai attempts to take control of its wielder and escape Undermountain, whereupon it can use its {@spell transport via plants} spell to return whence it came.
entries_es: Tearulai admira gran belleza, música, arte fino y poesía. Vain, el arma se esfuerza por mejorar su apariencia. Anhela gemas y busca mejores piedras con las que adornarse. La mayoría de todo, anhela volver a los bosques alrededor de Mi Drannor, donde fue creado. Si los objetivos de su wielder son contrarios a los suyos, Tearulai intenta tomar el control de su wielder y escapar de Undermountain, por lo que puede utilizar su hechizo {@spell transport via plants} para devolver cuando vino.

entries: When you attack an object with this magic sword and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target.

When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, that target takes an extra 14 slashing damage. Then roll another {@dice d20}. If you roll a 20, you lop off one of the target's limbs, with the effect of such loss determined by the DM. If the creature has no limb to sever, you lop off a portion of its body instead.
{@note Note: According to the SRD, it is an extra {@damage 4d6} slashing damage, although {@link this is incorrect|https://rpg.stackexchange.com/a/174522/53884}}.

In addition, you can speak the sword's command to cause the blade to shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. Speaking the command word again or sheathing the sword puts out the light.
entries_es: El longsword, Tearulai, es un bien sensible y neutral {@item sword of sharpness} con una espada de color esmeralda y piedras preciosas incrustadas en su empuñadura y pommel. Las propiedades mágicas de la espada se suprimen hasta que se elimina del cráneo de Valdemar.

Las criaturas malvadas no pueden atontar a Tearulai; cualquier criatura malvada que trate de hacerlo toma 20 daños psíquicos. La hoja de esmeralda del arma no puede ser dañada o desenterrada, y la espada no puede ser teletransportada en ningún lugar sin su peladora mientras los dos están afinados entre sí.

Cuando atacas un objeto con esta espada mágica y golpeas, maximiza tu arma dañando dados contra el objetivo.

Cuando atacas a una criatura con este arma y lanzas un 20 en el rollo de ataque, ese objetivo toma un daño adicional de 14 golpes. Luego rodar otro [[TAG0]. Si rodas un 20, te quitas una de las extremidades del objetivo, con el efecto de tal pérdida determinada por el DM. Si la criatura no tiene extremidad para sever, usted saque una parte de su cuerpo en su lugar.
{@note Note: According to the SRD, it is an extra {@damage 4d6} recortando daños, aunque {@link this is incorrect|https://rpg.stackexchange.com/a/174522/53884}}.

Además, usted puede hablar el comando de la espada para hacer que la espada derrame luz brillante en un radio de 10 pies y luz desmenuza por 10 pies adicionales. Hablando de nuevo la palabra de mando o derramando la espada pone la luz.

item.name: Teeth of Dahlver-Nar
entries: The Teeth of Dahlver-Nar are stories given form. They are a collection of teeth, each suggestive of wildly different origins and made from various materials. The collection rests within a leather pouch, stitched with images of heroes and whimsical creatures. Where the teeth fall, they bring legends to life.

entries.name: Using the Teeth
entries: While you are holding the pouch, you can use an action to draw one tooth. Roll on the Teeth of Dahlver-Nar table to determine which tooth you draw, and you can either sow the tooth or implant it (both of which are described later).

If you don't sow or implant the tooth, roll a die at the end of your turn. On an even number, the tooth vanishes, and creatures appear as if you sowed the tooth, but they are hostile to you and your allies. On an odd number, the tooth replaces one of your teeth as if you implanted it (potentially replacing another implanted tooth, see below).
Each tooth can only be used once. Track which teeth have been used. If a tooth's result is rolled after it's been used, you draw the next lowest unused tooth on the table.

entries.caption: Teeth of Dahlver-Nar
rows: The Staring Cats of Uldun-dar (ivory cat molar)
9 {@creature cat||cats}

The tooth has 8 charges. As an action, you can expend 1 charge to cast the {@spell revivify} spell from the tooth. If you are dead at the start of your turn, the tooth expends 1 charge and casts {@spell revivify} on you.
Duggle's Surprising Day (human molar)
1 {@creature commoner}
When you finish a long rest, the tooth casts {@spell sanctuary} ({@dc 18}) on you, and the spell lasts for 24 hours or until you break it.
The Golden Age of Dhakaan (golden goblin bicuspid)
10 {@creature goblin||goblins}, 1 {@creature goblin boss}
When you are hit by an attack and an ally is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to cause them to be hit instead. You can't use this reaction again until you finish a short or long rest.
The Mill Road Murders (halfling canine)
3 {@creature green hag||green hags} in a coven
When you damage a target that hasn't taken a turn in this combat, the target takes an extra {@damage 3d10} slashing damage from ghostly blades.
Dooms of the Malpheggi (emerald lizardfolk fang)
1 {@creature lizard queen||lizardfolk queen} and 4 {@creature lizardfolk}

You gain reptilian scales, granting you a +2 bonus to your AC. Additionally, when you finish a long rest, you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion}.
The Stable Hand's Secret (sweet-tasting human canine)
2 {@creature Incubus||incubi}
When you make a Charisma check against a humanoid, you can roll a {@dice d10} and add the number rolled as a bonus to the result. The creature then becomes hostile to you at the next dawn.
The Donkey's Dream (rainbow-colored donkey molar)
1 {@creature unicorn}

The tooth has 3 charges. As an action, you can expend 1 charge to touch a creature. The target regains {@dice 2d8 + 2} hit points, and all diseases and poisons affecting it are removed. When you use this action, a shimmering image of a unicorn's horn appears until the end of your turn, sprouting from your forehead. The tooth regains all expended charges daily at dawn. You gain the following flaw: "When I see wickedness in action, I must oppose it."
Beyond the Rock of Bral (silver mind flayer tooth)
2 {@creature mind flayer||mind flayers}

You gain telepathy out to 120 feet as described in the Monster Manual, and you can cast the {@spell detect thoughts} spell at will, requiring no components. You also have disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks from constant whispers of memories and nearby minds.
The Disappearances of Half Hollow (vomerine tooth of a Large toad)
4 {@creature giant toad||giant toads}
Your long jump is up to 30 feet and your high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.
Legendry of Phantoms and Ghosts (obsidian human molar)
1 {@creature giant octopus}, 1 {@creature mage}, 1 {@creature specter}
As an action, you can use the tooth to cast the {@spell Evard's black tentacles} spell ({@dc 18}). Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
The Thousand Deaths of Jander Sunstar (yellowed vampire fang)
1 {@creature vampire}

You can make a bite attack as an unarmed strike. On a hit, it deals {@damage 1d6} piercing damage plus {@damage 3d6} necrotic damage. You regain a number of hit points equal to the necrotic damage dealt. While you are in sunlight, you can't regain hit points.
Nightmares of Kaggash (twisted beholder tooth)
1 {@creature beholder}

As an action, you can cast the {@spell eyebite} spell from the tooth. Once you use this action, it can't be used again until the next dawn. Whenever you finish a long rest, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 20, an aberration chosen by the DM appears within 30 feet of you and attacks.
Three Bridges to the Sky (lapis lazuli oni fang)
3 {@creature oni}

You gain a flying speed of 30 feet, and you can use the tooth to cast the {@spell detect magic} spell at will. While you are attuned to fewer than 3 magic items, you gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} that can't be removed until you are attuned to three or more magic items.
The Claws of Dragotha (broken translucent fang)
1 {@creature adult red dracolich|tce}

You can use the tooth to cast the {@spell create undead} spell. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn. Each time you create an undead creature using the tooth, a {@creature skeleton}, {@creature zombie}, or {@creature ghoul} also appears at a random location within 5 miles of you, searching for the living to kill. A humanoid killed by these undead rises as the same type of undead at the next midnight.
Ashes of the Ages and Eternal Fire (jade humanoid bicuspid)
1 {@creature dao}, 1 {@creature djinni}, 1 {@creature efreeti}, 1 {@creature marid}

You can use the tooth to cast {@spell counterspell} at 9th level. Once you use this property, it can't be used again until the next dawn. Whenever you finish a long rest, if you haven't used the tooth to counter a spell since your last long rest, your hit point maximum is reduced by {@dice 2d10}. If this reduces your hit point maximum to 0, you die.
Daughters of Bel (green steel pit fiend fang)
1 {@creature pit fiend}
You can use the tooth to cast {@spell dominate monster} ({@dc 18}). Once you use this property, it can't be used again until the next dawn. You smell strongly of burning sulfur.
Why the Sky Screams (blue dragon fang)
1 {@creature ancient blue dragon}
You gain immunity to lightning damage and vulnerability to thunder damage.
The Last Tarrasque (jagged sliver of tarrasque tooth)
1 {@creature tarrasque} (ignores you and your commands appears for {@dice 1d4} rounds then vanishes)

You deal double damage to objects and structures. If you take 20 or more damage in one turn, you must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or spend your next turn in a murderous fury. During this rage, you must use your action to make an unarmed strike against a creature that damaged you, or a random creature you can see if you weren't damaged by a creature, moving as close as you can to the target if necessary.
Incendax's Tooth (ruby-veined red dragon fang)
1 {@creature ancient red dragon}

You gain immunity to fire damage, and as an action, you can exhale fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 26d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After using the breath weapon, you gain 2 levels of {@condition exhaustion}.
Dahlver-Nar's Tooth (dusty human molar)
1 {@creature priest}

As an action you can call on a divine force to come to your aid. Describe the assistance you seek, and the DM decides the nature of the intervention (the effect of any cleric spell would be appropriate). Once this property is used, it can't be used again for 7 days.

entries_es: Mientras sostienes la bolsa, puedes usar una acción para dibujar un diente. Roll on the Teeth of Dahlver-Nar table to determine what diente you draw, and you can either sow the diente or implant it (both of which are described later).

Si no siembras ni implantas el diente, muévete al final de tu turno. En un número uniforme, el diente desaparece, y las criaturas aparecen como si sembraras el diente, pero son hostiles a ti y a tus aliados. En un número impar, el diente reemplaza uno de sus dientes como si lo implantaras (potencialmente reemplazando otro diente implantado, ver abajo).

Cada diente solo se puede usar una vez. Rastrear qué dientes se han utilizado. Si el resultado de un diente se enrolla después de que se haya usado, dibujas el siguiente diente más bajo sin usar en la mesa.

entries.name: Sowing Teeth
entries: To sow the tooth, you place it on the ground in an unoccupied space within your reach, or you throw it into an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you in a body of water that is at least 50 feet wide and 50 feet long. Upon doing so, the tooth burrows into the ground and vanishes, leaving no hole behind, or it vanishes into the water. The creatures noted in the Creatures Summoned column appear in an unoccupied space as close to where the tooth was sown as possible. The creatures are allies to you, speak all languages you speak, and linger for 10 minutes before disappearing, unless otherwise noted.
entries_es: Para sembrar el diente, lo colocas en el suelo en un espacio inocupado dentro de tu alcance, o lo arrojas en un espacio inocupado dentro de 10 pies de ti en un cuerpo de agua que tiene al menos 50 pies de ancho y 50 pies de largo. Al hacerlo, el diente se hunde en el suelo y desaparece, sin dejar ningún agujero atrás, o desaparece en el agua. Las criaturas señaladas en la columna de Criaturas Invocadas aparecen en un espacio no ocupado tan cerca de donde se sembraba el diente como sea posible. Las criaturas son aliados para usted, hablan todos los idiomas que usted habla, y linger por 10 minutos antes de desaparecer, a menos que se note otra cosa.

entries.name: Implanting Teeth
entries: To implant the tooth, you place it in your mouth, whereupon one of your own teeth falls out, and the drawn tooth takes its place, resizing to fit in your mouth. Once the tooth is implanted, you gain the effect noted in the Implanted Effect column. The tooth can't be removed while you are attuned to the teeth, and you can't voluntarily end your attunement to them. If removed after your death, the tooth vanishes. You can have a maximum number of the teeth implanted at one time equal to 1 + your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2 teeth total). If you try to implant more teeth, the newly implanted tooth replaces one of the previous teeth, determined randomly. The replaced tooth vanishes, and you lose the implanted effect.
entries_es: Para implantar el diente, lo colocas en la boca, donde uno de tus propios dientes cae, y el diente dibujado toma su lugar, redimensionándose para encajar en tu boca. Una vez implantado el diente, usted obtiene el efecto observado en la columna de Efecto Implantado. El diente no puede ser removido mientras estás afinado a los dientes, y no puedes terminar voluntariamente tu atontado a ellos. Si se retira después de su muerte, el diente desaparece. Usted puede tener un número máximo de los dientes implantados en un momento igual a 1 + su modificador de la Constitución (mínimo de 2 dientes totales). Si intenta implantar más dientes, el diente recién implantado reemplaza uno de los dientes anteriores, determinado aleatoriamente. El diente reemplazado desaparece, y usted pierde el efecto implantado.

entries.name: Recovering Teeth
entries: Once all the teeth have vanished, their pouch also vanishes. The pouch with all the teeth then appears in a random destination, which could be on a different world of the Material Plane.
entries_es: Una vez que todos los dientes han desaparecido, su bolsa también desaparece. La bolsa con todos los dientes aparece entonces en un destino aleatorio, que podría estar en un mundo diferente del Plano Materiales.

entries.name: Destroying the Teeth
entries: Each tooth must be destroyed individually by sowing it in the area where the tooth's story originated, with the intention to destroy it. When planted in this way, creatures summoned are not friendly to you and do not vanish. Some of the creatures summoned merely head off in search of home, while others act as their tales dictate. In either case, the tooth is gone forever.
entries_es: Cada diente debe ser destruido individualmente por sembrarlo en el área donde se originó la historia del diente, con la intención de destruirla. Cuando se plantan de esta manera, las criaturas llamadas no son amigables contigo y no desaparecen. Algunas de las criaturas llamadas simplemente se dirigen en busca de casa, mientras que otras actúan como sus cuentos dictan. En cualquier caso, el diente se ha ido para siempre.

Los dientes de Dahlver-Nar son historias dadas forma. Son una colección de dientes, cada sugestivo de orígenes salvajemente diferentes y hechos de diversos materiales. La colección descansa dentro de una bolsa de cuero, cosida con imágenes de héroes y criaturas caprichosas. Donde caen los dientes, traen leyendas a la vida.

entries_es.name: Using the Teeth
entries: While you are holding the pouch, you can use an action to draw one tooth. Roll on the Teeth of Dahlver-Nar table to determine which tooth you draw, and you can either sow the tooth or implant it (both of which are described later).

If you don't sow or implant the tooth, roll a die at the end of your turn. On an even number, the tooth vanishes, and creatures appear as if you sowed the tooth, but they are hostile to you and your allies. On an odd number, the tooth replaces one of your teeth as if you implanted it (potentially replacing another implanted tooth, see below).
Each tooth can only be used once. Track which teeth have been used. If a tooth's result is rolled after it's been used, you draw the next lowest unused tooth on the table.

rows: The Staring Cats of Uldun-dar (ivory cat molar)
9 {@creature cat||cats}

1 {@creature commoner}

10 {@creature goblin||goblins}, 1 {@creature goblin boss}
When you are hit by an attack and an ally is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to cause them to be hit instead. You can't use this reaction again until you finish a short or long rest.
The Mill Road Murders (halfling canine)
3 {@creature green hag||green hags} in a coven

1 {@creature lizard queen||lizardfolk queen} and 4 {@creature lizardfolk}

1 {@creature unicorn}

The tooth has 3 charges. As an action, you can expend 1 charge to touch a creature. The target regains {@dice 2d8 + 2} hit points, and all diseases and poisons affecting it are removed. When you use this action, a shimmering image of a unicorn's horn appears until the end of your turn, sprouting from your forehead. The tooth regains all expended charges daily at dawn. Beyond the Rock of Bral (silver mind flayer tooth)
2 {@creature mind flayer||mind flayers}

1 {@creature vampire}

Nightmares of Kaggash (twisted beholder tooth)
1 {@creature beholder}

Three Bridges to the Sky (lapis lazuli oni fang)
3 {@creature oni}

You gain a flying speed of 30 feet, and you can use the tooth to cast the {@spell detect magic} spell at will. While you are attuned to fewer than 3 magic items, you gain 1 level of {@condition exhaustion} that can't be removed until you are attuned to three or more magic items.
The Claws of Dragotha (broken translucent fang)
1 {@creature adult red dracolich|tce}

You can use the tooth to cast the {@spell create undead} spell. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn. Each time you create an undead creature using the tooth, a {@creature skeleton}, {@creature zombie}, or {@creature ghoul} also appears at a random location within 5 miles of you, searching for the living to kill. A humanoid killed by these undead rises as the same type of undead at the next midnight.
Ashes of the Ages and Eternal Fire (jade humanoid bicuspid)
1 {@creature dao}, 1 {@creature djinni}, 1 {@creature efreeti}, 1 {@creature marid}

You can use the tooth to cast {@spell counterspell} at 9th level. Once you use this property, it can't be used again until the next dawn. Whenever you finish a long rest, if you haven't used the tooth to counter a spell since your last long rest, your hit point maximum is reduced by {@dice 2d10}. If this reduces your hit point maximum to 0, you die.
Daughters of Bel (green steel pit fiend fang)
1 {@creature pit fiend}
You can use the tooth to cast {@spell dominate monster} ({@dc 18}). Once you use this property, it can't be used again until the next dawn. You smell strongly of burning sulfur.
Why the Sky Screams (blue dragon fang)
1 {@creature ancient blue dragon}
You gain immunity to lightning damage and vulnerability to thunder damage.
The Last Tarrasque (jagged sliver of tarrasque tooth)
1 {@creature tarrasque} (ignores you and your commands appears for {@dice 1d4} rounds then vanishes)

You deal double damage to objects and structures. If you take 20 or more damage in one turn, you must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or spend your next turn in a murderous fury. During this rage, you must use your action to make an unarmed strike against a creature that damaged you, or a random creature you can see if you weren't damaged by a creature, moving as close as you can to the target if necessary.
Incendax's Tooth (ruby-veined red dragon fang)
1 {@creature ancient red dragon}

You gain immunity to fire damage, and as an action, you can exhale fire in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 24} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 26d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. After using the breath weapon, you gain 2 levels of {@condition exhaustion}.
Dahlver-Nar's Tooth (dusty human molar)
1 {@creature priest}

As an action you can call on a divine force to come to your aid. Describe the assistance you seek, and the DM decides the nature of the intervention (the effect of any cleric spell would be appropriate). Once this property is used, it can't be used again for 7 days.

item.name: Tej
entries: Tej is an amber-colored, fermented drink made from honey. It's more common and popular in Chult than beer or ale. A mug of tej costs 4 cp in Port Nyanzaru or 6 cp in Fort Beluarian. A 1-gallon cask costs 2 sp in the city or 3 sp at the fort.
entries_es: Tej es una bebida fermentada de color ámbar hecha de miel. Es más común y popular en Chult que cerveza o cerveza. Una taza de tej cuesta 4 cp en Port Nyanzaru o 6 cp en Fort Beluarian. Una barrica de 1 galón cuesta 2 sp en la ciudad o 3 sp en el fuerte.

item.name: Teleportation Tablet
entries: This clay tablet is eight inches long, four inches wide, and half an inch thick. Inscribed on it is the sigil sequence for a permanent teleportation circle. A creature that studies the sequence for 10 minutes can make a {@dc 21} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check, learning the circle's destination on a success.

You can use an action to break the tablet in half, turning it to dust. If the tablet is broken while it is on the same plane of existence as the teleportation circle whose sigil sequence was engraved on it, a 10-foot-diameter teleportation circle of glowing blue light appears on the ground in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of you. This teleportation circle has the characteristics of one created using the {@spell teleportation circle} spell, except that it connects to the teleportation circle whose sigil sequence appears on the tablet.
The teleportation circle created by the tablet disappears at the end of your next turn.
entries_es: Esta tableta de arcilla tiene ocho pulgadas de largo, cuatro pulgadas de ancho y media pulgada de espesor. Inscrito en él es la secuencia de sigil para un círculo permanente de teletransportación. Una criatura que estudia la secuencia durante 10 minutos puede hacer un {@dc 21} Inteligencia ([TAG1]]) comprobar, aprendiendo el destino del círculo sobre un éxito.

Puedes usar una acción para romper la tableta a la mitad, convirtiéndolo en polvo. Si la tableta está rota mientras está en el mismo plano de la existencia como el círculo de teletransportación cuya secuencia de sigil fue grabada en ella, un círculo de teletransportación de 10 pies de diámetro de luz azul brillante aparece en el suelo en un espacio no ocupado que elijas a menos de 30 pies de ti. Este círculo de teletransportación tiene las características de uno creado utilizando el hechizo {@spell teleportation circle}, excepto que se conecta al círculo de teletransportación cuya secuencia de sigil aparece en la tableta.
El círculo de teletransportación creado por la tableta desaparece al final de su próximo turno.

item.name: Teleporter Ring
entries: As an action, a creature wearing a teleporter ring can activate the teleportation circle either in area K22 or area E1, teleporting itself and up to six other willing creatures from one circle to the other.
entries_es: Como acción, una criatura que lleva un anillo teleportador puede activar el círculo de teletransportación ya sea en la zona K22 o área E1, teletransportándose a sí misma y hasta seis otras criaturas dispuestas de un círculo a otro.

item.name: Telescopic Transporter
entries: This enormous telescope allows you to view distant celestial objects, including stars, Wildspace systems, and Astral Sea phenomena like the cities of deities or the petrified husks of dead gods.

After spending 1 hour calibrating the telescope, you can attempt to travel to the planet or celestial body at which the telescope is currently pointed. At the end of the hour, make a {@dc 17} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. On a successful check, you and eight other willing creatures touching the telescope, along with everything all travelers are wearing and carrying, safely teleport to unoccupied spaces at the intended destination. On a failed check, a mishap occurs instead. The DM rolls on the Telescope Travel Mishaps table to determine the mishap or chooses a mishap that's good for the campaign.

entries.caption: Telescope Travel Mishaps
rows: The travelers appear adrift in the Astral Sea.
The travelers appear on a different plane of existence, determined randomly or chosen by the DM.

Excess cosmic energy overloads the telescope, causing it to explode. Each creature within 60 feet of the telescope takes {@damage 8d6} necrotic damage. Any Humanoid who survives this damage is transformed into a different kind of creature, as if it had been subject to the {@spell Reincarnate} spell.
A creature from the Astral Sea (such as a {@creature githyanki knight}) appears within 60 feet of the telescope. The DM decides its attitude.
The travelers appear on a different planet or celestial body in the Wildspace system nearest to their target destination.
The travelers arrive at their intended destination, but they each appear coated in harmless slime.

entries_es: Este enorme telescopio le permite ver objetos celestes distantes, incluyendo estrellas, sistemas Wildspace y fenómenos del Mar Astral como las ciudades de deidades o las cáscaras petrificadas de dioses muertos.

Después de pasar 1 hora calibrando el telescopio, puede intentar viajar al planeta o al cuerpo celeste en el que se apunta actualmente el telescopio. Al final de la hora, haga un cheque {@dc 17} Inteligencia ([TAG1]]). En un cheque exitoso, usted y otras ocho criaturas dispuestas tocando el telescopio, junto con todo lo que todos los viajeros llevan y llevan, teletransporte seguro a espacios no ocupados en el destino previsto. En un cheque fallido, se produce un mishap. Los rollos de DM en la tabla de Mishaps de Viaje del Telescopio para determinar el accionamiento o elegir un amuleto que es bueno para la campaña.

entries_es.caption: Telescope Travel Mishaps
rows: The travelers appear adrift in the Astral Sea.
The travelers appear on a different plane of existence, determined randomly or chosen by the DM.

Excess cosmic energy overloads the telescope, causing it to explode. Each creature within 60 feet of the telescope takes {@damage 8d6} necrotic damage. Any Humanoid who survives this damage is transformed into a different kind of creature, as if it had been subject to the {@spell Reincarnate} spell.
A creature from the Astral Sea (such as a {@creature githyanki knight}) appears within 60 feet of the telescope. The DM decides its attitude.
The travelers appear on a different planet or celestial body in the Wildspace system nearest to their target destination.
The travelers arrive at their intended destination, but they each appear coated in harmless slime.

item.name: Tent
entries: A Tent sleeps up to two Small or Medium creatures.
entries_es: Una tienda duerme hasta dos criaturas pequeñas o medianas.

item.name: Tentacle Rod
entries: Made by the {@creature drow}, this rod is a magic weapon that ends in three rubbery tentacles. While holding the rod, you can use an action to direct each tentacle to attack a creature you can see within 15 feet of you. Each tentacle makes a melee attack roll with a +9 bonus. On a hit, the tentacle deals {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage. If you hit a target with all three tentacles, it must make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature's speed is halved, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it can't use reactions for 1 minute. Moreover, on each of its turns, it can take either an action or a bonus action, but not both. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
entries_es: Hecho por {@creature drow}, esta vara es un arma mágica que termina en tres tentáculos goma. Mientras sostienes la vara, puedes usar una acción para dirigir cada tentáculo para atacar a una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 15 pies de ti. Cada tentáculo hace un rollo de ataque de melee con un bono +9. En un golpe, el tentáculo se ocupa {@damage 1d6} de los daños. Si golpeas un objetivo con los tres tentáculos, debe hacer un {@dc 15} La Constitución salvando el tiro. En un fracaso, la velocidad de la criatura se reduce a la mitad, tiene desventaja en los lanzamientos de ahorro de Dexterity, y no puede utilizar reacciones durante 1 minuto. Además, en cada uno de sus turnos, puede tomar una acción o una acción de bonificación, pero no ambas. Al final de cada uno de sus turnos, puede repetir el lanzamiento de ahorro, terminando el efecto sobre sí mismo en un éxito.

item.name: Tentacle Rod
entries: This rod ends in three rubbery tentacles. While holding the rod, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to direct the tentacles to stretch outward, each one attacking a creature you can see within 15 feet of yourself. For each tentacle, make a melee attack roll with a +9 bonus. A tentacle deals {@damage 1d6} Psychic damage on a hit. If you hit the same target with all three tentacles, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to release the target, or until the target is no longer within 15 feet of you. While {@condition Restrained|XPHB} in this way, the target takes {@damage 3d6} Psychic damage at the start of each of its turns. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
entries_es: Esta varilla termina en tres tentáculos goma. Mientras sostienes la vara, puedes tomar una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para dirigir los tentáculos para extenderse hacia fuera, cada uno atacando a una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 15 pies de ti mismo. Para cada tentáculo, haz un rollo de ataque de melee con un bono +9. Un tentáculo trata {@damage 1d6} Daño psíquico en un golpe. Si golpeas el mismo objetivo con los tres tentáculos, el objetivo debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition, until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to release the target, or until the target is no longer within 15 feet of you. Mientras {@condition Restrained|XPHB} de esta manera, el objetivo toma {@damage 3d6} Daño psíquico al inicio de cada turno. Al final de cada uno de sus turnos, el objetivo repite el ahorro, terminando el efecto sobre sí mismo en un éxito.

item.name: Thayan Spell Tattoo
entries: This magical tattoo contains the essence of a level 1-3 spell chosen by the tattoo's creator. While the tattoo is on your body, you always have the associated spell prepared, and you can cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, the spell uses your spellcasting ability; otherwise, if the spell requires a saving throw or an attack roll, the spell save DC is 13 and the attack bonus is +5. If your {@variantrule Attunement|XPHB} to the tattoo ends, the tattoo vanishes.
You can also cast the spell once without a spell slot and spell components. Once the spell is cast in this way, the tattoo vanishes.

entries.name: Inking Thayan Spell Tattoos
entries: The Thayan art of magical tattooing is highly guarded by its practitioners, and thus, Thayan Spell Tattoos can't be crafted like other magic items. To learn how to ink Thayan Spell Tattoos, you must have a Renown Score of 50+ with the Red Wizards.

To ink a Thayan Spell Tattoo, you must have proficiency in the {@skill Arcana|XPHB} skill and with {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB} and have the spell prepared each day of the inking. You must also have at hand any Material components required by the spell; if the spell consumes its Material components, they are consumed when you complete the tattoo. Inking a Thayan Spell Tattoo takes the same amount of {@book time and money|XDMG|6|Time and Cost} as scribing a {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG} of an equivalent level.
entries_es: El arte Thayan de tatuajes mágicos está muy protegido por sus practicantes, y por lo tanto, los tatuajes Thayan Spell no pueden ser elaborados como otros elementos mágicos. Para aprender a tinta Thayan Spell Tattoos, usted debe tener un Renown Score de 50+ con los Magos Rojos.

Para tintar un tatuaje de lanzamiento Thayan, debe tener competencia en la habilidad {@skill Arcana|XPHB} y con {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB} y tener el hechizo preparado cada día de la tinta. También debe tener a mano cualquier componente Material requerido por el hechizo; si el hechizo consume sus componentes Materiales, se consumen cuando se completa el tatuaje. Hacer un tatuaje de habla Thayan toma la misma cantidad de {@book time and money|XDMG|6|Time and Cost} que describir un {@item Spell Scroll|XDMG} de un nivel equivalente.

Este tatuaje mágico contiene la esencia de un hechizo nivel 1-3 elegido por el creador del tatuaje. Mientras el tatuaje está en tu cuerpo, siempre tienes preparado el hechizo asociado, y puedes lanzar el hechizo usando cualquier ranura de hechizo que tengas del nivel apropiado. Si usted tiene la función Spellcasting o Pact Magic, el hechizo utiliza su habilidad de ortografía; de lo contrario, si el hechizo requiere un lanzamiento de ahorro o un rollo de ataque, el hechizo guardar DC es 13 y el bono de ataque es +5. Si su [[TAG0] al tatuaje termina, el tatuaje desaparece.
También puede lanzar el hechizo una vez sin una ranura de hechizo y componentes de hechizo. Una vez que el hechizo es lanzado de esta manera, el tatuaje desaparece.

items.name: Awakened
entries: When the morningstar reaches an awakened state, it gains the following properties:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.
The saving throw DC for spells cast from the morningstar increases to 15.

When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with an attack using The Bloody End, you can cause the following effect: each creature of your choice within 15 feet of you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.
When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal {@damage 1d6} psychic damage to the attacker.

entries_es: Cuando la estrella de la mañana llega a un estado despierto, gana las siguientes propiedades:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.
The saving throw DC for spells cast from the morningstar increases to 15.

When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with an attack using The Bloody End, you can cause the following effect: each creature of your choice within 15 feet of you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.
When a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal {@damage 1d6} psychic damage to the attacker.

item.name: The Bloody End (Dormant)
entries: Carrying the power of Bane, this adamantine morningstar sports foot-long spikes and has a jagged blade on its pommel.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: The Bloody End is a sentient lawful evil weapon with an Intelligence of 22, a Wisdom of 18, and a Charisma of 24. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak, read, and understand Common and Infernal.
entries_es: El Fin Sangriento es un arma lícita sensible con una Inteligencia de 22, una Sabiduría de 18, y una Charisma de 24. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.
El arma se comunica telepáticamente con su wielder y puede hablar, leer y comprender Común e Infernal.

entries.name: Personality
entries: A tyrannical {@creature pit fiend} named Izeelzee lives within The Bloody End. The weapon boisterously pushes its wielder to subjugate others and to never back down from a challenge. If the wielder doesn't demand fealty from others, the weapon is happy to demand it on their behalf.
entries_es: Un tiránico {@creature pit fiend} llamado Izeelzee vive dentro del Fin Sangriento. El arma empuja bosatamente a su pelador para subyugar a otros y nunca retroceder de un desafío. Si el pelador no demanda la lealtad de otros, el arma está feliz de exigirla en su nombre.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: The morningstar grants the following benefits in its dormant state:

items: You can speak, read, and write Infernal.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

While holding the morningstar, you can use an action to cast one of the following spells from it (save {@dc 13}): {@spell charm person}, {@spell dominate person}, or {@spell fear}. Once a spell has been cast using the morningstar, that spell can't be cast from it again until the next dawn.
While holding the morningstar, you have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks.

entries_es: La madrugada otorga los siguientes beneficios en su estado inactivo:

items: You can speak, read, and write Infernal.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

While holding the morningstar, you can use an action to cast one of the following spells from it (save {@dc 13}): {@spell charm person}, {@spell dominate person}, or {@spell fear}. Once a spell has been cast using the morningstar, that spell can't be cast from it again until the next dawn.
While holding the morningstar, you have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks.

entries.name: Betrayer Artifact Properties
entries: The Arms of the Betrayers advance in power in the same manner as the Vestiges of Divergence. In its dormant state, each of these artifacts has one {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property and one {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property. When the artifact attains an awakened state, it gains an additional {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property and an additional {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property. When the item reaches its exalted state, it gains a {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property. See "Artifact Properties" in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for more information.
entries_es: Los brazos de los Betrayers avanzan en el poder de la misma manera que los Vestigos de la Divergencia. En su estado inactivo, cada uno de estos artefactos tiene una propiedad [[TAG0] y una propiedad {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental}. Cuando el artefacto alcanza un estado despertado, gana una propiedad adicional [[TAG0] y una propiedad adicional {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental}. items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +3.
Add {@spell dominate monster} to the list of spells that can be cast from the morningstar.
The saving throw DC for spells cast from the morningstar, as well as for creatures to avoid being {@condition frightened} by it, increases to 17.
When you use your reaction to deal psychic damage to a creature that hits you with a melee attack, the amount of psychic damage increases to {@damage 2d6}.

The saving throw DC for spells cast from the morningstar, as well as for creatures to avoid being {@condition frightened} by it, increases to 17.
When you use your reaction to deal psychic damage to a creature that hits you with a melee attack, the amount of psychic damage increases to {@damage 2d6}.

item.name: The Codicil of White
entries: The Codicil of White is a tall, thin volume bound in white ermine fur over seasoned boards of white pine and sealed with a clasp and lock of tarnished silver. The book is cold to the touch, and the fur is worn about the edges from use. The twenty-seven pages within are of vellum painted with silver gilt on the outer edges. The whole is sewn to a leather binding with strips of sinews, making it quite durable.
A creature with the codicil in its possession has resistance to cold damage.

The codicil was written by followers of Auril as a primer on her worship. The first page is a title page with the snowflake symbol of Auril on it. The remaining pages describe various priestly rituals and ceremonies in chilling detail. Nestled among these descriptions is a spell that wizards can learn ({@spell frost fingers|IDRotF}), and a poem called "Rime of the Frostmaiden" (see appendix E). The poem is an incantation, the power of which can be used to split a glacier (see chapter 6). The poem might have other capabilities, at your discretion
entries_es: La Codicil of White es un volumen alto y delgado, atado en piel de ermina blanca sobre tablas de pino blanco y sellado con un cierre y cerradura de plata empañada. El libro es frío al tacto, y la piel se usa sobre los bordes del uso. Las veintisiete páginas dentro son de vellum pintado con dobladillo plateado en los bordes exteriores. Todo está cosido a una unión de cuero con tiras de sinews, lo que lo hace bastante duradero.
Una criatura con el codicil en su posesión tiene resistencia al daño frío.

El codicil fue escrito por seguidores de Auril como una cartilla en su adoración. La primera página es una página de título con el símbolo de copo de nieve de Auril en ella. Las páginas restantes describen varios rituales y ceremonias sacerdotales en detalle. Entre estas descripciones se encuentra un hechizo que los magos pueden aprender ([TAG0]) y un poema llamado "Rime of the Frostmaiden" (véase el apéndice E). El poema es un encantamiento, cuyo poder se puede utilizar para dividir un glaciar (ver capítulo 6). El poema podría tener otras capacidades, a su discreción

item.name: The Incantations of Iriolarthas
entries: The Incantations of Iriolarthas is a weighty spellbook. Its black leather covers have dead, toothy worms glued to them, sheathed in glossy varnish. Set into this morbid display on the front cover is a gold rune that resembles a stylized eye with a pupil shaped like a candle flame—the sigil of Iriolarthas, a Netherese lich.
The book contains sixty pages of brittle yellow vellum. Written on these pages are the following wizard spells:

items: 1st level: {@spell alarm}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell identify}, {@spell magic missile}, {@spell shield}, {@spell Tasha's hideous laughter}, {@spell thunderwave}
2nd level: {@spell arcane lock}, {@spell continual flame}, {@spell invisibility}, {@spell knock}, {@spell levitate}, {@spell Melf's acid arrow}, {@spell mirror image}
3rd level: {@spell animate dead}, {@spell bestow curse}, {@spell clairvoyance}, {@spell counterspell}, {@spell dispel magic}, {@spell fireball}, {@spell glyph of warding}
4th level: {@spell arcane eye}, {@spell banishment}, {@spell blight}, {@spell dimension door}, {@spell Evard's black tentacles}, {@spell phantasmal killer}
5th level: {@spell Bigby's hand}, {@spell cloudkill}, {@spell dominate person}, {@spell planar binding}, {@spell scrying}, {@spell telekinesis}
6th level: {@spell create undead}, {@spell disintegrate}, {@spell globe of invulnerability}, {@spell move earth}, {@spell Otto's irresistible dance}
7th level: {@spell create magen|IDRotF}, {@spell finger of death}, {@spell prismatic spray}, {@spell teleport}
8th level: {@spell demiplane}, {@spell dominate monster}, {@spell mind blank}, {@spell power word stun}
9th level: {@spell blade of disaster|TCE}, {@spell power word kill}

Situado en esta pantalla morbida en la tapa delantera es una runa de oro que se asemeja a un ojo estilizado con una pupila formada como una llama de vela, el sigil de Iriolarthas, una lica Netherese.
