entries.caption: Wand of Wonder Effects
rows: You cast a spell originating from the chosen point. Roll {@dice 1d10} to determine the spell: on a {@b 1-2}, {@spell Darkness|XPHB}; on a {@b 3-4}, {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB}; on a {@b 5-6}, {@spell Fireball|XPHB}; on a {@b 7-8}, {@spell Slow|XPHB}; on a {@b 9-10}, {@spell Stinking Cloud|XPHB}.
Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn, believing something awesome just happened.
You cast {@spell Gust of Wind|XPHB}. The {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} created by the spell extends from you to the chosen point of origin.
Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you take {@damage 1d6} Psychic damage.

Heavy rain falls for 1 minute in a 120-foot-high, 60-foot-radius {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on the chosen point of origin. During that time, the area of effect is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB}.

A cloud of 600 oversized butterflies fills a 60-foot-high, 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on the chosen point of origin. The butterflies remain for 10 minutes, during which time the area of effect is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}.
You cast {@spell Lightning Bolt|XPHB}. The {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} created by the spell extends from you to the chosen point of origin.

The creature closest to the chosen point of origin is enlarged as if you had cast {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|XPHB} on it. If the target isn't you and can't be affected by that spell, you become the target instead.

A magically formed creature appears in an unoccupied space as close to the chosen point of origin as possible. The creature isn't under your control, acts as it normally would, and disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine which creature appears. On a {@b 1}, a {@creature Rhinoceros|XMM} appears; on a {@b 2}, an {@creature Elephant|XMM} appears; and on a {@b 3-4}, a {@creature Rat|XMM} appears.

Grass covers a 60-foot-radius circle of ground, with the center of that circle as close to the chosen point of origin as possible. Grass that's already there grows to ten times its normal size and remains overgrown for 1 minute.

An object of the DM's choice disappears into the Ethereal Plane. The object must be neither worn nor carried, within 120 feet of the chosen point of origin, and no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. If there are no such objects in range, nothing happens.
Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you shrink as if you had cast {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|XPHB} on yourself and remain in that state for 1 minute.
Leaves grow from the creature nearest to the chosen point of origin. Unless they are picked off, the leaves turn brown and fall off after 24 hours.

Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, a burst of colorful, shimmering light extends from you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you cast {@spell Invisibility|XPHB} on yourself.

Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, a stream of {@dice 1d4 × 10} gems, each worth 1 GP, shoots from the wand's tip in a {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} 30 feet long and 5 feet wide toward the chosen point of origin. Each gem deals 1 Bludgeoning damage, and the total damage of the gems is divided equally among all creatures in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}.

You cast {@spell Polymorph|XPHB}, targeting the creature closest to the chosen point of origin. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the target's new form. On a {@b 1}, the new form is a {@creature Black Bear|XMM}; on a {@b 2}, the new form is a {@creature Giant Wasp|XMM}; on a {@b 3-4}, the new form is a {@creature Frog|XMM}.

The creature closest to the chosen point of origin makes a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition and begins to turn to stone. While {@condition Restrained|XPHB} in this way, the creature repeats the save at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Petrified|XPHB} condition instead of the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the {@spell Greater Restoration|XPHB} spell or similar magic.

item.name: Wand Sheath
entries: A wand sheath clamps onto your arm and imparts the following benefits:

items: The wand sheath can't be removed from you while you're attuned to it.
You can insert a wand into the sheath as an action. The sheath can hold only one wand at a time.
You can retract or extend a wand from the sheath as a bonus action. While the wand is extended, you can use it as if you were holding it, but your hand remains free.

entries: If a sheathed wand requires attunement, you must attune to the wand before you can use it. However, the wand sheath and the attached wand count as a single magic item with regard to the number of magic items you can attune to. If you remove the wand from the sheath, your attunement to the wand ends.
entries_es: Una varita de varita se aferra a su brazo e imparte los siguientes beneficios:

items: The wand sheath can't be removed from you while you're attuned to it.
You can insert a wand into the sheath as an action. The sheath can hold only one wand at a time.
You can retract or extend a wand from the sheath as a bonus action. While the wand is extended, you can use it as if you were holding it, but your hand remains free.

entries_es: Si una varita con varita requiere attunement, debes atontar la varita antes de que puedas utilizarla. Sin embargo, la vaina de varita y la varita adjunta cuentan como un solo elemento mágico con respecto al número de elementos mágicos a los que se puede sintonizar. Si quitas la varita de la vaina, tu atontado hasta los extremos de la varita.

item.name: War Horn of Valor
entries: This brass war horn is engraved with the war rune, which glows purple when the horn is blown.

You can blow the horn as a bonus action. When you do, if you have the frightened condition, you immediately end that condition on yourself. You also have advantage on saving throws against being frightened until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Invoking the Rune
entries: When you blow the horn, you can also invoke the rune, imbuing the horn's deep call with protective magic that affects creatures of your choice within 30 feet of yourself. You and all affected creatures gain a +1 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.
Once the rune has been invoked, it can't be invoked again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Cuando soplas el cuerno, también puedes invocar la runa, imbuyendo la profunda llamada del cuerno con magia protectora que afecta a las criaturas de tu elección dentro de 30 pies de ti mismo. Usted y todas las criaturas afectadas ganan un bono +1 a AC hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno.
Una vez invocada la runa, no puede ser invocada de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

Puedes soplar el cuerno como una acción de bonificación. Cuando lo haces, si tienes la condición asustada, terminas inmediatamente esa condición contigo mismo. Usted también tiene ventaja en ahorrar lanzamientos contra estar asustado hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno.

item.name: Warm Fungal Clothing
entries: When you're wearing Warm Fungal Clothing, you automatically succeed on saving throws against the effects of extreme cold. See chapter 3 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for rules on extreme cold. One pound of fungus is sewn into Fungal Clothing. This fungus can be eaten as food. Once all the fungus is consumed, this becomes a mundane set of {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}.
entries_es: Cuando estás usando Warm Fungal Clothing, automáticamente tienes éxito en ahorrar lanzamientos contra los efectos del frío extremo. Véase el capítulo 3 de la Guía del Maestro de Dungeon para reglas sobre el frío extremo. Una libra de hongos es cosida en ropa fúngica. Este hongo se puede comer como comida. Una vez que todo el hongo se consume, esto se convierte en un conjunto mundano de {@item Traveler's Clothes|XPHB}.

item.name: Warrior's Passkey
entries: This silver skeleton key is warm to the touch. While holding the key in its key form, you can use an action to cast the {@spell Knock} spell from the key.

entries.name: Transforming the Key
entries: While holding the key, you can use a bonus action to transform it into a magic longsword. You are considered proficient with the sword, and you have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. On a hit, the sword deals {@damage 1d10} force damage. The item remains in its sword form until it leaves your grasp or you use another bonus action to revert it to its key form.
If you end your attunement to the item while it's in its sword form, it automatically reverts to its key form.
entries_es: Mientras sostiene la clave, puede utilizar una acción de bonificación para transformarla en una palabra de larga duración mágica. Usted es considerado competente con la espada, y tiene un bono +1 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con él. En un golpe, la espada trata {@damage 1d10} de la fuerza daño. El artículo permanece en su forma de espada hasta que deja tu alcance o usas otra acción de bonificación para volverlo a su forma clave.
Si terminas tu attunement al artículo mientras está en su forma de espada, automáticamente se vuelve a su forma clave.
Esta llave de esqueleto plateado está caliente al tacto. Mientras sostiene la clave en su forma clave, puede utilizar una acción para echar el hechizo {@spell Knock} de la clave.

item.name: Wasp Ship
entries: Wasp ships are lightweight wooden vessels capable of landing safely on the ground, but not on water. They appeal to adventurers because they're affordable and don't require a large crew. Pirates like them because they're swift. Aristocrats are fond of using them as flying yachts because the ship's cargo hold can be easily converted into posh living quarters.
The ship's raised back provides high ground for a weapon emplacement, which is typically equipped with a ballista.
entries_es: Los buques de avispa son vasos de madera ligeros capaces de aterrizar con seguridad sobre el suelo, pero no sobre el agua. Llaman a los aventureros porque son asequibles y no requieren una gran tripulación. Piratas como ellos porque son rápidos. Aristócratas les gusta utilizarlos como yates voladores porque la bodega de carga del barco se puede convertir fácilmente en posh barrios vivos.
La nave levantada hacia atrás proporciona un terreno alto para un emplazamiento de armas, que normalmente está equipado con un balista.

item.name: Watchful Helm
entries: While you wear this helm, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and remain aware of your surroundings even while you're asleep, and you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.
As a bonus action, you can cast the {@spell see invisibility} spell from the helm. Once this property of the helm is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras usted usa este timón, usted gana un bono +1 a AC y permanecer consciente de su entorno incluso mientras usted está dormido, y tiene ventaja en la Sabiduría ({@skill Perception}) cheques que confían en la vista.
Como una acción de bonificación, usted puede lanzar el hechizo [[TAG0] del timón. Una vez que se utiliza esta propiedad del timón, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Waterskin
entries: A waterskin can hold up to 4 pints of liquid.
entries_es: Una calabaza puede contener hasta 4 pintas de líquido.

item.name: Waterskin
entries: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk dehydration.
entries_es: Un Waterskin tiene hasta 4 pintas. Si no bebes suficiente agua, corres el riesgo de deshidratación.

item.name: Wave
item.reqAttune: by a creature that worships a god of the sea
entries: Held in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain, this trident is an exquisite weapon engraved with images of waves, shells, and sea creatures. Although you must worship a god of the sea to attune to this weapon, Wave happily accepts new converts.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. If you score a critical hit with it, the target takes extra necrotic damage equal to half its hit point maximum.

The weapon also functions as a {@item trident of fish command} and a {@item weapon of warning}. It can confer the benefit of a {@item cap of water breathing} while you hold it, and you can use it as a {@item cube of force} by choosing the effect, instead of pressing cube sides to select it.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Wave is a sentient weapon of neutral alignment, with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 10, and a Charisma of 18. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.

The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak, read, and understand Aquan. It can also speak with aquatic animals as if using a {@spell speak with animals} spell, using telepathy to involve its wielder in the conversation.
entries_es: Wave es un arma sensible de alineación neutral, con una Inteligencia de 14, una Sabiduría de 10, y una Charisma de 18. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.

El arma se comunica telepáticamente con su wielder y puede hablar, leer y entender Aquan. También puede hablar con animales acuáticos como si usara un hechizo {@spell speak with animals}, utilizando la telepatía para involucrar su wielder en la conversación.

entries.name: Personality
entries: When it grows restless, Wave has a habit of humming tunes that vary from sea chanteys to sacred hymns of the sea gods.

Wave zealously desires to convert mortals to the worship of one or more sea gods, or else to consign the faithless to death. Conflict arises if the wielder fails to further the weapon's objectives in the world. The trident has a nostalgic attachment to the place where it was forged, a desolate island called Thunderforge. A sea god imprisoned a family of storm giants there, and the giants forged Wave in an act of devotion to—or rebellion against—that god.

Wave harbors a secret doubt about its own nature and purpose. For all its devotion to the sea gods, Wave fears that it was intended to bring about a particular sea god's demise. This destiny is something Wave might not be able to avert.
entries_es: Cuando crece inquieto, Wave tiene un hábito de agitar melodías que varían de los cantos marinos a himnos sagrados de los dioses del mar.

Wave desea fervientemente convertir a los mortales a la adoración de uno o más dioses marinos, o de otro modo enviar a los infieles a la muerte. El conflicto surge si el pelador no logra promover los objetivos del arma en el mundo. El tridente tiene un apego nostálgico al lugar donde fue forjado, una isla desolada llamada Thunderforge. Un dios del mar encarceló a una familia de gigantes de tormenta allí, y los gigantes forjaron a Wave en un acto de devoción a —o rebelión contra— ese dios.

Wave alberga una duda secreta sobre su propia naturaleza y propósito. Por toda su devoción a los dioses del mar, Wave teme que tenía la intención de provocar la muerte de un dios del mar en particular. Este destino es algo que Wave podría no ser capaz de evitar.

entries: A bubble of air forms around your head while you are underwater, allowing you to breathe normally in that environment.
entries_es: Una burbuja de formas de aire alrededor de su cabeza mientras usted está bajo el agua, lo que le permite respirar normalmente en ese ambiente.

entries: Wave can be destroyed only on the island of Thunderforge, where it was forged. The weapon must be melted down by a {@creature storm giant|XMM} or someone imbued with a storm giant's strength. Destroying Wave angers a god of the sea, who sends powerful agents to attack the island and punish the destroyers.

item.name: Wayfarer's Boots
entries: This pair of boots is made of durable cloth, with the journey rune stitched in golden thread above each heel. While you are wearing this item, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks.

entries.name: Invoking the Runes
entries: As a bonus action, you can invoke the boots' runes to cast the {@spell expeditious retreat} spell with them. Once the runes have been invoked, they can't be invoked again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Como una acción de bonificación, puede invocar las runas de las botas para lanzar el hechizo [[TAG0] con ellos. Una vez invocadas las runas, no pueden ser invocadas hasta el siguiente amanecer.

Este par de botas está hecho de tela duradera, con la runa de viaje cosida en hilo dorado sobre cada tacón. Mientras usted está usando este artículo, su velocidad de caminar aumenta en 10 pies, y usted tiene ventaja en las comprobaciones de Sabiduría ([TAG0]).

item.name: Waythe
entries: Waythe is a unique greatsword most recently in the possession of a high-ranking {@creature cloud giant} ambassador.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature of the giant type with it, the giant takes an extra {@damage 2d6} slashing damage, and it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.
The sword also functions as a {@item wand of enemy detection}. It regains all of its expended charges at dawn and isn't at risk of crumbling if its last charge is used.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Waythe is a sentient weapon of neutral good alignment, with an Intelligence of 12, a Wisdom of 2, and a Charisma of 14. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.
The weapon can speak and understand Giant and Common, and it can communicate telepathically with its wielder.
entries_es: Waythe es un arma sensible de buena alineación neutral, con una Inteligencia de 12, una Sabiduría de 2, y una Charisma de 14. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.
El arma puede hablar y entender Giant y Common, y puede comunicarse telepáticamente con su wielder.

entries.name: Personality
entries: This sword believes in freedom and allowing others to live as they see fit. It is protective of its friends, and wants to be friends with a like-minded wielder. (It takes only 1 minute for a good-aligned character to gain attunement with the sword.) Waythe is courageous to the point of foolhardiness, however, and vocally urges bold action. It is likely to come into conflict with an evil or a timid wielder.
entries_es: Esta espada cree en la libertad y permitiendo que otros vivan según lo que ven apropiado. Es protector de sus amigos, y quiere ser amigos con un wielder de mente similar. (Lleva sólo 1 minuto para que un personaje de buena alineación pueda ganar atontado con la espada.) Waythe es valiente al punto de la dureza, sin embargo, e insta vocalmente a la acción atrevida. Es probable que entre en conflicto con un mal o un pelador tímido.

additionalEntries: Weaver's tools allow you to create cloth and tailor it into articles of clothing.

additionalEntries.name: Components
entries: Weaver's tools include thread, needles, and scraps of cloth. You know how to work a loom, but such equipment is too large to transport.
entries_es: Las herramientas de Weaver incluyen hilo, agujas y pedazos de tela. Usted sabe cómo trabajar un telar, pero este equipo es demasiado grande para transportar.

additionalEntries.name: Arcana, History
entries: Your expertise lends you additional insight when examining cloth objects, including cloaks and robes.
entries_es: Su experiencia le brinda información adicional al examinar objetos de tela, incluyendo mantos y túnicas.

additionalEntries.name: Investigation
entries: Using your knowledge of the process of creating cloth objects, you can spot clues and make deductions that others would overlook when you examine tapestries, upholstery, clothing, and other woven items.
entries_es: Usando su conocimiento del proceso de creación de objetos de tela, puede detectar pistas y hacer deducciones que otros pasarían por alto al examinar tapices, tapicería, ropa y otros artículos tejidos.

additionalEntries.name: Repair
entries: As part of a short rest, you can repair a single damaged cloth object.
entries_es: Como parte de un breve descanso, puede reparar un solo objeto dañado de tela.

additionalEntries.name: Craft Clothing
entries: Assuming you have access to sufficient cloth and thread, you can create an outfit for a creature as part of a long rest.
entries_es: Asumiendo que usted tiene acceso a tela suficiente e hilo, usted puede crear un traje para una criatura como parte de un descanso largo.

item.name: Weird Tank
entries: A weird tank is a ten-gallon tank of blown glass and sculpted bronze with a backpack-like carrying harness fashioned from tough leather. A {@creature water weird} is contained within the tank. While wearing the tank, you can use an action to open it, allowing the {@creature water weird} to emerge. The {@creature water weird} acts immediately after you in the initiative order, and it is bound to the tank.

You can command the {@creature water weird} telepathically (no action required) while you wear the tank. You can close the tank as an action only if you have first commanded the {@creature water weird} to retract into it or if the {@creature water weird} is dead.

If the {@creature water weird} is killed, the tank loses its magical containment property until it spends at least 24 hours inside an elemental water node. When the tank is recharged, a new {@creature water weird} forms inside it.

The tank has AC 15, 50 hit points, vulnerability to bludgeoning damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. Reducing the tank to 0 hit points destroys it and the {@creature water weird} contained within it.
entries_es: Un tanque extraño es un tanque de diez galones de vidrio soplado y bronce esculpido con un arnés de carga tipo mochila de cuero duro. A {@creature water weird} está contenida dentro del tanque. Mientras lleva el tanque, puede utilizar una acción para abrirlo, permitiendo que el [[TAG0] emerger. El {@creature water weird} actúa inmediatamente después de usted en el orden de iniciativa, y está obligado al tanque.

Puede ordenar el [[TAG0] telepáticamente (no se requiere acción) mientras usa el tanque. Usted puede cerrar el tanque como una acción sólo si usted ha ordenado primero al {@creature water weird} para retractarse en él o si el {@creature water weird} está muerto.

Si el {@creature water weird} es asesinado, el tanque pierde su propiedad mágica de contención hasta que pasa al menos 24 horas dentro de un nodo de agua elemental. Cuando el tanque es recargado, un nuevo [[TAG0] forma dentro de él.

El tanque tiene AC 15, 50 puntos de impacto, vulnerabilidad a la reducción de daños, e inmunidad a daño venenoso y psíquico. Reducir el tanque a 0 puntos de impacto lo destruye y el [[TAG0] contenido en él.

item.name: Well of Many Worlds
entries: This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter.

You can use an action to unfold and place the well of many worlds on a solid surface, whereupon it creates a two-way portal to another world or plane of existence. Each time the item opens a portal, the DM decides where it leads. You can use an action to close an open portal by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up. Once well of many worlds has opened a portal, it can't do so again for {@dice 1d8} hours.
entries_es: Este fino paño negro, suave como seda, se dobla hasta las dimensiones de un pañuelo. Se desarrolla en una hoja circular de 6 pies de diámetro.

Puedes usar una acción para desplegar y colocar el pozo de muchos mundos en una superficie sólida, donde crea un portal bidireccional a otro mundo o plano de existencia. Cada vez que el artículo abre un portal, el DM decide dónde conduce. Usted puede utilizar una acción para cerrar un portal abierto al agarrar los bordes del paño y doblarlo. Una vez que muchos mundos han abierto un portal, no puede hacerlo de nuevo por {@dice 1d8} horas.

item.name: Well of Many Worlds
entries: This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter.

You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to unfold the Well of Many Worlds and place it on a solid surface, whereupon it forms a two-way, 6-foot-diameter, circular portal to another world or plane of existence. Each time the item opens a portal, the DM decides where it leads. The portal remains open until a creature within 5 feet of it takes a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to close it by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up.
Once the Well of Many Worlds has opened a portal, it can't do so again for {@dice 1d8} hours.
entries_es: Este fino paño negro, suave como seda, se dobla hasta las dimensiones de un pañuelo. Se desarrolla en una hoja circular de 6 pies de diámetro.

Puedes tomar una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para desplegar el Bien de Muchos Mundos y colocarla en una superficie sólida, sobre la cual forma un portal circular de dos vías, de 6 pies de diámetro, a otro mundo o plano de existencia. Cada vez que el artículo abre un portal, el DM decide dónde conduce. El portal permanece abierto hasta que una criatura dentro de 5 pies de él toma una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para cerrarlo tomando posesión de los bordes de la tela y doblarla.
Una vez que el pozo de muchos mundos ha abierto un portal, no puede hacerlo de nuevo por {@dice 1d8} horas.

item.name: Wheel of Stars
entries: While attuned to this device, you have a +1 bonus to Wisdom saving throws, and you can use an action to cast the {@spell dancing lights}, {@spell guidance}, or {@spell message} cantrips.

entries.name: Portent of the Stars
entries: As a reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, you make that creature roll a {@dice d10} and add or subtract the number rolled (your choice) from the roll. Once you use this feature of the wheel of stars, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Como reacción cuando una criatura puede ver dentro de 60 pies de usted hace un rollo de ataque, ahorro de tiro, o control de habilidad, usted hace que la criatura rodar un {@dice d10} y añadir o restar el número rodado (su elección) del rollo. Una vez que utilizas esta característica de la rueda de las estrellas, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Alter Gravity
entries: As an action, you can cast {@spell fly} on yourself or you can cast {@spell levitate} (save {@dc 15}). Once you use this feature of the wheel of stars, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Como acción, usted puede lanzar {@spell fly} en sí mismo o puede lanzar {@spell levitate}] (salvar {@dc 15}). Una vez que utilizas esta característica de la rueda de las estrellas, no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Part of a Whole
entries: While this component is not installed in the {@item Orrery of the Wanderer|AI}, its magic might function sporadically or with unpredictable side effects, as determined by the DM.
entries_es: Si bien este componente no se instala en {@item Orrery of the Wanderer|AI}, su magia puede funcionar esporádicamente o con efectos secundarios impredecibles, según lo determinado por el DM.

Mientras se ajusta a este dispositivo, usted tiene un bono +1 a los lanzamientos de ahorro de Sabiduría, y puede utilizar una acción para lanzar los {@spell dancing lights}, {@spell guidance}], o {@spell message}.

item.name: Wheel of Wind and Water
entries: When mounted at the helm of an elemental galleon or airship, this wheel allows a creature that possesses the Mark of Storm to telepathically control the elemental bound inside the vessel.

If a wheel of wind and water is mounted on a mundane sailing ship, a creature with the Mark of Storm who is using the wheel can create an area of ideal conditions around the vessel, increasing its speed by 5 miles per hour.
entries_es: Cuando se monta en el timón de un galleón elemental o una nave aérea, esta rueda permite a una criatura que posee la marca de la tormenta controlar telepáticamente el límite elemental dentro de la nave.

Si una rueda de viento y agua se monta en un barco mundano de vela, una criatura con la marca de tormenta que está utilizando la rueda puede crear una zona de condiciones ideales alrededor del buque, aumentando su velocidad en 5 millas por hora.

item.name: Whelm
entries: Whelm is a powerful warhammer forged by dwarves and lost in the dungeon of White Plume Mountain.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. At dawn the day after you first make an attack roll with Whelm, you develop a fear of being outdoors that persists as long as you remain attuned to the weapon. This causes you to have disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks while you can see the daytime sky.

entries.name: Thrown Weapon
entries: Whelm has the thrown property, with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. When you hit with a ranged weapon attack using it, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d8} bludgeoning damage, or an extra {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning damage if the target is a giant. Each time you throw the weapon, it flies back to your hand after the attack. If you don't have a hand free, the weapon lands at your feet.
entries_es: Whelm tiene la propiedad lanzada, con un rango normal de 20 pies y una larga gama de 60 pies. Cuando usted golpea con un ataque de arma extendida usándolo, el objetivo toma un daño extra {@damage 1d8} desgarrador, o un daño extra {@damage 2d8} desgarrando si el objetivo es un gigante. Cada vez que tiras el arma, vuelve a tu mano después del ataque. Si no tienes una mano libre, el arma aterriza a tus pies.

entries.name: Shock Wave
entries: You can use an action to strike the ground with Whelm and send a shock wave out from the point of impact. Each creature of your choice on the ground within 60 feet of that point must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or become {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Puede utilizar una acción para golpear el suelo con Whelm y enviar una onda de choque desde el punto de impacto. Cada criatura de su elección en el suelo dentro de 60 pies de ese punto debe tener éxito en un {@dc 15} Constitución ahorrando lanzamiento o convirtiéndose {@condition stunned} por 1 minuto. Una criatura puede repetir el lanzamiento de ahorro al final de cada uno de sus turnos, terminando el efecto sobre sí mismo en un éxito. Una vez utilizado, esta propiedad no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Supernatural Awareness
entries: While you are holding the weapon, it alerts you to the location of any secret or concealed doors within 30 feet of you. In addition, you can use an action to cast {@spell detect evil and good} or {@spell locate object} from the weapon. Once you cast either spell, you can't cast it from the weapon again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras usted está sosteniendo el arma, le alerta a la ubicación de cualquier puerta secreta o oculta dentro de 30 pies de usted. Además, puede utilizar una acción para lanzar {@spell detect evil and good} o {@spell locate object} del arma. Una vez que lanzas cualquier hechizo, no puedes echarlo del arma de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Whelm is a sentient lawful neutral weapon with an Intelligence of 15, a Wisdom of 12, and a Charisma of 15. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak, read, and understand Dwarvish, Giant, and Goblin. It shouts battle cries in Dwarvish when used in combat.
entries_es: Whelm es un arma sensible lícita neutral con una Inteligencia de 15, una Sabiduría de 12, y una Charisma de 15. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.
El arma se comunica telepáticamente con su wielder y puede hablar, leer y entender Dwarvish, Giant y Goblin. Grita gritos de batalla en Dwarvish cuando se usa en combate.

entries.name: Personality
entries: Whelm's purpose is to slaughter giants and goblinoids. It also seeks to protect dwarves against all enemies. Conflict arises if the wielder fails to destroy goblins and giants or to protect dwarves. Whelm has ties to the dwarf clan that created it, variously called the Dankil or the Mightyhammer clan. It longs to be returned to that clan. It would do anything to protect those dwarves from harm. The hammer also carries a secret shame. Centuries ago, a dwarf named Ctenmiir wielded it valiantly for a time. But Ctenmiir was turned into a {@creature vampire}. His will was strong enough that he bent Whelm to his evil purposes, even killing members of his own clan.
entries_es: El propósito de Whelm es destruir gigantes y goblinoides. También busca proteger enanos contra todos los enemigos. El conflicto surge si el wielder no destruye goblins y gigantes o para proteger enanos. Whelm tiene vínculos con el clan enano que lo creó, varios llamados el Dankil o el clan Mightyhammer. Anhela ser devuelto a ese clan. Haría cualquier cosa para proteger a esos enanos del daño. El martillo también lleva una vergüenza secreta. Hace siglos, un enano llamado Ctenmiir lo marchó valientemente por un tiempo. Pero Ctenmiir se convirtió en un {@creature vampire}. Su voluntad fue lo suficientemente fuerte como para doler a Whelm a sus propósitos malvados, incluso matando miembros de su propio clan.
Whelm es un poderoso guerrero forjado por enanos y perdido en la mazmorra de White Plume Mountain.

Ganas un bono +3 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma mágica. Al amanecer el día después de hacer un rodaje de ataque con Whelm, desarrollas un miedo de estar al aire libre que persiste mientras permanezcas al tanto del arma. Esto te hace tener desventaja en los rollos de ataque, ahorros de tiros y controles de habilidad mientras puedes ver el cielo del día.

entries: While you are holding the weapon, it alerts you to the location of any secret or concealed doors within 30 feet of you. In addition, you can cast {@spell Detect Evil and Good|XPHB} or {@spell Locate Object|XPHB} from the weapon. Once you cast either spell, you can't cast it from the weapon again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Mientras usted está sosteniendo el arma, le alerta a la ubicación de cualquier puerta secreta o oculta dentro de 30 pies de usted. Además, puede echar {@spell Detect Evil and Good|XPHB} o {@spell Locate Object|XPHB} del arma. Una vez que lanzas cualquier hechizo, no puedes echarlo del arma de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Whelm is a sentient, Lawful Neutral weapon with an Intelligence of 15, a Wisdom of 12, and a Charisma of 15. It has hearing and {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and speaks Dwarvish, Giant, and Goblin.
entries_es: Whelm es un arma neutral sensible y legal con una inteligencia de 15, una sabiduría de 12, y una carisma de 15. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a 120 pies.
El arma se comunica telepáticamente con su wielder y habla Dwarvish, Giant y Goblin.

entries.name: Personality
entries: Whelm has ties to the dwarf clan that created it, called the Dankil or the Mightyhammer clan. It longs to be returned to that clan. Whelm's purpose is to protect dwarves. Conflict arises if the wielder doesn't share this goal.
entries_es: Whelm tiene vínculos con el clan enano que lo creó, llamado el Dankil o el clan Mightyhammer. Anhela ser devuelto a ese clan. El propósito de Whelm es proteger enanos. El conflicto surge si el wielder no comparte este objetivo.

entries.name: Destroying Whelm
entries: Whelm can be dissolved in the acidic bile of a recently slain {@creature ancient black dragon|XMM}. It can also be melted down in the forges of the Mightyhammer dwarf clan, but only by the rightful leader of that clan.
entries_es: Whelm se puede disolver en la bilis ácida de un recién muerto {@creature ancient black dragon|XMM}. También puede ser derribado en las forjas del clan enano de Mightyhammer, pero sólo por el líder legítimo de ese clan.
Whelm es un arma poderosa forjada por enanos y perdida en la mazmorra de White Plume Mountain.
Ganas un bono +3 para atacar rollos y rollos de daño hechos con este arma mágica.

entries_es.name: Hurl
entries: Whelm has {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} with a normal range of 60 feet and a long range of 180 feet. When you hit with a ranged attack roll using Whelm, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d8} Force damage, or an extra {@damage 4d8} Force damage if the target is a Construct, an Elemental, or a Giant. Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon flies back to your hand.
entries_es: Whelm tiene {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} con un rango normal de 60 pies y una larga gama de 180 pies. Cuando golpeas con un rollo de ataque con Whelm, el objetivo toma un extra {@damage 1d8} Daño de la fuerza, o un extra {@damage 4d8} Daño de la fuerza si el objetivo es un constructo, un elemento o un gigante. Inmediatamente después de golpear o perder, el arma vuelve a tu mano.

entries_es.name: Shock Wave
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to strike the ground with Whelm and send a shock wave out from the point of impact. Each creature of your choice on the ground within 60 feet of that point must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. A creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: Usted puede tomar una [[TAG0] acción para golpear el suelo con Whelm y enviar una onda de choque desde el punto de impacto. Cada criatura de su elección en el suelo dentro de 60 pies de ese punto debe tener éxito en un {@dc 20} Constitución ahorrando o tener la condición [[TAG2] por 1 minuto. Una criatura repite el ahorro al final de cada uno de sus turnos, terminando el efecto sobre sí misma en un éxito. Una vez utilizado, esta propiedad no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: Whisper (Dormant)
entries: Forged with a mercurial metal accidentally drawn from the Realms Beyond, this dagger shimmers with an unsettling sourceless light. It was once wielded by {@creature Champion of Ravens|TDCSR|Vax'ildan, a legendary champion of the Matron of Ravens}. Two raven feathers are linked to its pommel as a memento of its former bearer.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: While Whisper is in a dormant state, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Additionally, when you score a critical hit with this dagger, the target must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw} or become {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. On a success, the target is immune to this effect for 24 hours.
entries_es: Mientras Whisper está en un estado inactivo, usted gana un bono +1 para atacar y dañar rollos hechos con este arma mágica.

Además, cuando usted anota un éxito crítico con esta daga, el objetivo debe tener éxito en una {@dc 13} Sabiduría {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}] o convertirse {@condition frightened} de usted por 1 minuto. En un éxito, el objetivo es inmune a este efecto durante 24 horas.

Una vez fue manipulado por {@creature Champion of Ravens|TDCSR|Vax'ildan, a legendary champion of the Matron of Ravens}. Dos plumas de cuervo están vinculadas a su pommel como un recuerdo de su anterior portador.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When Whisper reaches an exalted state, you gain the following benefits:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +3, and the extra psychic damage it deals increases to {@dice 1d8}.
The DC to resist being {@condition frightened} from a critical hit increases to 17.

When this dagger is used to make a ranged attack, you can choose to transform into shadow and merge with the blade as part of the action used to attack, teleporting to another location. If the attack hits, you appear in an unoccupied space of your choice within 5 feet of the target. If the attack misses, you appear where the GM determines the dagger lands (typically within {@dice 1d6 × 5} feet of the target). In either case, you appear with the dagger in your hand.

item.name: Whisper Jar
entries: Also at rank 1, you are the beneficiary of a whisper jar—a common magic item resembling an ether-filled jar with a long tap hose. The jar is used to record others' stories and your own observations, like a verbal notebook with unlimited space. The whisper jar records as fast as a creature can speak into it, and whispers back words at the same pace they were recorded. Activating the playback of a particular recording is an action.

entries.caption: Things Recorded in Your Whisper Jar
rows: A live recording of the only performance of the mostly forgotten stage play Tabaxi on a Hot Tin Roof
The life's work of the loremonger who owned the jar before you
Every courageous thought you've ever had, to cover for how scared you are most of the time
Everything, because everyone else around you will eat their words one day!
The top seven places to eat fried rat skewers in every settlement you've ever visited
The entire family tree of every royal line, extant or lost, in Faerûn
A moment-by-moment review of your favorite Jim Darkmagic stage performance
The sound of raucous applause, which you play back liberally

entries.name: Whispered Encyclopedia
entries: At rank 2, your whisper jar becomes an uncommon magic item that can tap into the broader lore of Acquisitions Incorporated. As a bonus action, you ask the jar for information on a specific subject and make a {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check. On a success, the jar plays back a recording on that subject, made somewhere, sometime by another Acq Inc loremonger. This property of the whisper jar can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: En el rango 2, su tarro de susurros se convierte en un elemento mágico infrecuente que puede tocar en el loro más amplio de las adquisiciones incorporadas. Como una acción de bonificación, usted pide al tarro para obtener información sobre un tema específico y hacer un {@dc 15} Inteligencia ([TAG1]) cheque. En un éxito, el tarro reproduce una grabación sobre ese tema, hecha en algún lugar, en algún momento por otro loremonger Acq Inc. Esta propiedad del tarro de susurros no puede ser usada de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Whispered Warnings
entries: Also at rank 3, your whisper jar gains additional power and becomes a rare magic item. As an action, you can cause the jar to function as a {@item wand of enemy detection}, whereupon it whispers the direction to foes within range. This property of the whisper jar can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: También en el rango 3, su jarra de susurros gana poder adicional y se convierte en un elemento mágico raro. Como acción, usted puede hacer que el tarro funcione como un {@item wand of enemy detection}, donde a continuación susurra la dirección para los enemigos dentro del rango. Esta propiedad del tarro de susurros no puede ser usada de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Whispered Arcana
entries: Also at rank 4, your whisper jar gains access to even more magic. By whispering the name of one of the following spells into the jar as an action, you can cast that spell from the jar: {@spell detect evil and good}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell detect poison and disease}, {@spell find traps}, {@spell identify}, or {@spell locate animals or plants}. This property of the whisper jar can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: También en el rango 4, su jarra de susurros gana acceso a aún más magia. Al susurrar el nombre de uno de los siguientes hechizos en el frasco como una acción, usted puede echar ese hechizo del frasco: {@spell detect evil and good}, {@spell detect magic}], {@spell detect poison and disease}, {@spell find traps}], {@spell identify}], o {@spell locate animals or plants}. Esta propiedad del tarro de susurros no puede ser usada de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

También en el rango 1, usted es el beneficiario de un tarro de susurros, un elemento mágico común que se parece a un frasco lleno de éter con una manguera larga del grifo. El tarro se utiliza para grabar historias de otros y sus propias observaciones, como un cuaderno verbal con espacio ilimitado. El tarro de susurros registra tan rápido como una criatura puede hablar en él, y susurra palabras al mismo ritmo que fueron grabados. Activar la reproducción de una grabación en particular es una acción.

item.name: Whistle-Stick
entries: The {@race grung|OGA} of {@book One Grung Above|OGA} are trained to use this new musical instrument. This is a hollow tube with holes cut throughout, much like a flute. You can play music with it for entertainment, but the grung also swing it about by a sturdy cord (attached) to create a sound recognizable by other grung, so they know each other's approximate location. Additionally, grung that know {@language Thieves' Cant} can use a whistle stick in this manner to communicate over distance.
entries_es: Los {@race grung|OGA} de {@book One Grung Above|OGA}] son entrenados para utilizar este nuevo instrumento musical. Este es un tubo hueco con agujeros cortados a lo largo, como una flauta. Puedes tocar música con ella para el entretenimiento, pero el grung también lo columpio por un cordón robusto (apegado) para crear un sonido reconocible por otros grung, por lo que se conocen la ubicación aproximada del otro. Además, grung que sabe {@language Thieves' Cant} puede utilizar un bastón de silbato de esta manera para comunicarse a lo largo de la distancia.

entries_es: [[TAG0]

item.name: White Dragon Cape
entries: You have resistance to cold damage while wearing this cape.
entries_es: Usted tiene resistencia al daño frío mientras usa esta capa.

item.name: White Dragon Mask
entries: This gleaming mask is white with highlights of pale blue and is topped by a spined crest. The mask reshapes to fit a wearer attuned to it. While you are wearing the mask and attuned to it, you can access the following properties.

entries.name: Damage Absorption
entries: You have resistance against cold damage. If you already have resistance to cold damage from another source, you instead have immunity to cold damage. If you already have immunity to cold damage from another source, whenever you are subjected to cold damage, you take none of that damage and regain a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt of that type.
entries_es: Tienes resistencia contra el daño frío. Si usted ya tiene resistencia al daño frío de otra fuente, en su lugar tiene inmunidad al daño frío. Si usted ya tiene inmunidad al daño frío de otra fuente, cada vez que está sujeto a daños fríos, usted no toma ninguno de esos daños y recuperar un número de puntos de impacto igual a la mitad de los daños de ese tipo.

entries.name: Draconic Majesty
entries: While you are wearing no armor, you can add your Charisma bonus to your Armor Class.
entries_es: Mientras no llevas armadura, puedes añadir tu bono de Charisma a tu Clase Armor.

entries.name: Dragon Breath
entries: If you have a breath weapon that requires rest to recharge, it gains a recharge of 6.
entries_es: Si usted tiene un arma respiratoria que requiere descanso para recargar, gana una recarga de 6.

entries.name: Dragon Sight
entries: You gain {@sense darkvision} out to 60 feet, or to an additional 60 feet if you already have that sense. Once per day, you can gain {@sense blindsight} out to 30 feet for 5 minutes.
entries_es: Usted gana {@sense darkvision} a 60 pies, o a 60 pies adicionales si usted ya tiene ese sentido. Una vez por día, puede ganar [[TAG1] a 30 pies por 5 minutos.

entries.name: Dragon Tongue
entries: You can speak and understand Draconic. You also have advantage on any Charisma check you make against White Dragons.
entries_es: Puedes hablar y entender Draconic. También tiene ventaja en cualquier cheque de Charisma que haga contra los Dragones Blancos.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: (1/Day) If you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.
entries_es: (1/Día) Si falla un tiro de ahorro, puede elegir tener éxito en su lugar.

entries.name: Winter's Fury
entries: While your current hit points are equal to or less than half your hit point maximum, you deal an extra {@damage 1d8} cold damage with your melee attacks.
entries_es: Mientras que sus puntos de impacto actuales son iguales o menos de la mitad de su punto de éxito máximo, usted se ocupa de un daño adicional [[TAG0] frío con sus ataques de melee.

Esta máscara brillante es blanca con los momentos más destacados de azul pálido y está cubierta por una cresta girada. La máscara reforma para encajar con un usuario afinado. Mientras usted está usando la máscara y afinado a ella, usted puede acceder a las siguientes propiedades.

entries_es.name: Damage Absorption
entries: You have resistance against cold damage. If you already have resistance to cold damage from another source, you instead have immunity to cold damage. If you already have immunity to cold damage from another source, whenever you are subjected to cold damage, you take none of that damage and regain a number of hit points equal to half the damage dealt of that type.
entries_es: Tienes resistencia contra el daño frío. Si usted ya tiene resistencia al daño frío de otra fuente, en su lugar tiene inmunidad al daño frío. Si usted ya tiene inmunidad al daño frío de otra fuente, cada vez que está sujeto a daños fríos, usted no toma ninguno de esos daños y recuperar un número de puntos de impacto igual a la mitad de los daños de ese tipo.

entries_es.name: Draconic Majesty
entries: While you are wearing no armor, you can add your Charisma bonus to your Armor Class.
entries_es: Mientras no llevas armadura, puedes añadir tu bono de Charisma a tu Clase Armor.

entries_es.name: Dragon Breath
entries: If you have a breath weapon that requires rest to recharge, it gains a recharge of 6.
entries_es: Si usted tiene un arma respiratoria que requiere descanso para recargar, gana una recarga de 6.

entries_es.name: Dragon Sight
entries: You gain {@sense darkvision} out to 60 feet, or to an additional 60 feet if you already have that sense. Once per day, you can gain {@sense blindsight} out to 30 feet for 5 minutes.
entries_es: Usted gana {@sense darkvision} a 60 pies, o a 60 pies adicionales si usted ya tiene ese sentido. Una vez por día, puede ganar [[TAG1] a 30 pies por 5 minutos.

entries_es.name: Dragon Tongue
entries: You can speak and understand Draconic. You also have advantage on any Charisma check you make against White Dragons.
entries_es: Puedes hablar y entender Draconic. También tiene ventaja en cualquier cheque de Charisma que haga contra los Dragones Blancos.

entries_es.name: Legendary Resistance
entries: (1/Day) If you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.
entries_es: (1/Día) Si falla un tiro de ahorro, puede elegir tener éxito en su lugar.

entries_es.name: Winter's Fury
entries: While your current hit points are equal to or less than half your hit point maximum, you deal an extra {@damage 1d8} cold damage with your melee attacks.
entries_es: Mientras que sus puntos de impacto actuales son iguales o menos de la mitad de su punto de éxito máximo, usted se ocupa de un daño adicional [[TAG0] frío con sus ataques de melee.

item.name: White Dragon Scale Mail
entries: Dragon scale mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them to humanoids. Other times, hunters carefully skin and preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, dragon scale mail is highly valued. While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC, you have advantage on saving throws against the Frightful Presence and breath weapons of dragons, and you have resistance to cold damage.

Additionally, you can focus your senses as an action to magically discern the distance and direction to the closest white dragon within 30 miles of you. This special action can't be used again until the next dawn.
entries_es: El correo de escala de dragón está hecho de las escalas de un tipo de dragón. A veces los dragones recogen sus escamas desechables y les dan a los humanoides. Otras veces, los cazadores se pellejan cuidadosamente y preservan el escondite de un dragón muerto. En cualquier caso, el correo de escala de dragón es altamente valorado. Al usar esta armadura, usted gana un bono +1 a AC, usted tiene ventaja en el ahorro de tiros contra la Presencia y las armas de aliento de los dragones, y usted tiene resistencia al daño frío.

Además, usted puede enfocar sus sentidos como una acción para discernir mágicamente la distancia y dirección al dragón blanco más cercano dentro de 30 millas de usted. Esta acción especial no se puede utilizar de nuevo hasta el siguiente amanecer.

item.name: White Dragon Scale Mail
entries: {#itemEntry Dragon Scale Mail|XDMG}
entries_es: [[TAG0]

item.name: White Ghost Orchid Seed
entries: More rarely, the orchids produce a smaller pod holding a single white seed. Among its various magical properties, if a white seed is ground and scattered over a dead body, the body is affected by the {@spell resurrection} spell. A white ghost orchid seed has no effect if consumed.
entries_es: Más raramente, las orquídeas producen una cápsula más pequeña que sostiene una sola semilla blanca. Entre sus diversas propiedades mágicas, si una semilla blanca es tierra y dispersa sobre un cuerpo muerto, el cuerpo se ve afectado por el hechizo [[TAG0]. Una semilla de orquídea de fantasma blanco no tiene efecto si se consume.

item.name: Whitestone
entries: The sheer amount of leftover arcane power within the whitestone of the {@book Alabaster Sierra|TDCSR|3|Alabaster Sierras} mountains is incredibly receptive to enchantment. Magic items that incorporate at least an ounce of whitestone into their construction require only one-quarter the creation time of other magic items. Some alchemists in {@book Emon|TDCSR|3|Emon, the City of Fellowship} have discovered that dissolving whitestone with specific acids can leave behind pure {@item residuum|TDCSR}, which can substitute for expensive spell components when such materials are not readily available.
entries_es: La gran cantidad de energía arcana sobrante dentro de la piedra blanca de las montañas [[TAG0] es increíblemente receptivo al encantamiento. Los elementos mágicos que incorporan al menos una onza de piedra blanca en su construcción requieren sólo una cuarta parte del tiempo de creación de otros elementos mágicos. Algunos alquimistas en {@book Emon|TDCSR|3|Emon, the City of Fellowship} han descubierto que disolver la piedra blanca con ácidos específicos puede dejar atrás pura {@item residuum|TDCSR}, que puede sustituir componentes de hechizo caros cuando tales materiales no están disponibles fácilmente.

item.name: Wildroot
entries: Introducing the juice of a wildroot into a {@condition poisoned} creature's bloodstream (for example, by rubbing it on an open wound) rids the creature of the {@condition poisoned} condition. Once used in this way, a wildroot loses this property.
entries_es: Introducir el jugo de una raíz silvestre en un {@condition poisoned} torrente sanguíneo de la criatura (por ejemplo, frotándolo con una herida abierta) libera a la criatura de la condición [[TAG0]. Una vez utilizado de esta manera, un salvaje pierde esta propiedad.

item.name: Wildspace Orrery
entries: Inside a Wildspace system, this portable arcane device automatically tracks the positions and movements of all suns, planets, moons, and comets within that system, projecting a display of all these bodies in the space above its current location. In that display, a white, pulsating pinprick of light marks the orrery's location.
entries_es: Dentro de un sistema Wildspace, este dispositivo arcano portátil rastrea automáticamente las posiciones y movimientos de todos los soles, planetas, lunas y cometas dentro de ese sistema, proyectando una muestra de todos estos cuerpos en el espacio por encima de su ubicación actual. En esa pantalla, un pinprick blanco y pulsante de luz marca la ubicación de la orrería.

items.name: Awakened
entries: When the war pick reaches an awakened state, it gains the following properties:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.
The saving throw DC for the war pick's Breath Weapon property increases to 15, and that property deals {@damage 4d6} damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The saving throw DC for the war pick's Frightful Presence property increases to 15.
While carrying the weapon, you have resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison damage.

entries_es: Cuando la elección de la guerra llega a un estado despierto, gana las siguientes propiedades:

items: The weapon's bonus to attack and damage rolls increases to +2.
The saving throw DC for the war pick's Breath Weapon property increases to 15, and that property deals {@damage 4d6} damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
The saving throw DC for the war pick's Frightful Presence property increases to 15.
While carrying the weapon, you have resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, and poison damage.

item.name: Will of the Talon (Dormant)
entries: Black, blue, green, red, and white gems carved in the form of dragon heads cover this ostentatious gold war pick, marking it as a weapon channeling the power of Tiamat.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Will of the Talon is a sentient lawful evil weapon with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 15, and a Charisma of 19. It has hearing and {@sense darkvision} out to a range of 120 feet.
The weapon communicates telepathically with its wielder and can speak, read, and understand Common, Draconic, and Infernal.
entries_es: La voluntad del Talón es un arma lícita sensible con una Inteligencia de 14, una Sabiduría de 15, y una Charisma de 19. Tiene audición y [[TAG0] a una gama de 120 pies.
El arma se comunica telepáticamente con su wielder y puede hablar, leer y entender Common, Draconic e Infernal.

entries.name: Personality
entries: A short-tempered {@creature bone devil} named Ashtyrlon lives within Will of the Talon. The weapon is greedy and values strong leadership. It demands that its wielder take decisive action to keep order in high-pressure situations—and to always take a fair share of treasure in return.
entries_es: Un corto tiempo {@creature bone devil} llamado Ashtyrlon vive dentro de la Voluntad del Talón. El arma es codicioso y valora un liderazgo fuerte. Exige que su pelante tome medidas decisivas para mantener el orden en situaciones de alta presión, y siempre tomar una parte justa del tesoro a cambio.

entries.name: Dormant
entries: The war pick grants the following benefits in its dormant state:

items: You can speak, read, and write Draconic and Infernal.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

As a bonus action while holding the war pick, you can cause the following effect: each creature of your choice that is within 30 feet of you and is aware of you must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to your Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

While holding the war pick, you can use your action to exhale destructive energy. Pick a damage type from the Will of the Talon Breath Weapons table. Each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a {@dc 13} saving throw, the type of which is specified in the table. A creature takes {@damage 3d6} damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries: When you use the war pick to unleash a breath weapon of a specific damage type, you can't choose that same damage type again until the next dawn.
entries_es: La elección de guerra otorga los siguientes beneficios en su estado inactivo:

items: You can speak, read, and write Draconic and Infernal.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

As a bonus action while holding the war pick, you can cause the following effect: each creature of your choice that is within 30 feet of you and is aware of you must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to your Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

While holding the war pick, you can use your action to exhale destructive energy. Pick a damage type from the Will of the Talon Breath Weapons table. Each creature in the area of the exhalation must make a {@dc 13} saving throw, the type of which is specified in the table. A creature takes {@damage 3d6} damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries_es: Cuando usas el pico de guerra para desatar un arma de aliento de un tipo de daño específico, no puedes elegir ese mismo tipo de daño hasta el siguiente amanecer.

entries.name: Betrayer Artifact Properties
entries: The Arms of the Betrayers advance in power in the same manner as the Vestiges of Divergence. In its dormant state, each of these artifacts has one {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property and one {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property. When the artifact attains an awakened state, it gains an additional {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|dmg|minor beneficial} property and an additional {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental} property. When the item reaches its exalted state, it gains a {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|dmg|major beneficial} property. See "Artifact Properties" in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master's Guide for more information.
entries_es: Los brazos de los Betrayers avanzan en el poder de la misma manera que los Vestigos de la Divergencia. En su estado inactivo, cada uno de estos artefactos tiene una propiedad [[TAG0] y una propiedad {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental}. Cuando el artefacto alcanza un estado despertado, gana una propiedad adicional [[TAG0] y una propiedad adicional {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|dmg|minor detrimental}. Cuando el artículo alcanza su estado exaltado, gana una propiedad [[TAG4]. Ver "Artifact Properties" en el capítulo 7 de la Guía del Maestro Dungeon para obtener más información.
Las gemas negras, azules, verdes, rojas y blancas talladas en forma de cabezas de dragón cubren esta ostentosa selección de oro, marcando como arma canalizando el poder de Tiamat.
